questions.reason_for_classification: 관계대명사 that과 결과 부사절 접속사(so ~ that)의 쓰임을 구별하는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 42. 밑줄 친 (가)와 어법상 쓰임이 같은 것은?
questions.explanation: (가)의 that은 everything을 수식하는 목적격 관계대명사입니다. ①의 that 또한 money를 수식하는 목적격 관계대명사입니다. ②, ③, ④, ⑤는 모두 주격 관계대명사입니다.
options: ① I spent all the money <u>that</u> he gave me.
② This is the house <u>that</u> once belonged to us.
③ Did you see my phone <u>that</u> was on the table?
④ Is this the restaurant <u>that</u> makes amazing hamburgers?
⑤ We decided to throw away the chairs <u>that</u> were broken.

questions.reason_for_classification: 주격 관계대명사와 목적격 관계대명사의 쓰임을 구별하는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 43. 두 문장을 바르게 연결한 것은?
questions.explanation: ② girl을 선행사로 하여 her를 삭제하고 연결한 옳은 문장(목적격 관계대명사 생략)입니다. ① is, ③ the bed which, ④ were, ⑤ who was 혹은 That movie star... Mark, who was... 등으로 고쳐야 합니다.
options:
① Mina is my friend. She lives in France.
→ Mina was my friend who lived in France.

② She is the girl. I met her at the concert.
→ She is the girl I met at the concert.

→ I slept in which wasn't very comfortable.

④ The tickets were on the chair. I couldn't find them.

questions.reason_for_classification: 두 문장을 관계대명사를 활용해 알맞게 연결했는지 평가합니다.

questions.question: 45. (A)와 같은 기능을 하는 'that'을 고르면?

questions.question: 46. 어법상 바르게 쓴 문장의 수는?

questions.question: 47. 다음 <조건>에 맞추어 빈칸을 완성하시오.
questions.explanation: (1) 주격 관계대명사 who를 사용: The man who lives next door is friendly and outgoing. (2) 목적격 관계대명사 which와 so ~ that 구문 사용: The apples which I bought yesterday were so delicious that I had three more.

questions.question: 48. 대화의 밑줄 친 (A)와 같이 that이 목적격 관계대명사 용법으로 사용된 것은?

questions.question: 49. 대화의 밑줄 친 한국어 문장 ⓐ와 뜻이 같도록 <조건>을 반드시 지켜 영작하시오. (<조건>을 지키지 않을 경우 감점, 주어진 문장 변형 가능)

questions.question: 50. 윗글의 Ⓐthat과 쓰임이 같은 것은?

questions.question: 1. 다음 두 문장을 한 문장으로 고쳐 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: 두 문장에서 'the woman'과 'her'가 가리키는 대상이 같으므로, 목적격 관계대명사 whom(또는 that)을 사용하여 한 문장으로 연결할 수 있다. 전치사 with를 관계대명사 앞으로 보낼 수도 있다.
sentences: I met the woman.
You have worked with her for a year.
questions.answer: I met the woman whom(that) you have worked with for a year. (또는 I met the woman with whom you have worked for a year.)

questions.question: 2. 윗글의 ㉮에 맞게 다음 두 문장을 한 문장으로 고쳐 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: 'The little black dress'와 'it'이 공통 대상이다. 사물을 선행사로 하는 목적격 관계대명사 which(또는 that)을 사용하여 수식하는 절을 선행사 바로 뒤에 위치시킨다.
sentences: The little black dress is famous even today.
She wore it in a movie.
questions.answer: The little black dress which(that) she wore in a movie is famous even today.
questions.reason_for_classification: 목적격 관계대명사를 활용하여 주어를 수식하는 구조로 문장을 결합하는 능력을 평가한다.

questions.passage:
My name is Kim Namjoon, also known as RM, the leader of the group BTS. It is an incredible honor to be invited to an occasion with such significance for today’s young generation.
Last November, BTS launched the Love Myself campaign with UNICEF built on our belief ⓐ<u>that</u> true love first begins with loving myself. We’ve been partnering with UNICEF’s End Violence program to protect children and young people all over the world from violence. And our fans ⓑ<u>that</u> have become a major part of this campaign with their action and with their enthusiasm. We truly have the best fans in the world.
I’d like to begin by talking about myself.
I was born in Ilsan, a city near Seoul, South Korea. It is a really beautiful place with a lake, hills, and even an (c) annual flower festival. I spent a very happy childhood there, and I was just an ordinary boy. I used to look up at the night sky and wonder, and I used to dream the dreams of a boy. I used to imagine that I was a super hero ⓒ<u>that</u> could save the world.
In an intro to one of our early albums, there’s a line ⓓ<u>that</u> says, ‘My heart stopped when I was maybe nine or ten.’ Looking back, I think that’s when I began to worry about what other people thought of me, and started seeing myself through their eyes. I stopped looking up at the night skies, the stars. I stopped daydreaming. Instead, I just tried to jam myself into the molds ⓔ<u>that</u> other people made. Soon, I began to shut out my own voice, and started to listen to the voices of others. No one called out my name, and neither did I. My heart stopped, and my eyes closed shut. So, like this, I, we, all lost our names. We became like ghosts.
questions.question: 3. ⓐ~ⓔ에서 어법상 that의 쓰임이 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ의 that은 앞의 명사 belief와 뒤의 완전한 문장을 연결하는 동격의 접속사이다. ⓑ, ⓒ, ⓓ, ⓔ는 모두 선행사를 수식하는 관계대명사로 쓰였다.
questions.reason_for_classification: 관계대명사 that과 동격의 접속사 that의 쓰임을 구별하는 심화 문법 문항이다.

questions.question: 4. 관계대명사를 사용하여 두 문장을 한 문장으로 변환한 것 중 잘못된 것은?
questions.explanation: ②번 문장에서 관계대명사 that 뒤에는 주어 You와 동사 borrowed가 와야 한다. 'that borrowed'만 쓰면 주어가 빠진 주격 관계대명사처럼 보이지만, 'the pen'이 빌리는 행위의 주체가 될 수 없으므로 어색하다. 목적격 관계대명사 절에서는 원래 목적어 자리가 비어 있어야 하므로 'that you borrowed'가 되어야 한다.
options:
① I like a girl. I met her a week ago.
→ I like a girl whom I met a week ago.

② Return the pen. You borrowed the pen in the classroom.
→ Return the pen that borrowed in the classroom.

③ She loves dramas. The dramas have sad endings.
→ She loves dramas that have sad endings.

④ He saw a girl. She was talking with her friend.
→ He saw a girl who was talking with her friend.

⑤ I found the book. I lost the book two days ago.
→ I found the book that I lost two days ago.
questions.reason_for_classification: 목적격 관계대명사 절의 올바른 구조(관계사+주어+동사)를 파악하고 있는지 묻는 문제이다.

questions.question: 5. This difference comes from the different ideas that the two painters had.의 that과 쓰임이 같은 것은?

questions.reason_for_classification: 관계대명사 that과 접속사, 지시사 등 다른 용법의 that을 구별하는 문제이다.

questions.question: 6. <보기>에서 어법상 맞는 것의 개수는?
questions.explanation:
첫 번째(목적격 생략 가능) 문장만 맞다. 
- Tony loved the cookies whose(X) -> which/that(O) mother made... (소유격 부적절)
- The children shouted(X) -> shouting(O) in the street... (분사가 수식하거나 관계대명사가 필요)
- whom cheated(X) -> who cheated(O) (주격 자리이므로 who가 적절)
- took them(X) -> took(O) (관계대명사절 안에 중복 목적어 them 불가)

- Tony loved the cookies whose mother made for him.
- The children shouted in the street are not from our school.
- The teacher punished the students whom cheated on the test.
- Let's look at the photographs we took them during the summer vacation.
questions.reason_for_classification: 관계대명사의 격, 중복 목적어 사용, 분사와의 구별 등 다양한 관계사 관련 어법 오류를 종합적으로 판단해야 하는 문제이다.

questions.question: 7. 다음 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 조건에 맞게 빈칸에 알맞은 영어를 각각 한 단어씩 쓰시오.

questions.question: 9. 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 같은 것은?

questions.reason_for_classification: 다양한 용법의 that 중에서 목적격 관계대명사로 쓰인 것을 찾아내는 문항이다.

questions.passage:
My Tech-Free Trip Story
Last summer, my father suggested a surprising event: a family trip without smartphones! He said, “I hate to see you sitting together and only looking at your smartphones.” My sister and I explained the need for smartphones, but he kept saying that we could not fully enjoy the trip with them. So we started a technology-free trip to a new city, Barcelona, Spain.
Our list day was terrible. On the way to our guesthouse around Plaza Reial, we got lost in downtown Barcelona. Dad was busy looking at the map and asking for directions with a few Spanish words (A)___________ he got from a tour guidebook. Even though our guesthouse was right next to the Plaza, it took us about two hours to get there. We were so tired that we could not go out for dinner. I went to bed but couldn’t fall asleep because I was worried about what would happen the next day.
questions.question: 10. 글의 (A)에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
questions.explanation: (A) 앞의 'a few Spanish words'가 사물 선행사이고, 뒤의 he got의 목적어가 비어 있으므로 목적격 관계대명사 which가 가장 적절하다.
questions.reason_for_classification: 선행사의 종류와 관계대명사절 내의 역할을 파악하여 적절한 목적격 관계대명사를 선택하는 문제이다.

questions.question: 11. 다음 중 옳지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: ①번에서 전치사 뒤에는 관계대명사 that을 쓸 수 없다. 'with whom'으로 고쳐야 한다.
options: ① James is looking for volunteers with that he will clean up the street.
② Robert is afraid of talking with people whom he doesn't know.
③ Sophie is the student who Erin met at the department store.
④ The coffee I had in the morning tasted salty.
⑤ The city that I was born in is Cheonan.
questions.reason_for_classification: 전치사+관계대명사 구조에서 that을 사용할 수 없다는 문법적 제약 사항을 묻는 문제이다.

questions.question: 12. 밑줄 친 that을 생략할 수 없는 문장은?
questions.explanation: ①의 that은 '그렇게'라는 의미의 지시부사로, 문장에서 생략하면 의미가 통하지 않으므로 생략할 수 없다. 나머지는 목적격 관계대명사(③,④,⑤)이거나 타동사의 목적어절을 이끄는 접속사(②)로 생략이 가능하다.
options: ① The exam was not <u>that</u> difficult.
② He believes <u>that</u> the Earth is round.
③ The book <u>that</u> he wrote is interesting.
④ Did you eat the pizza <u>that</u> my father made?
⑤ The country <u>that</u> I visited last year was France.
questions.reason_for_classification: 관계대명사 및 접속사의 생략 가능 여부와 지시사와의 구별을 묻는 문항이다.

questions.passage:
Matisse and Chagall both deal with the same subject in their paintings, but they are different.
First, in Matisse's painting, Icarus is flying, but in Chagall's painting, the boy is falling. This difference (①) comes from the different ideas (②) the two painters (③) had. Matisse thought (④) Icarus (⑤) was brave and adventurous. In contrast, Chagall thought Icarus was foolish.
Second, Matisse's painting is very simple, but Chagall's painting has many details. In Matisse's painting, there are only Icarus and some stars.
Furthermore, Icarus' body has just a simple outline. In contrast, Chagall painted many people and houses in addition to Icarus. This difference comes from the different painting styles of the two painters.
questions.question: 13. 윗글의 ①~⑤ 중 관계대명사가 생략된 곳은?

questions.reason_for_classification: 지문 내에서 목적격 관계대명사가 생략된 위치를 찾는 문제이다.

questions.question: 14. 다음 주어진 우리말을 영어로 옮긴 것 중, 어법상 옳은 것만을 <보기>에서 있는 대로 고른 것은?
questions.explanation:
ⓑ(최상급 선행사 + that), ⓒ(목적격 생략 가능), ⓕ(who는 whom 대신 주격형태로 쓰인 목적격)가 어법상 옳다.
- ⓐ write -> writes (단수 주어 The pen)
- ⓓ made the city to a(X) -> into a(O) 또는 simply a
- ⓔ left it in(X) -> left in (중복 목적어 it 제거)
- ⓖ were -> was (주어가 One)
sentences: <보기>
ⓐ내가 샀던 그 펜은 매우 부드럽게 써진다.
The pen I bought write very smoothly.
ⓑ그녀는 내가 가르쳤던 가장 똑똑한 학생이다.
She is the smartest student that I have ever taught.
ⓒ내 친구가 어제 샀던 책은 매우 흥미로웠다.
The book my friend bought yesterday was very interesting.
ⓓ그 축제는 그 도시를 인기 있는 장소로 만들었다.
The festival made the city to a popular place.
ⓔ내가 그 방안에 두었던 그 잡지를 나에게 가져다줘.
Bring me the magazine I have left it in the room.
ⓕ내가 만나기를 원했던 그 소녀는 더 이상 그 건물에 없었다.
The girl who I wanted to meet was no longer at the building.
ⓖ그녀가 최근에 보았던 영화들 중 하나가 ‘아바타’였다.
One of the movies that she watched recently were Avatar.
questions.reason_for_classification: 관계대명사와 수 일치, 5형식 구문 등 복합적인 문법 지식을 요구하는 문항이다.

questions.question: 15. 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 생략할 수 있는 것만을 <보기>에서 있는 대로 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ 주격 관계대명사+be동사, ⓑ 목적어절 접속사, ⓒ 목적격 관계대명사, ⓓ 목적어절 접속사, ⓕ 목적어절 접속사는 생략 가능하다. ⓔ와 ⓖ는 주격 관계대명사 단독이므로 생략 불가하다.
sentences: <보기>
ⓐ The boy <u>who is</u> sitting on the bench is my brother.
ⓑ You mean <u>that</u> I need to replace the batteries in this camera?
ⓒ Bring me the magazines <u>which</u> I left in the room.
ⓓ People believed <u>that</u> dragons controlled the rain, rivers, lakes, and seas.
ⓔ I need to do the things <u>that</u> make me happy like spending time with my friends.
ⓕ I think <u>that</u> Internet addiction can cause pains in our bodies like the eyes and hands.
ⓖ Traffic light is a set of colored lights at the side of the road <u>that</u> shows when cars are allowed to move.
questions.reason_for_classification: 관계대명사(목적격, 주격+be동사)와 명사절 접속사의 생략 조건을 비교하는 심화 문항이다.

questions.question: 16. 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분을 생략할 수 있는 것은?
questions.explanation: 관계대명사를 생략할 수 있는 경우는 '목적격 관계대명사' 또는 '주격 관계대명사 + be동사'일 때이다. 하지만 보기 문장들에 밑줄이 표시되어 있지 않으므로 구조상 목적격인 경우를 찾아야 한다. ③번에서 'in which'의 which가 생략되려면 전치사 in이 문장 끝으로 가야 하며, 일반적으로 목적격 관계대명사는 단독 생략 가능하다. 만약 ①, ②, ④가 주격이라면 생략 불가하다. 문제 구성상 ③번이나 기타 목적격 구조를 묻는 의도이나 밑줄이 누락된 상태이다. 일반적인 문법 유형으로는 목적격을 찾는 문제이다. (지문의 구조를 고려할 때 목적격 관계대명사를 답으로 유도함)
options: ① Lily and Ivy are the girls who live in London.
② The piggy bank which was on my desk was broken.
③ This is the house in which their parents used to live.
④ Last month I met a boy who can speak 3 languages.
⑤ This is the cafeteria about which Hojin wrote a novel.
questions.reason_for_classification: 목적격 관계대명사의 생략 가능성을 묻는 문항이나, 전치사와의 결합 등 제약 사항이 포함되어 있다.

questions.question: 17. ⓐ～ⓖ중 어법상 옳은 것을 있는 대로 고른 것은?
questions.explanation:
ⓑ (목적격 생략), ⓒ (전치사 in이 뒤에 위치), ⓔ (주격 관계대명사), ⓖ (현재분사구 수식)가 옳다.
- ⓐ her 제거 (관계대명사절 중복 목적어)
- ⓓ who -> whose (소유격 필요)
- ⓕ that -> whom (전치사 뒤 that 사용 불가)
sentences: ⓐ This is my aunt I told you about her.
ⓑ Andy bought the same bike I wanted.
ⓒ This is the house that he was born in.
ⓓ There lived a girl who name was Gratel.
ⓔ The police caught the man who stole my money.
ⓕ Let me introduce my friend with that I traveled.
ⓖ The kid standing in front of the building is waiting for the famous singer.
questions.reason_for_classification: 관계대명사의 격, 전치사의 위치, 생략 가능성 등 관계대명사 전반을 아우르는 종합 어법 문제이다.

questions.question: 18. 밑줄 친 부분 중 생략할 수 없는 것은?
questions.explanation: ①, ②, ④, ⑤는 모두 목적격 관계대명사이므로 생략이 가능하다. ③은 주격 관계대명사이므로 생략할 수 없다.
options: ① The boy <u>who</u> I wanted to meet was Andy.
② I liked the music <u>which</u> Mom often listened to.
③ The bicycle <u>which</u> had pedals was invented in 19th century.
④ Who was the man <u>that</u> I met in the party last night?
⑤ She was eating cookies <u>that</u> her dad baked for her.
questions.reason_for_classification: 주격 관계대명사와 목적격 관계대명사를 구별하고 생략 여부를 판단하는 기초 문항이다.

questions.question: 19. 다음의 보기와 같이 관계대명사를 생략할 수 없는 것은?
questions.explanation: 보기의 that은 목적격 관계대명사로 생략 가능하다. ①, ②, ③, ④ 모두 목적격이지만, ⑤는 saw의 주어 역할을 하는 주격 관계대명사(who)이므로 생략할 수 없다.
options: ① She is wearing the hairpin <u>that</u> he bought her.
② She ate cookies <u>that</u> her mom baked for her.
③ He is reading a letter <u>that</u> he wrote to her.
④ He is the pop singer <u>whom</u> she likes best.
⑤ She was the person who saw it first.
sentences: 보기
It is something (that) you remembeer.
questions.reason_for_classification: 주격 관계대명사의 생략 불가 원칙을 묻는 전형적인 유형이다.

questions.question: 20. 의미와 어법을 고려했을 때 자연스러운 문장을 고르면?
questions.explanation:
⑤번 'The bag whose color is red'는 소유격 관계대명사 whose를 사용한 자연스러운 문장이다.
- ① that -> whose (소유격 필요)
- ② whom -> who (주격 필요)
- ③ monkeys teaching (who are teaching 등의 관계사 필요)
- ④ her 제거 (목적어 중복)
options: ① She saw a boy that hair was blue.
② I remember my grandmother whom was kind to me.
③ If you are lucky, you may see female monkeys are teaching flossing to their babies.
④ Jane is the girl who Peter met her in the park.
⑤ The bag whose color is red belongs to Georgina.
questions.reason_for_classification: 소유격 관계대명사와 기타 관계사의 격 및 절의 구조적 완결성을 묻는 문제이다.

questions.question: 21. 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
questions.explanation:
- What is important is your safety. (옳음 - 관계대명사 what)
- I don’t like that(X) -> what(O) he gave me... (선행사가 없으므로 what 필요)
- the last train what(X) -> that(O) (선행사 the last가 있으면 that 권장)
- which(X) -> what(O) (선행사 없음)
- which is... (옳음 - 주격 관계사)
옳은 문장은 2개이다.
sentences: ∘What is important is your safety.
∘I don’t like that he gave me as a present.
∘Is this the last train what leaves for Busan?
∘Don’t postpone until tomorrow which can be done today.
∘Most Koreans eat Songpyon which is half-moon shaped and stuffed with sesame seeds and sugar.
questions.reason_for_classification: 선행사 포함 여부에 따른 what과 which/that의 구별 및 관계대명사의 기본 쓰임을 묻는 복합 문항이다.

questions.question: 22. 밑줄 친 ① ~ ⑤ 중 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: ②번에서 콤마(,) 뒤에 'it was built'를 그대로 쓰면 문장이 연결되지 않는다. 선행사인 Starliner를 보충 설명하는 관계대명사의 계속적 용법을 사용하여 'which was built'로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.question: 23. 윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 어법상 옳은 것의 개수는?
questions.explanation:
- ⓐ what -> who/that (선행사가 있으므로 what 불가)

questions.question: 24. 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
questions.explanation:
- which hasn't arrived yet (계속적 용법 - 옳음)
- Rachel, who we met yesterday (계속적 용법 - 옳음)
틀린 문장:
- Our new car, (which) we bought (계속적 용법이므로 관계사 생략 불가)
- Mother Teresa, whom helped(X) -> who helped (주격 필요)
- leg, that(X) -> which (계속적 용법에서 that 불가)
- film, who(X) -> which (사물 선행사)
- Games, what(X) -> which (계속적 용법에서 what 불가)
옳은 문장은 2개이다.
sentences: <보기>
- Our new car, we bought last month, seats five people.
- I ordered a box of chocolates, which hasn't arrived yet.
- We saw a TV program about Mother Teresa, whom helped many people in the world.
- He kept shaking his leg, that was annoying.
- Rachel, who we met yesterday, lives in this house.
- We saw the latest Harry Potter film, who we enjoyed.
- The Olympic Games, what take place every four years, were first held in 1896.

questions.question: 25. 윗 글의 밑줄 친 (A)~(E)중, 어법상 옳은 문장은?
questions.explanation:

questions.question: 26. 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은 모두 몇 개인가?
questions.explanation:
- My father, who is a scientist... (옳음 - 계속적 용법)

questions.question: 27. 다음에 공통으로 들어갈 단어는?

questions.question: 28. 다음 <보기>의 빈칸에 들어갈 단어와 같은 말이 들어갈 수 있는 곳은?
questions.explanation: 보기에 들어갈 말은 전치사 in의 목적어 역할을 하는 관계대명사 which이다. ①번 'bag for which I have been looking'에서 looking for의 for가 앞으로 온 형태이므로 which가 들어갈 수 있다. ②는 선행사가 사람이므로 whom, ③은 결과 부사절 so ~ that, ④는 명사절 접속사 that, ⑤는 주격 관계대명사 who가 적절하다.
options: ① This is the bag for __________ I have been looking.
② The woman is sitting with her brother __________ we will soon work with.
③ The wall of the house was so high __________ the boys could not climb it.
④ I will tell my parents __________ my sister has already found a house to live in.
⑤ The person __________ won the race will receive a very expensive car as a prize.
sentences: <보기>
Pablo Picasso is an artist in __________ many people have been interested.
questions.reason_for_classification: 전치사 뒤에 오는 관계대명사의 격과 형태를 구별하는 심화 문법 문항이다.

questions.question: 29. 다음 글에서 어법상 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: 모든 보기가 어법상 틀린 부분을 포함하고 있어 정답을 고르기 어려우나, 출제 의도상 관계대명사의 목적어 중복(ⓐ의 them), 형용사/부사 병렬(ⓑ의 carelessly), 상관관계(ⓒ의 so...that), 전치사 오용(ⓓ의 to which) 등을 묻고 있다. ⓔ에서 bullying...and telling(병렬) 및 are(복수) 등 수정이 필요하다. 질문이 '가장 적절한 것'을 묻고 있으므로 원문에 오류가 있을 수 있으나, 문맥상 ⓔ의 bullying 구문의 주어 구조가 가장 논리적이나 문법적으로는 tell을 telling으로 고쳐야 한다. 만약 ⓓ가 correct라면 'give instructions to you'에서 유래한 것이나, 보통 give you instructions이므로 ⓓ도 부적절하다. 이 지문은 오류를 찾는 능력을 평가하며, 보기 중 하나가 정답으로 제시되어야 한다. (지문 분석 결과 ⓓ의 to which가 선행사 instructions를 수식하며 give A to B 구조에서 왔다고 가정하면 가능할 수 있음)

questions.question: 35. 글의 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 동사의 형태가 알맞은 것은?

questions.question: 36. 다음 <보기>의 문장을 우리말로 옳게 번역한 것은?
questions.explanation: 'Either A or B'는 'A와 B 둘 중 하나'라는 의미이므로 ④번이 정답이다.
options: ① 너와 다니엘은 둘 다 책이 있다.
② 너와 다니엘을 둘 다 책이 없다.
③ 너는 책이 없고 다니엘은 책이 있다.
④ 너와 다니엘 중에 한 명은 책이 있다.
⑤ 다니엘이 책이 없어서 네가 같이 봐야 한다.
sentences: <보기>
Either you or Daniel has the book.

questions.question: 37. 다음 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
questions.explanation:
③ 'Neither A nor B' 구문에서 동사는 B(the students)에 수 일치하므로 복수형 were가 옳다.
- ① have -> has (Each는 단수 취급)
- ② ends -> end (each 뒤 단수 명사)
- ④ either A or B (and를 or로)
- ⑤ entertain -> entertaining (형용사 보어 필요)
options: ① Each of us have a duty.
② Put glue on each ends of the stick.
③ Neither the teacher nor the students were in the classroom.
④ The students should bring either a raincoat and an umbrella.
⑤ The adventure movie is not only educational but also entertain.
questions.reason_for_classification: 상관접속사의 수 일치 및 each의 단수 취급 원칙을 묻는 문제이다.

questions.question: 38. 다음 표의 내용을 설명할 때 어법상 옳은 것은?
questions.explanation:
④ Eric은 표에서 English와 math를 둘 다 잘한다고 되어 있으므로 'Eric is good at both English and math'는 어법과 내용 모두 옳다.
- ① Both A and B 구문 사용 (or -> and)
- ② lives -> live (Both는 복수 취급)
- ③ or -> and
- ⑤ wants -> want (Both는 복수 취급)
options: ① Both Eric or Jane live in Seoul.
② Both Eric and Jane lives in Seoul.
③ Both Tom or Jane is good at math.
④ Eric is good at both English and math.
⑤ Both Tom and Jane wants to be a CEO.

I live in ...	Seoul	Busan	Seoul
I want to be ...	an English teacher	a CEO	a CEO
I'm good at ...	English, math	math	math
questions.reason_for_classification: 표의 데이터를 해석하여 상관접속사 both A and B의 올바른 어법으로 표현하는 능력을 평가한다.

questions.question: 40. 다음 Minji와 Sujin이 선호하는 것을 나타낸 문장 중 어법상 맞는 것을 두 개 고르면?

questions.question: 41. 다음 중 의미상, 어법상 어색한 문장을 두 개 고르면?

③ 'Neither A nor B'에서 동사는 B(Tom)에 일치시켜야 하므로 are를 is로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.question: 42. 다음 중 어법상 맞는 문장은?

I will send the report her tomorrow.
ⓑ 우리는 영화 한 편을 보거나 혹은 그 박물관에 갈 수 있다.

ⓕ 우리 할아버지는 우리에게 재미있는 이야기를 들려주셨다.

questions.reason_for_classification: 상관접속사의 수 일치 및 병렬 구조 등 세밀한 어법 지식을 요구한다.

questions.question: 45. 다음 문장의 빈칸에 들어갈 말은?
questions.explanation: '어느 쪽도 ~ 아니다'라는 전체 부정의 의미를 나타내는 Neither가 빈칸에 가장 적절하다.

questions.question: 46. <조건>에 맞게 주어진 우리말과 뜻이 같도록 문장을 영작하시오.
questions.explanation: (1) both A and B를 사용하여 'Andy likes both baseball and soccer.' (2) neither A nor B를 사용하여 'Neither we nor she wants to go to the library.' (3) either A or B를 사용하여 'You should bring either a raincoat or an umbrella.'

(3) 너는 비옷이나 우산을 가지고 가야 해. (either)
questions.answer: (1) Andy likes both baseball and soccer. (2) Neither we nor she wants to go to the library. (3) You should bring either a raincoat or an umbrella.

questions.question: 50. 어법상 올바른 문장만을 <보기>에서 있는 대로 고른 것은?

나. kindly -> kind (형용사 보어 병렬)

라. Both는 복수 취급이므로 likes -> like.
마. Neither A nor B에서 동사는 B(his children)에 일치시키므로 were가 적절.
결과적으로 보기에 제시된 모든 문장이 틀렸거나, 질문과 보기가 정합되지 않을 수 있으나 문법 원칙에 따라 판단한다. (옳은 것을 고르라는 지시 하에 가장 적절한 선택지를 고름)

마. Neither Tom nor his children was late for the party.

questions.passage:
An Interview with Dr. Park Byeong-seon
On May 27, 2011, 297 books of Uigwe, a collection of royal books the French army took in 1866, came back to Korea. The person behind this return is Dr. Park Byeong-seon, a historian who spent her whole life searching for Korean national treasures abroad.
Q: (가) <u>:의궤“에 어떻게 관심을 갖게 되셨는지 말씀해주시겠어요?</u>
Dr. Park: I studied history in college. I went to France to continue my studies in 1955. As you know, the French army took many of our national treasures in 1866. I wanted to find them while I was studying there. Uigwe was one of them.
Q: You found 297 books of Uigwe in the National Library of France, in Paris. Please tell me how you found them.
Dr. Park: As soon as I became a researcher at the National Library in 1967, I began to look for Uigwe. After 10 years, in 1977, I finally found the books. I think (a) <u>that</u> I looked at more than 30 million books.
Q: I’m sure (b) <u>that</u> you were very excited when you found the books.
Dr. Park: Yes, I was, but more difficulties were waiting for me. I thought (c) <u>that</u> the books should be returned to Korea, but my bosses at the library didn’t like (d) <u>that</u> idea. They even thought (e) <u>that</u> I was a Korean spy and fired me. After that, I had to go to the library as a visitor, so it was not easy to do research on Uigwe. However, I didn’t give up. For more than ten years, I went to the library every day to finish my research. I wanted to show people the value of Uigwe.

questions.question: 3. 다음은 JS여중의 2학년 스터디 모임에서 나온 내용 (a)-(e)에 대한 학생들의 개인적인 의견들을 모은 것이다. 올바르지 않은 내용을 제시한 학생들끼리 바르게 짝지어진 것은?

sentences: (a) Susan dances very well.

*정국: (a)는 ‘Susan is good at dancing.’으로 바꿀 수 있지.

④ 바깥 세상에 외계인들이 있는지 아닌지 확실하지 않다.
⑤ 체스 게임에서 나의 아빠를 이기는 것은 어렵다.
questions.reason_for_classification: 가주어-진주어(whether절/that절) 구문의 어순과 구성 요소의 문법적 적절성을 묻는 복합 문제임.

questions.question: 11. 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
questions.explanation: 옳은 문장: Do you know who broke the window? / I want to know what his phone number is. / Who do you think will be the class president? / Could you tell me if there is free parking? / I want to know what time he can pick me up. 총 5개임.
sentences: · Do you know who the window broke?
· I wonder when starts the concert.
· I want to know what his phone number is.
· I don’t understand why did she go home so early.
· I don’t know which book should read.
· Do you believe which team it will win?
· Who do you think will be the class president?
· Could you tell me if there is free parking?
· I want to know what time he can pick me up.
questions.reason_for_classification: 간접의문문의 다양한 어순(의문사+주어+동사), 의문사가 주어인 경우, 생각/추측 동사(think)의 의문사 도치 등을 묻는 종합 문제임.

questions.question: 12. 문장의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: 조건의 부사절 If절 내에서는 미래 시제 대신 현재 시제를 써야 하므로 will rain을 rains로 고쳐야 함.
sentences: If ⓐ<u>it</u> ⓑ<u>will rain</u> tomorrow, I ⓒ<u>will stay</u> home and ⓓ<u>relax</u> ⓔ<u>all</u> day long.
questions.reason_for_classification: 조건의 부사절 내에서 미래 시제 사용 불가 원칙을 묻는 가장 기본적인 문제임.

questions.question: 13. 다음 우리말에 대한 영어표현이 되도록 빈칸에 주어진 단어들을 바르게 배열해 쓰시오. (단, 필요시 형태를 변형할 것)
questions.explanation: '만약 ~한다면'의 조건절 If you pass the exam과 주절 I will be very happy를 연결하여 문장을 완성함.
sentences: 네가 시험에 합격한다면 나는 매우 기쁠 것이다.
will / the exam / I / pass / be / you / if / very happy
questions.answer: If you pass the exam, I will be very happy.
questions.reason_for_classification: 조건의 부사절을 이용한 영작 능력을 평가함.

questions.question: 14. 다음 밑줄 친 if와 쓰임이 같은 것은?
questions.explanation: 제시된 문장의 if는 '만약 ~하면'의 조건 부사절이며, 1번 역시 동일한 조건 부사절임. 2, 3, 4, 5번은 모두 '~인지 아닌지'의 명사절임.
options: ① I will forgive him if he apologizes.
② I wonder if Justin is at home now.
③ I asked Michael if he knew Korean.
④ I don't know if she likes my painting.
⑤ I couldn't tell if she was laughing or crying.
sentences: <u>If</u> you see Mark, tell him to call me.
questions.reason_for_classification: 접속사 if의 조건 부사절 용법과 명사절 용법을 구별하는 능력을 평가함.

questions.question: 15. 어법상 옳은 것은?
questions.explanation: 4번 문장은 조건절에 현재 시제 arrive, 주절에 미래 시제 will be able to를 사용하여 완벽한 어법을 갖춤. 1번은 'next Saturday'이므로 미래 의미이지만 rain을 현재형으로 쓴 것이 옳으므로 1번과 4번 모두 가능성이 높으나 전형적인 if/will 구조인 4번이 확실함.
options: ① Unless it rains next Saturday, let's go to the new aquarium.
② Even after I take the medicine, I still feel sick and I don't know if it effective.
③ If you have any questions about my report, please send an email to me immediately. sending
④ If we arrive on time for the meeting, we'll be able to hear all the important points.
⑤ If you’ll be too tired after the sports day tomorrow you should relax and get enough sleep.
questions.reason_for_classification: 조건의 부사절 내 시제 일치(현재가 미래 대용)를 정확히 적용한 문장을 고르는 문제임.

questions.passage:
Rada lives with her family on a spaceship far from Earth. Rada’s father and other people work on spaceships. Only Rada and Jonny are children, and they were both born in space. One day, their dad tells her and her brother Jonny that they are going to visit Earth. Rada and Jonny look at Dad in surprise and float toward him. They are excited and curious about Earth, so Rada asks Dad (a) what it is like on Earth.
Dad answers that everything is different there. He says that the sky is blue unlike the black sky in space, there are hills covered with green grass, and they won't need their big heavy spacesuits because there is air to breathe. After hearing Dad's answer, Rada wonders (b) if Dad has ever rolled down a hill. She asks him, and Dad says he has, and it is really amazing.
Suddenly, Jonny feels thirsty, so he opens a milk container and shakes it. The milk floats in the air and forms little balls. Jonny swallows the floating balls. Mom advises him that (c) if he will drink milk that way on Earth, he will get wet. Later that night, Rada and Jonny talk for a long time about Earth. Ⓐ It is exciting to think about all the new things they are going to see and do. There is one new thing Rada and Jonny really want to do. They think about Ⓑ it all night and don't tell Mom or Dad. Ⓒ It is their secret.
The next day, Rada’s family gets on a spaceship. Mom says it is going to be a long trip, but Rada and Jonny are so excited that they don't mind. The spaceship finally lands. As soon as they arrive on Earth, Rada and Jonny discover new experiences: Ⓓ It is hard to walk. Dad explains that the reason walking is hard is because of Earth's gravity. He says that (d) because Earth is pulling them down, they can’t float anymore.
Then, there is a strange sound. (A) 라다는 그녀의 엄마에게 그 소리가 무엇인지 설명해 줄 수 있는지 물어본다. She says that sound is birds’ singing. (e) Rada has never heard a bird sing, so Ⓔ it sounds wonderful to her. Jonny feels the wind blow for the first time! These are all new experiences. Rada and Jonny run up the nearest hill. At the top, they look at each other and laugh. Then they lie down on the soft green grass and roll down the hill. That is their secret! They shout, “This is the best new thing of all!” Then they run up to the top of the hill again.
questions.question: 16. 윗글의 (a)~(e) 중 어법상 올바르지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: (c)는 '만약 ~한다면'의 조건 부사절이므로 미래 시제 will drink 대신 현재 시제 drinks를 써야 함.
questions.reason_for_classification: 조건 부사절 내에서 미래 시제(will)를 사용할 수 없는 규칙을 지문 맥락에서 확인하는 문제임.

questions.passage:
Sawbona! My name is Ayanda and I'm a Zulu. We are a tribe in South Africa. What do you think of my beads?
Zulu people enjoy making clothes with beads. They are beautiful and each color has a special meaning.
When we did not have our own writing system, we used beads to communicate with each other. Check out the following box 만약 네가 그 색깔들의 의미를 알고 싶다면.
Color	Good Meaning	Bad Meaning
Black	marriage	death
Yellow	wealth	badness
Red	love	anger
White	love	ㅡ <The meanings from 4 colors of the beads>
questions.question: 17. 글의 밑줄 친 우리말 뜻에 맞도록 <보기>의 단어 중 알맞은 단어를 골라 영작하시오. (<보기>의 단어 변형불가, 각 괄호에 하나의 단어만 넣을 것)
questions.explanation: '만약 ~하고 싶다면'의 의미이므로 if(만약) + you(네가) + want(원하다) + to know(알기를) 순서로 구성됨.
sentences: 만약 네가 그 색깔들의 의미를 알고 싶다면.
<보기>
if / is / going / knew / know / to / you / want / wanted / wants / will
Check out the following box __________ __________ __________ __________ __________ the meaning of the colors.
questions.answer: if you want to know
questions.reason_for_classification: 조건의 부사절 if와 to부정사의 명사적 용법(목적어)을 결합한 영작 능력 평가임.

questions.question: 18. 다음 중 어법상 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: 5번은 간접의문문으로, '의문사 + 주어 + 동사' 어순이 되어야 하므로 if does he have가 아니라 if he has가 옳은 표현임.
options: ① He asked me if I had any money.
② I want to know who broke the vase.
③ I’m not sure if she will like my present.
④ I want to know how you spent your vacation.
⑤ I don’t know if does he have a brother or a sister.
questions.reason_for_classification: 의문사가 없는 간접의문문(if/whether)에서 평서문 어순을 유지해야 하는 규칙을 묻는 문제임.

questions.passage: Have you ever heard of 3D modelers? Taeho, a 3D modeler, ⓐ________ a company that makes artificial hands and legs. Taeho uses special software to print out new hands and legs. They are made specially for patients. ⓑ___________ computer programming and art, you can be a 3D modeler. Taeho ㉮더 많은 사람들이 3D 프린트로 출력된 제품들을 사용하기를 원한다 in the future.
questions.question: 19. 윗글 ⓐ，ⓑ에 들어갈 표현이 알맞게 짝지어진 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ는 '회사를 위해 일하다'는 의미의 works for가 적절하며, ⓑ는 '만약 ~에 능숙하다면'의 의미인 If you are good at이 문맥상 적절함.
options: ① works for		If you are good at
② works on		If you will be good at
③ works in		If you were good at
④ works out	If you will be able to do
⑤ works with	If you getting better at

questions.passage:
Jihye is a big data specialist. She works on many projects. For example, last year, she made bus routes. To find the best right routes, she needed to ⓐ_____ smartphone use data and taxi use patterns from late-night travelers. Then she ⓑ_____ this information to create the most useful routes. Now Jihye is working with an online shopping mall. She is collecting data from customers to find out the best styles for them. ㉮If she can not get enough data, she won’t be able to work on the project successfully. She knows big data ⓒ_____ us to learn more about our daily lives. If you want to become a big data specialist, you should ⓓ_____ your math and problem-solving skills!
Think about yourself and prepare for your future. If you ⓔ_____ looking ahead and dreaming big, your future will be bright.
questions.question: 20. 윗글 ㉮와 같은 뜻이 되도록 바꿔쓸 때 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: If ~ not은 unless (~하지 않으면)로 바꿔 쓸 수 있음. unless가 이미 부정의 의미를 포함하므로 동사는 긍정형(gets)으로 써야 함.
sentences: (단, if가 아닌 다른 접속사를 사용할 것)
questions.answer: Unless she gets
questions.reason_for_classification: 접속사 if ~ not을 unless로 전환하는 문법적 변환 능력을 평가함.

questions.question: 21. 다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: 조건의 부사절 if절 내에서는 미래 시제 will을 쓸 수 없으므로 2번의 will run은 run으로 고쳐야 함.
options: ① If you don’t sleep enough, you will be very tired.
② If you will run faster, you won’t miss the bus.
③ You should tell me the right answer if I’m wrong.
④ Start the meeting without me if I’m late tomorrow.
⑤ If I don’t come out at six tomorrow, please wake me up.
questions.reason_for_classification: 조건의 부사절 내 미래 시제 사용 금지 원칙을 묻는 문제임.

questions.question: 22. ⓐ～ⓔ 중 어법상 옳은 것을 있는 대로 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: 옳은 문장: ⓐ (if 명사절), ⓓ (whether 명사절), ⓕ (Whether 명사절 주어). ⓑ, ⓔ, ⓖ는 간접의문문의 어순이 틀렸고, ⓒ는 문맥상 시제가 어색할 수 있음.
sentences: ⓐ I wonder if he has the key.
ⓑ Do you know when is her birthday?
ⓒ He told us how he becomes a singer.
ⓓ I don’t know whether or not he will come.
ⓔ I am not sure when does the movie start.
ⓕ Whether you’ll forgive her is another issue.
ⓖ I’ll tell you where has he been since last Monday.
questions.reason_for_classification: 명사절 접속사 if/whether와 간접의문문의 어순 및 용법을 종합적으로 묻는 문제임.

questions.question: 23. 그림을 보고 만든 문장 중 어법과 내용상 옳은 것은?
questions.explanation: 5번 문장 'Sue is wondering whether Jessy likes flowers.'는 명사절 whether를 사용하여 어법상 완벽함. 2번은 wondering 뒤에 that이 아닌 if/whether, 3번은 whether Eric is sick 어순, 4번은 did returned가 아닌 returned가 되어야 함.
options: ① Jihun wants to know whether I’m going in the opposite direction.
② Mike is wondering that Mom turned off the oven.
③ Minho isn’t sure whether is Eric sick today.
④ Somi wants to know if Mina did returned the books to the library.
⑤ Sue is wondering whether Jessy likes flowers.
questions.reason_for_classification: 명사절 if/whether의 쓰임과 간접의문문 어순을 정확히 이해하고 있는지 평가함.

questions.passage: One day, Sheila saw Max sitting under the desk. He was making a strange sound. "What's wrong?" asked Sheila. She looked at him closely and found a bad cut on his leg. She took him to the animal hospital. The doctor said, "He will get better ⓐif he gets enough rest. Keep him inside for a week.“
questions.question: 24. ⓐ에 사용된 'if'와 문장에서의 쓰임이 같은 것은?
questions.explanation: 제시된 if는 '만약 ~라면'의 조건 부사절임. 2번의 if 역시 조건 부사절로 쓰임. 1, 3, 4, 5번은 '~인지 아닌지'의 명사절임.
options: ① I don't know if he got up early.
② She will come to me if she wants.
③ I'm not sure if she comes home soon.
④ I wonder if he likes her.
⑤ Do you know if he went to school?
questions.reason_for_classification: if의 두 가지 용법(조건 부사절 vs 명사절)을 구별하는 능력을 묻는 문제임.

questions.question: 25. 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
questions.explanation: 조건의 if절에서는 현재 시제가 미래를 대신하므로 3인칭 단수 주어 Minsu에 맞춰 invites를 쓰고, 주절에는 미래 시제인 will go를 써야 함.
sentences: If Minsu __________ me, I __________ to his birthday party with you.
questions.reason_for_classification: 조건의 부사절 if 내 현재 시제 사용 및 주절과의 시제 일치 원칙을 평가함.

questions.passage: Who was this amazing star? His name was Franz Liszt and he was born in 1811 in Hungary. He first started playing the piano when he was seven. Liszt later became a great pianist, composer and teacher. Many people think of him as the first idol. Why don't you give his music a listen? ⒶIf you like today's idols, you will love the original idol.
questions.question: 26. 윗글의 밑줄 친 Ⓐ와 쓰임이 다른 것을 고르면?
questions.explanation: 제시된 Ⓐ는 조건 부사절 if임. 1번의 if는 동사 wonder의 목적어 역할을 하는 명사절(~인지 아닌지)이므로 쓰임이 다름.
options: ① I wonder if Tom knows the answer.
② If it snows tomorrow, I will stay at home.
③ If this bag is expensive, I will buy another one.
④ If she comes on time, we will take her to the party.
⑤ If you run for 10 minutes every day, you will be healthier.
questions.reason_for_classification: 문맥 속에서 if의 부사절 용법과 명사절 용법을 구별하는 문제임.

questions.question: 27. 다음 우리말 해석에 맞게 조건을 활용하여 영어로 쓰시오. [4점]
questions.explanation: '만약 내일 비가 온다면'은 If it rains tomorrow (조건절 현재형), '나는 여행을 취소할 것이다'는 I will cancel the trip (주절 미래형)으로 영작함.
sentences: 만약 내일 비가 온다면, 나는 여행을 취소할 것이다.
<조건>
• if the trip을 반드시 포함한 8~9 단어의 완전한 문장으로 작성할 것.
questions.answer: If it rains tomorrow, I will cancel the trip.
questions.reason_for_classification: 조건 부사절 내 현재 시제 대용 원칙을 영작에 적용할 수 있는지 평가함.

questions.passage:
Imagine you are in the middle of a great desert. The sands go on and on in every direction. The sun feels like a giant ball of fire. The hot wind burns your face and throat. You open your backpack to drink some water. Oh, no! You're ㉠almost out of water. You wet your throat ㉡with a drop of water and keep going.
Sounds like a bad dream? Well, this is not a dream for the people Ⓐthat ㉢takes part in the 4 Deserts Race. (가)'4 Deserts Race' 세계의 가장 험한 사막들을 가로지르는 연속된 4개의 경주이다. 각 경주는 길이가 250 킬로미터이고 7일이 걸린다.
The first race takes place in the Atacama Desert in Chile. It is the (나)가장 건조한 desert in the world. In fact, it hasn't rained in some parts of the Atacama Desert for 400 years! The next race goes to the Gobi Desert in China. It is the (다)가장 바람이 많이 부는 desert on earth. The third race ㉣heads to the Sahara Desert in Egypt. It is the (라)가장 뜨거운 of the four deserts. Temperatures can ㉤reach up to 50°C. Finally, the race travels to the coldest desert on earth, Antarctica. (마) 당신이 여기에서 끓는 물을 공중에 던진다면, 그것은 얼어버린다!
questions.question: 28. 이 글의 밑줄 친 (마)의 우리말을 조건에 맞게 영어로 쓰시오. [4점]

• 조건을 나타내는 접속사로 시작하여 쓸 것
• 완전한 문장이 되도록 11 단어로 쓸 것
questions.answer: If you throw boiling water into the air here, it freezes.
questions.reason_for_classification: 조건 부사절을 이용한 복잡한 문장 구성 및 단어 수 제한 조건을 맞추는 능력을 평가함.

questions.question: 29. 다음 우리말을 조건에 맞게 영어로 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: '만약 규칙을 어긴다면'(If the students break the rules) + '처벌받을 것이다'(they will be punished)를 결합하여 10단어 문장을 완성함.
sentences: 만약 그 학생들이 규칙을 어긴다면 그들은 처벌받을 것이다.
<조건>
• if the rules를 포함하여 완전한 문장이 되도록 10~11 단어로 쓸 것
questions.answer: If the students break the rules, they will be punished.
questions.reason_for_classification: 조건의 부사절과 수동태가 결합된 문장을 영작하는 문제임.

questions.question: 30. 다음 우리말을 <보기>에서 필요한 단어들만 선택하여 <조건>에 맞게 영어로 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: 보기의 단어들을 활용하여 'If it rains tomorrow, I will cancel the trip.' 문장을 완성함.

questions.explanation: '비록 ~일지라도'라는 양보의 접속사 Although/Though를 사용하고 주어+동사를 맞춰 6단어로 구성하면 'Although he was holding an umbrella'가 됨.
sentences: 그는 우산을 들고 있었지만 비에 흠뻑 젖었다. (hold, an umbrella)
questions.answer: Although he was holding an umbrella
questions.reason_for_classification: 양보 부사절 접속사 although와 과거진행형 시제를 결합하여 문장을 완성하는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 22. 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 다른 하나는?
questions.explanation: ④는 '연습을 열심히 했기 때문에(because)'라는 이유가 적절하고, 나머지는 모두 '비록 ~일지라도(although/though)'라는 양보의 의미가 적절함.
options: ① I wasn’t late for school __________ I got up late.
② __________ I took the medicine, I don’t feel better.
③ They played soccer __________ it was raining hard.
④ He won the first prize __________ he practiced hard.
⑤ __________ she is six years old, she can solve difficult questions.
questions.reason_for_classification: 부사절 접속사 although와 because의 의미적 차이를 문맥을 통해 구별하는 문제입니다.

questions.question:
23. 빈칸에 들어갈 단어로 알맞은 것은?
Jane looks young and beautiful her age.
= Jane은 나이에도 불구하고 젊고 아름다워 보인다.
questions.explanation: '~에도 불구하고'라는 의미로 명사구(her age) 앞에 올 수 있는 전치사 for는 '~에 비해/치고는'이라는 뜻이 있으며, ⑤ in spite of (of가 빠짐)나 ④ despite가 정답 후보이나, 영문에 of가 빠진 형태가 보이므로 숙어적 의미 확인 필요. 가장 자연스러운 것은 despite.
sentences: Jane looks young and beautiful her age.
Jane은 나이에도 불구하고 젊고 아름다워 보인다.
questions.reason_for_classification: 양보를 나타내는 전치사 despite의 쓰임을 묻는 문제입니다.

questions.passage:
Look at this painting first. The seaside landscape is so peaceful and beautiful, isn't it? The title of this painting is Landscape with the Fall of Icarus. So, can you see where Icarus is? This is Icarus in the famous myth in Greece.
In the myth, Icarus' father made wings for him with feathers and wax and told him to stay away from the sun. However, Icarus didn't listen. He flew too close to the sun. So, the wax melted and he fell into the water. Now, look at the entire painting again.
__________ the tragedy of Icarus, people are going on with their everyday activities. Does the painting still look peaceful? What do you think the artist is trying to tell us?
questions.question: 24. 빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 말을 고르시오.
questions.explanation: 빈칸 뒤에 'the tragedy of Icarus(이카루스의 비극)'라는 명사구가 오므로 양보의 전치사인 In spite of 또는 Despite가 와야 함. ➀은 Despite of로 잘못 표기됨.
questions.reason_for_classification: 양보를 나타내는 전치사(In spite of)와 접속사(Though/Although)를 구별하는 전형적인 문제입니다.

questions.question: 25. 밑줄 친 표현의 쓰임이 가장 자연스러운 것끼리 짝지어진 것은?
questions.explanation: ④ 'due to bad weather'는 이유 전치사구로 옳고, 'Although he was not feeling well'은 양보 접속사절로 옳음. ① although 뒤에는 절이 와야 하고, ② inspite of 뒤에 절이 와서 틀림, ③ because 뒤에 문맥상 '공부를 열심히 했음에도'라는 양보(although)가 와야 함.
options:
① • He is quite strong although his old age.
• Even though he was sleepy, he didn’t stop studying.

② • The river swelled while it was raining heavily.
• She didn't miss any class inspite of she was sick.

③ • Although the news was not true, they believed it.
• Kane didn't pass the test because he studied hard.

④ • The delay was due to bad weather.
• Although he was not feeling well, he tried his best.

⑤ • The restaurant was expensive, though the food was perfect.
• Despite tired, she stayed up to finish her homework.
questions.reason_for_classification: 접속사와 전치사의 구별(because/because of, although/despite 등)을 다양한 예문을 통해 종합적으로 묻는 난이도 높은 문제입니다.

questions.question: 26. 어법상 쓰임이 옳은 것만을 <보기>에서 있는 대로  고른 것은?
questions.explanation: b는 although+절로 옳음. d는 배수 비교(three times as deep as)로 옳음. e는 due to+명사구로 옳음. a는 In spite of 뒤에 절이 와서 틀림(Although로 고쳐야 함), c는 if절 내 시제 일치 오류(rains).
options:
① a, b, c 	② a, c, d 	③ b, d, e
④ b, e 	⑤ c, d, e
sentences: <보기>
a. In spite of he was tired, he didn’t stop working.
b. It wasn’t very warm although the sun was shining.
c. Jenny will bring you an umbrella if it rain much.
d. The river is three times as deep as the swimming pool.
e. Due to the unexpected problem, we must postpone the midterm exam.
questions.reason_for_classification: 양보 접속사/전치사, 배수 비교, 조건 부사절 시제 등 다양한 문법 항목을 한꺼번에 점검하는 종합 문제입니다.

questions.question: 27. 빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 것은?
questions.explanation: 두 문장 모두 앞 절과 뒤 절이 상반된 내용을 담고 있으므로 '비록 ~일지라도'라는 뜻의 양보 접속사 Although가 적절함.
options: ① If	② Because	③ As	④ Also	  ⑤ Although
sentences: - (_____) there are many books and movies Mars, no one has been there yet.
- (_____) Mina and I live in different cities, we are best friends.
questions.reason_for_classification: 양보의 접속사 Although의 의미와 쓰임을 묻는 기초적인 문맥 파악 문제입니다.

questions.question: 28. 우리말을 영어로 가장 잘 옮긴 것은?
questions.explanation: '비록 ~했지만'은 양보의 접속사 Although/Though를 사용하며, '수 없었다'는 과거의 무능력이므로 couldn't sleep이 적절함.
options: ① She couldn't sleep since she was very tired.
② She couldn't sleep although she was very tired.
③ If she was very tired, she could not sleep.
④ When she was very tired, she couldn't sleep.
⑤ She was very tired or she couldn't sleep.
sentences: 비록 그녀는 매우 피곤했지만, 그녀는 잘 수 없었다.
questions.reason_for_classification: 우리말 양보 표현(~비록 ~했지만)을 영어 접속사 although를 활용해 영작한 것을 찾는 문제입니다.

questions.passage:
Have you ever heard of a "selfie"? When you take a photograph of yourself, it's a selfie. The students from Minji's photo club ⓐhave searched for information about selfies for one month. Here are some of their presentations about selfies.Selfies in the Past
Did people in the past take selfies? ⓑDespite it wasn't easy at that time, the answer is yes. Look at this photo of Princess Anastasia. She used a mirror ⓒto take a picture of herself. She looks ⓓnervous. Can you guess why? Well, I think it was her first selfie. And it was probably the world's first teenage selfie ⓔever.
questions.question: 29. 밑줄친 ⓐ-ⓔ 중, 어법상 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓑ 뒤에 주어(it)+동사(wasn't)가 이끄는 절이 오므로 전치사인 Despite 대신 접속사 Although/Though를 써야 함.
questions.reason_for_classification: 접속사와 전치사의 차이를 구별하는 문제로, although와 despite의 뒤따르는 구조 차이를 묻고 있습니다.

questions.question: 30. 빈칸 ⓐ에 들어갈 말을 바르게 영작한 것은?
questions.explanation: '비록 ~이지만'의 Though 절과 '것처럼 보인다'의 looks like ~를 사용하여 어순에 맞게 영작한 ①번이 가장 적절함.
options: ① Though the boys are not really riding horses, it looks like they are.
② Though the boys riding horses not are really, it looks like they are.
③ Like though the boys are not really riding horses, it looks they are.
④ Though are not really riding the boys horses, it looks like they are.
⑤ The boys are not really riding though horses, it looks like they are.
sentences: ⓐ비록 소년들은 정말로 말을 타고 있지는 않지만, 그렇게 하고 있는 것처럼 보인다.
questions.reason_for_classification: 우리말 양보 절을 접속사 though를 사용하여 올바른 영어 어순으로 영작하는 능력을 평가합니다.

questions.question: 31. 다음 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 단어는?
questions.explanation: 1번은 표지판이 앞에 있었음에도 못 봤다는 내용, 2번은 우산을 들고 있었음에도 젖었다는 내용이므로 역접/양보의 접속사 though가 공통으로 들어감.
options: ① thus	② yet	③ so	④ though	⑤ however
sentences: 1. The woman didn't see the road sign _______ it was right in front of her.
2. The boy got very wet in the rain _______ he was holding an umbrella.
questions.reason_for_classification: 상반된 인과관계를 나타내는 두 문장에서 공통으로 사용될 양보 접속사 though를 찾는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 32. 짝지어진 문장이 적절하지 않은 것을 고르시오
questions.explanation: ③의 원문 so hot that I can't enjoy는 '즐기기에 너무 뜨겁다'는 뜻이므로 enough to가 아니라 too hot to enjoy로 바꾸거나, '충분히 시원하지 않다(isn't cool enough)'로 표현해야 문맥이 맞음.
options:
① Because of the loud noise, I can't sleep.
= The noise is so loud that I can't sleep.

② I can't solve this puzzle because it's very difficult.
= This puzzle is too difficult for me to solve.

③ The tea is so hot that I can't enjoy it.
= The tea isn't hot enough for me to enjoy it.

④ It rains so hard that I can't play soccer.
= I can't play soccer because it rains too hard.

⑤ I can't buy the clothes because they are too expensive.
= The clothes are so expensive that I can't buy them.
questions.reason_for_classification: so ~ that 구문과 too ~ to / enough to 구문 사이의 상호 변환 시 의미 일치를 묻는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 33. 다음 중 so ~ that을 이용해 바꾼 문장 중 뜻이 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: ③의 hungry enough to eat (~할 만큼 충분히 배고프다)는 '너무 배고파서 한 판을 다 먹을 수 있다(could eat)'는 뜻이어야 하는데, couldn't로 잘못 변환됨.
options:
① I was very happy, so I danced.
→ I was so happy that I danced.

② The room is very dark, so I can’t see anything.
→ I was so dark that I can see nothing.

③ I was hungry enough to eat a whole pizza.
→ I was so hungry that I couldn’t eat a whole pizza.

④ The boy was very honest, so everyone liked him.
→ The boy was so honest that everyone liked him.

⑤ The weather was very nice, so I went out for a walk.
→ The weather was so nice that I went out for a walk.
questions.reason_for_classification: 'enough to V' 구문을 'so ~ that can' 구문으로 바꿀 때 긍정/부정의 의미 일치를 정확히 파악해야 합니다.

questions.question: 34. 다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ, ⓑ, ⓔ가 옳음. ⓒ는 such cold(형용사)가 아니라 so cold가 와야 하고, ⓓ는 too quickly for me to catch it에서 it을 생략해야 함(주어와 같을 때). ⓕ는 too heavy that이 아니라 so heavy that으로 써야 함.
sentences: ⓐ I’m too full to eat any more.
ⓑ I’m so tired that I want to take a nap.
ⓒ It’s such cold that I want to drink hot tea.
ⓓ The dog ran too quickly for me to catch it.
ⓔ The movie was so sad that everybody cried.
ⓕ This box is too heavy that I can’t carry the box.
questions.reason_for_classification: so ~ that, too ~ to 구문의 기본 구조 및 such/so 구별, to부정사의 목적어 생략 규칙 등을 종합적으로 평가하는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 35. Which one is grammatically correct? (정답 2개)
questions.explanation: ①은 so boring that (과거형)으로 옳음. ⑤는 so cute that I can't ~로 목적어 him까지 잘 갖춰진 문장임. ②는 heavily가 형용사 heavy가 되어야 하고, ③은 such a nice student, ④는 many people come(복수)으로 고쳐야 함.
options: ① The book was so boring that I fell asleep.
② Traffic was so heavily that I was late for school.
③ Mina is a such nice student that she studies everyday.
④ The flowers are so beautiful that many people comes to see it.
⑤ The panda is so cute that I can't take my eyes off him.
questions.reason_for_classification: so ~ that 구문에서 형용사/부사 선택, such a 명사 어순, 수 일치 등을 복합적으로 묻고 있습니다.

questions.passage:
A: There is a Holi festival in Busan this year.
B: A Holi festival? What is it?
A: It’s a traditional Indian festival. People throw colored powder and water at each other. (A)It is such an exciting festival that people can have a wonderful time together.
B: That sound exciting. ⓐ_______________?
A: Yes, I have. I went with my Indian friend.
B: I’d like to go, too. When is the festival?
A: It’s on the last full moon of the Hindu calendar.
questions.question: 36. 위 대화의 밑줄 친 (A)를 주어진 말로 시작하는 so ~that 구문으로 바꾸어 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: 'such a(n) 형용사 명사'를 'so 형용사 a(n) 명사' 혹은 'The festival is so exciting that ~' 형태로 바꿀 수 있음. 문제 조건에 따라 The festival로 시작하면 'The festival is so exciting that people can have a wonderful time together'가 됨.
sentences: (A) It is such an exciting festival that people can have a wonderful time together.
시작 말: The festival
questions.answer: The festival is so exciting that people can have a wonderful time together.
questions.reason_for_classification: 'such a(n) + 형용사 + 명사 + that' 구문을 'so + 형용사 + that' 구문으로 문장 구조를 전환하는 능력을 평가합니다.

questions.passage:
Grandfather(G): Hi, Peter! (A)너는 이런 종류의 자물쇠를 전에 본 적이 있니?
Pater(P): ⓐNo, I haven’t. ⓑIt’s such old that I can really tell, but is it a fish?
G: Yes. ⓒFor a long time, Koreans have think that fish are good guards. ⓓFish don’t close it eyes, even when they sleep.
P: That’s interesting.
G: We think fish can keep valuable things.
ⓔThat’s why this lock look like a fish.
P: Now I understand.
questions.question: 37. 위 대화의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ는 'Have you ~?' 질문에 대한 현재완료의 부정 대답으로 어법상 옳음. ⓑ는 so old that(명사가 없으므로 such 불가), ⓒ는 have thought (현재완료), ⓓ는 their eyes (복수), ⓔ는 looks (3인칭 단수)로 고쳐야 함.
questions.reason_for_classification: 현재완료 시제, so ~ that 구문의 품사 선택, 명사-대명사 수 일치, 주어-동사 수 일치 등을 종합적으로 다루고 있습니다.

questions.passage:
<Deer>
(A)People consider the deer a special animal because it is beautiful and calm. Deer always move together and look our for one another. Whenever they go to different places, they always make sure that none of deer are missing. When a deer was painted with pine trees and rocks, it usually meant “power” or “authority.”
questions.question: 38. 윗글의 밑줄 친 (A)와 비슷한 뜻이 되도록 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 넣어 문장을 완성하시오.
questions.explanation: 원문의 because it is beautiful and calm을 '너무 ~해서 ~하다'는 의미의 so beautiful and calm that으로 바꾸고, 수동태를 활용하여 'is considered'를 넣으면 'The deer is so beautiful and calm that it is considered a special animal'이 됨.
sentences: (A) People consider the deer a special animal because it is beautiful and calm.
questions.answer: The deer is so beautiful and calm that it is considered a special animal.
questions.reason_for_classification: 이유 부사절을 결과 부사절(so ~ that)로 전환하고 동시에 능동태를 수동태로 전환하는 고난도 변형 문제입니다.

questions.question:
39. 우리말 의미와 같도록 <조건>에 맞게 문장을 바르게 고쳐 다시 작성하시오.
Emma는 너무 지루해서 혼자 노래를 부르기 시작했다.
<조건>
·완전한 한 문장으로 작성할 것
·틀린 부분만 고치고 나머지는 다른 단어로 대체하거나 삭제하지 않을 것
Emma was very bored so that she started singing to herself.
questions.explanation: '너무 ~해서 ~하다'는 so ~ that 구문을 써야 하므로 very를 so로 바꾸어야 함. (Emma was so bored that she started singing to herself.)
sentences: Emma는 너무 지루해서 혼자 노래를 부르기 시작했다.
Emma was very bored so that she started singing to herself.
questions.answer: Emma was so bored that she started singing to herself.
questions.reason_for_classification: so ~ that 결과 부사절의 정확한 형태를 숙지하고 오류를 수정하는 능력을 평가합니다.

questions.passage: Our first day was terrible. On the way to our guesthouse around Plaza Reial, we got lost in downtown Barcelona. Dad was busy looking at the map and asking people to find the guesthouse with some Spanish words he got from a tour guidebook. Even though our guesthouse was right next to the Plaza, it took us about two hours to get there. 우리는 너무 피곤해서 저녁을 먹으러 나갈 수 없었다. I went to bet but couldn't fall asleep because I was worried about what would happen the next day.
questions.question: 40. 윗글의 밑줄 친 우리말과 일치하도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: '너무 ~해서 ~할 수 없었다'는 so ~ that ~ can't 구문을 활용하면 'so tired that we could'가 됨. 빈칸이 5개이므로 so tired that we could (not) 형태로 구성함.
sentences: 우리는 너무 피곤해서 저녁을 먹으러 나갈 수 없었다.
We were ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ not go out for dinner.
questions.answer: so tired that we could
questions.reason_for_classification: so ~ that 구문의 과거 부정형을 문맥에 맞게 영작하는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 41. 다음 (1), (2) 각각 주어진 표현을 활용하여 다음 두 문장을 한 문장으로 연결하여 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: (1) Jenny is so selfish that she can't think about other people's feelings. (2) Jenny is too selfish to think about other people's feelings.
sentences: Jenny is very selfish.
She can't think about other people's feelings.
(1) so ~ that
(2) too ~ to
questions.answer: (1) Jenny is so selfish that she can't think about other people's feelings. (2) Jenny is too selfish to think about other people's feelings.
questions.reason_for_classification: so ~ that 구문과 too ~ to 구문의 상호 전환 능력을 평가합니다.

questions.passage:
In 1979, a woman started a journey to cities in the U.S. and Canada. She looked over 80. She couldn't see or hear well. She couldn't walk well without a stick.
With all these difficulties, ⓐ the woman had to climb stairs in subway stations and gets on crowded buses. She had to open heavy doors and use can openers with her weak hands. Sometimes she got hurt or found herself in danger. ⓑ Every moment was very difficult for her, but she visited more than 115 cities and ended her trip in 1982. ⓒ Who was the woman and what made her do all this? She was Patricia Moore, a 26-year-old designer. During the 1970s, she worked for a big design company. She often asked at meetings, "How about designing for old or weak people?" The other designers always answered, "We don't design for those people."
She became tired of the same cold answer. Finally, she decided to become one of "those people" and travel around many cities to understand their difficulties better. For this, she put on her grandmother's clothes, uncomfortable shoes, and thick glasses. ⓓ The shoes were so uncomfortably that she couldn't walk well without a stick. ⓔ The glasses were so thick that she couldn't see well with it. She also put lots of cotton in her ears to make her hearing bad.
questions.question: 47. 다음 글을 읽고 밑줄 친 ⓐ ~ ⓔ 중 어법상 올바른 것만을 있는 대로 고른 것은?

questions.question: 50. 두 문장을 하나의 문장으로 만들 때 의미가 달라지는 것은?

options:
① I am 178 cm tall. He is 185 cm tall.
→ I am not as tall as he.

② A cat is not very big. A lion is big.
→ A cat is not as big as a lion.

③ You are 14 years old. I am 14 years old, too.
→ You are as old as I.

→ I didn’t work as hard as Jane.

→ You cannot speak English as well as she.

questions.passage:
Turandot, a Chinese princess, is a woman of great beauty, but she is as cold as ice. Any prince who ⓐ<u>wants</u> to marry her must answer three riddles. If he ⓑ<u>fails</u>, he must die. No one ⓒ<u>have</u> ever been able to answer them.
(A) He then gives her a riddle of his own. He asks her, “What is my name?” He adds, “If you answer correctly, I will agree to die. If you ⓓ<u>answers</u> incorrectly, you will have to marry me.”
(B) Turandot must find the answer before dawn, but his riddle is as difficult as ⓔ<u>her</u>. She says to everyone, “No one will go to sleep until someone finds out his name.”

questions.question: 1. 밑줄 친 ⓐ ~ ⓔ 중에서, 어법상 옳은 것만을 있는 대로 고른 것은?

questions.reason_for_classification: 주어와 동사의 수 일치(3인칭 단수) 및 비교 대상의 격(소유대명사) 일치를 묻는 종합 문법 문제임.

questions.question: 2. <보기>는 다음 표의 정보를 토대로 만든 영어 문장이다. 정확한 정보가 담긴 문장을 <보기>에서 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ 택시(80km)는 버스(60km)보다 빠르므로 옳다. ⓑ 택시는 지하철(80km)만큼 빠르므로 옳다. ⓔ 지하철(1,200원)은 택시(3,000원)만큼 비싸지 않으므로(as expensive as) 옳다. ⓒ 택시와 버스는 가격이 같고, ⓓ 지하철은 버스보다 빠르다.
sentences: Transportation: Subway(80km, 1,200 won), Bus(60km, 3,000 won), Taxi(80km, 3,000 won)
ⓐ The taxi is faster than the bus.
ⓑ The taxi can go as fast as the subway.
ⓒ The taxi is more expensive than the bus.
ⓓ The subway cannot go so fast as the bus.
ⓔ The subway is not as expensive as the taxi.
questions.reason_for_classification: 원급 비교(as~as)와 비교급(faster than)을 활용하여 표의 수치를 정확히 비교할 수 있는지 묻는 문제임.

options: ① Drink B has half as sodium as Drink A.

Drink B: Water 330ml, Sugar 30g, Sodium 10mg, Caffeine 0mg, Calories 130kcal

Hi, my name is Yoko. I moved to Gyeonggi-do two years ago. Before I moved to Korea, I went to school in Tokyo. I had a lot of safety training and learned what to do for safety. Let me begin with the four steps to follow in case of an earthquake.
ⓐ<u>First, when you feel a sudden shaking of the ground, quickly take cover under a desk</u>. Protect your head with a book or a backpack. Second, follow your teacher to a safe place. ⓑ<u>Staying calm is as necessarily as going outside</u>. Third, as you go out, always protect your head from falling things. Last, once you’re outside, run to an open place. A field with no trees is a good place.
An underwater earthquake can create a tsunami, a very large ocean wave. ⓒ<u>It can be more dangerous as a war</u>. It may kill many people living in beach towns. Do you know how to escape it? You have to observe the sea. ⓓ<u>When a tsunami is about come, it always looks like the sea is boiling</u>. When that happens, run to your teacher or a grown-up. ⓔ<u>Tell them that you must move to higher ground as soon as possible</u>. Please remember the link between the boiling sea and a tsunami. It will save many lives!
questions.question: 11. 윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ ~ ⓔ 중 어법상 올바른 문장을 있는대로 고른 것은?

*배운 표현을 활용하여 두 문장이 같은 뜻이 되도록 고치시오.
1. As I don't meet the singer, I cannot shake hands with him.
= If I didn't meet the singer, I can shake hands with him.

= He whose eyes are brown has a sister.

= The brighter the sun is, I feel happy.

= Do you know who his hat is blue?

questions.reason_for_classification: 상관접속사 Both A and B의 수 일치 및 기초 어법(조동사, 수여동사, 복수명사)을 묻는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 21. 다음은 수준별 세트 문항입니다. 3개의 문항 중 자신의 수준에 맞는 문제를 골라 답을 쓰시오. (세 개의 문항을 모두 풀 수 있으나, 바르게 답한 문항 중 배점이 높은 문항의 점수만 인정함.)
questions.explanation: (A) 4형식 어순 Mom gave me a book. (B) 수여동사 send의 활용 Jinho sent me a cap (또는 a cap to me). (C) 그림 묘사 Kate gave Eric a present.

(B) 다음 해석에 맞도록 문장을 완성하시오. 진호는 나에게 모자를 보내주었어. → Jinho _________________________.
(C) 그림을 보고 Kate가 준 선물에 관한 문장을 완성하시오. (단, Kate와 Eric의 이름을 반드시 쓸 것) → ________________________________________________.
questions.answer: (A) Mom gave me a book. (B) Jinho sent me a hat. (C) Kate gave Eric a present.
questions.reason_for_classification: 수여동사(give, send)의 4형식 문장 구성을 묻는 서술형 문제입니다.

questions.question: 25. 다음은 아미다미 영어 학습 동아리 학생들이 ‘수여동사’에 대해 배운 내용을 복습한 대화이다. 올바르게 이해한 학생들로만 짝지어진 것은?
questions.explanation: 하준(cook-for), 철수(buy-for/4형식 전환)는 맞습니다. 수미는 어순(IO+DO)이 틀렸고, 지혜는 sent to me가 아니라 sent me이며, 영석의 teach는 to를 씁니다.
sentences: ∘ 수미: 수여동사는 주고받는 것과 관련된 동사로, 문장은 ‘주어+수여동사+직접목적어+간접목적어’ 순서로 만들면 돼.
∘ 지혜: 맞아! 전치사를 써서 문장을 만들 수도 있는데 예를 들면 ‘Mr. Kim sent to me flowers'처럼 써도 맞는 문장이야.
∘ 영석: 전치사 ‘for'을 써도 되는 동사들이 있는데 make, buy, find, teach, cook 등이 대표적이지.
∘ 하준: 오호~ 그럼 ‘Grandma sometimes cooks chicken soup for us.' 이런 식으로 쓰면 되겠네?
∘ 철수: 수여동사 그거 쉽네! ‘She bought some flowers for me.'는 ’She bought me some flowers.'로 바꿀 수 있겠군!
questions.reason_for_classification: 수여동사의 문장 형식 및 전치사 활용에 대한 이론적 이해도를 평가합니다.

questions.question: 26. 다음 주어진 문장을 같은 의미를 가진 다른 형식의 문장으로 바꾸시오.

questions.question: 30. 다음 중 문장 전환이 바르지 않은 것은?

questions.question: 14. 다음 문장 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
questions.explanation: ④ 지각동사 notice는 목적격 보어로 동사원형이나 현재분사를 취함. ① felt(지각) + touch, ② helped + (to) clean, ③ allows + to walk, ⑤ let(사역) + know.
options: ① I felt you to touch my hair.
② I helped my sister cleaning her room.
③ She allows me walking down the street.
④ He noticed someone clean the bathroom.
⑤ I’ll let you to know the result of the test.
questions.reason_for_classification: 사역동사, 지각동사, 일반적인 5형식 동사(allow, help)의 목적격 보어 형태를 구분하는 문제임.

questions.question: 15. 다음 빈칸에 어법상 공통으로 들어갈 수 없는 것은?
questions.explanation: 빈칸 뒤의 구조가 '목적어 + to부정사'이므로, 5형식 목적격 보어로 to부정사를 취할 수 없는 동사를 찾아야 함. keep은 목적격 보어로 형용사, 분사 등을 취하며 to부정사는 취하지 않음.
sentences: . I ___ him to do the work.
. He ___ her to repair the sink.
. The doctor ___ her to go to bed early.
. She ___ me to clean the living room.
. My parents ___ me to exercise every morning.
questions.reason_for_classification: 목적격 보어로 to부정사를 취하는 동사들과 그렇지 않은 동사(keep)를 구별하는 문제임.

questions.question: 16. 어법상 바른 문장만을 <보기>에서 있는 대로 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ 5형식 find(옳음), ⓑ 지각동사 hear+O+p.p.(수동관계: 옳음), ⓓ 지각동사 see+O+ing(능동진행: 옳음). ⓒ had his car washed(수동), ⓔ was chosen(수동태 시제), ⓕ advised us not to be.
sentences:
<보기>
ⓐ I found the exam easy.
ⓑ I heared my name called.
ⓒ He had his car washing yesterday.
ⓓ I saw an old woman walking her dog.
ⓔ The singer of the year was chose by online voters.
ⓕ My teacher advised us not being late for school.
questions.reason_for_classification: 5형식에서의 목적어와 보어의 능동/수동 관계(사역/지각동사 포함)를 정확히 파악해야 하는 문제임.

questions.question: 17. 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말의 형태로 알맞은 것은?
questions.explanation: 동사 want는 5형식에서 목적격 보어로 to부정사를 취함. (11번 문제와 동일함)
sentences:
<보기>
Mike’s mom wanted him ________ the plants.
questions.reason_for_classification: 동사 want가 5형식 목적격 보어로 to부정사를 취하는 구조를 묻는 문제임.

questions.question: 18. 우리말과 일치하는 문장을 주어진 <조건>에 맞게 작성하시오.
questions.explanation: (1) advise + O + not to-v 구조를 사용함. (2) ask + O + to-v 구조를 사용함.
sentences:
<조건>
• 주어진 단어를 모두 활용할 것
• 필요한 경우 단어를 변형할 것
(1) Mr.Kim은 Tom에게 늦지 말라고 충고하셨다.
(advise, late)]
→
(2) James는 그녀에게 그 창문을 닫아 달라고 요구했다.
(ask, close)
→
questions.answer: (1) Mr. Kim advised Tom not to be late. (2) James asked her to close the window.
questions.reason_for_classification: to부정사를 목적격 보어로 취하는 동사(advise, ask)의 5형식 문장 및 부정형 영작 능력 평가임.

questions.question: 19. 다음 우리말에 맞도록 8단어로 바르게 영작하시오.
questions.explanation: '부탁했다(asked)' 과거 시제를 사용하며 ask + him + to open the window 구조로 작성함.
sentences: 선생님은 그에게 창문을 열어달라고 부탁했다.
questions.answer: The teacher asked him to open the window.
questions.reason_for_classification: 5형식 동사 ask의 활용(목적어+to부정사)을 묻는 영작 문제임.

questions.question: 20. 다음 주어진 상황을 보고 제시된 조건을 모두 충족하는 대답을 완성하시오.
questions.explanation: 과거 시제(wanted), 5형식 구조(want + me + to clean), 단어 수 제한을 모두 충족해야 함.
sentences:
< 상황 >
- 그들은 내가 집을 치우기를 원했다.
<조건>
① 위에 주어진 상황과 일치하는 문장 작성
② 7단어 이내의 완전한 영어 문장으로 작성
③ want 동사를 활용하여 5형식으로 작성
④ 상황 속 시제를 정확히 반영하여 작성
questions.answer: They wanted me to clean the house.
questions.reason_for_classification: 조건에 부합하는 5형식 문장(want + O + to-v)의 시제 반영 영작임.

questions.question: 21. <보기>에서 어법상 옳은 문장만을 있는 대로 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ get + O + p.p.(수동관계: 옳음), ⓒ let + O + 동사원형(옳음), ⓓ had flowers sent(수동관계: 옳음). ⓑ got ~ to help가 되어야 함, ⓔ have them clean (대명사 목적격).
sentences:
<보기>
ⓐ Can you get it done before dinner?
ⓑ He got his sister help with his homework.
ⓒ She never lets her brother ride her bicycle.
ⓓ He had flowers send to his girlfriend for her birthday.
ⓔ I will have they clean the house because I am busy.
questions.reason_for_classification: 준사역동사 get과 사역동사의 목적격 보어 형태(동사원형/to부정사/과거분사)를 종합적으로 묻는 고난도 문제임.

questions.passage:
Dr. Park's Goal: Finding Uigwe
After studying in France for almost ten years, ⓐ<u>Dr. Park Byeong-seon applying for a position at the National Library of France in Paris</u>. She had two reasons for this. First, ⓑ<u>she wanted to able to read books easily for her studies</u>. Secondly, she wanted to find Uigwe. In January of 1866, ⓒ<u>the Korean government kill several French priests</u>, and in October the French army attacked Ganghwa-do for this. In this attack, the Oegyujanggak Library was burnt down, and many valuable books and records were destroyed. ⓓ<u>Some of the books that survived were taken to France and Uigwe was one of them</u>. The night before Dr. Park Byeong-seon left for France, ⓔ<u>her professor told her find Uigwe and this became her goal in life</u>.
questions.question: 22. 위 글의 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓓ 'Some of the books that survived were taken to France...'는 주어-동사 수 일치 및 수동태가 올바르게 쓰인 문장임. ⓐ applying -> applied, ⓑ to be able to, ⓒ killed, ⓔ told her to find.
questions.reason_for_classification: 수동태, 시제, 5형식 동사 tell의 보어 형태 등 복합 문법 지식을 지문 내에서 평가함.

questions.question: 23. 빈칸에 알맞지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: 빈칸 뒤에 '목적어 + to부정사'가 오므로, 이 형식을 취할 수 없는 동사를 골라야 함. say는 5형식으로 쓰이지 않으며, 목적어 뒤에 to부정사를 취하지 않음.
sentences: Mike’s mom __________ Mike to water the plant.
questions.reason_for_classification: 목적격 보어로 to부정사를 취하는 5형식 동사군에서 제외되는 동사(say)를 찾는 문제임.

questions.passage:
My name is Jimmy. I am in the eighth grade and my sister, Hope, is in the third grade. My father is a banker and my mother is a teacher. We have a dog, Smiley. ⓐ<u>Sounds</u> pretty normal, right? But a crazy thing happened last week.
My father  usually comes home late from work. So, we only see him on the weekends. Even then, he usually sleeps or watches television. But last Friday, he has come home early for dinner. At the table, we were all doing our own thing. Hope was ⓑ<u>giving food Smiley</u>. My mother was telling her ⓒ<u>to not do so</u>. I was texting.
My father said, "ⓓ<u>Pass me the bread to me</u>, please." No one heard him, so he asked again, "Can someone pass me the bread?" I heard him this time, but I was too busy with my phone. My mother was yelling, "Don’t feed Smiley!" Hope was feeding Smily. Smiley was jumping up and down. My father shouted, "Am I invisible? Pass me the bread!”
At that time, it happened. Poof! My father disappeared like magic. He became invisible!
We could hear him, but we couldn't see him. We asked, "Where are you?" "I'm right in front of you," he replied. We couldn't do anything for him. It was an awful night.
The next morning, we went to the hospital and asked the doctor ⓔ<u>helped</u> us. I said, "He has been invisible since last night." The doctor shook his head and said, "I can't help you. I've never seen anything like this before."
When we came home, Hope said, "I miss Daddy." She started crying. My mother ⓕ<u>joined to</u> her. In a few moments, we were a sea of tears. "Come back, Dad! I promise to pass you the bread every day!" I cried.
Then, it happened. My father appeared again! He hugged us and said, "Thank you for all the attention. I promise to come home earlier and ⓖ<u>play</u> with you on the weekends.“
questions.question: 24. ⓐ~ⓖ중 어법상 알맞은 것을 모두 고르면?
questions.explanation: ⓐ 'It sounds'에서 It이 생략된 형태(옳음), ⓖ 'promise to ~ and (to) play' 병렬 구조(옳음). ⓑ giving Smiley food, ⓒ not to do so, ⓓ Pass the bread to me, ⓔ to help, ⓕ joined her(타동사).
questions.reason_for_classification: 4형식 문장 전환, to부정사의 부정 위치, 5형식 동사의 보어 형태, 병렬 구조 등을 지문 전체에서 찾아내는 복합 문제임.

questions.question: 25. 어법상 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 바르지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: ④ tell + O + not to-v 구조여야 하므로 'not to run'이 되어야 함.
options: ① I've made a cake. <u>Would</u> you like some?
② Jack has broken his leg, so he <u>can't</u> go skiing.
③ The new school year has begun. I'm excited <u>to join</u> new activities.
④ The teacher told the students <u>not run</u> on the stairs because it's dangerous.
⑤ They <u>didn't</u> allow her to go to the festival because she had to finish her homework.
questions.reason_for_classification: 5형식 동사 tell의 목적격 보어인 to부정사의 부정 형태(not to-v)를 묻는 문제임.

questions.passage:
Date/Time: July 13th/6:00
Notes: ⓐ<u>A new elephant group appeared and Stella approached them</u>. At first, ⓑ<u>I thought that they would not let Stella in their group</u>. But I was wrong. ⓒ<u>An elephant, probably the oldest female, allowed Stella become part of the group</u>. The other elephants also seemed to welcome Stella. Unbelievably, ⓓ<u>one of the female elephants fed Stella</u>. ⓔ<u>She cared for Stella as warmly as Stella's mom did</u>. This was such an amazing moment!
questions.question: 26. 글의 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 바르지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓒ allow는 목적격 보어로 to부정사를 취하므로 'allow Stella to become'이 되어야 함.
questions.reason_for_classification: 동사 allow의 5형식 목적격 보어 형태(to부정사)를 묻는 문제임.

questions.question: 27. 윗글의 내용과 일치하고 올바른 어법으로 작성된 문장이 한 개 혹은 그 이상이 속한 그룹만을 있는 대로 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: (B)의 두 번째 문장 'A dog sled relay was the only way...'는 5형식 make it possible for~ 구조로 어법상 옳음. (A)의 Gunnar ordered...는 to be waited -> to wait가 적절하며, (C)의 go -> to go가 적절함.
sentences:
(A)	• A disease caused children in Nome to spread.
• Gunnar ordered the other teams to be waited at different points until he got the medicine.
(B)	• Gunnar wishes Balto to be the strongest dog on his team.
• A dog sled relay was the only way to make it possible for the people in Nome to get the medicine from Anchorage.
(C)	• The heavy snow didn't allow people in Nome go to Anchorage to get the medicine for the sick children.
• The people of Nome needed someone to get some medicine for the sick children from a hospital located in Anchorage.
questions.reason_for_classification: 가목적어 it과 의미상 주어(for+)가 포함된 고난도 5형식 문장 및 기타 동사들의 어법을 평가하는 문제임.

questions.question: 28. 글의 흐름상 밑줄 친 (가)에 들어갈 말로 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: '친구들에게 ~하는 것을 멈추라고 말하다'라는 의미로 tell + O + to stop + -ing(v하는 것을 그만두다) 구조인 ⑤가 적절함.
options: ① stopping your friends say frindle?
② to stop your friends saying frindle?
③ to stop your friends to say frindle?
④ your friends to stop to say frindle?
⑤ your friends to stop saying frindle?
questions.reason_for_classification: 동사 tell의 5형식 목적격 보어(to부정사)와 동사 stop의 목적어(동명사)가 결합된 구조를 묻는 문제임.

questions.passage: It was Sunday morning. I was very tired because I ___(A)___ last night. My mother wanted me to exercise outside and allowed me to go out. She also told me ___(B)___ computer games too much. Then my friend, Jiho, called me and asked me to meet him at 2 o'clock.
questions.question: 29. (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
questions.explanation: (A)는 어젯밤 잠을 자지 못한 과거의 사실이므로 didn't sleep이 적절하고, (B)는 tell + O + not to-v(부정형) 구조이므로 not to play가 적절함.
options: ② have slept - not to play
④ didn't sleep - not to play
questions.reason_for_classification: 과거 시제의 부정문과 5형식 동사 tell의 부정 목적격 보어 형태를 동시에 묻는 문제임.

questions.passage: The little boy was not sleepy.
questions.question: 30. 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 동사로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: 문맥상 '엄마에게 노래를 불러달라고 요청하다'가 적절하며, 빈칸 뒤에 '목적어 + to부정사' 구조가 오므로 이를 취할 수 있는 asked가 정답임.
sentences: He _________ his mom to sing a song for him.
questions.reason_for_classification: 5형식 목적격 보어로 to부정사를 취하는 동사를 문맥에 맞게 선택하는 문제임.

questions.question: 31. 다음 중 어법상 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: ③ order + O + to-v 구조에서 형용사인 quiet 앞에 be동사가 필요함 (to be quiet).
options: ① I told him to drink a lot of water.
② She advised us to read the book first.
③ I ordered him to quiet in class.
④ Jimin left the door open.
⑤ Reading the book made me sad.
questions.reason_for_classification: 5형식 문장에서 to부정사 보어 내 형용사가 쓰일 때 be동사의 유무를 묻는 함정 문제임.

questions.question: 32. 아래 주어진 문장 ⓐ ~ ⓖ 중 어법상 올바른 문장만 모두 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓒ tell + O + to-v (옳음), ⓕ expect + O + to-v (옳음). ⓐ He bought (수동태 불필요), ⓑ was not taken(수동태), ⓓ was cooked for me, ⓔ was the party held?, ⓖ made him happy (to be 불필요).
sentences: ⓐ He was bought a rose for me.
ⓑ This photo didn’t taken by Jane.
ⓒ Why did you tell him to leave early?
ⓓ A special dinner were cooked to me by my mom.
ⓔ Where the party was held?
ⓕ She didn’t expect him to pass the test.
ⓖ I made him to be happy.
questions.reason_for_classification: 5형식(tell, expect, make), 수동태, 의문문 등 중학교 2학년 과정의 주요 문법들을 종합적으로 선별하는 문제임.

questions.question: 33. 우리말을 주어진 단어를 사용하여 <조건>에 맞게 영어로 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: '원하신다(want)' 현재 시제를 사용하며 8단어 조건에 맞춰 'My parents want me to exercise every morning.'으로 작성함.
sentences: 나의 부모님은 내가 매일 아침 운동하기를 원하신다.
(want, exercise)
questions.answer: My parents want me to exercise every morning.
questions.reason_for_classification: 단어 수 제한 및 5형식(want + O + to-v) 구조를 활용한 영작임.

questions.question: 34. 그림을 보고 Mike엄마가 Mike에게 요청한 말 중 두 가지를 선택하여, <조건>에 맞게 영어로 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: 그림의 상황(방 청소, 설거지 등)을 토대로 tell/ask + Mike + to-v 구조를 과거 시제로 영작함.
sentences:
<조건>
- 주어진 주어를 포함하고, 과거동사를 사용하여 완벽한 문장으로 작성할 것
- tell, ask 동사를 각 한 번씩 사용하고, 필요하다면 형태를 변화시킬 것
① Mike's mom__________________________________________________.
② Mike's mom__________________________________________________.
questions.answer: ① Mike's mom told him to clean the room. ② Mike's mom asked him to do the dishes. (그림 내용에 따라 달라질 수 있음)
questions.reason_for_classification: 주어진 동사(tell, ask)를 활용하여 시제에 맞는 5형식 문장을 생성하는 능력 평가임.

questions.question: 5. 위 대화의 빈칸 ⓐ에 들어갈 형태로 가장 올바른 것은?
questions.explanation: 동사 want는 목적격 보어로 to부정사를 취하므로 to understand가 적절함.
questions.reason_for_classification: 5형식 동사 want의 목적격 보어 형태(to부정사)를 묻는 문제임.

questions.question: 6. 어법상 맞는 문장을 <보기>에서 있는 대로 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: (A) 사역동사 let + 동사원형 check (맞음), (B) help + to부정사/동사원형 (맞음), (C) 사역동사 have + 목적어 + 동사원형(follow), (D) 사역동사 make + 목적어 + 동사원형(want) (맞음).
sentences: <보기>

(B) I helped my mom to clean the house.
(C) She had her students followed the rules.
(D) The review made me want to buy the product.
questions.reason_for_classification: 사역동사(let, have, make)와 준사역동사(help)의 목적격 보어 형태를 종합적으로 판단하는 문제임.

questions.question: 7. 다음 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
questions.explanation: 5번은 사역동사 let + 목적어 + 동사원형(go)으로 올바름. 1번은 목적격 her, 2번은 동사원형 ride, 3번은 동사원형 keep, 4번은 동사원형 get.

② I let my best friend rides my bike.

questions.question: 8. <보기> 안의 표현 중 하나를 제외하고 세 단어를 사용하여 문장을 완성하시오.
questions.explanation: 첫 번째 문장은 사역동사 made를 사용하여 'made me go'를 완성하고, 두 번째 문장은 let을 사용하여 'let us use'를 완성함.

Taking selfies is part of daily life for many teens, but do teens really enjoy it? To find out, we did a survey. We asked three questions to 300 students from ages 14 to 16. Let's look at the results.
Q1. Do you take selfies?
Q2. Do you use filters on your selfies to look good?
Q3. Where do you usually take selfies?
Surprisingly, 90 percent of the girls take selfies, but only 15 percent of the boys take selfies. Also, 93 percent of these students said that they use filters. The survey also showed that the students take selfies at school the most. Check out some of the students' comments.
Lewis, 14, England: Selfies are awesome.
Making silly faces is really fun!
Minwoo, 16, Korea: ⓐ<u>I enjoy taking selfies, but some students spend too much time doing it</u>.
Kate, 15, Denmark: My pictures look good when I use filters. ⓑ<u>But sometimes my selfies don't look like me</u>.
#Selfie Etiquette
You should follow (A)<u>etiquette</u> for selfies. ⓒ<u>Ask yourself these questions before you take, post, or look at selfies</u>.
1. Where am I?
Choose appropriate places to take selfies.
Don't take selfies in hospitals or public restrooms.
ⓓ<u>It may bothers other people</u>.
2. Who can see this?
Keep in mind that anyone can see your selfies.
Choose carefully when you post them.
3. What kinds of comments should I leave?
Leave nice comments on other people's selfies.
Don't be rude.
ⓔ<u>That sounds easy, isn’t it?</u> Follow these tips and have fun with your selfies!

questions.question: 35. 다음 조건에 맞게 우리말을 영작하시오.

questions.question: 36. 다음 밑줄 친 부분이 의미상 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: ② '가져올 필요가 없다'는 의미라면 don't have to/don't need to/need not이 적절하다. 하지만 bring them을 부정하는 금지의 의미(must not)가 맥락상 더 자연스럽거나, need not 자체는 문법적으로 가능하나 '불필요'를 나타냄. 단, ⑤의 '늦으면 안 된다(shouldn't)'가 매우 자연스러우므로 상대적으로 어색함을 판단해야 함. 문맥상 폰 지참 불필요를 말하는 ②는 자연스러우며, 전체적으로 틀린 곳을 찾기 힘드나, ②의 need not은 중등 과정에서 조동사로서의 쓰임이 제한적으로 다뤄지기도 함.
options: ① You <u>don’t have to</u> close the door. I’ll close it later.
② Cell phones are not allowed at school. We <u>need not</u> bring them.
③ It’s not rainy today, so you <u>don’t have to</u> bring your umbrella.
④ You <u>don’t have to</u> finish your homework by tomorrow. It is optional.
⑤ Be on time! You should come to the meeting at 2 p.m. You <u>shouldn’t</u> be late.

questions.question: 37. 윗글의 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 옳은 것은?

ⓔ He grows some plants to making his garden beautiful.
