questions.reason_for_classification: 조동사의 부정문 형성, to부정사의 형태, 주어와 동사의 수 일치 등 다양한 문법 오류를 복합적으로 찾는 문제임.

questions.question: 4. 다음 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
questions.explanation: ① now와 과거형 had to가 어울리지 않음, ② too ~ to 구문이 되어야 함(so -> too), ③ 주어가 3인칭 단수이므로 doesn't have to, ⑤ yesterday와 현재형 has to가 어울리지 않음(had to). ④ decided + to부정사의 부정(not to)은 옳음.
options: ① We had to leave now.
② I am so tired to go out.
③ He don’t have to hurry up.
④ We decided not to go to New York.
⑤ She has to walk to school yesterday.
questions.reason_for_classification: to부정사의 부정 위치 및 시제와 조동사의 일치 여부를 판단하는 문제임.

questions.question: 5. 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 문맥상 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: 기분이 좋지 않다면(isn't feeling well) 의사를 만날 '필요가 없는' 것이 아니라 만나야 하므로 have to가 적절함.
options: ① Today is a holiday. I don’t have to go to school.
② We have to study hard for our next grammar test.
③ You don’t have to tell your secret if you don’t want to.
④ She doesn’t have to see a doctor because she isn’t feeling well.
⑤ I have a new car, so I don’t have to take a bus to work anymore.
questions.reason_for_classification: don't have to(~할 필요가 없다)의 의미가 문맥 속에서 인과관계에 맞게 쓰였는지 묻는 문제임.

questions.question: 6. 다음 주어진 우리말을 영어로 옮긴 것 중, 옳은 것만을 있는 대로 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ yesterday이므로 had to, ⓓ must 뒤에 동사원형 have, ⓕ 무료이므로 낼 필요가 없다(don't have to), ⓖ Does 뒤에 동사원형 have to. 옳은 것은 ⓑ, ⓒ, ⓔ.
sentences: ⓐ 나의 형은 어제 첫 기차를 타야만 했다. (My brother has to catch the first train yesterday.)
ⓑ 당신은 신선하지 않은 음식을 먹어서는 안 돼요. (You must not eat the food which is not fresh.)
ⓒ 이곳에서 수영하는 것이 위험할 리가 없다. (It cannot be dangerous to swim here.)
ⓓ 에밀리가 계속 운다. 그녀는 문제가 생긴 게 틀림없다. (Emily keeps crying. She must has a problem.)
ⓔ 당신이 원하지 않는다면 내일 일할 필요가 없다. (You don’t have to work tomorrow if you don’t want to.)
ⓕ 당신은 아이스크림값을 내지 않아도 돼요. 무료입니다. (You must not pay for the ice crea. It’s free.)
ⓖ 그녀는 숙제를 오늘까지 해야만 하나요? (Does she has to finish her homework by today?)
questions.reason_for_classification: 조동사의 시제 일치, 형태(동사원형), 부정 의미(금지 vs 불필요)를 종합적으로 평가하는 문제임.

questions.question: 7. 다음 그림의 상황에 맞게 주어진 문장을 완성하고자 한다. 말풍선 (A)와 (B)에 들어갈 말을 <조건>에 맞게 영어로 완성하시오.
questions.explanation: (A) 늦지 않았으므로 '일어날 필요가 없다'는 의미: I don't have to get up. (6단어) / (B) 방이 더러우므로 '청소해야 한다'는 의미: You have to clean your room. (5단어)
sentences: <조건>
(A), (B) 모두 have to 표현을 반드시 사용할 것
(A)는 get, not을 사용하되, 빈칸에 6단어로만 작성할 것(축약형은 1단어로 간주함)
(B)는 room, clean을 사용하되, 5단어로만 작성할 것
questions.answer: (A) I don't have to get up. (B) You have to clean your room.
questions.reason_for_classification: 의무와 불필요의 표현(have to / don't have to)을 주어진 조건과 단어 수에 맞춰 영작하는 문제임.

questions.passage:
Jenny woke up this morning and felt really sick. She thought she might have a cold, but she wasn't sure. She decided to wait and see before making any decisions. As the day went on, Jenny started to feel better. She ______ go to the doctor. So, she went to take a yoga lesson.
* decision: 결정
questions.question: 8. 다음 글을 읽고 빈칸에 must 또는 have to를 활용하여 문맥에 맞는 문장을 완성하시오.
questions.explanation: 기분이 나아졌으므로(feel better) 의사에게 갈 필요가 없다는 내용이 되어야 함. 과거 시제이므로 didn't have to가 적합함.
questions.answer: didn't have to
questions.reason_for_classification: 지문의 시제(과거)와 전후 문맥을 파악하여 '불필요'의 의미를 가진 조동사 구문을 완성하는 문제임.

questions.question: 9. 문장을 읽고 have(has) to와 don’t(doesn’t) have to를 사용하여 문장을 완성하시오.
questions.explanation: (1) 늦지 않았으므로 서두를 '필요가 없다' (don't have to), (2) 피곤하므로 휴식을 '취해야 한다' (has to).
sentences: (1) We are not late. We _________ hury.
(2) He feels very tired. He _________ take a rest.
questions.answer: (1) don't have to (2) has to
questions.reason_for_classification: 주어의 인칭과 문맥에 따라 have to의 적절한 형태를 선택하는 기초적인 문제임.

questions.passage:
Julie: Phew, what ___(A)___ I do? I spend money too fast.
Hyun-Soo: Well, I think you ___(A)___ make a plan before you buy things.
Julie: Maybe I ___(A)___ do.
questions.question: 10. 다음 대화의 밑줄 친 (A)에 공통으로 들어가는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: 첫 문장은 의무/조언을 구하는 should, 두 번째는 조언하는 should, 세 번째는 동의하는 should가 자연스러움. (have는 뒤에 to가 필요함)

questions.passage:
Announcer=A / Sejin=S
A: Could you ⓐ<u>tell us your experience</u>?
S: Sure. ⓑ<u>I am waiting</u> for the bus with my friend, Jinho. A man suddenly fell in front of us. Nobody knew ⓒ<u>what they should do</u>. I was ⓓ<u>as scared as</u> ⓔ<u>the others</u> at first. Then, I ran to him and tapped him on the shoulder. He wasn't moving or breathing, I said to Jinho, "Call 119." and started CPR.
questions.question: 11. 위 대화의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ중 어법상 틀린 것은?
questions.explanation: 과거의 특정 시점(A man suddenly fell)에 일어난 일을 설명하고 있으므로 '버스기다리고 있었다'는 과거진행형(was waiting)이 되어야 함.
questions.reason_for_classification: 문장 전체의 시제가 과거이므로 특정 동작을 강조하는 진행형도 시제 일치에 따라 과거진행형으로 써야 함을 묻는 문제임.

questions.passage:
Rada lived on a little world, far out in space. She lived there with her father, mother, and brother Jonny. Rada’s father and other people worked ⓐ<u>on</u> spaceships. Only Rada and Jonny were children, and they were born in space.
One day, Dad told Rada and Jonny, “We (A)<u>are going</u> back ⓑ<u>to</u> Earth tomorrow.”
Rada and Jonny looked at Dad ⓒ<u>in</u> surprise and floated ⓓ<u>towards</u> him. Rada asked Dad, “What’s it ⓔ<u>like</u> on Earth?”
“Everything is different there. For example, the sky is blue,” answered Dad.
“I (B)<u>have never seen</u> a blue sky,” said Jonny.
“The sky is always black here,” said Rada.
questions.question: 12. 윗글의 밑줄 친 (A)와 쓰임이 같은 것은?
questions.explanation: (A)는 'are going back tomorrow'로 가까운 미래의 확정된 계획을 나타내는 현재진행형임. ①번 'are arriving soon' 역시 가까운 미래를 나타냄.
options: ② What is she going now?
③ What are you listening to?
④ I am going to see a doctor.
⑤ They are taking a walk in the park.
questions.reason_for_classification: 현재진행형의 용법 중 '가까운 미래 대용'으로 쓰인 경우를 구분하는 문제임.

questions.passage:
Jake: Hey! Mike, what are you going to do tomorrow? I have a lot of homework about science project. Can you help me? 
Mike: Oh, I'm sorry. I'm going to meet Jenny to watch a movie.
Jake: Really? then how about this Saturday? Do you have a special plan?
Mike: I'm so sorry again. _____________________________________________________

questions.question: 13. 다음 Mike의 계획표를 보고 <조건>에 맞게 대화를 완성하시오.
questions.explanation: 이번 토요일에 콘서트에 갈 계획이므로 'I am planning to go to a concert' 또는 'I am planning a concert' 등이 가능하나 '현재진행형'과 '동사 plan'을 사용하라는 조건에 맞춰야 함.
sentences: <조 건>
⦁현재진행형 시제로 작성할 것.
⦁동사 plan을 사용하여 문장을 완성할 것.
questions.answer: I am planning to go to a concert.
questions.reason_for_classification: 현재진행형을 사용하여 미래의 계획을 나타내는 표현을 조건에 맞게 작성하는 문제임.

questions.passage:
ⓐ <u>Seho and Jihun are talking in the hallway when Dami came over.</u> "Happy birthday!" she said to Seho. "Here. They're from my dad.” "Wow, two KBL tickets! Thanks!”
"Who are you going to take with you?" Dami asked.

questions.question: 14. 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ중 어법상 어색한 것을 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ 과거의 일(came over)이므로 were talking, ⓒ 조동사 won't 뒤에는 동사원형 go, ⓔ 병렬 구조에 따라 said와 시제를 맞춰 continued로 써야 함.
questions.reason_for_classification: 과거 시제 상황에서의 진행형 사용, 조동사 뒤 동사원형, 그리고 등위접속사로 연결된 동사의 시제 병렬 등 복합적인 어법 판단 문제임.

questions.question: 15. 다음 문장과 같은 의미가 되도록 바꾸어 쓴 것으로 옳은 것은?
questions.explanation: 3년 전부터 지금까지 계속 사랑하고 있으므로 현재완료의 계속 용법(have loved)과 기간을 나타내는 for three years가 적절함.
options: ① I loved you for three years.
② I loved you three years ago.
③ I have loved you for three years.
④ I have loved you three years ago.
⑤ I have loved you since three years.
sentences: I started to love you three years ago, and I still love you.
questions.reason_for_classification: 과거의 동작이 현재까지 이어짐을 나타내는 현재완료의 '계속' 용법과 기간 전치사(for)의 쓰임을 묻는 문제임.

questions.question: 16. 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: last week와 같은 명백한 과거 시점 부사는 현재완료와 함께 쓸 수 없으므로 과거형 lost로 써야 함.
options: ① The train has just arrived.
② I have lost my pencil last week.
③ She has lived in Seoul since 2015.
④ Have you seen this movie before?
⑤ They have never eaten Indian food.
questions.reason_for_classification: 현재완료와 명백한 과거 시점 부사(last week)의 공존 불가 원칙을 묻는 전형적인 문제임.

questions.passage:
Sumi: Hey, Junho! Did you have a good weekend?
Junho: Yeah, it was perfect. ⓐ<u>l went to a soccer game with my brother is who a big fan of FC Seoul</u>.

Sumi: We watched The Great Adventure.

questions.question: 17. 다음 대화의 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ who is ~ 순서 오류, ⓒ never의 위치 오류(have never seen), ⓓ Both A and B는 복수 취급하므로 want, ⓔ All of us로 써야 함. ⓑ는 현재 시제로 일반적인 사실을 기술하므로 적절함.

questions.question: 18. 다음 중 어법상 가장 올바른 것은?
questions.explanation: ① has just woken, ② has been sitting (완료 진행), ③ have fallen, ⑤ have lain. ④ swum은 swim의 과거분사로 has already swum은 어법상 옳음.
options: ① Jake has just woke up to do his homework.
② William has been sit at my desk since 7 o'clock.
③ The trees on the street have fell after the storm.
④ The dolphin has already swum away into the deep sea.
⑤ The students have lay on the grass for an hour to take a rest.
questions.reason_for_classification: 현재완료(have + p.p.) 구문에서 불규칙 동사의 과거분사 형태(woken, fallen, swum, lain)를 정확히 알고 있는지 묻는 문제임.

questions.passage: ⓐ<u>Have you ever see a goat on the roof of a house? In Norway, we can see animals on roofs</u>. ⓑ<u>Norway have large forests</u>. ⓒ<u>In order to live in harmony with nature, people have built wooden houses a long time ago</u>. ⓓ<u>So as to built strong and warm houses, they cover their roofs with grass</u>. The grass roofs protect them from the long cold winters and strong winds. ⓔ<u>Sometimes, trees or plants grow from the grass roofs, and some animals eat leaves of the trees or grass there.</u>
questions.question: 19. 윗글의 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 가장 옳은 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ Have you ever seen, ⓑ Norway has, ⓒ a long time ago가 있으므로 built(과거), ⓓ to build. ⓔ는 주어-동사 수 일치 및 문맥상 오류가 없는 옳은 문장임.
questions.reason_for_classification: 현재완료의 형태, 주어-동사 수 일치, 과거 시점 부사와 완료 시제의 관계, to부정사의 형태 등 기본 어법을 지문 내에서 판단하는 문제임.

questions.passage:
Kelly: Hi! Jin. Long time no see. How was your trip to Africa?
Jin: Hi! Kelly. It was so good. The weather was hot, but ⓐ<u>all the foods was very delicious.</u>
ⓑ<u>Have you ever trying cous-cous</u>?
Kelly: No, I haven't.
Jin: Really? When I visit Africa, I love eating cous-cous. It's a traditional North African dish.
Kelly: ⓒ<u>When have you first eaten it?</u>
Jin: ⓓ<u>l ate it in 2015 when I visited Egypt</u>. I had it again on a recent trip to Africa.
Kelly: Did you take some photos of the food? 
Jin: Yes, I did. ⓔ<u>Would you like to see them on my blog?</u>
Kelly: Of course!
questions.question: 20. 다음 대화의 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 옳은 문장만으로 짝지어진 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ foods는 불가산 명사 취급하여 was가 맞지만, 문맥상 복수(여러 음식들)로 쓰였다면 were이나 foods의 복수형태가 어색함. ⓑ Have you ever tried, ⓒ When은 현재완료와 함께 쓸 수 없음. ⓓ 명확한 과거 시점(in 2015)과 과거 동사 ate는 적절함. ⓔ 권유의 표현으로 적절함.

questions.passage: (A) <u>Did you ever been to or heard of Jeju-do</u>? (B) <u>Jeju Ísland is a beautiful place in South Korea who many people like to visit</u>. It has amazing Mt. Halla and lovely beaches. There are many things you can do there. (C) <u>For example, it is fun ride horses</u>. (D) <u>You can enjoy swimming at beautiful beaches</u>. Also,hiking up Mt. Halla lets you enjoy beautiful natural views. Lastly, you should try Jeju's special food by tasting different seafood dishes. (E) <u>If you have never visit leju-do, you should go there.</u>
questions.question: 21. 다음 밑줄 친 (A)~(E) 중 어법상 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: (A) Have you ever been, (B) 선행사가 사물이므로 which/that, (C) 가주어-진주어 구문에서 to ride, (E) have never visited. (D) enjoy는 동명사를 목적어로 취하며 문맥상 옳음.
questions.reason_for_classification: 현재완료의 형태, 관계대명사의 선택, 가주어-진주어 구문, 동사의 목적어 형태(동명사) 등 중등 수준의 빈출 문법 요소를 판단하는 문제임.

questions.question: 22. 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
questions.explanation: 1. Who broke (특정사건), 2. When did you (When은 완료 불가), 4. Do you think which team (간접의문문 어순 및 think류 동사의 의문사 이동 필요: Which team do you think will...), 3, 5, 6, 7은 어법상 옳음. 총 4개.
sentences: Who have broken the window?
When have you finished your investigation?
My English has improved since I moved to Canada.
Do you think which team will win the game?
How many times have you written this letter so far?
Is it OK for us to receive the finished product a week earlier?
They believed it was cruel of me to keep so many animals in one house.
questions.reason_for_classification: 현재완료와 When의 병용 금지, 간접의문문의 특수 어순, 가주어-의미상주어-진주어 구문 등 고급 어법이 섞인 개수 파악 문제임.

questions.question: 23. 다음 문장이 어법에 알맞으면 O, 알맞지 않으면 X일 때, 각 문장에 해당하는 기호를 옳게 나열한 것은?
questions.explanation: a: last year가 있으므로 X(went), b: When은 현재완료 불가 X, d: haven't turned p.p. 형태가 되어야 함 X. 옳은 것은 e, i, k. (i는 과거 시점 2 days ago와 과거형 finished가 일치함)
sentences: O X Sentence
a b I’ve gone to Jejudo last year.
c d When have you visited the city?
e f She has taught English since 2010.
g h The banana didn’t have turned brown yet.
i j I finished doing my project two days ago.
k l He has been interested in Korean culture for a long time.
questions.reason_for_classification: 현재완료 시제의 성립 조건(과거 시점 부사 유무, Since 구문) 및 부정문 형태를 O/X로 정확히 판단하는 문제임.

questions.passage:
“You don’t have to wear your big heavy space suits because there is air everywhere. (a) <u>It’s also hard to jump there because Earth pull you down</u>,” said Dad.
“What else?” asked Rada.
“(b) <u>There are hills, and it is covered with soft green grass.</u> You can roll down the hills,” answered Mom.
“Dad, have you ever rolled down a hill?” asked Rada.
“Yes, it’s really amazing!” answered Dad.
(c) <u>Jonny was thirsty, so he opened a milk container and shook it.</u> The milk floated in the air and formed balls. Jonny swallowed the balls.
“Jonny, (d) <u>if you drink milk that way on Earth, you get wet,</u>” said Mom.
Later that night, Rada and Jonny talked a long time about Earth. (e) <u>It was exciting to think about all the new things they were going to see and do</u>. There was one new thing Rada and Jonny really wanted to do. They thought about it all night and didn’t tell Mom and Dad about it. It was their secret.
The next day, Rada’s family got on a spaceship.
“It’s going to be a long trip,” said Mom.
“That’s alright. I’m so excited!” said Rada.
The spaceship finally landed.
“Dad, (가) it’s difficult to walk on Earth,” said Rada.
“I know. Earth is pulling you down,” said Dad.
Rada and Jonny couldn’t float anymore. That was the first new thing.
“What’s that sound?” asked Rada.
“A bird is singing,” said Mom.
“(나) <u>I’ve never heard a bird sing</u>,” said Rada.
“And I’ve never felt the wind,” said Jonny.
These were all new things.
Rada and Jonny ran up the nearest hill. At the top, they looked at each other and laughed. Then they lay down on the soft green grass and rolled down the hill. That was their secret!
questions.question: 24. 윗글의 밑줄 친 (나)와 같은 현재완료 용법으로 쓰인 문장은?
questions.explanation: (나)는 'never'가 포함된 '경험' 용법임. ②번의 'been to ~ twice' 역시 횟수를 나타내는 '경험' 용법임.
options: ➀ He has already eaten dinner.
➁ They have been to London twice.
➂ How have you lived in Japan?
➃ I have lost my key in my classroom.
➄ You have grown very tall since last year.
questions.reason_for_classification: 현재완료의 4가지 용법(경험, 계속, 완료, 결과) 중 '경험' 용법을 구분해내는 문제임.

questions.question: 25. 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 순서대로 알맞게 짝지어진 것은?
questions.explanation: 첫 문장은 '가버리고 지금 없다'는 결과이므로 has gone to, 두 번째 문장은 '가본 적이 있다'는 경험이므로 has been to가 적절함.
sentences: · Jihun to India. He is not here now.
· Jihun to India before. He wants to visit there again.
questions.reason_for_classification: 현재완료 '가버렸다(결과)'와 '가본 적 있다(경험)'의 핵심적 차이인 have gone to와 have been to를 구분하는 문제임.

questions.question: 26. 어법상 옳은 것은?
questions.explanation: ① last year와 현재완료 불가, ② never의 위치는 have p.p. 사이, ③ lay는 lie의 과거형이며 p.p.는 lain임, ④ last weekend와 현재완료 불가. ⑤ since last Sunday와 현재완료 계속 용법은 어법상 옳음.
options: ① I have gone to China last year.
② They never have eaten Korean food.
③ How long have you lay on the bed?
④ The students have eaten pizza last weekend.
⑤ My sister has been upset with me since last Sunday.
questions.reason_for_classification: 현재완료의 기본 시제 규칙(과거 시점 부사 불가, Since 동반 가능)과 형태적 요소(부사 위치, 불규칙 p.p.)를 점검하는 문제임.

questions.question: 27. 두 문장의 의미가 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: ② Mina still lives in Paris(지금도 살고 있다)라면 현재완료 계속 용법인 'has lived in Paris'가 되어야 하며, has begun은 '시작했다(완료/결과)'는 의미로 문맥상 어색함.
options: ① Sheila went to Japan to study a year ago, and she is still studying there. = Sheila has gone to Japan to study.
② Mina began living in Paris three years ago, and she still lives in Paris. = Mina has begun in Paris.
③ Tina got sick a week ago, and she is still sick. = Tina has been sick for a week.
④ Minsu lost his soccer shoes, so he doesn’t have them right now. = Minsu has lost his soccer shoes.
⑤ It was rainy yesterday. It is still rainy now. = It has been rainy sice yesterday.
questions.reason_for_classification: 과거와 현재를 연결하는 문장을 현재완료의 4가지 용법(결과, 계속, 완료)으로 바르게 전환할 수 있는지 묻는 문제임.

questions.question: 28. 다음 두 문장의 뜻을 모두 나타내도록 한 문장으로바꿀 때, 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: 지난 금요일부터 지금까지 계속 읽고 있는 상태이므로 현재완료 계속 용법(has read)과 시점을 나타내는 since last Friday가 적절함.
options: ① He read this book last Friday.
② He is reading this book now.
③ He's read this book since last Friday.
④ He has read this book for last Friday.
⑤ He read this book but now he doesn't read.
sentences: He started to read this book last Friday.
He is still reading this book now.
questions.reason_for_classification: 시작된 동작이 현재까지 계속됨을 나타내는 현재완료와 전치사 since의 조합을 묻는 문제임.

questions.question: 29. 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
questions.explanation: 옳은 것: She told us not to be late (5형식), Has he heard anything (의문문), Nobody expected her to bring (5형식), He's been interested (since/for), 총 4개 또는 6개 판단. rode->ridden, wore->worn, has->have, since a week->for a week 등 오류 확인.
sentences: . I've rode the horse in Jeju.
. Since when have you drank?
. I want her be honest with me.
. Have you ever wore Korean clothes?
. She told us not to be late for class.
. She hasn't had any food since a week.
. Has he heard anything from her recently?
. Jane and her friend has finished their project.
. Nobody expected her to bring her dog to the school.
. He's been interested in Korean culture for a long time.
questions.reason_for_classification: 불규칙 p.p. 형태, 5형식 목적격 보어(to부정사), 주어-동사 수 일치, 현재완료와 어울리는 전치사 등 다방면의 어법 지식을 요구함.

questions.question: 30. 다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장끼리 묶은 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓓ Just와 함께 쓰인 완료 용법, ⓔ 기간을 묻는 의문문, ⓖ 잃어버려서 지금 없다는 결과 용법. ⓐ는 1인칭이 has gone to를 쓰는 것이 어색하며, ⓑ yesterday와 함께 불가, ⓕ ago는 현재완료와 함께 불가.
sentences: ⓐ I have gone to New York.
ⓑ It has rained a lot yesterday.
ⓒ It is watered since last week.
ⓓ She has just finished her project.
ⓔ How long have you been in Korea?
ⓕ He has never eaten raw fish ago.
ⓖ She has lost her ring, so she can’t wear it now.
questions.reason_for_classification: 현재완료의 1인칭 사용 제한(결과 용법), 과거 시점 어구(yesterday, ago)와의 호응 관계를 묻는 문제임.

questions.passage:
Peter(P): What is on that piece of paper?
It looks strange.
Grandfather(G): Do you (A)______ this painting of a rooster?

questions.question: 31. 다음 글의 빈칸 (A)에 공통으로 들어갈 단어와 (B)의 표현으로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: (A)는 문맥상 '의미하다'는 뜻의 mean이 적절함. (B)는 '수년 동안 믿어왔다'는 현재완료의 계속 용법인 have believed가 적절함.

questions.question: 32. 다음 중 어법상 가장 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: five years ago는 명백한 과거 시점이므로 현재완료(have been)와 함께 쓸 수 없음. I was in Korea five years ago 등으로 써야 함.
options: ① I have been in Korea five years ago.
② When young, we used to go surfing every weekend.
③ I owe a fancy dinner to you.
④ Why don't we have an early dinner?
⑤ Two thirds of the earth's surface is water.
questions.reason_for_classification: 현재완료와 명백한 과거 시점 부사(ago)의 공존 불가 원칙을 묻는 기본 문법 문제임.

questions.question: 33. 다음 중 옳은 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓓ 과거 동사 hurt, ⓕ 현재진행형, ⓖ since 구문과 현재완료. ⓐ avoid + -ing, ⓑ up to, ⓒ ago와 현재완료 불가, ⓔ yelled at 등 전치사 필요.
sentences: ⓐ There are useful tips on how to avoid catch a cold.
ⓑ A bear can grow up two meters in height.
ⓒ I have been to Italy two years ago.
ⓓ She hurt her arm during the game.
ⓔ We yelled the top of the mountain.
ⓕ He is moving his stuff to his new office.
ⓖ It has been a year since I met him.
questions.reason_for_classification: 동명사를 목적어로 취하는 동사, 현재완료와 특정 시점 부사의 관계, 관용적인 완료 구문(It has been ~ since) 등을 고루 묻는 문제임.

questions.question: 34. 다음 두 문장이 같은 뜻이 되도록 빈칸을 채우시오. (한 칸에 한 단어)
questions.explanation: 5년 전부터 지금까지 공부하고 있으므로 현재완료 계속 용법: have studied English for five years.
sentences: I began to study English 5 years ago, and I still study English.
questions.answer: have studied / for five years
questions.reason_for_classification: 과거의 시작점이 현재까지 이어짐을 나타내는 현재완료와 기간 전치사 for를 활용하여 문장을 완성하는 문제임.

questions.passage:

questions.question: 35. 글의 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 옳은 것을 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ 감각동사 look 뒤에는 형용사 safe, ⓒ 현재완료 형태는 have watered, ⓔ How about -ing 뒤에 목적보어 형태나 전치사 관계가 어색함. ⓑ 조동사와 문맥이 적절하며, ⓓ 명령문 형태가 옳음.
questions.reason_for_classification: 2형식 감각동사의 보어, 현재완료의 형태, 조동사의 가능성 표현, 제안하기(-ing) 등 지문 내의 다양한 어법 요소를 판단하는 문제임.

questions.question: 36. 다음 빈칸 ⓐ~ⓓ에 들어갈 말로 옳은 것을 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ 과거 시점(were teenagers)이므로 met, ⓑ 30년 동안의 기간이므로 현재완료 have been, ⓒ 역접/양보의 접속사 Though, ⓓ 이유의 접속사 because.
options: ① met / have been / Though / because
② have met / have been / Though / because
③ met / have been / Because / though
④ have met / were / Because / though
sentences: Soyun is my best friend. I ⓐ__________ her when we were teenagers. We ⓑ__________ friends for thirty years. ⓒ___________ we don't always agree, we never stay angry for long ⓓ____________. we understand each other. My life is better with her every day.
questions.reason_for_classification: 과거 시점 부사와 시제 일치, 기간 전치사와 현재완료의 호응, 그리고 문맥에 맞는 부사절 접속사의 선택을 묻는 복합 문제임.

questions.question: 37. <보기>에서 어법상 옳은 것만을 있는 대로 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ last year와 현재완료 불가, ⓓ three years ago와 현재완료 불가. ⓑ yet과 함께 쓰인 부정, ⓒ since와 결합한 계속, ⓔ 가버리고 없다는 결과 용법은 모두 옳음.
sentences: <보기>
ⓐ We have been there last year.
ⓑ I haven't done it yet and I will do it tomorrow.
ⓒ He moved to Seoul and has lived there since 2010.
ⓓ She has started learning a new language three years ago.
ⓔ She has gone to work and won't come back until evening.
questions.reason_for_classification: 현재완료의 시제 제한 규칙(특정 과거 부사 불가)과 주요 용법(완료, 계속, 결과)을 개별 문장을 통해 확인하는 문제임.

questions.question: 38. 다음 중 어법상 옳은 것만을 <보기>에서 있는 대로 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: (A) I haven't had (have p.p.), (C) your friend가 3인칭 단수이므로 has, (D) for you to play (진주어 to), (F) last night이 있으므로 과거형 stayed. (B) 가주어-의미상주어(성품of)-진주어, (E) since가 있는 현재완료 계속은 옳음.
sentences: (A) I've not have a bicycle before.
(B) It was careless of you to lose your bag.
(C) How long have your friend lived with you?
(D) It is not good for you play games too much.
(E) Sam has taken care of his cat since he was ten.
(F) I've stayed up late last night to study for an exam.
questions.reason_for_classification: 가주어-진주어 구문의 의미상 주어 선택(of vs for)과 현재완료 시제의 형태 및 제한 사항을 종합적으로 묻는 문제임.

questions.question: 39. 다음 두 문장을 현재완료를 사용하여 한 문장으로 바르게 완성한 것은?
questions.explanation: ① has been (be의 p.p.), ② We have written (수 일치), ③ has worn (p.p. 형태), ⑤ since four years -> for four years. ④는 과거부터 현재까지 아는 상태이므로 'has known ~ since'가 적절함.
options: ① My sister was sick two days ago. She is still stick in bed now. → My sister has be sick in bed for two days.
② We started writing books on music a year ago. We still do. → We has written books on music for a year.
③ He wore the blue shirt yesterday. He still wears the blue shirt today. → He has wore the blue shirt since yesterday.
④ Tom met Kate when he was a middle school student. Tom still knows Kate. → Tom has known Kate since he was a middle school student.
⑤ Jiyun began to live in impo four years ago. She still lives in Gimpo. → Jiyun has lived in Gimpo since four years.
questions.reason_for_classification: 과거의 사건과 현재의 상태를 현재완료 한 문장으로 통합할 때의 동사 형태(p.p.)와 전치사(for, since) 사용의 적절성을 평가함.

questions.question: 40. ⓐ~ⓔ를 현재완료로 어법상 바르게 고친 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ Today has been, ⓑ has read (수 일치), ⓒ has lain (lie의 p.p.), ⓓ has sung (sing-sang-sung), ⓔ has taught (teach-taught). ⑤번이 p.p. 형태를 바르게 고침.
options: ② ⓑ have read -> has been read
sentences: Today ⓐwas been a happy day with lots of fun with my parents. My mom ⓑhave read me a book about pandas, and I ⓒhave lied on her knee to listen carefully to her. My dad ⓓhas sang beautiful songs with his guitar for me. He also ⓔhas teach me the ways to play songs.
questions.reason_for_classification: 현재완료 시제에서 주어에 따른 수 일치와 불규칙 동사의 과거분사(p.p.) 형태를 정확하게 수정할 수 있는지 묻는 문제임.

questions.passage: Next morning, we went to the hospital and asked the doctor to help us. I said, "He has been invisible ____(A)____ last night." The doctor said, "I can't help you. I haven't seen anything like this ____(B)____ I was born."
questions.question: 41. 어법상 (A)와 (B)에 공통으로 들어갈 단어가 빈칸에 들어갈 수 없는 것은?
questions.explanation: (A), (B)에 들어갈 말은 '~이래로'라는 뜻의 since임. ⑤번 'two months'는 기간이므로 for가 와야 함.
options: ① She has been sick __________ then.
② He has felt uneasy __________ yesterday.
③ We've been friends __________ we were ten.
④ I have waited for him __________ 6 o'clock.
⑤ We haven't met him __________ two months.
questions.reason_for_classification: 현재완료와 함께 쓰이는 since(시점/절)와 for(기간)의 차이를 구별하는 기초 문법 문제임.

questions.passage:
<보기>
How long have you learned piano?
ⓐ I have lived in Seoul since I was five.
ⓑ My sister and I have never been to Japan.
ⓒ I have known him for more than 10 years.
ⓓ They haven’t bought a new televisio yet.

questions.question: 42. ⓐ~ⓔ 중 현재완료의 쓰임이 <보기>와 같은 것끼리 짝지어진 것은?

questions.question: 43. 빈칸 ⓐ, ⓑ, ⓒ에 들어갈 단어가 알맞게 짝지어진 것은?

questions.passage: ⓐ<u>Have</u> you ever <u>watched</u> the TV cartoon The Simpsons? Maybe you are familiar with these characters. The Simpsons are an example of an American family. questions.question: 44. 밑줄 친 ⓐ와 쓰임이 같은 것은?
questions.explanation: 밑줄 친 ⓐ는 ever와 함께 쓰인 '경험' 용법임. ③번 before와 함께 쓰인 'ridden' 역시 '경험' 용법임. ① 결과, ② 완료, ④, ⑤ 계속.

② I have just finished my project.
③ She has ridden a horse before.
④ I have studied English for five years.
⑤ He has kept a diary since he was ten.
questions.reason_for_classification: 현재완료의 용법 중 '경험'을 나타내는 단서(ever, before 등)를 통해 용법을 구분하는 문제임.

questions.question: 45. 어법상 ⓐ,ⓑ에 들어갈 단어로 옳은 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ Have you p.p. 형태이므로 heard, ⓑ 앞의 명사(the one)를 수식하며 주어 역할을 하는 주격 관계대명사 that(또는 who/which)이 적절함.
questions.reason_for_classification: 현재완료 시제의 의문문 형태(p.p.)와 선행사를 수식하는 주격 관계대명사의 쓰임을 동시에 묻는 문제임.

questions.reason_for_classification: 현재완료의 4가지 용법 중 '계속' 용법(since, for 수반)을 가려내는 문제임.

questions.question: 15. 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?

• Julie has played the violin since three months.
• We have had the same car for 10 years.
• Last January, I saw snow for the first time in my life.
• She has been with her friends on the phone for more than an hour.
• He have talked to her about it last Monday.

questions.question: 16. 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?

questions.explanation: ⓑ five days ago와 함께 과거시제(finished) 적절. ⓓ since 절과 함께 현재완료(has improved) 적절. ⓐ never는 has 뒤에(has never eaten), ⓒ Have you ever watched, ⓔ when 절(과거 시점)이 있으므로 과거시제(went)를 써야 함.
sentences: ⓐ She never has eaten Greek food.
ⓑ Mike finished his work five days ago.
ⓒ Did you ever watched the movie before?
ⓓ My English has improved a lot since I moved to England.

questions.passage:
People have made cartoons for hundreds of years. There are many types of cartoons, and they play different roles. One form of cartoon is a picture with a few words. It is sometimes called a "gag cartoon." The cartoonist makes a funny character, and the character makes you laugh by doing or saying silly things.
Another type of cartoon is called a caricature. In a caricature, some parts of a character are different or bigger than usual. Artists have used this type of cartoon to make fun of well-known people.
When several cartoon pictures come together and tell a story, we have a comic strip. Comic strips ⓐ<u>has / have</u> been in newspapers for many years. They are often just amusing stories. People have also used comic strips for education. Comics can make information clearer and easier to learn. You have probably ⓑ<u>seen / saw</u> comic history or science books.
In the 1990s, a new type of cartoon was developed. It is called a webtoon. Webtoons are published online, so you can read them anytime, anywhere on your phone or computer. They are very popular, and some of them ⓒ<u>have / are</u> even made into TV dramas or movies.
New forms of cartoons may appear in the future. They could be different and even more exciting than now, but one thing will remain the same: cartoons will help us laugh, relax, and learn.

questions.question: 28. 어법상 바른 것은?
questions.explanation: ① 'I've met a movie star before'는 현재완료 경험 용법으로 완벽함. ② didn't 뒤에는 동사원형 ride가 와야 함. ③ advise + 목적어 + to부정사. ④ have known. ⑤ ask + 목적어 + not to부정사.

② He didn't have ridden a horse.

예시) cook for my family	O
(1) eat Spanish food (I)	O
(2) make a snowman (He)	X
예시) I have cooked for my family.
questions.answer: (1) I have eaten Spanish food. (2) He has never made a snowman.
questions.reason_for_classification: 표의 정보를 바탕으로 인칭에 따른 현재완료(have/has) 변화와 경험의 표현(긍정/부정)을 정확히 영작할 수 있는지 평가합니다.

questions.question: 30. 다음 한글 해석에 맞는 완전한 문장을 <조건> 에 따라 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: '3년이 흘렀다'는 Three years have passed를 주어로 하거나 It has been three years를 쓸 수 있으나, 제시어 since, pass, three와 8단어 조건을 고려하면 'Three years have passed since I left home.'이 정답입니다.
sentences: (1) 내가 집을 떠난 지 3년이 흘렀다. (since / pass / three)
<조건>
⦁대소문자 및 철자를 정확히 쓸 것
⦁주어진 단어 수에 맞춰 쓰되, 축약형은 쓰지 말 것
⦁제시된 단어를 반드시 포함하되, 필요시 변형할 것
questions.answer: Three years have passed since I left home.
questions.reason_for_classification: 현재완료 시제를 활용하여 '시간의 경과'를 나타내는 고난도 영작 문제입니다. 단어 수와 형태 변형 조건을 모두 충족해야 합니다.

questions.passage: My best friend is Subin. I ________ known her for 3 years. She is humorous. She tells me many funny jokes. She and I both like movies. So we ______ watched many movies together. I’m sure we’ll be friends forever.
questions.question: 31. 다음 글의 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 것은?
questions.explanation: 과거분사 known과 watched 앞에서 현재완료를 만드는 조동사이며, 주어가 I와 We이므로 공통으로 have가 들어갑니다.
questions.reason_for_classification: 현재완료 시제의 기본 구조인 'have + p.p.'에서 주어의 인칭에 따른 조동사 형태를 묻는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 32. 주어진 조건을 활용하여 우리말 의미에 맞는 영어 문장을 완성하시오.
questions.explanation: '말을 타본 경험이 있다'는 현재완료 경험 용법이므로 'Tom has ridden a horse before.'로 영작합니다.
sentences: Tom은 이전에 말을 타본 경험이 있다. (ride a horse, before)
<조건>
하나의 영어 문장으로 완성할 것
주어진 단어를 모두 활용하고, 필요시 변형할 것
현재 완료를 사용할 것
questions.answer: Tom has ridden a horse before.
questions.reason_for_classification: 현재완료 경험 용법과 ride의 불규칙 과거분사 형태(ridden)를 알고 있는지 확인하는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 33. 주어진 조건을 활용하여 우리말 의미에 맞는 영어 문장을 완성하시오.
questions.explanation: '영국에 다녀온 적이 있습니까?'는 현재완료 경험을 묻는 의문문이므로 'Have you ever been to England?'가 정답입니다.
sentences: 당신은 영국에 다녀온 적이 있습니까? (ever, you, to England)
<조건>
하나의 영어 문장으로 완성할 것
주어진 단어를 모두 활용하고, 필요시 변형할 것
현재 완료를 사용할 것
ever의 위치를 지킬 것
questions.answer: Have you ever been to England?
questions.reason_for_classification: 현재완료 경험 의문문에서 'have been to' 구문과 부사 ever의 위치를 평가합니다.

questions.question: 34. 다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장의 개수는?
questions.explanation: 옳은 문장: 'He's been sick...' (계속), 'It was hard...' (가주어), 'Is this possible...' (가주어 문장이지만 possible의 경우 it이 적절하므로 논란이 있으나 구조상 3개로 분류되는 경우가 많음. 그러나 'Is it possible'이 표준임). 명확히 옳은 것은 1, 5번 2개임. 2번은 when과 현재완료 불가, 3번은 traveled, 4번은 has just arrived. 따라서 2개로 보는 것이 합당함.
sentences: ∘ He's been sick since last night.
∘ When have you visited the city?
∘ Have you ever travel to Canada?
∘ He have just arrived at the airport.
∘ It was hard for her to understand him.
∘ Is this possible for you to get tickets of the match?
questions.reason_for_classification: 현재완료의 시점 제한, 형태, 수 일치 및 가주어 구문의 적절성을 묻는 복합적인 문제입니다.

questions.question: 35.  대화의 밑줄 친 한국어 문장 ⓐ와 뜻이 같도록 <조건>을 반드시 지켜 영작하시오. (<조건>을 지키지 않을 경우 감점)
questions.explanation: '초등학교 이후로'는 since elementary school이며, '가장 친한 친구들이다'라는 상태가 계속되므로 현재완료 계속 용법을 써서 'They have been best friends since elementary school.'이 됩니다.
sentences: <조건>
- 현재완료 계속적 용법을 사용할 것
- best friends를 사용할 것

questions.reason_for_classification: 현재완료 계속 용법(have been)과 since의 조합을 활용하여 문맥에 맞는 문장을 영작하는 능력을 평가합니다.

questions.question: 36. 다음 밑줄 친 부분의 용법이 같은 것을 두 개 고르면?
questions.explanation: ① 경험(tried before), ③ 경험(several times). ② 계속, ④ 완료, ⑤ 결과입니다.
options: ① I have not tried Swedish food before.
② She has worked for this company since 1998.
③ They have visited this place several times.
④ He has just uploaded his homework on the website.
⑤ He has lost his key, so he can’t get into the house.
questions.reason_for_classification: 현재완료의 네 가지 용법 중 '경험'에 해당하는 문장들을 골라내는 문제입니다.

questions.passage:

questions.question: 37. 윗글의 밑줄 친 (A)의 쓰임과 같은 것은?
questions.explanation: (A) 'haven't felt'는 지금까지 바람을 느껴본 적이 없다는 '경험' 용법입니다. ④ 'have fought... many times'도 횟수를 나타내는 말과 함께 쓰인 경험 용법입니다. ① 결과, ② 완료, ③ 계속, ⑤ 계속입니다.

questions.passage:

questions.question: 38. 윗글의 밑줄 친 (B)와 쓰임이 같은 것은?
questions.explanation: (B) 'have never seen'은 과거부터 지금까지 한 번도 본 적이 없다는 '경험' 용법입니다. ② 'have seen... three times'도 횟수를 나타내는 말과 쓰인 경험 용법입니다. ① 계속, ③ 완료(부정), ④ 완료, ⑤ 결과(망각하여 지금 모름)입니다.

questions.question: 39. 우리말과 의미가 같도록 괄호 안의 단어들을 모두 배열하여 문장을 완성할 때, 세 번째 오는 단어는?
questions.explanation: 'Have you ever heard of beach safety rules?'(또는 have you heard of safety rules of beach 등)를 배열하면, 'Have(1) you(2) heard(3) of(4)...' 순서가 되므로 세 번째 단어는 heard입니다.
sentences: 너 바닷가 안전 수칙에 대해 들어 본 적 있니?
[safety, of, have, heard, rules, you, beach, ?]

questions.question: 40. 두 문장을 요약한 문장으로 가장 알맞은 것은?
questions.explanation: 3년 전에 일본으로 이사해서 지금도 살고 있으므로, 3년 동안 일본에 살고 있다는 현재완료 계속 용법이 적절합니다. 'Sera has lived in Japan for three years.'
options: ① Sera has never lived in Japan.
② Sera has already lived in Japan.
③ Sera lived in Japan for three years.
④ Sera has lived in Japan for three years.

questions.reason_for_classification: 두 개의 시점(과거, 현재)을 나타내는 문장을 하나의 현재완료 계속 용법 문장으로 통합하여 요약하는 능력을 평가합니다.

questions.question: 41. 어법상 바른 문장만 묶인 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ 계속 용법 적절. ⓓ 결과 용법 적절. ⓗ 경험(부정) 적절. ⓑ 주어 복수이므로 have, ⓒ never는 has 뒤에, ⓔ last weekend와 완료 불가, ⓕ three days ago와 완료 불가, ⓖ when과 완료 불가.

ⓑ They has tried Italian food many times.
ⓒ He never has learned to play the piano.
ⓓ He has lost his cell phone.
ⓔ I have heard the news last weekend.
ⓕ Have you visited your grandparents three days ago?
ⓖ When has she played the violin?
ⓗ She has not been to the museum before.
questions.reason_for_classification: 현재완료 시제의 다양한 오류 유형(수 일치, 빈도부사 위치, 과거 시점 부사와의 병용 금지 등)을 완벽히 이해해야 풀 수 있는 복합 문제입니다.

questions.question: 42. 밑줄 친 부분의 용법이 나머지와 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: ④ 'have gone to'는 '~에 가버렸다(그래서 여기 없다)'는 결과 용법입니다. 나머지는 모두 '~해본 적이 있다'는 경험 용법입니다.
options: ① She has been to Canada.
② He has watched the movie before.
③ I have never tried Thai food.
④ They have gone to the United States.
⑤ Have you ever driven his car?
questions.reason_for_classification: 현재완료의 '경험' 용법들 사이에서 '결과' 용법(have gone to)을 구분해낼 수 있는지 묻는 전형적인 문제입니다.

questions.question: 43. 밀줄 친 ⓐ~ⓕ중 어법상 틀린 것의 개수는?
questions.explanation: ⓑ have searched (p.p.), ⓓ to take (목적), ⓕ it was (단수 지칭). 틀린 것은 3개입니다. ⓐ, ⓒ, ⓔ는 적절합니다.
questions.reason_for_classification: 현재완료 형태, to부정사 용법, 수 일치, 감각동사 뒤 형용사 등 교과 과정 내 주요 문법 사항들을 지문 속에서 찾아내는 종합적인 평가입니다.

questions.passage:

questions.question: 44. (가)를 <조건>에 맞게 영어로 쓰시오.

sentences: (가)나는 결코 거기에(그곳에)가 본 적이 없어, 하지만 나는 거기에(그곳에) 이번 여름에 갈 거야.

questions.reason_for_classification: 현재완료의 경험 용법(부정)과 미래 시제 문장을 접속사 but으로 대조하여 영작하는 능력을 확인합니다.

questions.question: 45. 다음 중 우리말을 영작한 것이 옳은 것은?
questions.explanation: ④ '보았다(경험)'를 현재완료 have seen으로 옳게 영작함. ①은 '10년 동안'이므로 has lived. ②는 '언제'를 묻는 의문문이므로 Did you visit(과거). ③은 seen. ⑤는 '작년'이 있으므로 graduated(과거).
options: ① 그녀는 NY에서 10년 동안 살고 있다. → She lived in NY ten years ago.
② 너는 그 도시를 언제 방문했니? → When have you visited the city?
③ 나는 1996년 이래로 Jake를 본 적이 없다. → I've never saw Jake since 1996.
④ 그들은 그 영화를 여섯 번이나 보았다. → They have seen the movie six times.
⑤ 그들은 작년에 고등학교를 졸업했다. → They have graduated from high school last ear.
questions.reason_for_classification: 영작된 문장의 시제 적절성(현재완료 vs 과거)을 비교 분석하는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 46. 다음 중 어법상 맞는 것의 개수는?
questions.explanation: 옳은 문장: 'Do not pull...' (명령문), 'It was careless...' (의미상 주어 of), 'It is true...' (가주어-진주어) 총 3개입니다. 틀린 문장: a hundred years ago가 있으므로 was(과거), It's difficult 'for' him, pulls you down (대명사 목적어 위치), since last year가 있으므로 has written(완료).
sentences: ㆍDo not pull down the safety bar.
ㆍLife has been different a hundred years ago.
ㆍIt's difficult of him to answer the question.
ㆍIt was careless of her to leave the key in the car.
ㆍYou can't jump well because Earth pulls down you.
ㆍIt is true that she met the beggar at the park.
ㆍHe wrote many creative short stories since last year.
questions.reason_for_classification: 명령문, 시제(완료 vs 과거), to부정사 의미상 주어(for/of), 이어동사 어순, 가주어 구문 등 다채로운 문법 요소를 점검하는 종합 평가입니다.

questions.question: 47. 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
questions.explanation: ⑤ 'for two hours'와 함께 '시청해오고 있다'는 현재완료 진행(has been watching)이 적절함. ① been friends 'since' last year. ② have -> has (단수 주어). ③ know는 상태동사이므로 진행형을 쓰지 않고 현재완료(has known)로 씀. ④ 'for 3 years'가 적절함.
options: ① We've been being friends last year.
② The girl have been laughing this morning.
③ He's been knowing the teacher since 2019.
④ I've been going to this school since 3 years.
⑤ My family has been watching this TV program for two hours.
questions.reason_for_classification: 현재완료 진행형의 쓰임과 그 제약(상태동사 불가), 그리고 시간 부사구(for/since)와의 호응 관계를 묻는 고난도 문제입니다.

questions.question: 48. <보기>의 우리말 뜻이 되도록 괄호 안의 단어를 모두 이용하여 문장을 완성하시오. (필요시 단어의 형태를 바꿀 수 있음)
questions.explanation: '나에게 말해줬다'는 told me, '비행기를 타본 적이 없다'는 (그 전까지의 경험이므로) had never flown이나 had not flown이 적절하나, 중2 수준에서 현재완료 대화 속 상황을 묻는다면 'Jack told me that he has never flown' 등이 가능하나 문맥상 과거에 말한 시점 이전의 경험이므로 과거완료(had never flown)가 가장 정확합니다. 단, 문제 취지가 현재완료 단원이면 has never flown을 의도했을 수 있습니다.
sentences: <보기>
Jack은 그가 전에 비행기를 타본 적이 없었다고 나에게 말해줬다. (tell / fly)
questions.answer: told me that he had never flown
questions.reason_for_classification: 주절이 과거(told)일 때 종속절의 시제 일치 및 과거 이전의 경험(과거완료)을 표현하는 능력을 평가합니다.

questions.question: 49. <보기>의 두 문장을 한 문장으로 쓰려고 할 때 가장 올바른 것은?
questions.explanation: 2년 전부터 지금까지 계속 일하고 있으므로 현재완료 계속 용법과 기간의 전치사 for를 사용한 ①이 가장 적절합니다.
options: ① Ms. Kim has worked with us for two years.
② Ms. Kim has worked with us since two years.
③ Ms. Kim has worked with us for two years ago.
④ Ms. Kim has begun to work with us two years ago.
⑤ Ms. Kim has begun to work with us for two years ago.
sentences: <보기>
Ms. Kim began to work with us two years ago.
Ms. Kim still works with us.
questions.reason_for_classification: 과거에 시작된 동작이 현재까지 계속됨을 나타내는 현재완료 계속 용법의 문장 구성을 평가합니다.

questions.passage:
[ Jihun : Selfie safety ]
These selfies look great, but were they a good idea? I don't think so. They don't look safe. You should take special care when you take selfies in the wild or at high places like these. A monkey could bite you at any time, or you could fall.      Here are some safety tips:
1. Don't take selfies while you're walking.
2. Do not pose with or near wild animals.
3. Never take selfies in dangerous places.
[Soyun] Selfies for a Better School Life
I think we can use selfies to make a better school life. We can do good things at school and take selfies. Then we can post the photos on our school website. I've watered the plants and flowers at school for one month. (A) <u>I've also helped the teacher at the school library many times</u>. Look at my selfies of those things. How about joining me to create a better school life?
questions.question: 50. 다음 글을 읽고 밑줄 친 (A)의 쓰임과 같은 것은?
questions.explanation: (A) 'have helped... many times'는 횟수를 나타내어 '경험' 용법으로 쓰였습니다. ③ 'never been to' 역시 경험 용법입니다. ① 결과, ② 결과, ④ 계속, ⑤ 완료입니다.
options: ① They have gone to Italy.
② Kevin has lost his favorite shoes.
③ Emma has never been to U.K. before.
④ Daniel has lived in Korea since he was 20.
⑤ We have already finished our history homework.
questions.reason_for_classification: 지문 내 현재완료 용법(경험)을 정확히 분석하고, 이와 동일한 용법으로 쓰인 보기를 찾는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 1. 어법상 올바른 것은?
questions.explanation: ②는 현재완료의 경험 용법으로 올바른 문장입니다. ①은 의문사가 있는 현재완료 의문문에서 When은 현재완료와 함께 쓸 수 없으며, ③ yesterday, ④ in 1990, ⑤ last summer와 같이 명백한 과거 시점을 나타내는 표현은 현재완료와 함께 쓸 수 없습니다.
options: ① When you have seen her?
② I have never seen her so sad.
③ I have called you twice yesterday.
④ My father has become a doctor in 1990.
⑤ I have gone to Italy for a vacation last summer.
questions.reason_for_classification: 현재완료 시제의 기본 형태와 특정 과거 시점 부사구(yesterday, in+연도, last 등)와의 병행 불가 규칙을 묻는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 2. 다음 중 문법적으로 바르지 못한 문장의 개수는?
questions.explanation: 바르지 못한 문장은 'He hasn't meet (-> met)', 'Mel has lived... since 6 months (-> for 6 months)'로 총 2개입니다.
sentences: ㆍHe hasn't meet him before.
ㆍHow long has he known you?
ㆍEmily has had mint-flavored ice cream.
ㆍMel has lived in Boryeong since 6 months.
questions.reason_for_classification: 현재완료의 형태(have+p.p.)와 계속 용법에서 전치사 for(기간)와 since(시점)의 구별을 묻는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 3. 다음 밑줄 친 부분이 보기와 같은 의미로 사용된 것은?
questions.explanation: 보기의 have been... since는 현재완료의 '계속' 용법입니다. ④ has fought... for와 ⑤ have not slept... for 역시 기간을 나타내는 표현과 함께 쓰인 계속 용법입니다. 선택지 중 계속 용법에 해당하는 ④ 또는 ⑤가 정답이 될 수 있으나, 전형적인 기간 표현인 ④가 가장 적절합니다.
options: ① I have studied this book twice.
② We haven't bought the watch yet.
③ He has lost his car key in the room.
④ She has fought with her brother for 20 minutes.
⑤ Jinsu and Min have not slept for more than five hours.
sentences: They <u>have been</u> best friends since elementary school.
questions.reason_for_classification: 현재완료의 네 가지 용법(경험, 계속, 완료, 결과) 중 '계속' 용법을 구분하는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 4. 어법상 적절하지 않은 문장은?
questions.explanation: ⑤에서 'since 2022'와 함께 쓰여 상태의 계속을 나타내려면 현재완료 형태인 'has been sick'이 되어야 합니다. 'has sick'은 문법적으로 틀린 형태입니다.
options: ① I have been to Busan.
② What have you done today?
③ She has never written a book.
④ Have you ever seen a rainbow?
⑤ My father has sick since 2022.
questions.reason_for_classification: 현재완료의 계속 용법에서 be동사의 완료 형태(has been) 누락을 묻는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 5. 우리말 의미에 맞도록 주어진 단어를 재배열하여 문장을 만들 때, 어법상 바르게 영작할 수 있는 것은? (대소문자 구분 없음)
questions.explanation: ④ 'I had studied English for more than two years before I moved to New York.'는 과거의 특정 시점(moved)보다 이전부터의 계속된 동작을 나타내는 과거완료 용법으로 올바릅니다. ① had gone, ② had never seen 등으로 시제 수정이 필요합니다.
options: ① Cathy는 서울로 이사 가기 전에 종종 낚시하러 가곤 했었다.
② 나는 Kate가 작년까지 눈을 본 적이 없었다고 들었다.
③ 그 선생님이 교실로 들어왔을 때, Ben은 벌써 그의 간식을 다 먹었다.
④ 나는 뉴욕으로 이사 가기 전에 2년 넘게 영어 공부를 했었다.
⑤ 그는 그의 돈을 다 써버려서 그 영화표를 살 수 없었다.
sentences: (often / before / Cathy / she / go / moved / to / Seoul / fishing / .)
(year / Kate / has / I / heard / that / never / snow / seen / last / until / .)
(Ben / teacher / when / the / the / comes / into / had / classroom / snack / already / eaten / his / . / ,)
(to / two / English / I / I / studied / for / than / years / before / moved / New York / more / had / .)
(all / had / movie / buy / the / his / ticket / can’t / of / spent / since / he / he / money / .)
questions.reason_for_classification: 기준이 되는 과거 시점보다 앞선 일을 나타내는 과거완료(had+p.p.) 시제의 올바른 사용을 묻는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 6. 다음 중 쓰임이 바른 문장의 개수는?
questions.explanation: 바른 문장은 'I had never had...', 'The man had already drunk...' 등 2개입니다. 1번은 시제 불일치, 4번은 is(현재)와 hadn't cleaned(과거완료)의 조합이 어색하며, 5번은 has just started를 had just started로 고쳐야 합니다.
sentences: - Ben had felt better after he took the test.
- Where did he live before he came to Korea?
- I had never had Mexican food before I visited Mexico.
- My house is dirty because I hadn't cleaned it for weeks.
- The movie has just started when I arrived at the theater,
- The man had already drunk all his coffee by the time she got there.
questions.reason_for_classification: 과거의 특정 시점을 기준으로 그 이전에 완료된 동작을 나타내는 과거완료 시제의 쓰임을 종합적으로 묻는 문제입니다.

questions.passage: Green City Ideas So many ideas (A)present by the Earth Savers Club. In the restaurants, food is served on small plates. Food waste (B)reduce this way. At every house, rainwater is stored in the tanks. Water is saved this way.
questions.question: 7. 다음 (A), (B)를 어법상 알맞게 고친 것은?
questions.explanation: 주어인 ideas와 Food waste는 각각 제시되고 줄어드는 대상이므로 수동태(be+p.p.)를 써야 합니다. (A)는 복수이므로 are presented, (B)는 단수이므로 is reduced가 적절합니다. 선택지 중 (A) were presented (과거)와 (B) is reduced (현재)의 조합인 ④번이 문맥상 가능합니다.
questions.reason_for_classification: 수동태의 기본 형태(be+p.p.)와 주어와의 수 일치를 묻는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 8. 주어진 우리말과 같은 의미가 되도록 5단어를 써서 문장을 완성하십시오.
questions.explanation: 많은 나무가 '잘려 나간다'는 현재의 수동태를 나타내며, 주어인 A lot of trees가 복수이므로 'are cut down to make'가 정답입니다.
sentences: <조건>
- 괄호 안에 주어진 단어를 모두 사용할 것
- 필요시 단어의 형태를 변화시킬 것
많은 나무가 종이를 만들기 위해 잘려 나간다.
→ A lot of trees ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ paper.(be, cut down)
questions.answer: are cut down to make
questions.reason_for_classification: 현재 시제 수동태와 부사적 용법의 to부정사를 결합하여 영작하는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 9. 다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓒ (항상 엄마에 의해 세탁된다)와 ⓓ (그녀에 의해 나를 위해 만들어졌다)가 수동태 문장으로 올바릅니다. ⓐ I was sent a strange letter (to 삭제), ⓑ cannot be seen (be 누락), ⓔ disappointed with (전치사 오류)입니다.
sentences: ⓐ I was sent to a strange letter.
ⓑ Stars cannot see by the rain.
ⓒ The laundry is always done by Mom.
ⓓ A mushroom pizza was made for me by her.
ⓔ She was very disappointed to her new secretary.
questions.reason_for_classification: 수동태의 기본 형태, 조동사 수동태, 4형식 문장의 수동태 전환 및 감정 수동태의 전치사를 묻는 종합적인 문제입니다.

questions.passage:
Interviewer: The results of your research ⓐ<u>were published</u> as a book in Korea in 1990. Many Koreans paid more attention to Uigwe because of your book.
Dr. Park: Yes. In 1992, the Korean government asked the French government for its return and, finally, the 297 books are here now.
Interviewer: Before I finish this interview, I’d like to ask you about Jikji, a book that ⓑ<u>was changed</u> the history of printing.
Dr. Park: I found it in my first year at the library. I knew right away that it was very special. I worked hard to prove its value and finally ⓒ<u>was succeeded</u>. At a book exhibition in Paris in 1972, Jikji ⓓ<u>was displayed</u> as the oldest book in the world that was printed with movable metal type.
Interviewer: Dr. Park, thanks to your hard work, Jikji and Uigwe ⓔ<u>was found</u>, and all Koreans thank you for that.
Dr. Park: I hope people will care more about our national treasures abroad and work for their return.
questions.question: 10. 윗글의 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 옳은 것을 두 개 고르면?
questions.explanation: ⓐ '결과가 출판되었다' (복수 주어 were p.p.)와 ⓓ '직지가 전시되었다' (단수 주어 was p.p.)가 어법상 옳습니다. ⓑ는 능동태 changed, ⓒ는 자동사 능동태 succeeded, ⓔ는 복수 주어이므로 were found로 고쳐야 합니다.
questions.reason_for_classification: 문맥에 따른 능동태/수동태의 구별 및 수동태의 수 일치를 묻는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 11. <보기>처럼 바꿔 쓸 수 있는 문장은?
questions.explanation: 보기는 타동사 문장을 수동태로 바꾼 것입니다. ⑤ visit은 타동사로 'The Great Wall of China is visited by many people every year'로 수동태 전환이 가능합니다. ①~④는 모두 자동사이거나 수동태로 쓰지 않는 동사들입니다.
options: ① I arrived at the airport at midnight.
② The world’s richest man disappeared.
③ The Olympics take place every four years.
④ A terrible accident happened at the corner.
⑤ Many people visit the Great Wall of China every year.
sentences: <보기>
My father fixed the computer.
→ The computer was fixed by my father.
questions.reason_for_classification: 수동태가 가능한 문장(타동사 문장)과 불가능한 문장(자동사 문장)을 구별하는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 12. <보기> 중 밑줄 친 부분이 어법상 옳은 문장만을 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓑ (명령받았다), ⓒ (이송되었다), ⓓ (만들어진다)가 수동태로 옳게 쓰였습니다. ⓐ는 was found, ⓔ는 was composed가 되어야 합니다.
sentences: <보기>
ⓐ My car found on the street yesterday.
ⓑ I got a ticket for speeding. When I went to traffic court, I was ordered to pay $100.
ⓒ There was a terrible accident last nigt. A lot of people were taken to the hospital.
ⓓ More than 30,000 new computers are made every month in China.
ⓔ How old was Mozart when his first symphony composed?
questions.reason_for_classification: 수동태의 기본 형태(be+p.p.)의 올바른 사용 여부를 묻는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 13. 다음 중 주어진 능동태 문장을 수동태 문장으로 바르게 전환하여 쓴 것은?
questions.explanation: ⑤ 'The professor used the computer...'를 수동태로 바꾸면 'The computer was used by the professor...'가 되어 올바릅니다. ① were turned (p.p. 오류), ② made by (전치사 오류), ③ was written (수 일치), ④ invented by (by 누락)입니다.
options: ① My dad turned off the lights. → The lights were turn off by my dad.
② King Sejong made Hangeul. → Hangeul was made of King Sejojng.
③ Mary wrote the report last month. → The report were written by Mary last month.
④ Alexander Graham Bell invented the telephone. → The telephone was invented Alexander Graham Bell.
⑤ The professor used the computer for two days. → The computer was used by the professor for two days.
questions.reason_for_classification: 능동태 문장을 수동태 문장으로 전환할 때 be동사 시제/수 일치 및 p.p. 형태, 전치사 사용의 정확성을 묻는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 14. 우리말을 영어로 가장 적절하게 옮겨 쓴 것은?
questions.explanation: ② 'not only A but also B' 구문을 사용하여 'He is good at not only basketball but also baseball.'로 올바르게 영작되었습니다. ① were attacked (수동태 형태), ③ Someone was felt to touch (5형식 수동태), ④ was seen stealing/to steal (지각동사 수동태), ⑤ was cooked for (전치사 오류)입니다.
options: ① 오리 몇 마리가 야생 늑대들에 의해 공격받았다. →Some ducks were attacking by wild wolves.
② 그는 농구뿐만 아니라 야구도 잘한다. →He is good at not only basketball but also baseball.
③ 누군가가 그녀의 주머니를 만지는 것이 그녀에 의해 느껴졌다. Someone was felt touch her pocket by her.
④ 그 강도가 그의 지갑을 훔치는 것이 그에 의해 목격되었다. → The robber was seen stolen his wallet by him.
⑤ 그 손님들에게 그 세프에 의해 맛있는 식사가 요리되었다 →A delicious meal was cooked to the guests by the chef.
questions.reason_for_classification: 상관접속사 구문과 다양한 형식(3, 4, 5형식)의 수동태 전환 규칙을 복합적으로 묻는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 15. 어법상 적절한 문장을 <보기>에서 있는 대로 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓒ (사랑받는다), ⓕ (만들어지고 사용된다), ⓖ (지도받았다), ⓗ (이야기를 들었다)가 어법상 적절합니다. ⓐ for me, ⓑ sent to him, ⓓ given, ⓔ taught, ⓘ held로 고쳐야 합니다.
sentences: <보기>
ⓐ A book was bought to me by Mom.
ⓑ Tickets for the opera were sent him.
ⓒ The rose is loved by the Little Prince.
ⓓ Freedom is not gave for us by anyone.
ⓔ Stella will be teached by him next year.
ⓕ Computers are made and used by people.
ⓖ Students were guided by the teacher in English.
ⓗ We were told the scary story by our grandmother.
ⓘ A special meeting was holded by Mr. Kim last night.
questions.reason_for_classification: 수동태의 불규칙 과거분사 형태와 4형식 수동태의 전치사 사용을 묻는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 16. 우리말 (A)와 의미가 일치하도록 주어진 조건에 맞게 가장 바르게 영작한 것은?

questions.passage:
Singapore is hot throughout the year. Most buildings need air conditioning, which uses a lot of energy and contributes to climate change. That’s why architects in Singapore have begun to design eco-friendly buildings that use less air conditioning but are still cool inside. For example, many buildings in Singapore are (A) [designed/designing] to have an open structure. This structure makes it possible for outside air to move throughout a building. Eco-friendly buildings like these not only help protect the environment, but also [provide/providing] people with a good quality of life. Those are the goals of this new style of architecture. Hopefully, architects will keep coming up with new eco-friendly ideas.

questions.reason_for_classification: 시제 일치, 분사구문의 능동 형태, 사역동사의 목적격 보어 등 기초 문법과 분사 구문을 종합적으로 묻는 문제임.

questions.question: 36. 다음 중 밑줄 친 단어의 쓰임이 옳지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: ② '너'가 결과에 대해 실망을 느낀 것이므로 과거분사 'disappointed'가 적절함. ① 'be busy -ing', ③ 'unfriendly(형용사)', ④ 'rather than -ing', ⑤ 'be worked out(수동태)'는 모두 적절함.
options: ① Jane <u>is busy doing</u> many jobs these days.
② I understand why you'<u>re so disappointing</u> at the result.
③ I don't go to that store because the clerks <u>are unfriendly</u>.
④ I prefer calling <u>rather than texting</u>.
⑤ The matter must <u>be worked out</u> first.
questions.reason_for_classification: 감정 분사의 능동/수동(-ing/-ed) 구별 및 동명사 관용 표현을 확인하는 문제임.

questions.question: 37. 다음 문장의 빈칸에 알맞은 단어가 순서대로 짝지어진 것은?
questions.explanation: a. 수학(사물)이 흥미를 주는 것이므로 'interesting', b. 그(사람)가 걱정을 느끼는 것이므로 'worried', c. 영화(사물)가 지루함을 주는 것이므로 'boring', d. 그녀(사람)가 무서움을 느끼는 것이므로 'scared'가 적절함.
sentences: a. Math is difficult, but it’s ____, too.
b. He is ____ about his mom in the hospital.
c. The movie was so ____ that I fell asleep.
d. She was ____ of walking home in the dark.
questions.reason_for_classification: 감정 유발(-ing)과 감정 느낌(-ed)을 구별하는 전형적인 감정 분사 문제임.

questions.passage:
Sally: James, why are you still up? It’s 11 o’clock!
James: I can’t sleep because I’m ⓐ<u>worried</u> about the Bookworm Competition tomorrow.
Sally: You ⓑ<u>have read</u> all of the books on the list. What do you have to worry about?
James: Some of the writers’ names are ⓒ<u>confused</u>, so I’m worried that I might not remember them.
Sally: Don’t worry about something that ⓓ<u>hasn’t happened</u> yet. You’ll do fine.
James: Thanks. I’ll try ⓔ<u>not to worry</u> so much.
questions.question: 38.  대화의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓒ 작가들의 이름(사물)이 혼란을 주는 것이므로 현재분사 'confusing'이 적절함. ⓐ 감정의 과거분사, ⓑ 현재완료 완료 용법, ⓓ 현재완료 부정형, ⓔ to부정사의 부정 위치는 모두 옳음.
questions.reason_for_classification: 감정 분사의 태(사물 주어일 때 -ing)와 현재완료, 부정사 부정의 위치를 묻는 문제임.

questions.passage: Have you heard of the expression, "Art imitates nature"? ⓐ<u>Many artists get their ideas and inspirations from the world around it</u>. This is because the natural world is a beautiful place. ⓑ<u>The shapes in nature are very pleasing to the eye</u>. For example, look at the egg. It is round and delicate, but it is so strong that it can protect its contents. ⓒ<u>Can you imagine a building that look like an egg</u>? Such a building actually exists in London. Nature has inspired many architects around the world. This is the Sagrada Familia in Spain. ⓓ<u>It is one of the most famous churches in the world</u>. Look at the beautiful tall columns inside the church. They look like trees, don't they? ⓔ<u>The famous architect, Antoni Gaudi, used the shape of trees in the Sagrada Familia</u>. That's how he brought the beauty of nature indoors.
questions.question: 39. 윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 어법상 옳은 것만을 있는 대로 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓑ 'pleasing(즐거움을 주는)', ⓓ 'one of the 최상급 복수명사(churches)', ⓔ 'used(과거시제)'는 모두 옳음. ⓐ 'it'은 'many artists' 또는 'the world' 문맥상 복수인 'them'이 되어야 하며, ⓒ 'look'은 선행사가 단수(a building)이므로 'looks'가 되어야 함.

questions.passage:
Have you heard of the expression, "Art imitates nature?" Many artists get their ideas and inspirations from the world around them. This is (A) why / because the natural world is a beautiful place. The shapes in nature are very pleased to
the eye. For example, look at the egg on the left. Isn't it beautiful? It is round and looks (B) fragile/sturdy. Yet it is enough strong to protect its contents. Can you imagine a building that looks like an egg? Such a building actually exists in London. Nature has inspired many architects around the world. This is the Sagrada Familia in Spain. It is one of the most famous church in the world. Look at the beautiful tall columns inside the church. They look like trees, don't they? The famous architect, Antoni Gaudi, used the shape of trees in the Sagrada Familia. That's how he brought the beauty of nature (C) indoors/outdoors.
questions.question: 40. 어법상 틀린 부분을 세 군데 찾아 쓰고 바르게 고치시오. (본문의 내용은 바꾸지 말 것)
questions.explanation: (1) 자연의 모양(사물)이 즐거움을 주는 것이므로 'pleasing'이 되어야 함. (2) '형용사+enough' 순서이므로 'strong enough'가 되어야 함. (3) 'one of the + 복수명사'이므로 'churches'가 되어야 함.
sentences: <틀린 것>	<고친 것>
questions.answer: (1) pleased -> pleasing (2) enough strong -> strong enough (3) church -> churches
questions.reason_for_classification: 분사의 능동적 수식(pleasing), 어순(enough), 수 일치(one of the 복수명사) 등 기초 문법과 분사를 통합 평가함.

questions.question: 41. 다음 분사구문 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수가 많은 순서대로 묶은 것은?
questions.explanation: (A)는 3문장 모두 옳음(완료분사구문, 수동분사구문). (B)는 비인칭 주어 it을 생략하지 않은 'It being rainy'가 되어야 하며 'Not getting' 순서가 되어야 하므로 1문장(Saving...)만 옳음. (C)는 'Having finished', 'Excited'로 고쳐야 하므로 1문장(Hoping...)만 옳음. 정답은 1번임.
sentences: (A)  Sent yesterday, the letter arrived today.
 Having seen the results, he felt relieved.
 Being invited to the party, she was very happy.
(B)  Being rainy yesterday, I stayed inside all day.
 Getting not enough sleep, she had a headache.
 Having saved enough money, she had bought a new car.
(C)  Finished his homework, he went out to play.
 Exciting by the news, she couldn't sleep all night.
 Hoping to pass the exam, he studied late into the night.
questions.reason_for_classification: 분사구문의 완료형, 수동형, 부정 위치 및 독립분사구문(주어 다름)을 정확히 알고 있는지 평가함.

questions.passage: ⓐ[Are / Being] very powerful and dangerous, volcanoes do harm to people in many ways. Sometimes people get hurt, or they may lose their houses. Crops may ⓑ[be / have] destroyed, and air traffic can be threatened. Volcanoes can also have serious effects on world weather. A volcanic eruption shoots lots of ash and dust into the air, ⓒ[prevented / preventing] some of the sunlight from reaching Earth and thus disturbing usual weather patterns.
questions.question: 42. ⓐ, ⓑ, ⓒ의 각 네모 안에서 어법에 맞는 말을 선택하여 바르게 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: ⓐ 문장의 주어(volcanoes)에 연결되는 분사구문이므로 'Being', ⓑ 조동사 뒤 수동태 형태인 'be destroyed', ⓒ 결과나 부대상황을 나타내는 분사구문으로 능동의 'preventing'이 적절함.
questions.reason_for_classification: 분사구문의 기본 형태와 수동태, 그리고 부대 상황을 나타내는 현재분사 구문을 묻는 문제임.

questions.question: 43. 다음 두 문장의 의미를 같게 할 때, 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
questions.explanation: 부사절(While she walked...)을 분사구문으로 전환하면 접속사와 주어를 생략하고 동사를 현재분사 형태로 바꾼 'Walking in the grass'가 적절함.
options: ③ To walk in the grass
④ She walked in the grass
⑤ While walked in the grass
sentences: · While she walked in the grass, she was bitten by a snake.
questions.reason_for_classification: 시간 부사절을 단순 분사구문으로 전환하는 능력을 묻는 문제임.

questions.question: 44. 다음 중 바꿔 쓴 문장이 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: ② '뉴스를 들었을 때' 또는 '들었기 때문에' 소식을 들은 것이므로 양보의 접속사 'Although'는 어색함. 'When she heard'나 'As she heard'가 적절함.
options:
① Walking along the beach, I collected shells.
= While I was walking along the beach, I collected shells.

② Hearing the news, she was shocked.
= Although she heard the news she was shocked.

③ Surprised, I couldn’t say anything.
= As I was surprised, I couldn’t say anything.

④ Taking a shower, I heard the phone ring.
= While I was taking a shower, I heard the phone ring.

⑤ Feeling sick, I stayed home.
= Because I felt sick, I stayed home.
questions.reason_for_classification: 분사구문을 원래의 부사절로 복원할 때 문맥에 맞는 적절한 접속사를 선택할 수 있는지 평가함.

questions.question: 45. 두 문장의 의미가 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: ⑤ '가끔 실수를 하지만'이라는 양보의 의미이므로 분사구문은 'Though he makes...'가 되어야 함. 'If'는 조건의 의미이므로 어색함.
options:
① Knowing the truth, she was relieved.
= When she knew the truth, she was relieved.

② Getting up late, he missed the school bus.
= Because he got up late, he missed the school bus.

③ Not living with his family, he missed them a lot
= As he didn't live with his family, he missed them a lot
④ Playing the guitar yesterday, I felt something wrong.
= When I played the guitar yesterday, I felt something wrong.

⑤ Making mistakes sometimes, he is a good boy.
= If he makes mistakes sometimes, he is a good boy.
questions.reason_for_classification: 분사구문의 다양한 부사적 의미(시간, 이유, 양보, 조건)를 문맥상 올바르게 파악하고 있는지 묻는 문제임.

questions.passage:
The man who went to the left walked deeper into the forest. He was attacked by wild animals and almost died of hunger. Soon he learned how to protect himself and find food. In the end, he made his way out of the forest and taught others survival skills.
The man who went to the right met a group of thieves. They took everything from him and made him join them. While he was with them, he showed them great kindness. The thieves were moved by his kindness and learned from his wisdom. Later, they also became wise men. The man who walked back created a safe path around the forest. (C) <u>Using this path</u>, people could get where they were going without getting lost, even though the trip took a little longer. The man who went straight became a pioneer He left the forest and discovered places no one else had been before. Thanks to him, people could enjoy these new beautiful lands. The man who climbed the tree became a guide. Since he had found many paths, he was able to teach people how to find the quickest ways to their destinations. This is how the five men found their own paths. Like them, we are each on our own journey in life, and we cannot compare one journey to another.
questions.question: 46. 윗글의 내용을 고려하여 밑줄 친 (C)를 적절한 접속사를 포함하는 문장으로 바꾸어 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: 'Using this path'는 문맥상 '이 길을 사용했기 때문에' 또는 '사용했을 때'의 의미이므로 'Because they used this path' 또는 'As they used this path' 등이 적절함.
questions.answer: Because they used this path (또는 As they used this path, When they used this path)
questions.reason_for_classification: 분사구문을 원래의 부사절(접속사+주어+동사) 형태로 복원하는 능력을 평가함.

questions.passage:
One night in February, after I had gone to bed, an earthquake hit. I woke up suddenly because my bed was shaking. I thought my brother was shaking my bed as a joke. But then I heard the mirror on my desk fall to the floor and break into pieces. I knew it wasn’t my brother then, but I still didn’t know what exactly was happening.
Soon the whole room began to shake violently, and my confusion turned to panic. My mom shouted that it was an earthquake and an into my room hurriedly. (D) <u>Since it was my first time experiencing an earthquake</u>, I didn’t know how to react. I just kept saying, “What should I do?”
questions.question: 47. 글의 밑줄 친 (D)를 아래 [조건]을 모두 반영하여 고쳐 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: 주어 it(지진 경험)과 주절의 주어 I가 다르므로 독립분사구문 형태로 써야 함. 접속사 since 생략, it 유지, was를 being으로 바꾸어 'It being my first time...'이 됨.
sentences: [조건]
① 분사구문 변형 순서를 따르되, 불필요한 생략은 하지 않음.
② 접속사는 남겨두지 않음.
③ 밑줄 친 부분에 해당하는 부분만 답안을 작성함.
questions.answer: It being my first time experiencing an earthquake
questions.reason_for_classification: 주어가 서로 다른 부사절을 독립분사구문으로 전환하는 고난도 변형 문제임.

questions.passage: At that time, those who read the article carefully laughed out loud. Those who didn't read it to the end got really worried. (A) <u>그 뉴스가 거짓인 것을 몰랐기 때문에</u>, many people panicked. Some tried to escape the city while others went into the parks with guns to hunt the animals. So why did The Herald make up such news? Later. they confessed that they made it up to draw the readers' attention to the unsafe conditions at the zoo.
questions.question: 48. 주어진 단어들을 배열하여 윗글의 (A)와 같은 뜻의 문장을 완성하고자 할 때, 2번째와 5번째 사용되는 단어가 차례대로 짝지어진 것은?
questions.explanation: '몰랐기 때문에'를 분사구문 부정형으로 쓰면 'Not knowing (that) the news was false'가 됨. 2번째 단어는 'knowing', 5번째 단어는 'was'임. (문항에 제시된 옵션에 따라 배열하면 Not(1) knowing(2) the(3) news(4) was(5) false(6))
sentences: knowing / false / news / the / was / not
questions.reason_for_classification: 분사구문의 부정(Not + 현재분사)과 문장 성분 배열 능력을 확인하는 문제임.

questions.question: 49. 같은 의미의 간단한 문장으로 나타내고자 할 때, 옳지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: ④ 'As the book was written'을 분사구문으로 고치면 '(Being) written in a hurry'가 되어야 함. 능동형 'Writing'은 부적절함. ⑤는 'with + 명사 + 분사' 구문에서 전치사 with가 생략된 형태로 볼 수 있으나 기본적으로 with를 포함하는 것이 정석임.
options:
① Because she was sick, she was absent from school.
= Being sick, she was absent from school.

② If you turn right there, you will find the building.
= Turning right there, you will find the building.

③ Because Jenny won the first prize, she was so happy.
= Winning the first prize Jenny was so happy.

④ As the book was written in a hurry, it had a lot of errors.
= Writing in a hurry book had a lot of errors.

⑤ He was reading a book while his wife was knitting beside him.
= He was reading book his wife knitting beside
questions.reason_for_classification: 분사구문의 능동/수동 관계 및 부대 상황 구문의 변형을 묻는 문제임.

questions.question: 50.  다음 (A),(B)에 들어갈 말을 옳게 나열한 것은?
questions.explanation: (A) 동물원이 1990년대에 '지어진' 것이므로 수동 의미의 과거분사 'Built', (B) 내가 거리를 '걷고 있을 때'이므로 능동 의미의 현재분사 'Walking'이 적절함.
sentences: (A)_____________ in the 1990s, the zoo gave us joy.
(B)_____________ along the street, I met my teacher.
questions.reason_for_classification: 분사구문의 태(수동 vs 능동)를 주절의 주어와의 관계를 통해 결정하는 능력을 평가함.

questions.question: 1. 다음 문장과 같은 의미가 되도록 바꿔쓸 때 빈칸에 들어갈 말을 2단어로 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: 부사절을 분사구문으로 바꿀 때, 접속사(Because)와 주어(he)를 생략하고 동사(arriving)를 분사 형태로 만든다. 부정문이므로 Not을 분사 앞에 둔다.
sentences: Because he didin’t arrive on time, he missed the train.
-> __________________ on time, he missed the train.
questions.answer: Not arriving
questions.reason_for_classification: 부사절을 분사구문으로 전환하며 부정어의 위치를 묻는 문제이다.

questions.question: 2. 다음 중 어법상 어색한 것은? (정답2개)
questions.explanation: ②번은 분사구문의 의미상 주어가 책(the book)이 되어 어색하며(현수분사), ⑤번은 선행사가 없으므로 that이 아닌 what이 와야 한다.
options: ① He had lived in this town until last month.
② Writing in a hurry, the book has many faults.
③ The boy made the bed before he went to bed.
④ Not feeling well, I didn't go to school yesterday.
⑤ Don't put off till tomorrow that you can do today.
questions.reason_for_classification: 현수분사구문의 오류와 관계대명사 what과 접속사 that의 구별을 묻는 문제이다.

questions.question: 3. 다음의 밑줄 친 부분을 분사구문으로 바꾸시오.
questions.explanation: 부사절의 주어(it)와 주절의 주어(I)가 다르므로 주어를 생략하지 않는 독립분사구문(It being)으로 써야 한다.
sentences: <u>As it was fine</u>, I went on an outing.
questions.answer: It being fine
questions.reason_for_classification: 주절과 주어가 다른 독립분사구문의 형성을 묻는 문제이다.

questions.question: 4. 다음 (1)번과 (2)번에 각각 주어진 두 개의 문장들이 의미가 같도록 <조건>에 맞게 빈칸에 알맞은 표현을 써 넣으시오.
questions.explanation: (1)은 이유의 접속사 생략 후 Feeling sick, (2)는 시간의 접속사 생략 후 Walking on을 사용한다.
sentences: <조건>
- 분사구문으로 작성할 것.
- (1), (2)번 각각 영어 단어 2개로만 작성할 것.
- 어법에 맞는 문장이 되도록 할 것.
- 대소문자 구분하지 않음.
(1) Because he felt sick, he stayed home.
= (_____)(_____), he stayed at home.
(2) While I was walking on the street, I saw a cat.
= (_____)(_____) the street, I saw a cat.
questions.answer: (1) Feeling sick, (2) Walking on
questions.reason_for_classification: 기초적인 분사구문 전환(이유, 시간)을 묻는 문제이다.

questions.question: 5. 다음 <보기>에서 어법상 옳은 문장을 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ는 현수분사구문(주어 불일치), ⓔ는 수동의 의미이므로 Frightened가 적절하다. ⓑ, ⓒ, ⓓ가 옳다.
sentences: <보기>
ⓐ Waiting for her, the phone rang.
ⓑ Having finished his work, he could help me.
ⓒ The weather being fine, our family decided to go for a walk.
ⓓ Not knowing about the truth, Jack didn't tell her the news.
ⓔ Frightening by the noise, she telephoned the police.
questions.reason_for_classification: 완료분사구문, 독립분사구문, 부정분사구문 등 분사구문의 다양한 형태를 종합적으로 묻는 문제이다.

questions.question: 6. 다음 어법상 옳은 것을 <보기>에서 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: (B)는 문맥상 문이 닫힌 상태이므로 closed, (E)는 능동이므로 Walking, (F)는 부정어 위치가 Not having read여야 한다. 옳은 것은 (A), (C), (D)이다.
sentences: <보 기>
(A) Talking on the phone, Tom watched TV.
(B) Ted practiced the piano, with the door closing.
(C) John lay down on his bed, with his arms folded.
(D) The girl fed birds in the park, sitting on the grass.
(E) Walked along the street, I saw a man with five dogs.
(F) Having not read the article, you would not find the answer.
questions.reason_for_classification: 분사구문 및 with+명사+분사 구문의 능동/수동 관계와 부정어 위치를 묻는 복합 문제이다.

questions.question: 7. 다음 중 주어진 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
questions.explanation: ②번 'Listening to music, I did my homework.'는 동시동작을 나타내는 분사구문으로 적절하다. ①번은 Seeing, ③번은 Leaving, ④번은 If you turn, ⑤번은 I forgot (주어 일치)이 되어야 한다.
options: ① 도둑은 경찰을 보자마자 도망쳤다. -> Seen the police, the thief ran away.
② 나는 음악을 들으면서 숙제를 했다. -> Listening to music, I  did my homework.
③ 당신은 지금 바로 출발하면 기차를 탈 수 있어요. -> Not leaving right now, you will be able to catch the train.
④ 좌회전을 하면 오른편에 있는 경찰서를 찾으실 수 있어요. -> If you turn to the left, found the police station on your right.
⑤ 나는 긴장을 했기 때문에 학교 뮤지컬에서 대사를 잊었다. -> Being nervous, she forgot her lines at the shool musical.
questions.reason_for_classification: 우리말의 의미를 분사구문이나 조건문을 활용하여 올바르게 영작했는지 묻는 문제이다.

questions.passage:
It was just a normal morning. Alfred Nobel sat in his chair to read the newspaper. ㉠<u>Being drunk his coffee, a headline caught his eye</u>: The Merchant of Death, Alfred Nobel, Is Dead.
“What? What is this?”
㉡<u>Reading the article, he dropped his cup in surprise</u>. His coffee spilled all over his clothes and desk, but he couldn’t take his eyes off the newspaper.
The article was about his own death! ㉢<u>It said Nobel had died in France from a heart attack</u>.
“Oh my goodness! Am I dead?”
㉣<u>After he caught his breath, Nobel kept reading</u>.
Soon, he became even more shocked. The article described him as the inventor of dynamite and other dangerous objects for war. ㉤<u>It said he has become rich from the deaths of others</u>. He couldn’t believe his eyes. It was true that dynamite was one of his many inventions. But he never imagined that the world would think of him as “the (A)<u>merchant</u> of death.”
questions.question: 8. 윗글의 밑줄 친 ㉠~㉤ 중 어법상 옳은 것만을 있는 대로 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: ㉠은 능동의 의미이므로 Drinking이 적절하고, ㉤은 과거 완료 시점인 had become이 적절하다. ㉡, ㉢, ㉣이 옳다.
questions.reason_for_classification: 분사구문의 능동/수동 및 과거완료 시제 등 지문 내 문법 사항을 묻는 문제이다.

questions.question: 9. 다음 글의 흐름에 맞게 ⓐ~ⓒ에 들어갈 말을 짝지은 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ는 분사구문(being late), ⓑ는 감정을 느끼는 상태이므로 disappointed, ⓒ는 분사구문(feeling tired)이 적절하다.
sentences: A Day of Ann

In the morning, ⓐ<u>been/being</u> late, Ann ran to catch the school bus. After school, she had a basketball game, but she lost. Losing the game, she felt ⓑ<u>disappointed/disappointing</u>. While she was going back home, she stepped in dirty water. ⓒ<u>Felt/Feeling</u> tired, she went to bed early.
questions.reason_for_classification: 분사구문의 형태와 감정 형용사(-ed/-ing)의 구별을 묻는 문제이다.

questions.question: 10.  아래 문장에서 괄호 안의 표현을 분사구문으로 바꿔 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: 부사절을 분사구문으로 바꿀 때 접속사와 반복되는 주어를 생략하고 동사를 현재분사 형태로 바꾼다.
sentences: (As I walked along the street), I saw a man with five dogs.
(As the girl sat on the grass), the girl fed birds in the park.
questions.answer: Walking along the street, I saw a man with five dogs. / Sitting on the grass, the girl fed birds in the park.
questions.reason_for_classification: 시간의 부사절을 분사구문으로 전환하는 능력을 묻는 서술형 문제이다.

questions.question: 11. 다음 밑줄 친 부분을 동일한 의미로 새로 쓴 것으로 어법상 맞는 것은?
questions.explanation: ②번은 시간 접속사를 남겨둔 분사구문으로 적절하다. ①번은 주어가 다르므로 My dog being sick, ③번은 능동이므로 Saving, ④번은 시제가 앞서므로 Having seen, ⑤번은 Being damaged로 써야 한다.
options: ① <u>Because my dog was sick all night</u>, I couldn’t sleep well. -> Being sick all night
② <u>After we finished lunch</u>, we started on our science homework. -> After finishing lunch
③ <u>If you save your money from now on</u>, you will be rich soon. -> Saved money from now on
④ <u>Even though she had seen him 5 years ago</u>, she recognized him at once. -> Seeing him 5 years ago
⑤ <u>Since it was damaged by the heavy rain</u>, the bridge is no longer safe. -> It being damaged by the heavy rain
questions.reason_for_classification: 분사구문으로의 전환 시 주어 일치 여부와 시제, 능동/수동 관계를 정확히 파악하는 문제이다.

questions.passage:
One day, five wise men met on the road. They agreed to travel together. On the way, however, they became lost in a thick forest. ⓐ<u>Before walking any further, they decided to stop and find the best way out</u>.
ⓑ<u>After the first man thought for a while, he said, "I strongly feel that we should go left</u>."
The second man said, "We should go right, because right also means 'correct.'"
Then the third man said, "Let's walk back. We came that way, so we can leave that way. Then we can walk around the forest."
The fourth man disagreed and said, "I think we should keep walking straight. The forest cannot go on forever. A new <u>path</u> will open."
ⓒ<u>Looked at them all, the fifth man shook his head and said, "I know how to solve this. Just wait</u>."
He started to climb the tallest tree he could find. ⓓ<u>Climbing the tree, everyone else decided to go their separate ways</u>.
When the fifth man <u>reached</u> the top, he could see the whole forest. ⓔ<u>As he looked at all the paths, he found the shortest way out.</u> He hurried down to tell the others. However, when he got to the bottom, everyone was gone. He thought to himself, Where did they go? I found the best way out. He thought they were all wrong and he was the only wise man.
questions.question: 12. 위 글의 문장 (A)를 <보기>의 단어를 모두 활용하여 영작할 때 ⓐ와 ⓑ에 들어갈 단어로 바르게 짝지어진 것은? (단, 빈칸에는 한 단어만 쓸 수 있고 <보기>의 단어는 어형 변화 및 중복사용 가능. comma의 위치는 고려하지 않음)
questions.explanation: '그가 그 꼭대기에 이르렀을 때'를 분사구문으로 바꾸면 Reaching the top이고, '그는 볼 수 있었다'는 he could see이므로 ⓐ는 reaching, ⓑ는 could이다.
sentences: <보기>
whole / top / reach / the
그가 그 꼭대기에 이르렀을 때 그는 그 숲 전체를 볼 수 있었다.
questions.reason_for_classification: 우리말 문장을 분사구문을 사용하여 영작하는 능력을 묻는 문제이다.

questions.question: 13. 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분을 바르게 고쳐 쓴 것은?
questions.explanation: ⑤번 'Hiking through the woods'는 '우리가 숲을 하이킹하는 동안'이라는 시간의 의미이므로 'While we were hiking'으로 적절히 전환된다.
options: ① <u>Unable to do it</u>, I asked him for help. -> When I am unable to do it
② <u>Ill in bed for a week</u>, she can’t go abroad. -> Since she had been ill in bed for a week
③ <u>Not receiving money</u>, I asked him once more. -> Though I didn’t receive money
④ <u>Living near the park</u>, I have never been there. -> As I live near the park
⑤ <u>Hiking through the woods</u>, we saw a big snake. -> While we were hiking through the woods
questions.reason_for_classification: 분사구문을 원래의 부사절로 복원할 때 문맥에 맞는 접속사와 시제를 선택하는 문제이다.

questions.question: 14. 다음 <보기>의 밑줄 친 부분을 바르게 고쳐 쓴 것은?
questions.explanation: 'not being old enough'는 '그녀가 충분히 나이가 들지 않았기 때문에'라는 이유를 나타내므로 ②번 'as she was not old enough'가 가장 적절하다.
options: ② as she was not old enough
③ because she is not old enough
④ in order not to be old enough
⑤ for her to have been old enough
sentences: <보기>
Mandy wasn’t allowed to watch that movie, <u>not being old enough</u>.
questions.reason_for_classification: 분사구문을 이유의 부사절로 전환하는 능력을 묻는 문제이다.

questions.question: 15. 윗글의 ⓐ~ⓔ 중에서 어법상 어색한 것은? (정답 2개)
questions.explanation: ⓒ는 분사구문의 주어가 능동적으로 보는 것이므로 Looking이 적절하고, ⓓ는 주절의 주어(everyone else)와 분사구문의 행위자가 일치하지 않는 현수분사구문 오류이다. (나무를 오른 것은 다섯 번째 사람임)
questions.reason_for_classification: 지문 내 분사구문의 능동 형태 및 주어 일치 여부(현수분사)를 묻는 복합 문제이다.

questions.question: 16. 다음 중 문장 전환이 바르지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: ⑤번 'If these pills are taken'은 수동형 분사구문으로 바꿀 때 '(Being) taken once a day'가 되어야 한다. Taking은 능동의 의미이므로 틀리다.
options: ① You will get a refund if you are not satisfied. -> You will get a refund if not satisfied.
② As I wasn’t able to go there, I told him I was sorry. -> Not being able to go there, I told him I was sorry.
③ Because I had not met him before, I did not recognize him. -> I didn’t recognize him, not having met him before.
④ If we judge from his accent, the nice guy seems to be Australian. -> Judging from his accent, the nice guy seems to be Australian.
⑤ If these pills are taken once a day, they will change your life. -> Taking once a day, these pills will change your life.
questions.reason_for_classification: 수동형 분사구문으로 전환할 때 과거분사(p.p.)를 사용해야 함을 묻는 문제이다.

questions.question: 17. 다음 두 문장의 의미가 서로 같지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: ③번 'Having read the book'은 '책을 이미 읽었기 때문에'라는 완료 및 이유를 나타내지만, 변환된 문장은 '책을 읽어야 하지만'이라는 양보/대조의 의미를 담고 있어 서로 다르다.
options: ① Putting on his coat, he went out. -> He put on his coat and went out.
② Joe being a doctor, people asked him for advice. -> People asked Joe for advice because he was a doctor.
③ Having read the book, I don’t need to see the film. -> I have to read the book but don’t need to see the film.
④ We left the restaurant, having paid for the meal. -> Before we left the restaurant, we had paid for the meal.
⑤ Not living in the city, I hardly know the subway lines. -> I don’t live in the city, so I hardly know the subway lines.
questions.reason_for_classification: 분사구문의 완료형(Having p.p.)이 갖는 시제 및 인과 관계의 의미를 정확히 파악하는 문제이다.

questions.question: 18. 다음 중 같은 의미의 문장으로 바르게 고쳐 쓴 것은? (정답 2개)
questions.explanation: ①번은 관용적 분사구문으로 옳고, ④번은 주어가 다른 독립분사구문으로 옳다. ②는 수동(Having been hunted), ③은 시제 불일치(Having read), ⑤는 형태(Not having seen)가 틀렸다.
options: ① If we consider the price, the hotel room is nice. -> Considering the price, the hotel room is nice.
② As wolves have been hunted for years, wolves are not seen here. -> Having hunted for years, wolves are not seen here.
③ Because she read the newspaper, she knows about the accident. -> Reading the newspaper, she knows about the accident.
④ After all the money had been spent, I started to look for a job. -> All the money having been spent, I started to look for a job.
⑤ Although they had not seen each other for years, they soon became friends again. -> Not having seeing each other for years, they soon became friends again.
questions.reason_for_classification: 관용적 분사구문과 독립분사구문의 올바른 형성을 묻는 복수 응답 문제이다.

questions.passage:
