questions.question: 19. 윗글의 밑줄 친 우리말을 영어로 바꿀 때 ★에 들어갈 알맞은 것은?
questions.explanation: '가족 구성원들과 이야기를 나누는 동안'은 while (it is) talking with family members로 표현할 수 있으므로 while 뒤에 talking이 오는 것이 적절하다.
sentences: 이 로봇은 그것이 가족 구성원들과 이야기를 나누는 동안 감정을 감지할 수 있다.
→ This robot can sense feelings (       ) (   ★   )
(       ) (       ) members.
questions.reason_for_classification: 접속사가 생략되지 않은 분사구문의 형태를 묻는 문제이다.

questions.question: 20. 다음 밑줄 친 부분이 어법상 바르게 쓰인 것을 모두 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ(독립분사구문), ⓓ(독립분사구문), ⓔ(이유 분사구문)가 옳다. ⓑ는 Left(수동), ⓒ는 Printed(수동), ⓕ는 Praised(수동)가 되어야 한다.
sentences: ⓐ<u>It being fine</u>, we went for a walk.
ⓑ<u>Leaving alone in the room</u>, the baby began to cry.
ⓒ<u>Printing in haste</u>, the book has many mistakes.
ⓓ<u>Peter having finished dinner</u>, we went out for a walk.
ⓔ<u>Being just fourteen</u>, she couldn't watch the movie.
ⓕ<u>Praising for her hard work</u>, she felt a sense of success.
questions.reason_for_classification: 분사구문의 능동/수동 관계 및 주어 일치 여부를 판단하는 종합 문제이다.

questions.question: 21. 다음 대화의 ⓐ~ⓓ 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ는 '네가 살을 뺀 것이 아니라 내가 뺀 것'이므로 주어 불일치 오류이며, ⓒ는 가정법 과거 시제가 맞지 않는다 (if it were not for ..., I couldn't ...). 따라서 ⓐ, ⓒ가 어색하다.
sentences: A: ⓐ<u>Losing weight, you helped me a lot by encouraging me to exercise regularly</u>.
B: ⓑ<u>I just wanted to help you reach the goal.</u>
A: ⓒ<u>If it were not for your help, I can't lose weight</u>.
B: ⓓ<u>As you can see, exercising is good for not only your mind but also your body</u>.
questions.reason_for_classification: 현수분사구문(의미상 주어 불일치)과 가정법 과거의 시제 일치를 묻는 복합 문제이다.

questions.question: 22. 주어진 문장과 같은 의미를 갖는 문장으로 바르게 고친 것은?
questions.explanation: Since Alex completed... 는 완료의 의미를 담은 분사구문 'Completing the project, Alex was excited'로 적절히 전환될 수 있다.
options: ① Completed the project, she was excited.
② Being excited, Alex completed the project.
③ Completing the project, Alex was excited.
④ Alex was so excited that she completed the project.
⑤ Since Alex completed the project. being excited.
sentences: Since Alex completed the project, she was excited.
questions.reason_for_classification: 이유의 부사절을 분사구문으로 전환하는 전형적인 능력을 묻는 문제이다.

questions.question: 23. 맥락이 같은 문장으로 전환이 잘못된 것은?
questions.explanation: ⑤번 'Turning left, you will find...'는 조건의 의미이므로 'If you turn left'가 적절하나, 선택지가 비어있거나 완결되지 않았다. 주어진 1~4번은 모두 적절한 전환이다. 지문상 오류 또는 5번 미완성으로 인해 5번이 정답으로 간주된다.
options: ① Running to me, she waved her hand. -> As she ran to me, she waved her hand.
② Losing the game, she felt disappointment. ->After she lost, she felt disappointment.
③ Hearing the news, I gave a shout of joy. -> When I heard the news, I gave a shout of joy
④ Being nervous, I forgot my lines at the musical. -> Since I was nervous. I forgot my lines at the musical.
⑤ Turning left, you will find the school right away.
questions.reason_for_classification: 분사구문을 원래의 부사절로 복원할 때 접속사 선택의 적절성을 묻는 문제이다.

questions.passage:
AWFUL DISASTER
The Herald November 9th, 1874
Last night, an angry group of rhinoceroses broke down the walls of the cage at the zoo and escaped. They also broke down the walls of the other wild animals’ cages. These animals ran down the streets and injured hundreds of people. Twelve of the animals are still on the loose. Citizens should stay indoors until further notice.
Not a single act or incident described above has taken place.
At that time, those who read the article above carefully laughed out loud. Those who didn’t read it to the end got really worried. (A)As many people didn’t know the news was false, many people panicked. Some tried to escape the city while others went into the parks with guns to hunt the animals.
So why did The Herald make up such news? Later, they confessed that they made it up so as to draw the readers’ attention to the unsafe conditions at the zoo. Likewise, there have been various fake news reports throughout history to show ‘the hidden motives’ behind them.
questions.question: 24.  글의 (A)와 뜻이 같도록 ‘분사구문’으로 영작하시오.
questions.explanation: 부사절 'As many people didn't know the news was false'를 분사구문으로 바꿀 때, 주어(many people)가 일치하므로 생략하고 부정어 Not을 맨 앞에 두어 'Not knowing the news was false'로 쓴다.
questions.answer: Not knowing the news was false
questions.reason_for_classification: 부정 분사구문을 사용하여 부사절을 전환하는 능력을 묻는 서술형 문제이다.

questions.passage:

questions.question: 25. 윗글을 읽고, 위 지문의 밑줄 친 (가) 속 “teaching”과 문장 내에서의 역할이 같은 것을 모두 고르면? (2개)
questions.explanation: (가)의 teaching은 접속사 While 뒤의 분사구문(현재분사)이다. ⓐ(Hearing)와 ⓓ(eating) 역시 분사구문으로 쓰인 현재분사이다. ⓒ(Seeing)는 동명사 주어, ⓔ(amazing)는 감정 형용사이다.
questions.reason_for_classification: 현재분사와 동명사를 구별하고, 분사구문으로서의 역할을 찾아내는 문제이다.

questions.question: 26. 윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 올바른 문장의 개수는?
questions.explanation: ⓐ(find items), ⓒ(saving money)가 어법상 옳다. ⓑ는 user who has, ⓓ는 Having seen(또는 Seeing), ⓔ는 let other users know(원형부정사)가 되어야 한다. 옳은 것은 1개(ⓐ는 help+목적어+동사원형이므로 맞고, ⓒ는 love+-ing이므로 맞으나 지문상 문법 포인트에 따라 개수가 달라질 수 있음. 여기선 핵심 문법 위주로 판단)이다. 원문에 따라 ⓒ가 포함되어 2개일 가능성이 높다.
questions.reason_for_classification: 사역동사, 분사구문, 동명사, 관계대명사 등 지문 내 다양한 문법 요소의 정오를 판별하는 문제이다.

questions.question: 27. 다음 각 문장을 변형한 것으로 알맞은 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓓ 'Though I live next door'를 접속사 생략 없이 'Though living next door'로 쓴 것은 적절한 분사구문 변형이다. ⓐ는 walked, ⓑ는 walking, ⓒ는 Having no money..., ⓔ는 finding the key(주어 불일치 시 주의) 등이 틀렸다.
sentences: ⦁Walking home in the rain, I got wet.
→ ⓐ<u>As I walk home in the rain, I got wet</u>.
⦁He stood up and he walked out of the room.
→ ⓑ<u>He stood up walked out of the room</u>.
⦁Having no money, he couldn’t buy a new cap.
→ ⓒ<u>He had no money because he couldn’t buy a new cap</u>.
⦁Though I live next door, I don’t know her.
→ ⓓ<u>Though living next door, I don’t know her</u>.
⦁I could get into my house because my mom found the key.
→ ⓔ<u>I could get into my house finding the key</u>.
questions.reason_for_classification: 분사구문과 부사절 간의 상호 전환이 어법상 완벽한지 묻는 문제이다.

questions.question: 28. 다음 (A), (B) 문장을 연결한 것으로 적절하지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: ②번 'She opened the wine'과 'she poured it...'를 연결할 때 'Opening the wine' 또는 'Having opened the wine'이 되어야지 수동형 'Being opened'는 어색하다.
options: ① He was reading the letter while crying loudly.
② Being opened the wine, she poured it into my glass.
③ Taking a key out of his pocket, he opened the door.
④ I gave up buying a new cap, having no money.
⑤ The man being rude to us, we didn’t invite him to the party.
sentences: (A) He was reading the letter / (B) He was crying loudly
(A) She opened the wine / (B) She poured the wine into my glass
(A) He took a key out of his pocket / (B) He opened the door
(A) I gave up buying a new cap / (B) I had no money
(A) The man was rude to us / (B) We didn’t invite him to the party
questions.reason_for_classification: 두 문장을 분사구문으로 연결할 때 능동/수동 관계 및 독립분사구문 적용의 적절성을 묻는 문제이다.

questions.question: 29. 다음 문장 중, 어법상 옳은 것은?
questions.explanation: ②번 'Being very sick in bed, I still did my homework'는 양보의 의미를 담은 분사구문으로 적절하다. ①은 Surprised, ③은 Walking, ④는 Sitting, ⑤는 forgot이 되어야 한다.
options: ① Surprising at the news, he could say nothing.
② Being very sick in bed, I still did my homework.
③ Walked in the park, he met one of his friends.
④ Sit on the bench, he enjoyed the beautiful scenery.
⑤ Having been nervous on the stage, the actor forgetting his lines.
questions.reason_for_classification: 분사의 능동/수동 및 문장 내 정동사 유무를 판별하는 문제이다.

questions.question: 30. 다음 문장을 분사구문으로 바꿀 때, 어법상 옳은 것은?
questions.explanation: ⑤번 'While she was listening to music...'에서 접속사 While과 주어 she를 생략하고 현재분사 'Listening to music'으로 쓴 것은 옳다. ①은 Being late, ②는 Seeing, ③은 Left alone, ④는 Having not met이다.
options: ① As I was late to the audition, I took a taxi. -> Lating to the audition, I took a taxi.
② When the thief saw the police, he ran away. -> Seen the police, the thief ran away.
③ If you are left alone home, you may feel lonely. -> Leaving alone home, you may feel lonely.
④ As I had not met him before, I didn’t know him. -> Having not meet him before, I didn’t know him.
⑤ While she was listening to music, she did her homework. -> Listening to music, she did her homework.
questions.reason_for_classification: 부사절을 분사구문으로 전환할 때 나타나는 철자 및 형태 오류를 잡아내는 문제이다.

questions.question: 31. 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
questions.explanation: ①번 'Jane being sick, I did her work'는 주어가 다른 독립분사구문으로 어법상 옳다. ②는 비인칭 주어 It을 생략할 수 없어 'It being a holiday'가 되어야 하며, ③은 strong, ④는 could, ⑤는 lucky가 맞다.
options: ① Jane being sick, I did her work.
② Being a holiday, the bank was closed.
③ He is so strongly that he could lift the box.
④ He spoke loudly so that everyone can hear him.
⑤ She was luckily enough to travel all over the world.
questions.reason_for_classification: 독립분사구문 및 결과 부사절, 형용사/부사 쓰임 등을 종합적으로 묻는 문제이다.

questions.question: 32. 다음 문장 중, 어법상 옳은 것은?
questions.explanation: ⑤번 'Going skydiving was one of the most thrilling experiences'는 감정을 유발하는 사물(경험)을 수식하므로 현재분사 thrilling이 적절하다. ①은 worried, ②는 bored, ③은 exciting, ④는 felt scared(동사 필요)가 맞다.
options: ① He is worry about his mom in the hospital.
② The audience were boring by the long speech.
③ Visiting my best friend in Busan is very excited.
④ The girl so scared when a ghost appeared on the screen.
⑤ Going skydiving was one of the most thrilling experiences.
questions.reason_for_classification: 감정을 나타내는 분사의 능동(-ing)과 수동(-ed) 구별을 묻는 문제이다.

questions.question: 33. 다음 <보기>와 같이 그림에 알맞은 영어 문장을 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: 동시동작을 나타내는 부사절 'While Daniel listened to music'을 분사구문 'Listening to music'으로 전환한다.
sentences: <보기>
While Tom talked on the phone, Tom watched TV.
→ Talking on the phone, Tom watched TV.
While Daniel listened to music, Daniel watered the plants.
→ ___________________________, Daniel watered the plants.
questions.answer: Listening to music, Daniel watered the plants.
questions.reason_for_classification: 주어진 예시를 참고하여 간단한 분사구문을 영작하는 능력을 묻는 문제이다.

questions.question: 34. 문장의 형태가 어법상 바르게 전환된 것은?
questions.explanation: ⑤번 'Since she hasn't finished...'를 완료 부정 분사구문 'Not having finished her homework yet'으로 전환한 것은 시제 차이와 부정어 위치 모두 정확하다. ①은 Stuck(또는 Being stuck)이 맞지만 의미상 원문과 대조 시 5번이 더 완벽하다.
options: ① As he was stuck in traffic, he missed the meeting. -> Stuck in traffic, he missed the meeting.
② If we judge from her voice, she is a famous singer. -> Judged from her voice, she is a famous singer.
③ We are having fun while we are watching a comic movie. -> Having fun while we are watching a comic movie.
④ Because he arrived late, we couldn’t start the meeting as it was scheduled. -> Him arriving late, we couldn’t start the meeting as it was scheduled.
⑤ Since she hasn't finished her homework yet, I will not allow her to hang out with her friend. -> Not having finished her homework yet, I will not allow her to hang out with her friend.
questions.reason_for_classification: 완료형 분사구문의 부정 형태를 정확하게 이해하고 있는지 묻는 문제이다.

questions.question: 35. 다음과 같이 답한 학생의 점수는?
questions.explanation: 1번 realer -> more real(틀림), 2번 careless of Kevin(옳음-성격 형용사), 3번 of his being(옳음), 4번 advised him to exercise(옳음), 5번 the very best / the most(틀림), 6번 as tall as(틀림), 7번 difficult for me to solve(옳음). 학생의 답과 비교하여 채점한다.
sentences: 문장이 어법상 옳으면 O, 틀리면 X로 표시하시오.
(3)학년 (15)반 번호(1) 이름 (권OO)
|문항|문제[각 1점]|답란|
|1|They were much realer than drawings.|O|
|2|It is careless for Kevin to lose his bag.|X|
|3|They were so sure of he being alive.|X|
|4|I advised him to exercise regularly.|O|
|5|This reason is the very most important.|X|
|6|No other girl in the class is as tallest as Jane.|X|
|7|This math problem is difficult for me to solve.|X|
questions.reason_for_classification: 비교급, 가주어-의미상주어, 동명사의 의미상 주어 등 중학 필수 문법 전반을 묻는 복합 문제이다.

questions.passage:

questions.question: 36. ⓐ~ⓕ 중 어법상 어색한 것끼리 묶인 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓒ는 had chosen과 병렬을 이루어 created가 되어야 하고, ⓔ는 사역동사 made 뒤에 동사원형 join이 와야 하며, ⓕ는 became 뒤에 보어로 형용사 wise가 와야 한다.
questions.reason_for_classification: 지문 내 병렬 구조, 사역동사의 보어, 2형식 동사 뒤 보어의 품사를 묻는 복합 문제이다.

questions.question: 37. 밑줄 친 ①~⑤ 중 어법상 맞는 것은?
questions.explanation: ④번 'Try to remember when you reach...'는 간접의문문 또는 시간의 부사절로서 어법상 적절하다. ①은 for any of us, ②는 including, ③은 when, ⑤는 It is best... 등이 틀렸다.
options: ① It is difficult any of us to maintain a constant level of attention throughout our working day.
② We all have body rhythms included peaks and valleys of energy and alertness.
③ You will achieve more and gain confidence if you schedule your most demanding tasks which you are in your best condition.
④ Try to remember when you reach your peak energy levels.
⑤ Being at best in the morning, but for others, it may take a while to warm up.
questions.reason_for_classification: 가주어-의미상주어, 분사 수식, 관계부사, 문장의 정동사 유무 등을 묻는 복합 문법 문제이다.

questions.question: 38. 밑줄 친 부분이 어법상 틀린 것은?
questions.explanation: ⑤번 '스테이크가 요리된' 것이므로 수동의 의미인 'Cooked to perfection'이 적절하다. Cooking은 능동이어서 어색하다.
options: ① There being no available parking spaces around, I had to park my car several blocks away from the venue.
② Compared with a year ago, the price of parking was up 28 percent.
③ Not having a credit card, I found it difficult to pay the parking fee.
④ Speaking of the birthday party food that night, I loved the way the cook made the steak.
⑤ Cooking to perfection, the steak was juicy and flavorful.
questions.reason_for_classification: 분사구문의 수동 관계와 관용적 분사구문(Speaking of 등)을 묻는 문제이다.

questions.question: 39. 윗글에서 밑줄 친 (A), (B)를 조건에 맞게 변경하시오.
questions.explanation: (A) 'When I heard this'는 주어 I가 같으므로 생략하고 'Hearing this'로, (B) 'As I watched this movie'는 'Watching this movie'로 바꾼다.

questions.question: 7. 다음 중 주어진 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
questions.explanation: ①은 '보자마자'이므로 Seeing이나 Seeing the police... 형태가 되어야 함. ③은 긍정 조건이므로 Not을 빼야 함. ④는 분사구문 Turning...이 오거나 If절 동사인 turn이 와야 함. ⑤는 주어가 she가 아닌 I가 되어야 함. ②는 동시동작을 나타내는 Listening to...가 적절함.
options: ① 도둑은 경찰을 보자마자 도망쳤다. -> Seen the police, the thief ran away.
② 나는 음악을 들으면서 숙제를 했다. -> Listening to music, I  did my homework.
③ 당신은 지금 바로 출발하면 기차를 탈 수 있어요. -> Not leaving right now, you will be able to catch the train.
④ 좌회전을 하면 오른편에 있는 경찰서를 찾으실 수 있어요. -> If you turn to the left, found the police station on your right.
⑤ 나는 긴장을 했기 때문에 학교 뮤지컬에서 대사를 잊었다. -> Being nervous, she forgot her lines at the shool musical.
questions.reason_for_classification: 우리말 의미에 맞는 분사구문 표현과 주어 일치 여부를 판단하는 문제임.

questions.passage:
It was just a normal morning. Alfred Nobel sat in his chair to read the newspaper. ㉠<u>Being drunk his coffee, a headline caught his eye</u>: The Merchant of Death, Alfred Nobel, Is Dead.
“What? What is this?”
㉡<u>Reading the article, he dropped his cup in surprise</u>. His coffee spilled all over his clothes and desk, but he couldn’t take his eyes off the newspaper.
The article was about his own death! ㉢<u>It said Nobel had died in France from a heart attack</u>.
“Oh my goodness! Am I dead?”
㉣<u>After he caught his breath, Nobel kept reading</u>.
Soon, he became even more shocked. The article described him as the inventor of dynamite and other dangerous objects for war. ㉤<u>It said he has become rich from the deaths of others</u>. He couldn’t believe his eyes. It was true that dynamite was one of his many inventions. But he never imagined that the world would think of him as “the (A)<u>merchant</u> of death.”
questions.question: 8. 윗글의 밑줄 친 ㉠~㉤ 중 어법상 옳은 것만을 있는 대로 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: ㉠ 분사구문의 주어는 headline이 아니라 노벨(he)이 되어야 하므로 'While he was drinking...'에서 Drinking...으로 바뀌어야 하며 headline이 주어라면 수동 관계도 어색함. ㉤ 과거 시점의 글이므로 has become을 과거완료 had become으로 고쳐야 함. 옳은 것은 ㉡, ㉢, ㉣임.
questions.reason_for_classification: 분사구문의 주어 일치, 시제(과거완료)의 적절성 등을 지문 내에서 판단하는 복합 문법 문제임.

questions.question: 9. 다음 글의 흐름에 맞게 ⓐ~ⓒ에 들어갈 말을 짝지은 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ 늦어서(이유)를 나타내는 분사구문으로 being이 적절함. ⓑ 실망을 '느낀' 것이므로 과거분사 disappointed가 적절함. ⓒ 피곤함을 느껴서(이유)를 나타내는 능동 분사구문 Feeling이 적절함.
sentences: A Day of Ann

In the morning, ⓐ<u>been/being</u> late, Ann ran to catch the school bus. After school, she had a basketball game, but she lost. Losing the game, she felt ⓑ<u>disappointed/disappointing</u>. While she was going back home, she stepped in dirty water. ⓒ<u>Felt/Feeling</u> tired, she went to bed early.
questions.reason_for_classification: 분사구문의 현재분사 선택과 감정 형용사(분사)의 구별을 묻는 문제임.

questions.question: 10.  아래 문장에서 괄호 안의 표현을 분사구문으로 바꿔 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: 부사절의 접속사와 주어를 생략하고 동사를 현재분사형으로 고친다. As I walked -> Walking, As the girl sat -> Sitting.
sentences: (As I walked along the street), I saw a man with five dogs.
(As the girl sat on the grass), the girl fed birds in the park.
questions.answer: Walking along the street, I saw a man with five dogs. / Sitting on the grass, the girl fed birds in the park.
questions.reason_for_classification: 부사절을 단순 분사구문으로 전환하는 기초 서술형 문제임.

questions.question: 11. 다음 밑줄 친 부분을 동일한 의미로 새로 쓴 것으로 어법상 맞는 것은?
questions.explanation: ① 주어 my dog가 주절의 I와 다르므로 My dog being sick...으로 써야 함. ③ 조건을 나타내므로 능동형 Saving...으로 써야 함. ④ 5년 전에 본 것이 먼저 일어난 일이므로 완료형 분사구문 Having seen...이 적절함. ⑤ 의미상 주어 it과 분사가 수동 관계이므로 It being damaged... 또는 Damaged...가 가능하나 presented 된 문장은 맞음. ② After를 살려둘 수 있으나 fishing이 아닌 finishing임. 답은 5번.
options: ① <u>Because my dog was sick all night</u>, I couldn’t sleep well. -> Being sick all night
② <u>After we finished lunch</u>, we started on our science homework. -> After finishing lunch
③ <u>If you save your money from now on</u>, you will be rich soon. -> Saved money from now on
④ <u>Even though she had seen him 5 years ago</u>, she recognized him at once. -> Seeing him 5 years ago
⑤ <u>Since it was damaged by the heavy rain</u>, the bridge is no longer safe. -> It being damaged by the heavy rain
questions.reason_for_classification: 분사구문의 주어 일치, 완료 시제, 능동/수동 관계를 모두 종합적으로 묻는 문제임.

questions.question: 12. 위 글의 문장 (A)를 <보기>의 단어를 모두 활용하여 영작할 때 ⓐ와 ⓑ에 들어갈 단어로 바르게 짝지어진 것은? (단, 빈칸에는 한 단어만 쓸 수 있고 <보기>의 단어는 어형 변화 및 중복사용 가능. comma의 위치는 고려하지 않음)
questions.explanation: '그가 꼭대기에 이르렀을 때'를 분사구문으로 쓰면 Reaching the top이 되고, '그는 볼 수 있었다'는 he could see가 됨. 따라서 ⓐ는 reaching(문두 대문자 Reaching), ⓑ는 could임.
sentences: <보기> lands- whole / top / reach / the
그가 그 꼭대기에 이르렀을 때 그는 그 숲 전체를 볼 수 있었다.
questions.reason_for_classification: 조건에 맞는 분사구문 영작 능력을 평가함.

questions.question: 13. 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분을 바르게 고쳐 쓴 것은?
questions.explanation: ①은 '할 수 없었기 때문에'이므로 As I was unable...이 적절함. ②는 현재완료나 과거의 상태를 나타내므로 Because she has been... 등이 적절함. ③은 '받지 않았기 때문에'이므로 As I didn't receive...가 적절함. ④는 양보의 의미(가까이 살지만 가본 적 없다)이므로 Though I live...가 적절함. ⑤는 '하이킹을 하는 동안'이므로 While we were hiking...이 정확함.
options: ① <u>Unable to do it</u>, I asked him for help. -> When I am unable to do it
② <u>Ill in bed for a week</u>, she can’t go abroad. -> Since she had been ill in bed for a week
③ <u>Not receiving money</u>, I asked him once more. -> Though I didn’t receive money
④ <u>Living near the park</u>, I have never been there. -> As I live near the park
⑤ <u>Hiking through the woods</u>, we saw a big snake. -> While we were hiking through the woods
questions.reason_for_classification: 분사구문의 생략된 접속사의 의미를 문맥에 따라 정확히 유추하여 부사절로 복원하는 능력을 묻는 문제임.

questions.question: 14. 다음 <보기>의 밑줄 친 부분을 바르게 고쳐 쓴 것은?
questions.explanation: '충분히 나이가 들지 않았기 때문에'라는 이유의 의미를 나타내는 부사절로 고치면 as/because she was not old enough가 적절함. 시제가 과거(wasn't allowed)이므로 시제 일치가 필요함.
options: ② as she was not old enough
③ because she is not old enough
④ in order not to be old enough
⑤ for her to have been old enough
sentences: <보기>
Mandy wasn’t allowed to watch that movie, <u>not being old enough</u>.
questions.reason_for_classification: 분사구문을 이유의 접속사가 포함된 부사절로 전환하되 시제 일치에 유의해야 하는 문제임.

questions.passage:
One day, five wise men met on the road. They agreed to travel together. On the way, however, they became lost in a thick forest. ⓐ<u>Before walking any further, they decided to stop and find the best way out</u>.
ⓑ<u>After the first man thought for a while, he said, "I strongly feel that we should go left</u>."
The second man said, "We should go right, because right also means 'correct.'"
Then the third man said, "Let's walk back. We came that way, so we can leave that way. Then we can walk around the forest."
The fourth man disagreed and said, "I think we should keep walking straight. The forest cannot go on forever. A new <u>path</u> will open."
ⓒ<u>Looked at them all, the fifth man shook his head and said, "I know how to solve this. Just wait</u>."
He started to climb the tallest tree he could find. ⓓ<u>Climbing the tree, everyone else decided to go their separate ways</u>.
When the fifth man <u>reached</u> the top, he could see the whole forest. ⓔ<u>As he looked at all the paths, he found the shortest way out.</u> He hurried down to tell the others. However, when he got to the bottom, everyone was gone. He thought to himself, Where did they go? I found the best way out. He thought they were all wrong and he was the only wise man.
questions.question: 15. 윗글의 ⓐ~ⓔ 중에서 어법상 어색한 것은? (정답 2개)
questions.explanation: ⓒ 노벨이 '모두를 보았을 때'이므로 능동인 Looking으로 고쳐야 함. ⓓ 나무를 오르는 주체는 다섯 번째 사람(he)인데 주절의 주어는 everyone else이므로 주어 불일치 오류임.
questions.reason_for_classification: 분사구문의 태(능동/수동)와 의미상 주어 일치 여부를 지문 맥락 속에서 찾는 고난도 문제임.

questions.question: 16. 다음 중 문장 전환이 바르지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: ⑤ 약이 '복용되는' 것이므로 수동의 분사구문인 Taken once a day로 고쳐야 함.
options: ① You will get a refund if you are not satisfied. -> You will get a refund if not satisfied.
② As I wasn’t able to go there, I told him I was sorry. -> Not being able to go there, I told him I was sorry.
③ Because I had not met him before, I did not recognize him. -> I didn’t recognize him, not having met him before.
④ If we judge from his accent, the nice guy seems to be Australian. -> Judging from his accent, the nice guy seems to be Australian.
⑤ If these pills are taken once a day, they will change your life. -> Taking once a day, these pills will change your life.
questions.reason_for_classification: 수동형 분사구문에서의 분사 형태(p.p.) 선택 오류를 지적하는 문제임.

questions.question: 17. 다음 두 문장의 의미가 서로 같지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: ③ Having read the book은 '그 책을 읽었기 때문에(이유)'의 의미인데, 전환된 문장은 '읽어야 하지만(역접)'의 의미로 제시되어 서로 다름.
options: ① Putting on his coat, he went out. -> He put on his coat and went out.
② Joe being a doctor, people asked him for advice. -> People asked Joe for advice because he was a doctor.
③ Having read the book, I don’t need to see the film. -> I have to read the book but don’t need to see the film.
④ We left the restaurant, having paid for the meal. -> Before we left the restaurant, we had paid for the meal.
⑤ Not living in the city, I hardly know the subway lines. -> I don’t live in the city, so I hardly know the subway lines.
questions.reason_for_classification: 분사구문의 부사적 의미(이유, 시간, 양보 등)를 정확히 파악하여 대조하는 문제임.

questions.question: 18. 다음 중 같은 의미의 문장으로 바르게 고쳐 쓴 것은? (정답 2개)
questions.explanation: ①은 관용적 분사구문(Considering...)으로 옳음. ④는 주어가 다른 독립분사구문으로 시제(대과거)를 반영한 완료형이 적절하게 쓰임. ②는 늑대가 '사냥되어 온 것'이므로 Having been hunted가 되어야 함. ③은 과거 시제이므로 Having read가 적절함. ⑤는 seeing을 seen으로 고쳐야 함(not having seen).
options: ① If we consider the price, the hotel room is nice. -> Considering the price, the hotel room is nice.
② As wolves have been hunted for years, wolves are not seen here. -> Having hunted for years, wolves are not seen here.
③ Because she read the newspaper, she knows about the accident. -> Reading the newspaper, she knows about the accident.
④ After all the money had been spent, I started to look for a job. -> All the money having been spent, I started to look for a job.
⑤ Although they had not seen each other for years, they soon became friends again. -> Not having seeing each other for years, they soon became friends again.
questions.reason_for_classification: 독립분사구문, 관용적 분사구문, 완료형 수동 분사구문 등 복잡한 형태를 평가함.

questions.passage:
Robots are not only in movies and books anymore.

Cooking and cleaning would be easier if you had ⓓ<u>one</u>. <u>이 로봇은 그것이 가족 구성원들과 이야기를 나누는 동안 감정을 감지할 수 있다</u>. A self-driving car doesn't need a driver. With cameras, sensors, and software, ⓔ<u>it</u> can navigate roads for you so that you can relax and enjoy the ride. questions.question: 19. 윗글의 밑줄 친 우리말을 영어로 바꿀 때 ★에 들어갈 알맞은 것은?
questions.explanation: '가족 구성원들과 이야기를 나누는 동안'을 분사구문으로 표현하면 while talking with family members가 된다. ★자리는 talking이 적절함.
sentences: 이 로봇은 그것이 가족 구성원들과 이야기를 나누는 동안 감정을 감지할 수 있다.
→ This robot can sense feelings (       ) (   ★   ) (       ) (       ) members.
questions.reason_for_classification: 접속사를 생략하지 않은 분사구문의 형태를 영작을 통해 확인하는 문제임.

questions.question: 20. 다음 밑줄 친 부분이 어법상 바르게 쓰인 것을 모두 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ는 독립분사구문으로 옳음. ⓓ도 독립분사구문으로 옳음. ⓔ는 이유의 분사구문으로 옳음. ⓑ는 아기가 남겨진 것이므로 Left로, ⓒ는 책이 인쇄된 것이므로 Printed로, ⓕ는 칭찬받은 것이므로 Praised로 고쳐야 함. 따라서 ⓐ, ⓓ, ⓔ가 옳음.
sentences: ⓐ<u>It being fine</u>, we went for a walk.
ⓑ<u>Leaving alone in the room</u>, the baby began to cry.
ⓒ<u>Printing in haste</u>, the book has many mistakes.
ⓓ<u>Peter having finished dinner</u>, we went out for a walk.
ⓔ<u>Being just fourteen</u>, she couldn't watch the movie.
ⓕ<u>Praising for her hard work</u>, she felt a sense of success.
questions.reason_for_classification: 분사구문의 능동/수동 및 독립분사구문 여부를 가려내는 종합 문법 문제임.

questions.question: 21. 다음 대화의 ⓐ~ⓓ 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ 분사구문의 주어는 you인데, '살을 빼는 것(Losing weight)'은 행위의 대상일 수 있으나 문맥상 '내가 살을 빼는 데 있어서 네가 도와주었다'는 의미라면 While I was losing...의 구조이므로 주어가 불일치함. ⓒ If it were not for...는 가정법 과거이므로 주절에 조동사 과거형(couldn't)이 와야 함. ⓐ와 ⓒ가 어색함.
sentences: A: ⓐ<u>Losing weight, you helped me a lot by encouraging me to exercise regularly</u>.
B: ⓑ<u>I just wanted to help you reach the goal.</u>
A: ⓒ<u>If it were not for your help, I can't lose weight</u>.
B: ⓓ<u>As you can see, exercising is good for not only your mind but also your body</u>.
questions.reason_for_classification: 분사구문의 주어 일치 문제와 가정법 과거의 시제 일치 문제를 결합한 복합 문법 문제임.

questions.question: 22. 주어진 문장과 같은 의미를 갖는 문장으로 바르게 고친 것은?
questions.explanation: 'Alex가 프로젝트를 완료했기 때문에'를 분사구문으로 바꾸면 주어가 같으므로 생략하고 Completing the project...가 됨. (완료 분사구문 Having completed도 가능하지만 3번이 가장 가까움)
options: ① Completed the project, she was excited.
② Being excited, Alex completed the project.
③ Completing the project, Alex was excited.
④ Alex was so excited that she completed the project.
⑤ Since Alex completed the project. being excited.
sentences: Since Alex completed the project, she was excited.
questions.reason_for_classification: 부사절을 단순 분사구문으로 전환하는 능력을 평가함.

questions.question: 23. 맥락이 같은 문장으로 전환이 잘못된 것은?
questions.explanation: ⑤ Turning left...는 '만약 왼쪽으로 돌면(If you turn left)'의 조건 의미인데, 생략된 부사절이 제시되지 않았거나 다른 의미로 오인될 수 있음. 하지만 다른 보기들은 명확한 시간/이유의 접속사로 잘 복원되어 있음. (제시문 상 5번은 미완성임)
options: ① Running to me, she waved her hand. -> As she ran to me, she waved her hand.
② Losing the game, she felt disappointment. -> After she lost, she felt disappointment.
③ Hearing the news, I gave a shout of joy. -> When I heard the news, I gave a shout of joy
④ Being nervous, I forgot my lines at the musical. -> Since I was nervous. I forgot my lines at the musical.
⑤ Turning left, you will find the school right away.
questions.reason_for_classification: 분사구문의 의미 유추를 통한 부사절 전환의 적절성을 판단하는 문제임.

questions.passage:
AWFUL DISASTER
The Herald November 9th, 1874
Last night, an angry group of rhinoceroses broke down the walls of the cage at the zoo and escaped. They also broke down the walls of the other wild animals’ cages. These animals ran down the streets and injured hundreds of people. Twelve of the animals are still on the loose. Citizens should stay indoors until further notice.
Not a single act or incident described above has taken place.
At that time, those who read the article above carefully laughed out loud. Those who didn’t read it to the end got really worried. (A)As many people didn’t know the news was false, many people panicked. Some tried to escape the city while others went into the parks with guns to hunt the animals.
So why did The Herald make up such news? Later, they confessed that they made it up so as to draw the readers’ attention to the unsafe conditions at the zoo. Likewise, there have been various fake news reports throughout history to show ‘the hidden motives’ behind them.
questions.question: 24.  글의 (A)와 뜻이 같도록 ‘분사구문’으로 영작하시오.
questions.explanation: As many people didn't know...를 분사구문으로 바꾸면, 부정어 Not을 분사 앞에 쓰고, 동사 know를 분사형으로 고치며, 주어가 동일하므로 생략하거나 문맥상 명확히 한다. 'Not knowing the news was false'가 적절함.
sentences: (A)As many people didn’t know the news was false, many people panicked.
questions.answer: Not knowing the news was false
questions.reason_for_classification: 부정형 분사구문을 활용한 영작 능력을 평가함.

questions.question: 25. 윗글을 읽고, 위  지문의 밑줄 친 (가) 속 “teaching”과 문장 내에서의 역할이 같은 것을 모두 고르면? (2개)
questions.explanation: (가)의 teaching은 접속사 While 뒤에 쓰인 분사구문의 현재분사이다. ⓐ Hearing(분사구문), ⓓ eating(분사구문)이 동일한 역할을 함. ⓒ Seeing은 동명사 주어, ⓔ amazing은 형용사적 분사임.

questions.question: 26. 윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 올바른 문장의 개수는?
questions.explanation: ⓐ는 help + 목적어 + 동사원형으로 옳음. ⓒ는 love + -ing, by + -ing, 관계대명사 that 등 어법상 옳음. ⓑ는 user와 has 사이에 주격 관계대명사가 빠졌거나 who has가 되어야 함. ⓓ는 긍정적인 리뷰를 '보았을 때'이므로 Seeing으로 고쳐야 함. ⓔ는 let이 사역동사이므로 to know를 know로 고쳐야 함. 따라서 옳은 문장은 2개임.
questions.reason_for_classification: 사역동사, 분사구문의 태, 관계대명사 등 다양한 문법 사항을 지문 전체에서 검증하는 복합 문제임.

questions.question: 27. 다음 각 문장을 변형한 것으로 알맞은 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓓ는 양보 접속사를 생략하지 않은 분사구문(Though living...)으로 옳음. ⓐ는 시제가 과거(got)이므로 walked가 되어야 함. ⓑ는 walked 앞에 and가 있거나 walking이 되어야 함. ⓒ는 because 뒤에 이유가 오므로 '돈이 없었기 때문에(because he had no money)'가 되어야 함. ⓔ는 key를 찾은 것이므로 finding the key가 '집에 들어갈 수 있었던 이유'가 되어 어순이나 논리가 어색할 수 있음.
sentences: ⦁Walking home in the rain, I got wet. -> ⓐ<u>As I walk home in the rain, I got wet</u>.
⦁He stood up and he walked out of the room. -> ⓑ<u>He stood up walked out of the room</u>.
⦁Having no money, he couldn’t buy a new cap. -> ⓒ<u>He had no money because he couldn’t buy a new cap</u>.
⦁Though I live next door, I don’t know her. -> ⓓ<u>Though living next door, I don’t know her</u>.
⦁I could get into my house because my mom found the key. -> ⓔ<u>I could get into my house finding the key</u>.
questions.reason_for_classification: 분사구문과 부사절의 상호 전환 과정에서 시제, 인과관계, 접속사 생략 규칙을 묻는 문제임.

questions.question: 28. 다음 (A), (B) 문장을 연결한 것으로 적절하지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: ②는 와인을 '연 후(After she opened...)'이므로 능동형 분사구문 Opening the wine...이 되어야 함. Being opened는 수동형임.
options: ① He was reading the letter while crying loudly.
② Being opened the wine, she poured it into my glass.
③ Taking a key out of his pocket, he opened the door.
④ I gave up buying a new cap, having money.
⑤ The man being rude to us, we didn’t invite him to the party.
sentences: (A) He was reading the letter / (B) He was crying loudly
(A) She opened the wine / (B) She poured the wine into my glass
(A) He took a key out of his pocket / (B) He opened the door
(A) I gave up buying a new cap / (B) I had no money
(A) The man was rude to us / (B) We didn’t invite him to the party
questions.reason_for_classification: 두 문장을 분사구문으로 연결할 때의 태(능동/수동)와 완료형 사용의 적절성을 묻는 문제임.

questions.question: 29. 다음 문장 중, 어법상 옳은 것은?
questions.explanation: ② '아파서 침대에 누워 있었지만 숙제를 했다'는 의미의 분사구문으로 옳음(Being 생략 가능). ① 뉴스를 듣고 '놀란' 것이므로 Surprised, ③ 공원을 '걷는 동안'이므로 Walking, ④ 벤치에 '앉아서'이므로 Sitting, ⑤ 분사구문이 완료형이면 Having been nervous 뒤에 주절 동사 forgot이 와야 함.
options: ① Surprising at the news, he could say nothing.
② Being very sick in bed, I still did my homework.
③ Walked in the park, he met one of his friends.
④ Sit on the bench, he enjoyed the beautiful scenery.
⑤ Having been nervous on the stage, the actor forgetting his lines.
questions.reason_for_classification: 감정 분사, 진행 분사, 분사구문의 기본 형태와 주절과의 관계를 묻는 문제임.

questions.question: 30. 다음 문장을 분사구문으로 바꿀 때, 어법상 옳은 것은?
questions.explanation: ⑤ While she was listening...에서 주어가 같으므로 생략하고 Listening to music...으로 전환한 것은 옳음. ① Being late, ② Seeing the police, ③ Left alone, ④ Not having met...으로 각각 고쳐야 함.
options: ① As I was late to the audition, I took a taxi. -> Lating to the audition, I took a taxi.
② When the thief saw the police, he ran away. -> Seen the police, he ran away.
③ If you are left alone home, you may feel lonely. -> Leaving alone home, you may feel lonely.
④ As I had not met him before, I didn’t know him. -> Having not meet him before, I didn’t know him.
⑤ While she was listening to music, she did her homework. -> Listening to music, she did her homework.
questions.reason_for_classification: 부사절을 분사구문으로 정확하게 전환하는 능력을 평가함.

questions.question: 31. 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
questions.explanation: ① 'Jane이 아파서 내가 그녀의 일을 했다'는 주어가 다른 독립분사구문으로 옳음. ② 빈칭주어 It을 생략할 수 없으므로 It being a holiday로 써야 함. ③ so strongly가 아닌 형용사 strong이 보어로 와야 함. ④ 시제 일치에 따라 can을 could로 고쳐야 함. ⑤ 부사인 luckily가 아닌 형용사 lucky가 와야 함.
options: ① Jane being sick, I did her work.
② Being a holiday, the bank was closed.
③ He is so strongly that he could lift the box.
④ He spoke loudly so that everyone can hear him.
⑤ She was luckily enough to travel all over the world.
questions.reason_for_classification: 독립분사구문의 주어 생략 불가 규칙과 so~that, enough to 구문의 형용사/부사 선택 문제를 결합함.

questions.question: 32. 다음 문장 중, 어법상 옳은 것은?
questions.explanation: ⑤ '스카이다이빙을 하러 가는 것'은 '스릴 넘치는(thrilling)' 경험이므로 감정 분사의 현재분사형 사용이 옳음. ① worried, ② bored, ③ exciting, ④ was so scared로 각각 고쳐야 함.
options: ① He is worry about his mom in the hospital.
② The audience were boring by the long speech.
③ Visiting my best friend in Busan is very excited.
④ The girl so scared when a ghost appeared on the screen.
⑤ Going skydiving was one of the most thrilling experiences.
questions.reason_for_classification: 감정을 나타내는 분사의 능동(-ing)과 수동(-ed) 의미 구분을 묻는 문제임.

questions.question: 33. 다음 <보기>와 같이 그림에 알맞은 영어 문장을 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: While Daniel listened to music...에서 접속사와 주어를 생략하고 동사를 현재분사로 바꾸면 Listening to music이 됨.
sentences: <보기> lands- While Tom talked on the phone, Tom watched TV. lands- → Talking on the phone, Tom watched TV.
While Daniel listened to music, Daniel watered the plants.
→ ___________________________, Daniel watered the plants.
questions.answer: Listening to music
questions.reason_for_classification: 동시동작을 나타내는 부사절을 단순 분사구문으로 전환하는 기초 문제임.

questions.question: 34. 문장의 형태가 어법상 바르게 전환된 것은?
questions.explanation: ⑤ 완료 부정 분사구문(Not having finished...)이 적절하게 쓰임. ①은 being stuck에서 being이 생략된 형태이나 문맥상 옳지만 ⑤가 가장 명확한 전환임. ② Judging from, ③ Having fun..., ④ His arriving late (독립분사구문 소유격/목적격) 등이 틀림.
options: ① As he was stuck in traffic, he missed the meeting. -> Stuck in traffic, he missed the meeting.
② If we judge from her voice, she is a famous singer. -> Judged from her voice, she is a famous singer.
③ We are having fun while we are watching a comic movie. -> Having fun while we are watching a comic movie.
④ Because he arrived late, we couldn’t start the meeting as it was scheduled. -> Him arriving late, we couldn’t start the meeting as it was scheduled.
⑤ Since she hasn't finished her homework yet, I will not allow her to hang out with her friend. -> Not having finished her homework yet, I will not allow her to hang out with her friend.
questions.reason_for_classification: 완료형 부정 분사구문 등 분사구문의 복잡한 변형 형태를 정확히 알고 있는지 평가함.

questions.question: 35. 다음과 같이 답한 학생의 점수는?
questions.explanation: 1. O(real의 비교급 realer는 드물지만 사용 가능, 단 보통 more real 선호), 2. X(of Kevin으로 고쳐야 함), 3. X(his being으로 고쳐야 함), 4. O(advise+O+to V), 5. X(very는 최상급 수식 불가, by far 등 사용), 6. X(as tall as), 7. X(O). 채점 결과 3점이 적절함(학생의 답란 O/X와 실제 정답 비교).
sentences: 문장이 어법상 옳으면 O, 틀리면 X로 표시하시오.
(3)학년 (15)반 번호(1) 이름 (권OO)
|문항|문제[각 1점]|답란|
|1|They were much realer than drawings.|O|
|2|It is careless for Kevin to lose his bag.|X|
|3|They were so sure of he being alive.|X|
|4|I advised him to exercise regularly.|O|
|5|This reason is the very most important.|X|
|6|No other girl in the class is as tallest as Jane.|X|
|7|This math problem is difficult for me to solve.|X|
questions.reason_for_classification: 의미상 주어, 비교급/최상급, 동명사의 의미상 주어 등 여러 문법 사항을 복합적으로 채점하는 문제임.

questions.question: 36. ⓐ~ⓕ 중 어법상 어색한 것끼리 묶인 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓒ had chosen과 병렬을 이루어야 하므로 created로, ⓔ 사역동사 made 뒤에는 동사원형 join이 와야 하므로 joined는 틀림. ⓕ became은 이형식 동사이므로 형용사 wise가 와야 함.

questions.question: 37. 밑줄 친 ①~⑤ 중 어법상 맞는 것은?
questions.explanation: ④ '기억하려고 노력하라(Try to remember)'는 어법상 자연스러움. ① it is difficult for any of us(가주어-의미상주어), ② including(분사수식), ③ when you are(시간 부사절/관계부사), ⑤ Some are at best(주어 필요) 등이 틀렸거나 어색함.
options: ① <u>any of us to maintain a constant level of attention</u>
② <u>included peaks and valleys of energy and alertness</u>
③ <u>which you are in your best condition</u>
④ <u>Try to remember when you reach your peak energy levels</u>
⑤ <u>Being at best in the morning</u>

We all have body rhythms ② <u>included peaks and valleys of energy and alertness</u>. You will achieve more and gain confidence if you schedule your most demanding tasks ③ <u>which you are in your best condition</u>. If you haven’t thought about energy peaks before, take a few days to observe yourself. ④ <u>Try to remember when you reach your peak energy levels</u>. We are all different. ⑤ <u>Being at best in the morning</u>, but for others, it may take a while to warm up.
questions.reason_for_classification: 가주어-진주어 구문의 의미상 주어, 분사 수식, 접속사 및 주어 유무를 종합적으로 판단하는 문제임.

questions.question: 38. 밑줄 친 부분이 어법상 틀린 것은?
questions.explanation: ⑤ 스테이크가 '완벽하게 요리된' 것이므로 수동의 과거분사 Cooked를 써야 함.
options: ① <u>There being no available parking spaces around</u>
④ <u>Speaking of the birthday party food that night</u>
sentences: We drove to the restaurant where my friend’s birthday party was held. ① <u>There being no available parking spaces around</u>, I had to park my car several blocks away from the venue. ② <u>Compared with a year ago</u>, the price of parking was up 28 percent. ③ <u>Not having a credit card</u>, I found it difficult to pay the parking fee. ④ <u>Speaking of the birthday party food that night</u>, I loved the way the cook made the steak. ⑤ <u>Cooking to perfection</u>, the steak was juicy and flavorful.
questions.reason_for_classification: 독립분사구문, 관용구, 부정형 분사구문 등에서 능동/수동 관계의 적절성을 가려내는 문제임.

questions.explanation: ⓐ는 선행사를 포함하여 brought의 목적어 역할을 하는 what, ⓑ는 사람 선행사 hero를 수식하는 주격 관계대명사 who, ⓒ는 said의 목적절을 이끄는 접속사 that이 적절하다.
questions.reason_for_classification: 관계대명사 what, 주격 관계대명사, 명사절 접속사 that을 문맥 속에서 구분하는 능력을 묻는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 21. 주어진 우리말을 괄호 안의 조건에 맞게 영작하시오.
questions.explanation: be supposed to(~하기로 되어 있다) 구문과 관계대명사 what을 결합하여 영작한다.
sentences: 우리는 우리가 오늘 해야 했던 것을 끝냈다. (* ‘what’, ‘suppose’ 사용.)
questions.answer: finished what we were supposed to
questions.reason_for_classification: 관계대명사 what과 be supposed to 관용 표현을 활용한 영작 능력을 평가합니다.

questions.question: 22. 주어진 우리말 의미의 영어 문장을 완성할 때 빈칸에 들어갈 단어로 알맞게 짝지어진 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ는 수동태 done (일이 행해지다), ⓑ는 선행사 포함 관계대명사 what, ⓒ는 조언을 구하는 대상에 쓰이는 전치사 on이 적절하다. (목적격 보어 done/명사절 what/전문 분야 전치사 on)
sentences: 오늘 할 수 있는 일을 내일로 미루지 마라.
Don’t put ( ) till tomorrow ( ) can be ( ⓐ ) today.
목적은 삶에 의미를 부여하는 것이다.
Purpose is ( ⓑ ) gives life a ( ).
우리는 마케팅에 있어 우리에게 조언을 해줄 전문가가 필요하다.
We need an expert ( ）can ( ) ( ) ( ⓒ ) marketing.
questions.reason_for_classification: 수동태의 분사 형태, 관계대명사 what, 그리고 특정 분야를 나타내는 전치사의 쓰임을 묻는 복합 문제입니다.

questions.question: 23. 다음 우리말을 영어로 옮길 때 빈칸에 들어갈 말을 주어진 단어를 활용하여 문장을 완성하시오.
questions.explanation: blame A for B (B에 대해 A를 탓하다) 구문과 선행사 포함 관계대명사 what을 사용한다.
sentences: 주어진 단어는 변형 불가, 의미상 필요한 단어 첨가는 가능
blaming, circumstances
사람들은 항상 그들이 어떤 사람인지에 대해 그들의 상황을 탓한다.
People ( ⓐ ) always ( ⓑ ) their ( ⓒ ) for ( ⓓ ) they are.
questions.answer: ⓐ are ⓑ blaming ⓒ circumstances ⓓ what
questions.reason_for_classification: 진행형 시제와 숙어(blame for), 그리고 보어로 쓰인 관계대명사 what을 포함한 영작 문제입니다.

questions.passage: I am an early adopter of new technology. An early adopter is someone who uses new products and technology (A)__________ others. When I get near my dream house, the front door recognizes my face and opens automatically. The furniture checks the weather conditions and advises me on (B)__________to wear. The bathroom mirror tells me my weight and the condition of my health. A robot cleans the house and cooks for me.
questions.question: 24. 윗글의 (A)와 (B)에 문맥상 가장 올바르게 들어갈 단어로 짝지어진 것은?
questions.explanation: (A)는 남들 '보다 먼저' 사용한다는 의미의 before, (B)는 무엇을 입을지 알려준다는 의문사+to부정사 구문의 what이 적절하다.

questions.question: 25. 주어진 문장에서 어법상 틀린 부분을 모두 찾아 올바른 문장으로 고쳐 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: what이 이끄는 명사절이 간접의문문 형태일 때 '의문사/관계대명사 + 주어 + 동사' 어순이 되어야 하므로 'are they'를 'they are'로 고쳐야 한다.
sentences: The letter shows what good friends are they.
questions.answer: The letter shows what good friends they are
questions.reason_for_classification: 관계대명사/의문사 what이 이끄는 절의 올바른 어순(간접의문문 어순)을 묻는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 26. 다음 문장이 같은 의미가 되도록 밑줄 친 부분에 알맞은 말을 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: 관계대명사 what은 'the thing(s) which/that'으로 바꾸어 쓸 수 있다.
sentences: She couldn’t believe what her friend said to her.
= She couldn’t believe______________ ______________ _______________ her friend said to her.
questions.answer: the thing that
questions.reason_for_classification: 관계대명사 what의 선행사 포함 정의를 이해하고 있는지 확인하는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 27. 다음 빈칸 ⓐ~ⓒ에 들어갈 말이 순서대로 연결된 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ는 선행사 없이 목적어 역할을 하는 what, ⓑ는 사람 선행사를 수식하는 주격 who/that, ⓒ는 뒤의 명사 dream과 소유 관계인 whose가 적절하다.
sentences: ⚪I don’t understand ____ he says.
⚪I need a person ____ can speak English.
⚪I know a girl ____ dream is to be a figure skater.
questions.reason_for_classification: 관계대명사의 세 종류(what, 주격, 소유격)를 구분하는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 28. 다음 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 보기와 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: 보기와 ①,②,③,⑤는 모두 관계대명사(~하는 것)로 쓰였으나, ④는 '무엇을 가져올지'라는 의미의 의문사이다.
options: ① That’s what I like about him.
② What I need is a good rest.
③ I heard what they were saying.
④ I’m not sure what he will bring.
⑤ He is what they call a book worm.
sentences: <보기> That’s exactly what I wanted.
questions.reason_for_classification: 관계대명사 what과 의문사 what의 쓰임 구별 문제입니다.

questions.question: 29. 빈칸에 들어갈 단어로 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: 문맥상 주어 역할을 하며 '동기를 부여하는 것'이라는 의미가 필요하므로 선행사를 포함한 관계대명사(the thing that 또는 what)가 적절하다.
sentences: There are hundreds of good tips out there, but everyone has their own way of learning. Find __________ keeps you motivated; then you will enjoy learning more. Remember, every language is hard at first, but a new language can make your world much bigger!
questions.reason_for_classification: 관계대명사 what의 풀이된 형태인 'the thing that'의 쓰임을 묻는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 30. 빈칸에 'what'이 들어갈 수 없는 것은?
questions.explanation: ⑤는 시드니 오페라 하우스라는 명백한 선행사가 있고 콤마가 있으므로 관계대명사의 계속적 용법인 which를 써야 한다. what은 선행사가 없을 때 쓴다.
options: ① _____ appeared in front of us was a strange ghost-like figure.
② She chose _____ she needed for the journey and packed only the essentials.
③ The children were amazed at _____ the magician pulled out of his hat.
④ We had many good ideas, but it was difficult to choose _____ we really wanted.
⑤ The Sydney Opera House, _____ took its shape from an orange, is one of the most beautiful buildings.
questions.reason_for_classification: 관계대명사 what과 관계대명사의 계속적 용법(which)의 선행사 유무에 따른 쓰임 차이를 묻는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 31. 다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것을 고르면? (2개)
questions.explanation: ②는 소유격 관계대명사 whose 뒤에 중복 대명사 his를 삭제해야 한다. ③은 주어가 The house(단수)이므로 동사를 is로 고쳐야 한다.
options: ① I met a woman whose brother I had worked with.
② We’re chasing a thief whose we haven’t seen his face.
③ The house whose garden is filled with colorful flowers are what I want to buy.
④ The dog whose swinging tail shows happiness lies peacefully in its favorite spot.
⑤ She showed us the old house whose windows were covered with colorful curtains.
questions.reason_for_classification: 소유격 관계대명사의 중복 요소 배제 원칙과 주어-동사 수 일치를 복합적으로 묻는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 32. 다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것을 고르면? (2개)
questions.explanation: ①은 phone이라는 선행사가 있으므로 that/which를 써야 하는데 문맥상 질문이므로 'Is this the phone that...' 형태가 자연스럽거나 what을 썼을 때 선행사가 없어야 함. 하지만 'the things what' 구조인 ②가 명백히 틀렸음(what은 선행사를 포함하므로 the things와 함께 쓸 수 없음). ①은 선행사 the가 빠져 어색함.
options: ① Is this phone that you’re looking for?
② Do the things what make you happy.
③ She found what he hid under the bed.
④ The thing that we need is an umbrella.
⑤ Show me what you drew on the paper.
questions.reason_for_classification: 관계대명사 what과 that의 선행사 포함 여부에 따른 차이를 구별하는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 33.  다음 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 1단어를 쓰시오. (단, 대소문자는 무시할 것)
questions.explanation: 첫 번째 문장은 주어 역할을 하는 관계대명사 what, 두 번째 문장은 think의 목적어 역할을 하는 관계대명사 what이 적절하다.
sentences: __________ I enjoy is watching action movies.
Think about ________ you did last weekend.
questions.answer: what
questions.reason_for_classification: 관계대명사 what의 공통적인 쓰임을 찾는 문제입니다.

questions.passage:
Garcia-Fuller said she was teaching her students how to tell fake news from real news. “One of the first steps is to slow down. If a story or a photo seems too good (A)[to be / being] true, stop and think: Is there anything that supports what the writer says? And where is this coming from?” Garcia-Fuller’s students also learn how to tell fact from opinion in the news. “Opinions are good to read,” said 15-year-old McKenzie Campbell, “but you also have to check if they are based on
facts.” Garcia-Fuller also said sometimes it can be very hard to be a smart news reader. She tests her students with a website that appears to provide information on an animal (B)[called / calling] a tree octopus. The site is full of information on this animal, along with a few unclear photos of octopuses in trees. But like the story of scary clowns, it’s totally made up. The lesson, Garcia-Fuller tells her students, is to “check the information you’re seeing once more carefully” and to “question everything, even things (C)[that / what] I say.“
questions.question: 34.  윗글의 (A)~(C)에 들어갈 말을 옳게 나열한 것은?
questions.explanation: (A)는 too...to부정사 구문인 to be, (B)는 동물이 불리는 것이므로 과거분사 called, (C)는 선행사 things가 있으므로 관계대명사 that이 적절하다.
questions.reason_for_classification: too...to 구문, 분사의 명사 수식, 관계대명사의 선행사 유무에 따른 선택 능력을 묻는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 35. 다음 중 어법이 틀린 문장은?
questions.explanation: ④에서 what은 선행사를 포함하므로 앞의 the book이라는 선행사와 함께 쓰일 수 없다. that이나 which로 고쳐야 한다.
options: ① You always make us laugh out loud.
② He is no only brave but also very nice.
③ Watching the news, she called her mom.
④ That is exactly the book what I want.
⑤ My sister is smart enough to understand economic rules.
questions.reason_for_classification: 관계대명사 what의 선행사 포함 특성을 이해하고 다른 관계대명사와 구별할 수 있는지 묻는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 36. 어법상 옳은 문장을 있는 대로 모두 고르면, 옳은 문장의 개수는?
questions.explanation: (A) 최상급, (D) 양보 접속사, (E) 가주어/진주어, (F) 시제와 명사구 모두 옳다. (B)는 책이 번역되는 것이므로 has been translated로, (C)는 선행사를 포함한 what they had to do로 고쳐야 한다.
sentences: (A) The cheetah is the fastest land animal.
(B) The book has been translating into 10 languages.
(C) That they had to do is to protect students who are in danger.
(D) He didn't wake up although the alarm clock rang many times.
(E) It is important to educate children about the good behaviors.
(F) The oil spill was a really serious matter to marine animals in 2010.
questions.reason_for_classification: 현재완료 수동태, 관계대명사 what, 가주어/진주어 등 다양한 문법 사항을 종합적으로 판단하는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 37. 주어진 조건에 따라 다음 우리말을 영어로 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: 사역동사 make와 관계대명사 what을 결합하여 'Mayonnaise made the turtles throw up what they ate.'로 영작한다. (마요네즈 주어/사역동사 make/목적어/동사원형 throw up/관계대명사절)
sentences: <조건>
- up, what, eat, make (변형 가능 & 필수 사용)
- 7~10단어로 이루어진 문장으로 쓸 것
(마요네즈가 거북이들이 먹은 것을 토해내게 만들었다.)
questions.answer: Mayonnaise made the turtles throw up what they ate
questions.reason_for_classification: 사역동사의 5형식 구조와 관계대명사 what절의 목적어 역할을 동시에 활용하는 고난도 영작 문제입니다.

questions.question: 38. 다음의 우리말을 의미와 어법에 맞도록 영작한 것은?
questions.explanation: ①은 'What they learned'가 단수 주어 역할을 하여 옳다. ②는 주어가 thing(단수)인데 were를 썼고, ③은 the thing과 what을 중복 사용했으며, ⑤는 things(복수)인데 was를 썼다.
options: ① What they learned today was about climate change.
② The thing they learned today were about climate change.
③ The thing what they learned today was about climate change.
④ The thing, that they learned today, were about climate change.
⑤ The things which they learned today was about climate change.
sentences: 그들이 오늘 배운 것은 기후 변화에 관한 것이었다.
questions.reason_for_classification: 관계대명사 what절의 주어 역할과 그에 따른 수 일치를 묻는 문제입니다.

questions.passage:
Minji: Minsu, there's no cup I can use. Why didn't you do the dishes?
Minsu: Sorry, but I forgot to do them.
Minji: ⓐ_________? You always forget ⓐ_________ you have to do. I can't stand it. I cleaned the living room all morning.
questions.question: 39. 밑줄 친 ⓐ에 공통으로 들어갈 것은? (대소문자 무관함)
questions.explanation: 앞에는 '뭐라고?(What?)'라는 단독 의문사로, 뒤에는 forget의 목적어인 관계대명사 what(~하는 것)으로 공통 사용된다.

questions.passage: Favio was an environmental educator and a musician. He wanted to teach us music, but there was a big problem. ⓐ<u>There were only a few musical instruments in the whole town</u>. ⓑ<u>We couldn’t afford to buy new ones</u>. But Favio didn‘t give up. He said that we could make musical instruments with objects from the landfill. ⓒ<u>A talented man named Nicholas was able to put this idea into practice</u>. He made violins from oil drums. He turned water pipes into flutes. There was another problem. No one knew how to play musical instruments. We didn’t even know how to read music. Favio taught us with great patience. Step by step, we began to make some sounds on our instruments. ⓓ<u>I still remember the first piece of music what we played</u>. It was very short and mostly out of tune. But it was the most beautiful music to us. We felt a new hope in our hearts. ⓔ<u>From then on, we gathered in order to practice every day</u>. One day, Favio told us some great news. We were going to have a concert, a real concert!
questions.question: 40. 윗글의 ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓓ에서 'the first piece of music'이라는 선행사가 존재하므로, 선행사를 포함하는 관계대명사인 what은 쓸 수 없다. that이나 which로 고쳐야 한다.
questions.reason_for_classification: 관계대명사 what과 선행사가 있는 관계대명사(that/which)를 구분하는 문제입니다.

questions.passage:
Jane: (가) <u>화성에 대해서 네가 알고 있는 것을 나에게 말해줘</u>.
Mike: Mars is about half the size of Earth.
questions.question: 41. (가)의 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영어로 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: 명령문 'Tell me'와 관계대명사 what절을 결합하여 'Tell me what you know about Mars.'로 영작한다.
sentences: <조건>
• 명령문의 형태를 활용할 것
• 7단어의 완전한 문장으로 쓸 것
questions.answer: Tell me what you know about Mars
questions.reason_for_classification: 명령문 구조 내에서 관계대명사 what절을 목적어로 사용하는 능력을 평가합니다.

questions.question: 42. 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영어로 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: 관계대명사 what을 보어로 사용하여 'This is different from what I expected.'로 영작한다.
sentences: 이것은 내가 기대했던 것과 다르다.
<조건>
• 7단어의 완전한 문장으로 쓸 것
questions.answer: This is different from what I expected
questions.reason_for_classification: 전치사의 목적어로 쓰인 관계대명사 what절을 활용한 영작 능력 평가 문제입니다.

questions.passage: We didn't spend much time on planning. All the members started building the tower right away. Our first tower looked like a tent. It wasn't very tall. We tried again. The next tower was tall but it couldn't stand by itself. After many tries, we could make a beautiful and tall tower. It looked like the Leaning Tower of Pisa. We finally made (가)__________ we wanted!
questions.question: 43. (가)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: made의 목적어이자 선행사를 포함하는 관계대명사인 what이 들어가서 '우리가 원했던 것'이라는 의미를 완성한다.
questions.reason_for_classification: 지문 문맥상 목적어 역할을 하는 선행사 포함 관계대명사를 찾는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 44. 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영어로 쓰시오.

questions.passage:
Why We Buy What We Buy
Have you ever wondered ___ⓐ___ you've bought things that you don't even want or need? Let's consider ___ⓑ___ affects us ___ⓒ___ it comes to buying things.
㉠<u>Why do I want to buy that my friends bought?</u>
㉡<u>Jeff goes to the shopping center and sees a pair of soccer shoe in display</u>. He recognizes the shoes (㉮) a glance because more than half of the boys on his soccer team wear them. Although he already has many pairs of soccer shoes, he ends up buying another new pair.
We can use the "bandwagon effect" to explain Jeff's behavior. ㉢<u>A bandwagon is a wagon in a parade which encourages people to jump aboard and enjoy the music</u>. ⒶAs more and more people get on the bandwagon, others are more likely (㉯) get on or follow it. ㉣<u>In this way people tend to buy something just because other people have bought</u>. 
Why do I buy a pair of pants and a bag after I have bought a new coat?
Lisa buys a coat that she really loves. Immediately, she realizes that her pants do not match her new coat. So, she buys new pants that go perfectly (㉰) her new coat But she sees that none of her bags match her new clothes. So, she buys a new bag. Most of her money is spent (㉱) buying the new items to complete her new look.
㉤<u>What made Lisa to search for new items immediately after buying a new coat</u>? The "Diderot effect" may explain it. Denis Diderot, a French writer, received a new gown as a gift. Soon after receiving the gift, he noticed that all of his furniture did not go well (㉲) his new gown. So, he ended up replacing most of it. The Diderot effect, therefore, is the concept that purchasing a new item often leads to more unplanned purchases.

questions.passage:
Different colored foods help our bodies in different ways. What does each color of food
do for our bodies? Red foods such as cherries and tomatoes ⓐpromote heart health and blood circulation. They also ⓑweaken your *immune system. Orange foods are known ___㉠___ be good for skin and eye health because they are ⓒpoor in vitamin A. So add carrots and sweet potatoes to your shopping list. Yellow foods keep our brains and stomachs healthy. So try some delicious yellow foods like pineapple, corn, and golden kiwifruit. Green vegetables contain many substances that ⓓdevelop cancer. They are also a good source of *fiber, which ___㉡___ maintain your weight. If you want to stay young, go for blue and purple foods. They are high in *antioxidants, which make them the perfect ⓔaging food. Now ___㉢___ you know the benefits of eating colorful foods, try to put as many colors as possible on your plate. This will make every part of your body healthier.
*immune system 면역 체계 *fiber 섬유질 *antioxidant 항산화제
questions.question: 10. 윗글의 ㉠~㉢에 들어갈 말을 알맞게 짝지은 것은?
questions.explanation: ㉠ be known to (~하는 것으로 알려지다), ㉡ 선행사 fiber는 불가산 명사로 취급하여 단수 동사 helps가 오거나 help를 준사역동사로 볼 때 수 일치에 따라 helps가 적절하며 (지문 맥락상 helps), ㉢ '이제 ~이니까'라는 뜻의 접속사 'Now that'이 적절하다.

questions.question: 11. 다음 문장의 빈칸에 들어갈 어법상 바른 것은?
questions.explanation: (A) 계속적 용법의 관계대명사 which (Ball 수식), (B) '무엇을 주어야 하는지'를 나타내는 관계대명사 또는 의문사 what, (C) '진실을 말했다고 믿었다'는 내용의 명사절 접속사 that, (D) '네가 말한 것'을 나타내는 관계대명사 what이 적절하다.
sentences: · We live on the Earth, (A)________ is like a ball.
· People knew (B)________ they should give him to help his family.
· He believed (C)________ he told me the truth, but it was not true.
· The problem you didn’t know is (D)________ you said hurt her feelings.
questions.reason_for_classification: 관계대명사(which, what)와 접속사(that)의 쓰임을 구별하는 문제이다.

questions.question: 12. 다음 중 어법상 바른 것은?
questions.explanation: ② 'What you like'가 명사절 주어로 쓰인 문장으로 어법상 옳다. ① 'what'은 'that'으로, ③ 'everything what'은 'everything that'으로, ④ 'song what'은 'song that/which'로, ⑤ 'What'은 뒤 문장이 완전하므로 'That'으로 고쳐야 한다.
options: ① His only fault is what he has not fault.
② I know what you like is something scary.
③ We don’t have everything what you ordered.
④ I like the song what is often used in TV commercials.
⑤ What she finished the project in 3 days was amazing.
questions.reason_for_classification: 관계대명사 what의 성질(선행사를 포함하며 불완전한 문장을 이끎)을 이해하고 다른 접속사/관계사와 구별하는 문제이다.

questions.passage: There are hundreds of good tips out there, but everyone has their own way of learning. (A)<u>Find what keeps you motivated; then you will enjoy learning more</u>. Remember, every language is hard at first, but (B)<u>a new language can make your world much bigger</u>!
questions.question: 13. 위 글의 밑줄 친 (A)를 <보기>와 같이 바꿔 쓸 때 빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 말은?
questions.explanation: '당신을 동기부여시키는 것'이라는 의미이므로 선행사를 포함한 관계대명사 what이 필요하며, 능동의 의미이므로 what motivates가 적절하다.
sentences: <보기>
To discover _______________ you can lead to a more enjoyable learning experience.
*lead to : result in, cause
questions.reason_for_classification: 관계대명사 what을 사용하여 '동기부여 하는 것'이라는 의미를 구성하는 문제이다.

questions.question: 14. 다음 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
questions.explanation: (A) '소위, 말하자면'이라는 뜻의 관용 표현 'what is called'가 적절하며, (B) '설상가상으로'라는 뜻의 관용 표현 'what was worse'가 문맥상 적절하다.
options: ① so called			what it does
② what he was		what it calls
③ what he has			what was better
④ what is called		what was worse
⑤ what he used to be		what was worse
sentences: ⦁It was the hottest day of summer and (B)_____________ the air conditioner in my room was broken.
questions.reason_for_classification: 관계대명사 what을 포함한 관용 표현(what is called, what is worse)의 암기 및 적용을 묻는다.

questions.passage: Hello, class. Today we're going to make bacon and egg sandwiches. Before we get started, let me tell you what you must ________. First, wash your hands before you start. Second, be careful when you use a knife. Is everything okay with you? All right, let's begin.
questions.question: 15. 빈칸에 들어가기에 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: 뒤에 이어지는 내용들이 손 씻기, 칼 조심 등 행동 지침이므로 '반드시 해야 할 것'을 의미하는 'do'가 가장 적절하다.

questions.question: 16. 빈칸에 ‘what’이 들어갈 수 없는 것은?
questions.explanation: ② 'nothing'과 같은 선행사가 있으므로 관계대명사 'what'을 쓸 수 없으며, 'that'이 적절하다. 나머지는 모두 선행사가 없으므로 'what'이 들어갈 수 있다.
options: ① Her rude attitude was ______ made us upset.
② There is nothing more ______ we can do to get things better.
③ Sarah's answer was not ______ we expected to hear from her.
④ The incident was ______ led to the start of the First World War.
⑤ ______ mainly caused the terrible disaster was the earthquake.
questions.reason_for_classification: 관계대명사 what은 선행사가 없을 때 사용한다는 기본 규칙을 묻는 문제이다.

questions.question: 17. 어법상 옳은 것만을 <보기>에서 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: (C), (E), (F)가 옳다. (A) 선행사가 없으므로 which 대신 what, (B) 선행사가 없으므로 that 대신 what, (D) 주어절을 이끌며 선행사가 없으므로 That 대신 What이 적절하다.
sentences: <보기>
(A) This is which I expected before.
(B) My parents always did that they believed was right.
(C) I really like what my mom gave me on my birthday.
(D) That I have to do in the morning is cleaning my room.
(E) Please don’t tell my teacher what I did in English class.
(F) You should pay attention to what your teacher says during the lesson.
questions.reason_for_classification: 관계대명사 what의 옳고 그름을 여러 문장에서 판단하는 문제이다.

questions.passage:
Many students learn new languages because of school _____(가)_____. Many others learn them for fun. In any case, students everywhere have found interesting ways to study new languages. 
There are hundreds of good tips out there, but everyone has hteir own way of learning. FInd (A)<u>what keeps you motivated</u>; then you will enjoy learning _____(나)_____. Remember, every language is hard at first, but a new language can make your world _____(다)_____!
questions.question: 18. 밑줄 친 부분이 윗글 (A)와 같은 역할로 쓰인 것은?
questions.explanation: (A)는 동사 Find의 목적어 역할을 하는 관계대명사절이다. ② 역시 동사 believe의 목적어 역할을 하므로 역할이 동일하다. (①, ③, ④는 보어, ⑤는 주어 역할)
options: ② I don’t believe <u>what you told me</u>.
③ Her honesty is <u>what I like about her</u>.
④ This is <u>what I bought from the store</u>.
⑤ <u>What surprised me</u> was Paul’s behavior.
questions.reason_for_classification: 관계대명사 what이 이끄는 절이 문장 내에서 수행하는 문장 성분(주어, 목적어, 보어)을 구별하는 문제이다.

questions.question: 19. 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 괄호 안의 말을 활용하여 문장을 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: '내가 찾고 있는 것'은 관계대명사 what을 사용하여 'what I am looking for'로 영작한다.
sentences: (1) 이 책은 바로 내가 찾고 있는 것이다. (this book, exactly, look for)
questions.answer: This book is exactly what I am looking for
questions.reason_for_classification: 관계대명사 what을 사용한 영작 문제이다.

questions.question: 20. 다음 빈칸 안에 들어갈 수 있는 관계대명사 중 같은 것만을 <보기>에서 있는 대로 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: a, c, e, g는 선행사가 없으므로 'what'이 들어가며, b, d, f는 선행사(present, things, newspapers)가 있으므로 'which'나 'that'이 들어간다.
options: ⑤ b, d, e, f, g
sentences: <보기>
a. Her honesty is _________ I like about her.
b. This is the present _________ my grandmother gave me.
c. _________ I need these days is more sleep.
d. My sister wanted to sweep the things _________ have fallen on the grass.
e. Please show me _________ you will wear to the party.
f. The newspapers _________ the boy is selling are cheap.
g. Is this _________ you want?
questions.reason_for_classification: 관계대명사 what과 that/which를 선행사의 유무를 통해 구별하는 문제이다.

questions.passage:
Jaewoo: What is Ron doing right now?
Mandy: He is watching his favorite drama.
Jaewoo: Really? I saw him watching it when I went out for dinner.
Mandy: When did you go out for dinner?
Jaewoo: About three hours ago! Did he eat his dinner yet?
Mandy: I made him chicken soup, but he has not even touched it.
questions.question: 21. 위 대화의 내용을 바탕으로 <보기>의 단어만을 모두 한 번씩 사용하여 ‘Mandy가 만든 음식’에 대한 한 문장을 만들 때 여섯 번째 올 단어는? (필요시 어형을 바꿀 것, 문장의 첫 번째 단어는 “Chicken”으로 할 것)
questions.explanation: 문장을 구성하면 "Chicken soup is what Mandy cooked for Ron's dinner."가 된다. 여섯 번째 단어는 'cooked'이다.
sentences: <보기>
Chicken / Mandy / what / dinner /
soup / for / Ron’s / cook / be
questions.reason_for_classification: 대화의 내용을 파악하고 관계대명사 what을 사용하여 적절한 영작 및 어순 배열을 수행하는 문제이다.

questions.question: 22. 다음 ⓐ~ⓖ 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ(소유격 whose), ⓓ(목적격 whom), ⓔ(관계대명사 what)가 옳다. ⓑ which -> what(선행사 없음), ⓒ barks -> bark(선행사 dogs 일치), ⓕ the thing what -> the thing that/which 혹은 what, ⓖ who -> whose(명사 life 수식)로 고쳐야 한다.
sentences: ⓐI have a friend whose hobby is to play tennis.
ⓑHe didn't pay attention to which I had told him.
ⓒMy friend has two dogs that barks all day long.
ⓓThe woman whom my boss is talking to is his wife.
ⓔShe loved what Joe gave her as a birthday present.
ⓕThe thing what you have done will be remembered in our hearts.
ⓖThis story is about the man who life is full of adventures and thrilling moments.
questions.reason_for_classification: 주격, 목적격, 소유격 관계대명사 및 관계대명사 what의 쓰임과 수 일치를 종합적으로 묻는 문제이다.

questions.question: 23. 다음 중 두 사람의 대화에서 밑줄 친 부분이 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: ⑤ 선행사가 없으므로 'that' 대신 'what'을 사용하여 'what I wanted to have most'라고 해야 한다.
options:
① Ann: Excuse me? May I help you? 
Jenny: You don't have <u>what I'm looking for</u>.

② Teacher: What did your father say?
Student: I can't remember <u>what he said</u> yesterday.

③ Tom: Let me see <u>the thing that you bought</u>.
Mike: I bought a cute doll for my sister.

④ Kevin: <u>What you did</u> will let your mom down.
Chris: Sorry, I will not do it again.

⑤ Mina: Look at this! My dad gave me a bike.
Jack: The bike is <u>that I wanted to have most</u>.
questions.reason_for_classification: 대화 상황에서 관계대명사 what의 올바른 쓰임을 구별하는 문제이다.

questions.question: 24. 다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
questions.explanation: '네가 가방에 가지고 있는 것'은 선행사가 포함된 관계대명사 what을 써서 'what you have in your bag'으로 표현하는 것이 가장 적절하다.
options: ① Show me what you have in your bag.
② Show me what you have a thing in your bag.
③ Show me something which have in your bag.
④ Show me something what you have in your bag.
⑤ Show me the thing which you have it in your bag.
sentences: 네가 가방에 가지고 있는 것을 나에게 보여줘.
questions.reason_for_classification: 관계대명사 what의 기본적 영작 능력을 평가한다.

questions.question: 25. 다음 <조건>에 맞게 주어진 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 영작하시오.
questions.explanation: (1) 'What we need now is a new computer'로 주어절을 what으로 구성한다. (2) 'He showed me what he made during the class'로 직접목적어절을 what으로 구성한다.
sentences: <조건>
관계대명사 what 사용할 것
괄호 안의 단어를 모두 활용하고, 필요시 단어를 추가하거나 변형할 것
(1) 우리가 지금 필요한 것은 새 컴퓨터이다. (new)
(2) 그는 나에게 그가 수업시간 동안 만든 것을 보여주었다. (during the class)
questions.answer: (1) What we need now is a new computer. (2) He showed me what he made during the class.
questions.reason_for_classification: 조건에 맞추어 관계대명사 what을 주어 및 목적어 위치에 사용하는 영작 문제이다.

questions.question: 26. 다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장의 개수는?
questions.explanation: ⓐ, ⓑ, ⓒ, ⓓ는 관계대명사 what을 선행사 없이 목적어절로 적절하게 사용했다. ⓔ는 'the homework'라는 선행사가 있으므로 'what' 대신 'that'이나 'which'를 써야 한다. 따라서 4개가 옳다.
sentences: ⓐ I haven’t received what I ordered yet.
ⓑ We ate what Mom had cooked for us.
ⓒ You haven’t given me what I asked for.
ⓓ She loved what Joe gave her as a birthday present.
ⓔ I forgot to bring the homework what I did yesterday.
questions.reason_for_classification: 관계대명사 what의 선행사 유무에 따른 올바른 쓰임을 확인하는 문제이다.

questions.question: 27. 다음 중 어법상 옳은 것만을 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓒ, ⓓ가 옳다. ⓐ which -> what(선행사 없음), ⓑ mom has cooked -> had cooked(과거 기준 이전의 일이므로 과거완료), ⓔ that -> what(선행사 없음)으로 고쳐야 한다.
sentences: ⓐ This is exactly which I want.
ⓑ We ate what mom has cooked for us.
ⓒ The table was what every dealer dreamed of.
ⓓ Lunchtime is what I like about my school.
ⓔ The store didn’t have that I wanted to buy.
questions.reason_for_classification: 관계대명사 what의 선행사 유무 판단과 더불어 시제(과거완료) 일치까지 고려해야 하는 문제이다.

questions.passage:
The word sherpa comes from the sherpa tribe, (A)<u>what / which</u> lives in the eastern part of Nepal. sherpas have good climbing skills and know their way around the mountains well. They also have little difficulty (B)<u>breathe / breathing</u> high up in the mountains. Therefore, mountain climbers started to hire sherpas to help them climb Mount Everest.
sherpas lead mountain climbers to the top of the mountain. they support climbers in many ways. For example, they put up tents and (C)<u>carry / carrying</u> climbers’ bags. sherpas are often called the invisible people of Mount Everest because people often see a picture of only the climbers at the top of the mountain.
questions.question: 28. 위 대화의 괄호(A)~(C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: (A)는 tribal을 수식하는 계속적 용법의 관계대명사이므로 which, (B)는 'have difficulty -ing' 관용 구문이므로 breathing, (C)는 put up과 병렬을 이루는 carry가 적절하다.
questions.reason_for_classification: 관계대명사의 계속적 용법, 동명사 관용구, 동사의 병렬 구조를 묻는 복합 문법 문제이다.

questions.question: 29. 다음 보기의 단어를 이용하여 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: '내가 생일에 하고 싶은 것'을 주어절로 구성해야 하므로 'What I want to do'가 적절하다.
sentences: <보기>
do, want, what
<조건>
· 주어진 단어를 반드시 사용할 것
· 한 칸에 한 단어만 쓸 것
A: Is there anything you want to do on your birthday?
B: ______ ______ ______ ______ ______ on my birthday is to go on a camping trip.
questions.answer: What I want to do
questions.reason_for_classification: 관계대명사 what을 사용한 명사절 주어 구성 능력을 평가한다.

questions.question: 30. 다음 우리말 해석에 맞게 <보기>의 단어를 모두 사용하여 영어 문장을 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: 'Joe가 그녀에게 준 것'을 what절로 만들어 'what Joe gave her'를 loved의 목적어로 사용한다.
sentences: 그녀는 Joe가 그녀에게 생일 선물로 준 것을 좋아했다.
<보기>
she / gave / what / her / loved / as a birthday present / Joe
questions.answer: She loved what Joe gave her as a birthday present
questions.reason_for_classification: 관계대명사 what을 사용한 목적어절 영작 문제이다.

questions.passage:
The man who walked back created a safe path around the forest. Using this path, people could get to the place ⓐ<u>where</u> they were going without getting lost, even though the trip took a little longer.
The man who went straight became a pioneer. He left the forest and discovered places no one else ⓑ<u>has</u> been before. Thanks to him, people could enjoy these new beautiful lands.
The man who climbed the tree became a guide. Since he had found many different paths, he was able to teach people how to find the quickest ways to their destinations.
This is the way ⓒ<u>which</u> they found their own paths. Like them, we are each on our own journey in life, and we cannot compare one journey to another. You have to create your own path. Listen to yourself, make a decision, and ⓓ<u>acting</u> on it. Then, someday, you will realize ⓔ<u>what</u> you have been living the life that is right for you.
questions.question: 31. ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 단어의 쓰임이 올바른 것의 개수는?
questions.explanation: ⓐ(관계부사 where)만 옳다. ⓑ 과거 이전 시점이므로 had, ⓒ the way와 how는 함께 쓸 수 없으나 이 경우 how 혹은 the way만 쓰거나 in which를 써야 함, ⓓ make와 병렬을 이루는 act, ⓔ realize의 목적어절은 완전하므로 접속사 that이 적절하다.
questions.reason_for_classification: 시제, 관계부사, 접속사, 병렬 구조 등을 포함한 고난도 종합 어법 문제이다.

questions.question: 17. 다음 문장의 빈칸에 들어갈 수 있는 어법상 알맞은 표현을 모두 고르면? (정답 2개)

questions.question: 22. 다음 중 어법상 바른 것은?

questions.question: 23. 그림을 올바르게 설명한 것은?
