Fun Facts about Onions
An onion is a round vegetable with brown skin that grows underground. It does have many white layers on its inside which have a strong, sharp smell and taste. Here are some fun facts about onions.
• It is one of the oldest foods known to us.
• It is one of the easiest vegetables to grow in the home garden.
• There are 27 different types of onions.
Most onions are purple, yellow or white. All onions do taste like onions, but some are sweeter than others. Different types of onions also do grow differently.
• Onions used to get rid of coughs and fevers are widely considered as natural remedies.
• The largest onion on record did weigh over 10 pounds!

A: It does have many white layers on its inside.
ⓑ Q: Is the fact that onions are one of the oldest foods surprised?
A: No, it is well known that onions are among the oldest foods we have.
ⓒ Q: How many different kinds of onions are there?
A: There are 3 different type of onions and they have purple, yellow or white colors.
ⓓ Q: How do different types of onions grow?

We all agreed that our wall painting wasn't perfect. But it didn't matter. (가) 우리는 우리의 동네를 조금 더 밝고 더 행복하게 만들었어. We didn't just paint pictures on a wall that day. It was a better tomorrow (나)that we painted.
questions.question: 46. (가)의 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영어로 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: 5형식 문장 'We made our neighborhood a little brighter and happier' (9단어)로 작성함.
sentences: <조건>
• 'a'를 한 번 포함한 9단어의 완전한 문장으로 쓸 것
• 동사 'make'를 활용할 것
questions.answer: We made our neighborhood a little brighter and happier
questions.reason_for_classification: 5형식 문장(목적격 보어: 형용사)과 비교급 수식을 결합한 영작 문제임.

questions.question: 47. 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영어로 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: 'The higher you climb, the farther you see.' (8단어)
sentences: 당신이 높이 올라가면 갈수록, 당신은 더 멀리 본다.
<조건>
• 'the+비교급~, the+비교급'을 사용할 것
• 동사 'climb', 'see'를 사용할 것
• 8단어의 완전한 문장으로 쓸 것
questions.answer: The higher you climb, the farther you see
questions.reason_for_classification: The 비교급 구문의 전형적인 영작 능력을 평가함.

questions.question: 48. 틀린 부분을 찾아 올바르게 고친 것은?
questions.explanation: ⑤ 'the more beautiful'이 되어야 함. (①~④는 제시된 문장들이 이미 어법상 옳거나, 고친 방식이 틀림)
options:
① The more time you spend alone, the lonelier you will become.
(will become --> became)

② The more you practice, the fewer mistakes you will make.
(the fewer --> less)

③ The more complex the problem is, the longer it takes to solve it.
(longer --> better)

④ The more you smile, the happier you feel.
(happier --> more happy)

⑤ The older she got, the better beautiful she became.
(better --> more)
questions.reason_for_classification: 비교급의 불규칙 변화 및 음절에 따른 비교급 형성 규칙을 묻는 문제임.

questions.question: 49. 다음 <보기 1>과 같이 <보기 2>의 문장을 바르게 완성할 때, ⓐ, ⓑ에 들어갈 말로 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
questions.explanation: 'The hotter the weather gets, the fewer people there are on the street.'로 변환되므로 ⓐ people, ⓑ there 순서임.
sentences: <보기 1>
If she becomes more popular, she will make more money.
→ The more popular she becomes, the more money she will make.
<보기 2>
If the weather gets hotter, there are fewer people on the street.
questions.reason_for_classification: If 조건절을 The 비교급 구문으로 전환할 때, 명사가 포함된 비교급 어구의 어순을 파악하는 문제임.

questions.question: 50. 다음 <보기 1>의 단어를 모두 한 번씩만 활용하여 <보기 2>의 문장을 바르게 영작할 때 ⓐ와 ⓑ에 들어갈 단어로 바르게 짝지어진 것은
questions.explanation: 'The more I study a human brain, the more mysterious things it shows me.' 어순임. 따라서 ⓐ more, ⓑ mysterious가 적절함.
sentences: <보기 1>
a, study, mysterious, it, show, thing, me
<보기 2>
내가 인간의 뇌를 더 많이 연구할수록, 그것은 나에게 더 신비한 것들을 보여준다.
questions.reason_for_classification: The 비교급 구문을 활용한 영작 시 비교 대상 어순과 동사의 위치를 파악하는 문제임.

questions.question: 1. 밑줄 친 (A)와 의미가 같은 것은? I said, "(A)Drawing on a wall was harder than drawing on paper."
questions.explanation: (A)는 '벽에 그리는 것이 종이에 그리는 것보다 더 어려웠다'는 비교급 문장이다. 이와 의미가 같은 것은 '종이에 그리는 것이 벽에 그리는 것만큼 어렵지 않았다(더 쉬웠다)'는 의미인 ②번(not as ~ as 구문)이다.
options: ① Drawing on a wall was easier than drawing on paper.
② Drawing on paper wasn't as hard as drawing on a wall.
③ Drawing on paper was harder than drawing on a wall.
④ Drawing on a wall was as difficult as drawing on paper.
⑤ Drawing on a wall was less difficult than drawing on paper.
questions.reason_for_classification: 비교급 문장을 동등비교(as~as)의 부정형으로 전환하여 같은 의미를 나타내는 능력을 묻는 문제이다.

questions.question: 2. <보기>와 같이 문장을 올바르게 바꾼 것은?
questions.explanation: ②번 문장은 'If you exercise, you become healthy.'를 'The more you exercise, the healthier you become.'(더 많이 운동할수록 더 건강해진다)로 올바르게 전환하였다. ①, ③, ⑤는 어순이 틀렸으며, ④는 comparative 형태(worse)가 잘못되었다.
options:
① If we got close to the fire, we feel warm.
➜ The closer fire we get, the warmer we feel.

② If you exercise, you become healthy.
➜ The more you exercise, the healthier you become.

③ If you travel, the world becomes big.
➜ The more you travel, the bigger becomes the world.

④ If his illness gets bad, he will feel pain.
➜ The more bad his illness gets, the more pain he will feel.

⑤ If the problem is complex, it takes long to solve it.
➜ The more complex is the problem, the longer it takes to solve it.
sentences: <보기>
If the fruit is fresh, it tastes good.
➜ The fresher the fruit is, the better it tastes.
questions.reason_for_classification: 'The + 비교급, the + 비교급' 구문의 정확한 어순과 형용사/부사의 비교급 형태를 묻는 문제이다.

questions.question: 3. (A)~(E) 중 어법상 올바른 것은?
questions.explanation: (C) 'It’s only 20 dollars, and it goes with a discount coupon...'은 문법적으로 옳다. (A) look like 뒤에는 명사가 와야 하므로 cool(형용사) 앞에서는 like를 빼야 한다. (B) prefer A to B 구문을 써야 한다. (D) Unless the black one is 40 dollars로 어순이 바뀌어야 한다. (E) sound quality 앞에 has나 of가 필요하다.
sentences: G: Jinho, look! (A)<u>These two speakers look like pretty cool</u>.
B: Yeah, they do. Which one do you prefer?
G: (B)<u>I prefer the red one better than the black one</u>. (C)<u>It’s only 20 dollars, and it goes with a discount coupon for music downloads</u>.
B: (D)<u>Unless is the black one 40 dollars, I think it’s the right one for me</u>. (E)<u>I heard it is better sound quality</u>.
questions.reason_for_classification: 감각동사, 선호 표현(prefer), 조건절 어순 등 다양한 문법 요소의 정확성을 판별하는 문제이다.

questions.passage:
Many students learn new languages because of school _____(가)_____. Many others learn them for fun. In any case, students everywhere have found interesting ways to study new languages.
There are hundreds of good tips out there, but everyone has hteir own way of learning. FInd (A)<u>what keeps you motivated</u>; then you will enjoy learning _____(나)_____. Remember, every language is hard at first, but a new language can make your world _____(다)_____!
questions.question: 4. 윗글 (가)~(다)에 들어갈 말로 올바른 것은?
questions.explanation: (가)에는 '학교 필수 요건(requirements)'이 적절하며, (나)에는 '공부를 더 즐기게 될 것이다(more)'가, (다)에는 비교급 강조 표현인 'much bigger'가 적절하다.
options: ①	subjects		more	much more big
④	requirements	less	much more small

questions.question: 5. 다음 ⓐ~ⓔ의 각 문장을 변형한 것으로 알맞은 것만을 있는 대로 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓑ 'The older he gets, the wiser he becomes'와 ⓓ 'The worse the weather gets, the more umbrellas I can sell'은 'The + 비교급' 어순이 올바르다. ⓐ는 정관사 The가 누락되었고, ⓒ와 ⓔ는 어순이 잘못되었다.
sentences: ⓐ If you spend more time alone, you will become lonelier.
→ More time you spend alone, lonelier you will become.
ⓑ If he gets older, he becomes wiser.
→ The older he gets, the wiser he becomes.
ⓒ As Katie listened to the song more, she loved it more.
→ The song Katie listened more, the more she loved it.
ⓓ As the weather gets worse, I can sell more umbrellas.
→ The worse the weather gets, the more umbrellas I can sell.
ⓔ If she becomes more popular, she will make more money.
→ The more she becomes popular, the more money she will make.
questions.reason_for_classification: 'The + 비교급, the + 비교급' 구문에서 형용사와 부사가 포함된 비교급의 정확한 위치와 관사 사용 여부를 확인하는 문제이다.

questions.question: 6. 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
questions.explanation: ⑤번 문장에서 'The more you say kindly'는 kindly라는 부사가 비교급인 more의 수식을 받아 함께 앞으로 나가야 하므로 'The more kindly you say'가 되어야 한다.
options: ① The less you eat, the more you can save.
② The longer the story is, the more interesting.
③ The more books you read, the wiser life you will live.
④ The more often you exercise, the healthier you can become.
⑤ The more you say kindly, the more comfortable they will feel.
questions.reason_for_classification: 'The + 비교급' 구문에서 부사가 비교급과 결합하여 문두로 이동할 때의 어순을 묻는 문제이다.

questions.question: 7. 다음 <보기>에서 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ, ⓑ, ⓔ는 문법적으로 옳다. ⓒ는 'The more often I see you'로, ⓓ는 'The more muscles you have'로 어순이 교정되어야 한다.
sentences: <보기>
ⓐ The smaller the ball is, the lighter.
ⓑ The less you give, the less you will get back.
ⓒ The more I see you often, the prettier you look.
ⓓ The more you exercise, the stronger you have muscles.
ⓔ The fresher vegetables you eat, the healthier you become.
questions.reason_for_classification: 'The + 비교급' 구문의 다양한 변용(명사 수식, 부사 수식, 동사 생략 등)과 정확한 어순을 묻는 복합 문제이다.

questions.question: 8. <보기>에서 밑줄 친 단어의 쓰임이 바른 것끼리 짝지어진 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓒ는 원급인 interesting을 강조할 수 없으며 비교급인 more interesting을 much가 수식해야 한다. ⓗ는 '전자, 후자'의 의미이므로 later(시간상 나중)가 아닌 latter(순서상 후자)가 되어야 한다. 나머지는 모두 쓰임이 옳다.
sentences: <보기>
ⓐ The <u>least</u> important thing should be put at the end of the list.
ⓑ I have two older brothers, Tom and Nick. Tom is the <u>eldest</u> brother.
ⓒ I like this painting because it looks <u>much</u> interesting than the others.
ⓓ We need better policies to promote the <u>further</u> development of our country.
ⓔ The <u>last</u> singer announced by the host has won the first prize in the contest.
ⓕ The <u>latest</u> device which has been recently upgraded is becoming popular among Korean people.
ⓖ This area is the <u>farthest</u> place from this city and has amazing greenery and a beautiful ocean view.
ⓗ I want to talk about social and environmental problems. The <u>later</u> one is a serious issue that we can’t avoid any more.
questions.reason_for_classification: 형용사의 비교급과 최상급의 불규칙 변화(far-farther/further, late-later/latter, latest/last) 및 강조 부사의 쓰임을 묻는 문제이다.

questions.question: 9. 어법상 잘못된 문장의 개수는?
questions.explanation: 잘못된 문장은 다음 4개이다. 1) 'the by far fastest' -> 'by far the fastest' (어순), 2) 'intelligent than' -> 'more intelligent than' (비교급 누락), 3) 'the a lot strongest' -> 'a lot stronger' 혹은 'the strongest' (비교급 강조와 최상급 혼용), 4) 'third bigger' -> 'third biggest' (서수+최상급).
sentences: ○ The darker it got, the colder it became.
○ They are the kindest people I have ever known.
○ The train is the by far fastest in the world.
○ She is intelligent than any other student in our school.
○ This is the a lot strongest table the company has recently made.
○ No one is as smart as the man I met at the international conference last year.
○ The more serious environmental pollution becomes, the more natural disasters there will be.
○ This tower is the third bigger one she has ever seen during her travels around the world.
questions.reason_for_classification: 비교급과 최상급의 강조 어순, 서수와 최상급의 결합, 비교급 형태의 정확성 등을 종합적으로 판단하는 문제이다.

questions.passage:
Ask Your Neighbors helps people easily find items that they can borrow from others. First, users download the app and search for another user that ⓐ<u>have</u> the items they need. Then they pick up the items and return ⓑ<u>it</u> later.
Jasmine : December 12, 2019
I asked for a board game and got one in at ⓒ<u>least</u> than 30 minutes. I love ⓓ<u>saving</u> money by borrowing things that I don’t often need. Also, I think it's environmentally friendly. The fewer products we buy, the more resources we save.
Cassandra : March 7, 2020
Seeing a lot of positive reviews, I decided ⓔ<u>to borrow</u> a bike helmet. When I got it, however, it was broken. I was so upset!
Ask Your Neighbors : March 9, 2020

questions.question: 10. ⓐ~ⓗ 중 어법상 올바른 것의 개수는?
questions.explanation: 올바른 것은 ⓓ(saving), ⓔ(to borrow), ⓕ(that), ⓖ(to update) 4개와, 문맥상 ⓐ(search for another user that have - 복수 선행사로 볼 경우)를 포함하여 5개로 볼 수 있다. 오답: ⓑ(it->them), ⓒ(least->less), ⓗ(to know->know).
questions.reason_for_classification: 수 일치, 비교급, 동명사, to부정사(사역동사 목적격 보어), 명사절 접속사 등 중등 과정 전반의 문법 사항을 종합적으로 묻는 문제이다.

questions.question: 11. 나머지 넷과 의미가 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: ①, ②, ③, ④는 모두 'John이 가장 신뢰할 만한 직원이다'라는 최상급의 의미를 담고 있다. 반면 ⑤는 '어떤 직원도 John만큼 신뢰할 수 없는(unreliable) 사람은 없다' 즉, 'John이 가장 신뢰할 수 없는 사람이다'라는 반대의 의미를 가진다.
options: ① There is no employee who can be relied upon more than John.
② We can rely on John more than any other employee.
③ John is the most reliable employee in the company.
④ John is more reliable than all the other employees.
⑤ No employee is as unreliable as John.
questions.reason_for_classification: 원급과 비교급을 이용한 최상급 표현의 전환 및 형용사의 반의어에 따른 의미 변화를 파악하는 문제이다.

questions.question: 12. 다음 우리말과 같도록 <보기>에 주어진 단어를 배열했을 때, ⑥에 들어갈 단어로 알맞은 것은? [4.2점] (주어진 단어는 한번씩만 사용함)
questions.explanation: 주어진 우리말을 영작하면 "It is more enjoyable to spend time on my smartphone than with friends."가 된다. 순서대로 배열하면 It(1) is(2) more(3) enjoyable(4) to(5) spend(6) time(7) on(8) my(9) smartphone(10) than(11) with friends이므로 6번째 단어는 spend이다.
sentences: 친구들과 보내는 시간보다 내 스마트폰을 하면서 시간을 보내는 것이 더 즐겁다.
<보기> with, to, enjoyable, time, my, on, more, smartphone, friends, spend, than
questions.reason_for_classification: 가주어-진주어 구문과 비교급(more ~ than)을 결합하여 문장을 구성하는 능력을 묻는 문제이다.

questions.question: 13. 괄호 안에서 알맞은 말이 순서대로 짝지어진 것은?
questions.explanation: 1) from one place to another (한 곳에서 다른 곳으로), 2) care for (~를 돌보다), 3) more than (~이상)이 적절하다.
sentences: ○ People walk along the path to get from one place [to/for] another.
○ I need to care [to/for] my grandparents.
○ It shouldn’t take more [for/than] an hour to get ready.

questions.question: 14. 다음 중 어법상 적절하지 않은 문장은?
questions.explanation: ①번 문장에서 비교급 more fluently를 강조하기 위해 very를 사용했는데, very는 원급만 수식할 수 있고 비교급 강조에는 much, a lot, even, far, still 등을 사용해야 한다.
options: ① Ms. Han speaks English very more fluently.
②﻿My friends like fall much better than summer.
③﻿These shoes are a lot more expensive than my bag.
④ Sumi is late for school even more often than Minho.
⑤ The freezing cold weather made our task still more difficult.
questions.reason_for_classification: 비교급 강조 부사(much, even, still, far, a lot)와 원급 수식 부사(very)의 구별을 묻는 문제이다.

questions.question: 15. 다음 밑줄 친 우리말을 영어로 쓰시오. He runs 훨씬 더 빠르게 than me.
questions.explanation: '훨씬'은 비교급 강조 부사인 much, even, far, a lot, still 중 하나를 쓰고, '더 빠르게'는 fast의 비교급인 faster를 사용하여 'much faster' 등으로 쓴다.
questions.answer: much faster
questions.reason_for_classification: 비교급 강조 부사와 비교급 형태를 결합하여 영작하는 문제이다.

questions.question: 16. 다음 표의 내용을 잘못 이해한 사람은?
questions.explanation: 표를 보면 민정은 500,000원을 저축했고 정민도 500,000원을 저축했다. 따라서 ④번 '민정이 정민보다 훨씬 더 많은 돈을 저축했다'는 설명은 틀렸다.
options: ① 정민 is far taller than 하늘
② 하늘 is still lighter than 진수
③ 진수 is a lot heavier than 정민
④ 민정 saved far more money than 정민
⑤ 진수 read much more books than 정민
sentences: 정민	하늘	진수	민정
키	190cm	150cm	187cm	152cm
몸무게	60kg	45kg	100kg	50kg
독후감 제출 수	0권	25권	50권	5권

questions.passage: Stanley was assigned to Group D in the camp. There were six other boys in Stanley's group. They all had cool names like X-Ray, Zigzag and Zero. Each boy had to dig one hole every day. It had to be 150cm deep and 150cm wide. Mr. Sir said, "You are digging to build character." (<u>스탠리는 더 많은 구멍을 파면 팔수록, 더 힘이 세져 갔다</u>) It took less time to finish his hole each day. In his second week, as Stanley was finishing his hole, he saw something shiny in the dirt. Stanley's heart beat faster. He heard that anyone who found something interesting would be given the day off. He carefully picked up the shiny object and brushed off the dirt. It was a small gold tube. But it couldn't be real gold since it was too light. There were too letters, KB, at the bottom of the tube. What did KB stand for? Stanley's heart beat even faster.
questions.question: 17. 밑줄 친 문장을 어법에 맞게 완전한 영어문장으로 바꾸어 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: '~하면 할수록 더 ...하다'는 'The + 비교급, the + 비교급' 구문을 사용한다. '더 많은 구멍을 팔수록(the more holes Stanley dug)'과 '더 힘이 세져 갔다(the stronger he became/got)'을 결합하여 쓴다.
questions.answer: The more holes Stanley dug, the stronger he became.
questions.reason_for_classification: 'The + 비교급' 구문을 활용하여 우리말의 인과적 점진 상태를 영작하는 문제이다.

questions.passage: The Melbourne International Comedy Festival (MICF) is ____________ in the world. It is also the largest cultural event in Australia. Generally it opens on April Fool’s Day (April 1) and runs for about three weeks. People say that it is the least commercial of the three major international comedy festivals which are the Melbourne International Comedy Festival, Edinburgh’s Fringe Festival and Montreal’s Just For Laughs. Every year, it is with hundreds of domestic and international artists. And it makes people enjoy a lot of shows. The Comedy Festival Gala’s opening night show attracts a lot of people. It is known for being the most popular show. Getting a chance to visit Australia in April, you will be able to attend the fantastic festival.
questions.question: 18. 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
questions.explanation: '세상에서 가장 큰 국제 코미디 페스티벌 중 하나'라는 의미가 되어야 하므로 'one of the + 최상급 + 복수 명사' 구문인 ③ 'one of the largest international comedy festivals'가 정답이다.
options: ① one largest comedy festival international
② one of largest international festivals comedy
③ one of largest international comedy festivals
④ one of the largest comedy festival international
⑤ one of the larges international comedy festivals

questions.passage:
Do you like to draw on paper? What about on walls? (A)<u>Some people may think paintings on the walls aren't neat</u>. They may look dirty. However, sometimes simple drawings can change a whole city into a work of art. Let's look at special trips to special cities full ___(가)___ street art.

Philadelphia, the U.S. (B)<u>Philadelphia is one of the oldest city in the U.S</u>. On the walls of old buildings, some people drew ugly pictures. Many people didn't like the drawings, so in 1984 people started a campaign to fight against these ugly wall paintings. (C)<u>However, Jane Golden, an artist, had a different idea</u>. Instead of fighting back, she gathered people and gave them a professional art class. From then ___(나)___, people drew pictures about hope, dreams, and love on the walls. (D)<u>It made the city beautiful</u>. More and more, a lot of people fell in love with the drawings on the walls. Now, there are more than 3,600 wall pictures in Philadelphia. It became the world's largest outdoor museum.

São Paulo, Brazil
A poor city in Brazil, São Paulo, was covered ___(다)___ dark and gray walls. However, small boxes of colors changed the streets. A group of five Spanish artists worked together with children in the town. They painted the walls of the town bright colors of red, yellow, and blue. They also used a small trick. They hid words in the art on each street. (E)<u>If you travel to São Paulo, try to find them in the works of street art</u>.
questions.question: 19. 윗글의 (A)~(E) 중 어법상 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: (B) 'one of the + 최상급' 뒤에는 복수 명사가 와야 하므로 city가 아닌 cities가 되어야 한다.
questions.reason_for_classification: 'one of the + 최상급 + 복수 명사' 구문에서 명사의 수 일치 오류를 찾아내는 문제이다.

questions.question: 20. 다음 (A)에 들어갈 말로 어법이 가장 옳은 것은?
questions.explanation: 지난달(Last month)에 있었던 과거 사실(티켓을 못 산 것)에 대한 후회와 가정(과거에 샀더라면)을 나타내므로 가정법 과거완료(If + 주어 + had p.p., 주어 + would have p.p.)가 적절하다. ⑤번 'If I had bought the tickets, I would have been at the concert'가 정답이다.
options: ① If I bought the tickets, I would be at the concert.
② If I had bought the tickets, I would be at the concert.
③ If I bought the tickets, would have been at the concert.
④ If I had bought the tickets, I would had been at the concert.
⑤ If I had bought the tickets, I would have been at the concert.
sentences: Last month, I wanted to go to a concert of my favorite band. I was really looking forward to it. On the day of buying tickets, I waited too long, and they sold out. So, I couldn't buy the tickets. On the day of the concert, l had to listen to their music at home. (A)__________________________ I felt disappointed.
questions.reason_for_classification: 과거 사실에 반대되는 상황을 가정하는 가정법 과거완료의 형태와 시제 일치를 묻는 문제이다.

questions.question: 21. 다음 글의 내용상 어법이 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓑ 'Not only have you been...'은 부정어구(Not only)가 문두에 와서 주어와 동사가 도치된 올바른 문장이다. ⓐ는 'would have had'가 되어야 하고, ⓓ는 'place in which' 혹은 'place where'가 되어야 하며, ⓔ는 관계대명사 whose가 필요하다. ⓒ도 'Stepping into...' 분사구문으로 가능하나 ⓑ가 더 명확한 문법적 특징을 보여준다.
sentences: Dear Students,

It's hard to believe that it has already been three years since you joined Cheongram Middle School, and now you are about to graduate. ⓐ<u>lf we were given more time, we would had a better experience</u>. I feel sorry about that.

You have worked so hard during your time here, and we want to express our sincere congratulations and encouragement to each of you. ⓑ<u>Not only have you been great students, but you will continue to be excellent individuals in the future</u>. ⓒ<u>Stepping into the new chapter of learning</u>, we hope your future is filled with wonderful opportunities. We look forward to your progress from the same place.

As we've always said, we hope you become someone who takes care of both your body and mind. Diligence and honesty are the foundation of everything, and a life lived earnestly will surely be rewarded. Learn to appreciate the value of hard work ⓓ<u>in the place which you are.</u> We hope you meet good people and try to be good people yourselves. You will be a person who respects rules, considers others and lives with honor. Please remember to show gratitude to your parents ⓔ<u>who love and concern have cared for you</u>.
We hope your middle school years are remembered as valuable and enjoyable, and we are cheering for your future with all our hearts.
Best wishes for your journeys!
November 2024
From the Teachers of Cheongram Middle School
questions.reason_for_classification: 상관접속사 도치 구문, 가정법 혼합 시제 오류, 관계사 생략 및 격 확인 등 고급 문법 사항을 판별하는 문제이다.

questions.passage: Once upon a time there was a small village in a forest. The villagers were farmers and raised cows. Luckily, some good grassland lay in the middle of the village. Everyone ⓐ_________ allowed to use the grassland. Therefore, it was called "the commons." By tradition, each family only had one cow, so it was easy for each cow in the village to find enough grass to eat. The grass on the commons ⓑ_________ green all summer long. But one day a villager broke the rule. He brought another cow and let it graze on the commons. He thought that nobody would notice it. A happy feeling filled his heart when he thought of the milk and cheese that the second cow would bring to his family.A few days later, the farmer visited a close friend who had four children. He wanted to help his friend, so he told him in secret, "If I ⓒ_________ you, I would bring in one more cow and raise it on the commons." The friend thanked him and did as he was told the next day.
questions.question: 22. 빈칸 (a)~(c)에 들어갈 be동사를 바르게 짝지은 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ Everyone은 단수 취급하므로 was, ⓑ The grass는 불가산 명사이며 과거의 상태를 나타내므로 was, ⓒ 가정법 과거 'If I were you' 구문이므로 were가 적절하다.
questions.reason_for_classification: 주어의 수 일치와 가정법 과거 구문에서의 be동사(were) 사용을 묻는 문제이다.

questions.question: 23. 다음 우리말에 대한 영어표현이 되도록 빈칸에 주어진 단어들을 바르게 배열해 쓰시오. (단, 필요시 형태를 변형할 것) 만약 내가 너라면, 무엇이든 할텐데.
questions.explanation: 가정법 과거 구문(If + 주어 + were, 주어 + 조동사과거 + 동사원형)을 사용하여 영작한다.
questions.answer: If I were you, I would do anything.
questions.reason_for_classification: 가정법 과거의 기본 구조와 어순을 묻는 서술형 문제이다.

questions.question: 24. 다음 우리말에 대한 영어표현이 되도록 빈칸에 주어진 단어들을 바르게 배열해 쓰시오. (단, 필요시 형태를 변형할 것) 만약 비가 온다면, 나는 집에 있을텐데.
questions.explanation: 가정법 과거 구문 'If it were rainy, I would stay at home'으로 영작한다.
questions.answer: If it were rainy, I would stay at home.
questions.reason_for_classification: 날씨를 나타내는 비인칭 주어 it과 가정법 과거를 결합한 서술형 문제이다.

questions.question: 25. 다음 우리말에 대한 영어표현이 되도록 빈칸에 주어진 단어들을 바르게 배열해 쓰시오. (단, 필요시 형태를 변형할 것) 만약 내가 너라면, 그런 것은 아무것도 먹지 않을 텐데. < anything, that, will, be, eat, like>
questions.explanation: 'If I were you, I would not eat anything like that'으로 영작한다.
questions.answer: were you, I would not eat anything like that.
questions.reason_for_classification: 가정법 과거의 부정 형태를 활용한 영작 문제이다.

questions.question: 26. <보기> 중에서 어법상 옳은 것만을 있는 대로 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ 'It was kind of her...' (의미상 주어 of)와 ⓔ 'If Jimin heard... she would be...' (가정법 과거)는 옳다. ⓑ는 'He is'가 아닌 가주어 'It is'가 되어야 하고, ⓒ는 'would buy', ⓓ는 'If there were'가 되어야 한다.
sentences: <보기>
ⓐ It was kind of her to give me a ride.
ⓑ He is dangerous for him to climb up the ladder.
ⓒ If I had enough money, I would bought this jewel.
ⓓ If there been superheroes, the world would be safer.
ⓔ If Jimin heard the news, she would be surprised.
questions.reason_for_classification: 가주어-진주어의 의미상 주어와 가정법 과거의 동사 형태(과거형, 조동사 과거+동사원형)를 구별하는 문제이다.

questions.question: 27. 다음 문장의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은? · If I __________ a millionaire, I would travel around the world.
questions.explanation: 주절의 동사가 'would travel'(조동사 과거 + 동사원형)이므로 가정법 과거 문장이다. If절에는 be동사 were가 적절하다.
options: ① am		② be		③ wasn’t
questions.reason_for_classification: 가정법 과거의 be동사 were의 쓰임을 묻는 기초적인 문제이다.

questions.question: 28. 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은? 네가 빛의 속도로 여행한다면, 너는 화성까지 13분 만에 갈 수 있을 텐데.
questions.explanation: 현재 사실의 반대나 실현 가능성이 희박한 상황을 가정하는 가정법 과거 구문 'If + 주어 + 과거동사, 주어 + 조동사과거 + 동사원형'인 ④번이 가장 적절하다.
options: ➀ If I traveled at the speed of light, you can go to Mars in 13 minutes.
➁ If you travel at the speed of light, you can’t go to Mars in 13 minutes.
➂ If you can travel at the speed of light, I could go to Mars in 13 minutes.
➃ If you traveled at the speeds of light, you could go to Mars in 13 minutes.
➄ If you want to travel at the speed of light, you can go to Mars in 13 minutes.
questions.reason_for_classification: 가정법 과거의 구조와 적절한 조동사(could) 사용을 확인하는 문제이다.

questions.question: 29. 밑줄 친 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 영어 단어를 활용하여 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 가장 적절한 표현을 각각 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: 현재 상황을 반대로 가정하는 가정법 과거이므로, (A)에는 'would read' (조동사 과거 + 동사원형), (B)에는 'didn't go' (과거 시제 부정형)이 적절하다.
sentences: 오늘 너희 학교 재량 휴업일이야? 좋겠다. 내가 학교에
안 간다면 나는 온종일 책을 읽을 텐데
I (A)_____(read) books all day if I (B)_____(go) to school.
questions.answer: (A) would read (B) didn't go
questions.reason_for_classification: 가정법 과거의 시제 일치와 부정형 구성을 묻는 서술형 문제이다.

questions.question: 30. 다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것을 고르면? (2개)
questions.explanation: ③ 'If you were ten years older'로 고쳐야 한다(가정법 과거). ⑤ 'I could do more things'로 고쳐야 앞뒤 시제가 가정법 과거로 일치한다.
options: ① I would speak to her if I saw her on the street.
② If I pass the exam, I won’t have to study again.
③ What would you do if you are ten years older?
④ Were I on vacation, I would be exploring new places.
⑤ If the day were longer, I could have done more things.
questions.reason_for_classification: 가정법 과거의 시제 일치 오류와 도치 구문(Were I)을 식별하는 문제이다.

questions.question: 31. 다음 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 말을 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: 현재의 직설법 'As I don't drive...'를 가정법 과거로 전환하면 'If I drove...'가 된다.
sentences: As I don’t drive a car, I can’t visit my friends more often.
-> If I ___________ a car, I could visit my friends more often.
questions.answer: drove
questions.reason_for_classification: 직설법 현재 문장을 가정법 과거로 전환하는 능력을 묻는 문제이다.

questions.passage:
(가) <u>If you look around, you will see other holes that play a helpful role in your life</u>. If you have ever cooked anything in a pot with a lid, perhaps you noticed a small hole in the lid. This hole, too, is there for safety. (나) <u>When cooking something in a pot with a lid, the pressure inside the pot builds up</u>. The water inside would quickly boil over if the lid did not have that hole. (다) <u>The hole lets steam out and keeps the water from coming out</u>. 
(라) <u>Have you ever been on an airplane</u>? Wasn’t it exciting to look out the window and see the world below? Surprisingly, there was a small hole in your window. Airplane windows are made up of three panes. There is a hole in the middle pane. It balances the air pressure. Without this little hole, airplane windows might break in an emergency. The hole also prevents the window from fogging up so that you can enjoy that fantastic view. 
There are many more products that have small hidden holes. (마)<u>In the future, when you see a little hole in something, ask yourself why it is there</u>. Maybe it is the result of a careful design to make your life safer.
questions.question: 32. 위 글의 밑줄 친 문장 (가)~(마) 중 어법상 바르지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: 모든 문장이 어법상 틀린 점이 없으나, 교과서 원문과의 대조나 지문의 흐름상 (다)에서 'coming out' 대신 'boiling over'가 문맥상 더 정확할 수 있다. 하지만 순수 문법적으로는 틀린 곳이 없으므로 문제의 의도를 면밀히 파악해야 한다.
questions.reason_for_classification: 가정법 과거, 분사구문, 관용 표현(keep A from -ing) 등 복합적인 어법의 정확성을 지문 내에서 확인하는 문제이다.

questions.question: 33. <보기> 중 어법상 옳은 것만을 있는대로 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓒ 'If You ate... you could get'(가정법 과거)와 ⓖ 'If I didn't have... I would go'(가정법 과거)가 어법상 옳다. ⓐ는 were, ⓑ는 had not been, ⓓ는 known, ⓔ는 could have escaped, ⓕ는 would have chosen이 되어야 한다.
sentences: <보기>
ⓐ If it was not for your help, I would be frozen to death.
ⓑ If I have not been busy, I could have met him.
ⓒ If You ate well, you could get healthy.
ⓓ If you have listened carefully, you could have knew about it.
ⓔ If the train had not stopped, they can escape death.
ⓕ If I had seen the movie several times, I have chosen to watch another mive at the theater.
ⓖ If I didn’t have any classes today, I would go to an amusement park.
questions.reason_for_classification: 가정법 과거와 과거완료의 혼용 시제 및 형태 오류를 정교하게 찾아내는 문제이다.

questions.question: 34. <보기>의 가정법 문장 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
questions.explanation: 옳은 문장은 2번, 4번, 5번, 6번, 7번으로 총 5개이다. 1번은 knew, 3번은 could로 고쳐야 한다.
sentences: <보기>
1. If I know her name, I would tell you.
2. If I were you, I would apply for the job.
3. If I had enough money, I can buy the dress.
4. If he lived near hear, I would visit him more often.
5. If I didn’t have to work, I would go out with you.
6. If I were born again, I would become a rapper.
7. If I had one million won, I could buy a new computer.
questions.reason_for_classification: 가정법 과거의 시제 일치 여부를 여러 문장 중에서 정확히 판별하는 문제이다.

questions.question: 35. 다음 문장을 가정법을 이용하여 바르게 옮긴 것은? As I don’t know his problem, I can’t help him.
questions.explanation: 현재의 직설법 부정문을 가정법 과거 긍정문으로 전환한 ③ 'If I knew his problem, I could help him'이 정답이다.
options: ① If he knew his problem, I can help her.
② If I knew his problem, I could help me.
③ If I knew his problem, I could help him.
④ If I will know his problem, I will help him.
⑤ If I have known his problem, I could help him.
questions.reason_for_classification: 직설법 현재의 인과관계를 가정법 과거로 전환할 때의 시제 및 긍정/부정 변화를 묻는 문제이다.

questions.passage: I already sent you a letter, but there was no reply, so I am sad about it. ⓐ<u>내가 편지를 받는다면, 나는 행복할 텐데</u>. Your mother fell ill, and I'm going to visit her in the hospital with some money and food. I'll go there with our middle son while the oldest looks after the youngest.
questions.question: 36. 윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ에 들어갈 말을 주어진 단어만을 사용하여 바르게 배열하여 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: 가정법 과거 문장인 'If I got a letter, I would be happy'로 배열한다.
sentences: I would be / I got / a letter / happy / if
questions.answer: If I got a letter, I would be happy.
questions.reason_for_classification: 우리말의 가정 의미를 가정법 과거의 정형화된 어순으로 배열하는 능력을 평가하는 문제이다.

questions.question: 37. '내가 오리라면, 물속에서 수영할 수 있을 텐데.'를 바르게 영작한 것은?
questions.explanation: 현재 사실의 반대를 가정하므로 가정법 과거를 쓴다. ① 'If I were a duck, I could swim in the water'가 가장 정확하다.
options: ① If I were a duck, I could swim in the water.
② If I had a duck, I could swim in the water.
③ If I am a duck, I swam in the water.
④ If I have been a duck, I could have swum in the water.
⑤ If I had been a duck, I could have swum in the water.
questions.reason_for_classification: 가정법 과거의 be동사와 조동사 과거형의 적절한 조합을 묻는 영작 문제이다.

questions.question: 38. 다음 글의 밑줄 친 (A)~(E) 중 어법상 옳은 것만을 있는 대로 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: (C) 가정법 과거의 주절과 조건절 형태가 올바르다. (E) 'went back'과 'cooked'가 과거 시제로 병렬 연결되어 올바르다. (A)는 are symbolized, (B)는 because of, (D)는 to catch가 되어야 한다.
sentences: (A<u>)Objects in Munjado often are symbolize</u>. (B)<u>For example, carp in the paintings of hyo symbolic  respect for parents because an old story</u>. The story goes as follows.

Once upon a ti me, a man lived with his old mother. One winter, the man's mother became ill and couldn't eat anything. On one very cold day, the mother said to the man, (C)<u>"It would be wonderful if I could eat fresh fish."</u>

The man went out to the river, but it was completely frozen. (D)<u>It was impossible catch any fish</u>. The man was so disappointed that he cried out to the sky, "What should I do? Please help me." Then the ice melted, and three carp suddenly came out of the water. (E)<u>The man went back home and cooked the fish for his mother</u>. Then his mother got well.
questions.reason_for_classification: 수동태, 전치사 vs 접속사, 가정법 과거, 가주어-진주어, 동사 병렬 구조 등 다양한 어법을 지문 내에서 분석하는 문제이다.

questions.question: 39. 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
questions.explanation: 옳은 문장은 'If he were a bird, he would fly'와 'He told me when to feed the dog' 2개이다. 나머지는 소유격 관계대명사(whose), 시제 불일치, 관계사 오류, 수 일치(is->are) 등의 오류가 있다.
sentences: • If he were a bird, he would fly.
• He told me when to feed the dog.
• I have a watch who price is 9,000 won.
• If it snowed much, I'll skied in the mountain.
• Pinocchio is a cute doll which wish is to become a boy.
• The other members in my orchestra is hugging one another.
questions.reason_for_classification: 가정법, 의문사+to부정사, 관계대명사, 수 일치 등 전반적인 문법 지식을 통합적으로 확인하는 문제이다.

questions.question: 40. 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영어로 쓰시오. 만약 그가 나의 주소를 안다면, 그는 나에게 편지를 보낼 텐데.
questions.explanation: 조건에 따라 가정법 과거(If + 과거동사, would + 동사원형)를 사용하여 'If he knew my address, he would send a letter to me' 혹은 'send me a letter'로 작성한다.
sentences: <조건>
• 가정법 과거의 형태로 쓸 것
• 'a'를 1번 사용할 것
• 'will'을 사용하되 필요시 어형을 바꿀 것
questions.answer: If he knew my address, he would send me a letter.
questions.reason_for_classification: 가정법 과거의 시제 변화와 특정 조건을 만족시키는 정교한 영작 능력을 평가하는 문제이다.

questions.passage:
Akbar, the third Mogul emperor, had a number of wise officials at his court. Among them were a man whose name was Raja Birbal. He was famous for his quick wit and was very wise with his words. Thus, the emperor always liked to have Birbal near him. 
[Sweet Punishment]
To test his officials’ wisdom, Akbar often asked them strange questions. One day, he came up with an interesting question.
Akbar: Someone pulled a hair from my head today. What should I do to him?
Official1: He should be punished, of course.
Official2: Yes, punish him!
Akbar turned to Birbal. 
Akbar: What’s your opinion, Birbal?
Birbal: (A)<u>제가 폐하라면, 저는 그에게 사탕을 주겠습니다</u>.
Official3: What’s he talking about?
Official4: Birbal’s crazy!
Akbar: What made you to say so? I can’t understand what you’re saying. 
Birbal: The person who pulled your hair must be your grandson. No one else could do such a thing. 
Akbar: You are indeed correct, Birbal. I’m so glad to have someone as more wise as you near me.
questions.question: 41. 위 글 (A)의 우리말 의미에 맞게 <보기>에서 필요한 단어를 선택하여 문장을 만들 때, 앞에서부터 7번째 오는 단어는? (단어의 형태 변화 없음, 단어 추가 및 중복 선택 없음)
questions.explanation: 가정법 과거 문장 'If(1) I(2) were(3) you(4), I(5) would(6) give(7) him(8) sweets(9)'에서 7번째 단어는 give이다.
sentences: <보기>
would / give / I / had / sweets /
you / were / will / If / have /
gave / them / wish / him / been / I
questions.reason_for_classification: 가정법 과거 구문의 정확한 배열과 구성 성분을 묻는 문제이다.

questions.question: 42. 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 <보기>에서 모두 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ 조건절(현재), ⓒ 가정법 과거, ⓔ 가정법 과거완료로 모두 어법상 옳다. ⓑ는 'behaved'가 아닌 'behaves' 혹은 'would employ'로, ⓓ는 'wouldn't have missed'로 고쳐야 한다.
sentences: <보기>
ⓐ If it rains, we won’t go on a picnic.
ⓑ If Tom behaved honestly, I will employ him.
ⓒ If I were older, I could travel all over the world alone.
ⓓ If I had woken up earlier, I wouldn‘t miss the first train.
ⓔ If Ann had had a magic lamp, she would have made three wishes.
questions.reason_for_classification: 직설법 조건문과 가정법의 혼합 오류를 식별하고 각각의 시제 일치 여부를 판별하는 문제이다.

questions.question: 43. 대화의 밑줄 친 (A)를 wish를 사용하여 영어문장을 만들었을 때 5번째 오는 단어로 옳은 것은?
questions.explanation: 'I(1) wish(2) I(3) could(4) live(5) in(6) space(7)' 문장에서 5번째 단어는 live이다.
sentences: Woo: Look at this man, Jake. He lived in space for one year.
Jake: It must have been tough for him.
Woo: Right, but you know what’s interesting? He grew 2 inches while in space.
Jake: Really? How is that possible?
Woo: I’m not sure, but maybe it’s because there’s no gravity in space.
Jake: That’s so cool. (A)<u>내가 우주에서 살면 좋겠어</u>. That way, I could become taller.
Woo: I’m sure there are other ways to become taller than going to space.
questions.reason_for_classification: I wish 가정법 과거 구문의 실현 불가능한 소망을 나타내는 문장 구조와 어순을 묻는 문제이다.

questions.question: 44. <보기>의 우리말과 뜻이 같은 가정법 과거 문장으로 옳은 것은?
questions.explanation: 현재의 상황을 가정하는 가정법 과거이므로 If절에 과거동사 existed를 쓴 ②번이 정답이다.
options: ① If such wormholes exist in space,
② If such wormholes existed in space,
③ If such wormholes is existed in space,
④ If such wormholes had existed in space,
⑤ If such wormholes was existed in space,
sentences: <보기>
<u>그런 웜홀들이 우주에 존재한다면</u>, we could get to places billions of light-years away quickly
questions.reason_for_classification: 가정법 과거의 기본적인 조건절 구성을 묻는 문제이다.

questions.question: 45. 두 문장의 뜻이 서로 같은 것은?
questions.explanation: ③ 'If it were sunny, we would go to the beach' (날씨가 맑다면 갈 텐데)는 직설법 'Because it is not sunny, we won't go to the beach' (맑지 않아서 가지 않을 것이다)와 의미가 같다. 나머지 문장은 긍정/부정 관계가 잘못되었다.
options:
① If I had enough time, I could visit her with you.
-> As I have enough time, I can visit them with you.

② If he knew the answer, he would tell you.
-> As he didn't know the answer, he couldn't tell you.

③ If it were sunny, we would go to the beach.
-> Because it is not sunny, we won't go to the beach.

④ If my parents lived in Seoul, I could often meet them.
-> Because my parents live in Seoul, I can't often meet them.

⑤ If she were good at swimming, she would take part in the contest.
-> Because she is good at swimming, she will not take part in the contest.
questions.reason_for_classification: 가정법과 직설법 사이의 전환 과정에서 의미(긍정/부정)와 시제의 적절성을 확인하는 문제이다.

questions.question: 46. 다음 중 어법상 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: ② 'could visited'에서 조동사 과거 뒤에는 동사원형이 와야 하므로 'could visit'이 되어야 한다.
options: ① If she were rich, she could travel all around the world.
② If I had enough time, I could visited them with you.
③ Please turn off the light so that we can go to sleep.
④ She called Tom so that she could invite him to dinner.
⑤ My cat would eat all my food if it could open the fridge.
questions.reason_for_classification: 조동사 뒤 동사원형 원칙과 가정법 과거의 형태를 확인하는 기초적인 문제이다.

questions.question: 47. 다음 중 어법상 바른 것은? (정답 2개)
questions.explanation: ② 가정법 과거 문장으로 'If it were not...'이 올바르다. ③ 'so that' 목적 구문으로 조동사 could가 쓰여 올바르다. ①은 would call, ④는 the world becomes, ⑤는 can get help가 되어야 한다.
options: ① If Tina knew his phone number, she will call him.
② If it were not raining, we could have lunch in the garden.
③ I bought some books so that I could complete my report.
④ The more you travel, the bigger becomes the world.
⑤ I donated my allowance so that people in need to get help.
questions.reason_for_classification: 가정법 과거와 목적을 나타내는 접속사(so that)의 쓰임을 복합적으로 묻는 문제이다.

questions.question: 48. 다음 문장의 의미가 변하지 않도록 고쳐 쓸 때 어법상 바르지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: ④ 'I am sorry that I don't know...'를 가정법으로 바꾸면 'I wish I knew'(과거동사)가 되어야 한다. wish 뒤에 현재형 know는 적절하지 않다.
options:
① They went to the museum in order that they could study the history.
→ They went to the museum so as to study the history.

② Since Jane doesn't ask politely, I may not feel like helping her.
→ If Jane asked politely, I might feel like helping her.

③ If we have enough time, we will go to Europe.
→ We are not sure whether we will have enough time to go to Europe.

④ I am sorry that I don't know John's phone number.
→ I wish I know John's phone number.

⑤ But for her help, I could not succeed.
→ If it were not for her help, I could not succeed.
questions.reason_for_classification: 목적, 가정법, I wish 구문, 조건 구문(But for) 등 다양한 표현의 상호 전환 능력을 평가하는 문제이다.

questions.question: 49. 다음 대화의 흐름상 밑줄 친 부분이 어법상 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: ④ B가 영화 보러 가고 싶다고 했으므로 실현 가능성을 열어둔 조건절(if I have time, I will go)을 써야 한다. 밑줄 친 'if I had time, I would go'는 시간이 없어서 못 간다는 반대 가정의 의미이므로 대화 흐름상 어색하다.
options:
① A: It’s still Thursday.
B: <u>I wish it were Saturday morning</u>.

② A: Is Alex coming to the party?
B: No. <u>If he came, I would be happy</u>.

③ A: I failed the test again. What should I do?
B: <u>If I were you, I would change my learning habits</u>.

④ A: Let’s go out for a movie tonight.
B: I’d love to. So, <u>if I had time, I would go out with you</u>.

⑤ A: <u>If I didn’t know Ken, I would think of him as an unfriendly man</u>.
B: Right. He is just very shy.
questions.reason_for_classification: 가정법 과거가 가지는 '현재 사실에 반대되는 불가능한 상황'이라는 속성을 대화의 맥락에서 정확히 이해하는지 묻는 문제이다.

questions.question: 50. 다음 주어진 문장과 의미가 같은 것은? But for water, all living things would not be alive.
questions.explanation: '~이 없다면'이라는 의미의 'But for'는 'If it were not for' 혹은 도치형인 'Were it not for'로 바꾸어 쓸 수 있다. ⑤번 문장이 문법적으로나 의미적으로 완벽하게 일치한다.
options: ① Without water, all living things would be alive.
② If there were no water, all living things would be alive.
③ If it were for water, all living things would not be alive.
④ If it were not for water, all living things would be alive.
⑤ Were it not for water, all living things would not be alive.
questions.reason_for_classification: 가정법의 특수 구문인 'But for / Without' 구문을 절의 형태로 전환하고, if 생략 도치 문장까지 파악하는 문제이다.

questions.question: 1. 다음 밑줄 친 부분이 문맥상 바르게 쓰인 것은? (정답 2개)
questions.explanation: ②는 현재 사실과 반대되는 일을 가정하는 가정법 과거 문장으로, 직설법(don't know)과 의미가 통하며 어순과 시제가 올바름. ③은 현재 개를 번역할 수 있는 번역기가 없다는 사실에 대해 '있었으면 좋겠다'라고 소망하는 I wish 가정법 과거(I wish I had) 구문으로 올바름.
options: ① I was late for school because I woke up late. <u>I wish I set my alarm</u>.
② I don’t know him, so I can’t say hello to him. <u>If I knew him, I could say hello to him</u>.
③ I don’t have a dog translator, so I can’t talk with my dog. <u>I wish I had a dog translator</u>.
④ We couldn’t go to the beach because it was not sunny. <u>Were it sunny, we would go to the beach</u>.
⑤ She didn’t practice hard, so she couldn’t get first prize in the contest last week. <u>If she practiced hard, she could get first prize in the contest</u>.
questions.reason_for_classification: 가정법 과거(If + 주어 + 과거동사, 주어 + 조동사과거 + 동사원형)와 I wish 가정법 과거의 올바른 형태 및 의미 연결을 묻는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 2. 다음 두 문장의 의미가 같을 때, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어가 순서대로 짝지어진 것은?
questions.explanation: 가정법 과거 문장(If he weren't tired, he could go...)은 현재 사실(그가 피곤하기 때문에 나랑 쇼핑을 갈 수 없다)을 나타내는 직설법 문장 'As he is tired, he can't go...'로 바꿀 수 있음.
sentences: If he weren’t tired, he could go shopping with me.
→ As he ____ tired, he ____ go shopping with me.
questions.reason_for_classification: 가정법 과거 문장을 직설법 현재 문장으로 전환하는 능력을 평가하는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 3. 다음 우리말을 주어진 단어를 모두 활용하여 영작하시오. (필요시 주어진 단어의 형태를 바꿀 것)
questions.explanation: 현재 공부를 열심히 하지 않는 사실의 반대를 가정하므로 가정법 과거(If + 주어 + 과거동사, 주어 + could + 동사원형)를 사용하여 'If he studied hard, he could pass the exam.'으로 영작함.
sentences: 만약 그가 열심히 공부한다면, 그는 그 시험에 합결할 수 있을 텐데.
(현재 그는 공부를 열심히 하지 않고 있음)
(if / study / can / exam)
questions.answer: If he studied hard, he could pass the exam
questions.reason_for_classification: 현재 사실의 반대를 가정하는 가정법 과거 구문을 조건에 맞게 영작하는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 4. 다음 상황에서 Christine이 할 말을 <조건>에 맞게 완성했을 때, ★에 오는 단어는?
questions.explanation: 제시된 상황은 '깜빡하면 사겠다'라는 실제 일어날 수 있는 조건을 거는 것이므로 가정법이 아닌 단순 조건문(If + 주어 + 현재동사, 주어 + will + 동사원형)이 적절함. 문장은 'If I forget to bring your textbook, I will buy you coffee.'가 되며 ★ 자리는 will이 됨.
sentences: <조건>
축약하지 말 것
단어의 형태는 변형 가능함
괄호 안 단어만을 모두 한 번씩 사용할 것
조건의 if와 가정법의 if 중 다음 상황을 설명하는데 가장 적절한 것을 골라 문장을 만들 것
Christine은 자주 깜빡한다. Ariana에게 빌린 교과서를 집에 놓고 오고, 가져다주는 것을 계속 잊었다. Ariana에게 자신이 다시 한번 교과서를 가져오는 것을 깜빡하면 커피를 사겠다고 다짐한다.
Christine: “If I                                        ,         ★                         .”
(buy, forget, to, textbook, will, I, your, bring, coffee)
questions.reason_for_classification: 단순 조건절(단순 미래 상황)과 가정법 과거(현재 사실과 반대)의 차이를 이해하고 문맥에 맞는 시제를 선택하는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 5. 다음 상황에서 Christine이 할 말을 <조건>에 맞게 완성했을 때, ★에 오는 단어는?
questions.explanation: 현재 아파서 과제를 할 수 없는 상황에 대해 '아프지 않다면 할 수 있을 텐데'라고 가정하는 것이므로 가정법 과거를 써야 함. 'If I were not sick, we could do our group assignment.'가 적절하며, ★ 자리는 were가 됨.
sentences: <조건>
축약하지 말 것
단어의 형태는 변형 가능함
괄호 안 단어만을 모두 한 번씩 사용할 것
조건의 if와 가정법의 if 중 다음 상황을 설명하는데 가장 적절한 것을 골라 문장을 만들 것
Christine은 심한 독감에 걸려 병원에 입원해있다. 오늘 Ariana를 만나 국립중앙박물관에 직접 가서 조별 과제를 위한 조사를 하기로 했는데 아파서 그럴 수가 없다. 이런 자신의 상황을 Ariana와 전화하며 이야기 중이다.
Christine: “If I ★                       ,                                                  .”
(group, can, be, our, do, we, sick, not, assignment)
questions.reason_for_classification: 현재 사실(아픔)과 반대되는 상황을 가정하는 가정법 과거의 문장 구조를 묻는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 6. 다음 주어진 문장을 가정법을 사용한 문장으로 바꾸어 쓸 때 알맞은 것은?
questions.explanation: 직설법 현재 문장(이유를 몰라서 화가 나지 않음)을 가정법 과거로 바꾸면, '이유를 안다면 화가 날 텐데'가 되어야 하므로 'If Steve knew the reason, he would be angry.'가 정답임.
options: ① If Steve knew the reason, he would be angry.
② If Steve knew the reason, he will be angry.
③ If Steve knows the reason, he will be angry.
④ If Steve doesn’t know the reason, he won’t be angry.
⑤ If Steve didn’t know the reason, he would not be angry.
sentences: As Steve doesn't know the reason, he isn't angry.
questions.reason_for_classification: 직설법 현재의 부정 상황을 가정법 과거의 긍정 상황으로 올바르게 전환하는 능력을 묻는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 7. 다음 대화의 문맥상 (A)~(D)에 올 알맞은 단어로만 묶인 것은?
questions.explanation: (A), (B)는 복도 끝으로 가면 도서관을 볼 것이라는 실제 상황을 설명하므로 단순 조건문 시제인 go - will이 적절함. (C), (D)는 학교에 불이 날 것을 가상으로 묻는 상황이므로 가정법 과거 시제인 would - were가 적절함.
sentences: Jessica: Tom, I heard that we are going to have a fire drill this afternoon. Do you know where the fire extinguisher is?
Tom: Sure. If you (A)[go / went] straight to the end of this hallway, you (B)[will / would] see the library. It is right in front of it.
Jessica: Thanks a lot. Hey, I’m just asking. Do you think there will be a fire in our school, I mean, in real?
Tom: I don’t think so. Our school is well-prepared for fires. What (C)[will / would] you do if there (D)[is / were] a fire in our school?
Jessica: That sounds awful just thinking about it.
questions.reason_for_classification: 단순 조건절과 가정법 과거의 차이를 문맥을 통해 구별하여 적절한 시제를 선택하는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 8. 다음 <보기>에서 가정법 문장을 직설법으로 바꾼 문장 중, 어법상 옳은 것만을 있는 대로 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: (B) 가정법 과거(If I were)를 직설법 현재(As I am not)로 잘 바꿈. (D) 가정법 과거완료(If I had gotten up)를 직설법 과거(As I didn't get up)로 잘 바꿈. (A)는 knew(과거)이므로 직설법은 don't know(현재)여야 함. (C)는 snowed(과거)이므로 직설법은 doesn't snow(현재/부정)여야 함. (E)는 had had(과거완료)이므로 직설법은 didn't have(과거)여야 함.
sentences: <보기>
(A) If he knew my address, he could send me a letter.
→ As he didn't know my address, he couldn't send me a letter.
(B) If I were a doctor, I could help sick people.
→ As I am not a doctor, I can't help sick people.
(C) If it snowed a lot, I would ski in the mountains.
→ As it snows a lot, I will ski in the mountains.
(D) If I had gotten up earlier, I wouldn't have been late for school.
→ As I didn't get up earlier, I was late for school.
(E) If I had had a magic lamp, I could have made three wishes.
→ As I don't have a magic lamp, I cannot make three wishes.
questions.reason_for_classification: 가정법 과거/과거완료 문장을 각각 직설법 현재/과거 문장으로 전환할 때 시제와 긍정/부정 여부를 정확히 판별하는 능력을 묻습니다.

questions.question: 9. 다음 가정법 문장 중, 어법상 옳은 것은?
questions.explanation: ② 'If + 주어 + 과거동사(were), 주어 + 조동사과거(could) + 동사원형'의 형태인 가정법 과거 문장으로 어법상 옳음. ①은 If I had... would have visited, ③은 If it rained... would not go, ④는 can을 could로, ⑤는 If he had finished... could have gone 등으로 고쳐야 시제가 일치함.
options: ① If I’d have enough time, I would have visit you.
② If my uncle were in the office, I could meet him.
③ If it rains a lot, I would not have gone to the picnic.
④ If you had a talent for music, you can become a composer.
⑤ If he has been finished his homework, he could go to the party.
questions.reason_for_classification: 가정법 과거 및 과거완료의 시제 일치 구조(If절과 주절의 짝)를 정확히 알고 있는지 평가하는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 10. 빈칸에 들어갈 수 없는 것은?
questions.explanation: ⑤번 'have been'은 현재완료 시제로, 가정법(I wish, as if, Without 등) 구문에서는 주절이나 종속절에 과거형(were, had p.p.) 또는 조동사 과거형(would, would have p.p.)이 와야 하므로 쓰일 수 없음.
sentences: ○ I wish I ______ been so happy.
○ But for air, I ______ not breathe.
○ I wish she ______ there to support me.
○ Without your support, I ______ failed.
○ She speaks as if she there before.
○ He talks about the situation as if he _____ handled it better.
questions.reason_for_classification: 가정법 구문(I wish, as if, Without/But for)에서 사용되는 특유의 시제(과거, 과거완료)를 구별하는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 11. ⓐ~ⓗ 중 문장 전환이 바른 것끼리 묶인 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓑ raining -> weren't raining (맞음), ⓓ isn't -> were (맞음), ⓔ can't travel -> could travel (맞음), ⓕ had traveled -> didn't travel (맞음), ⓖ had managed -> didn't manage (맞음). ⓐ는 had rich가 아니라 were rich(또는 had been rich), ⓒ는 can't swim(현재)이므로 could swim(가정법 과거), ⓗ는 had(과거)이므로 직설법은 doesn't have(현재)여야 함.
sentences: <보기>
ⓐ In fact, she was not rich.
→She talks as if she had rich.
ⓑ I’m sorry that it is raining.
→I wish it weren’t raining.
ⓒ I’m sorry that I can’t swim well.
→I wish I could have swum well.
ⓓ In fact, he isn’t a prince.
→He acts as if he were a prince.
ⓔ I’m sorry that my brother can’t travel with me.
→I wish my brother could travel with me.
ⓕ I wish I had traveled around the world.
→I’m sorry that I didn't travel around the world.
ⓖ My brother talks as if he had managed time efficiently.
→In fact, my brother didn’t manage time efficiently.
ⓗ If he had a lot of money, he could buy a big house.
→Because he didn’t have a lot of money, he can’t buy a big house.
questions.reason_for_classification: I wish, as if 가정법 구문과 직설법 간의 전환에서 시제 일치 및 문장 성분의 적절성을 종합적으로 판단하는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 12. 주어진 우리말에 맞게 영작하시오.
questions.explanation: 가정법 과거(If + 주어 + 과거동사, 주어 + 조동사과거 + 동사원형)를 사용하여 'If I had a million dollars, I would go abroad every year.'라고 영작함.
sentences: 만약 나에게 백만 달러가 있다면, 나는 매년 해외로 갈 텐데.
* 가정법 과거 활용할 것
questions.answer: If I had a million dollars, I would go abroad every year
questions.reason_for_classification: 주어진 조건을 만족하며 가정법 과거의 기본 구조를 활용해 문장을 구성하는 능력을 평가합니다.

questions.question: 13. 빈칸에 들어갈 단어가 아닌 것은?
questions.explanation: 각 문장은 현재 사실과 반대되는 가정을 하는 가정법 과거 문장임. 첫 번째 빈칸은 If he had (②), he wouldn't have to (⑤가 won't라 틀림). 두 번째는 If I were (③), I would tell (④). 세 번째는 If she were (③), she would know (①). 빈칸에 ② 'has'는 현재형이라 올 수 없음 (가정법 과거 If절에는 과거형 had가 와야 함).
sentences: Fred has only two pairs of socks. If he ______ more than two pairs of socks, he ________ wash this socks so often.
You should tell your father exactly what happened. If I _______ you, I ________ him the truth as soon as possible.
It’s too bad Halen isn’t here. If she _________ here, she ________ what to do.
questions.reason_for_classification: 가정법 과거 문장 내의 If절(과거동사)과 주절(조동사 과거+동사원형)의 형태를 정확히 구별하는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 14. 다음 글의 밑줄 친 (A), (B)에 들어갈 어법상 가장 알맞은 단어의 형태로 짝지어진 것은?
questions.explanation: (A) spend time (in) -ing 구문이므로 playing이 적절함. (B) 주절에 would be가 있으므로 가정법 과거 문장임을 알 수 있고, If절에는 과거동사 had가 와야 함.
sentences: By Jina, Hosung, and Minsu
More Time for Outside Activities - We will spend more time (A) outside without our smartphones.
If we (B) no smartphones, our lives would be more difficult, but too much use of a smartphone is dangerous.
questions.reason_for_classification: 동명사 관용 표현(spend time -ing)과 가정법 과거의 시제 일치를 동시에 묻는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 15. 다음 우리말을 영어로 옮기시오.
questions.explanation: 1) '마치 ~인 것처럼'은 as if 가정법을 사용하며, 가정법 과거를 쓰면 'She talks as if she read the fashion magazine.'이 됨. 2) '만약 ~라면 ~할 텐데'는 가정법 과거(If + 주어 + were, 주어 + would + 동사원형)를 사용하여 'If I were an angel, I would make you a poet.'가 됨.
sentences: 1) 그녀는 마치 그 패션 잡지를 읽은 것처럼 말한다. ]
(가정법 과거시제를 활용하여 쓰세요.)
2) 내가 만일 천사라면 나는 너를 시인으로 만들 텐데.
(가정법 과거시제를 활용하여 쓰세요.)
questions.answer: 1) She talks as if she read the fashion magazine. 2) If I were an angel, I would make you a poet.
questions.reason_for_classification: as if 가정법과 if 가정법 과거의 구문을 정확히 활용하여 영작하는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 16. 다음 문장에서 어법상 틀린 곳을 찾아 바르게 고쳐 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: 주절에 could write(조동사 과거 + 동사원형)가 있으므로 가정법 과거 문장이어야 함. 따라서 If절의 have known을 과거형인 knew로 고쳐야 함. (또는 주절을 could have written으로 고쳐 가정법 과거완료로 만들 수도 있으나 통상 If절 동사 수정이 일반적임)
sentences: If I have known his address, I could write to him.
questions.answer: have known -> knew
questions.reason_for_classification: 가정법 과거 시제의 일치 오류를 찾아 수정하는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 17. 다음 중 어법상 가장 자연스러운 것은?
questions.explanation: ④ 'It(가주어) + will be possible + for them(의미상 주어) + to learn(진주어)' 구조로 문법적으로 완벽함. ① Jim would be... if he were, ② ...for her to swim, ③ If I were you, ⑤ ...I would travel로 고쳐야 함.
options: ① Jim would be happier if he is with her.
② It was not easy for she to swim at the beach.
③ If I am you, I would not use mobile on the street.
④ It will be possible for them to learn yoga next month.
⑤ If I were a college student, I will travel all around
questions.reason_for_classification: 가정법 과거의 시제 일치와 to부정사의 의미상 주어 등 여러 문법 사항을 비교하여 옳은 문장을 고르는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 18. <보기>에서 어법상 옳은 것을 있는 대로 모두 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ 사역동사 let + 목적어 + 동사원형(play) - 맞음. ⓓ 가정법 과거(If + weren't, could arrive) - 맞음. ⓕ It(가주어) + wise(성품 형용사) + of her(의미상 주어) + to부정사 - 맞음. ⓑ Some of the clothes... 뒤에는 복수 동사인 are, ⓒ 목적격 관계대명사 what은 선행사가 없을 때 쓰는데 앞에 sandwich가 있으므로 that/which, ⓔ 강조 구문 it ~ that 사이에서 her를 강조했으므로 뒤에 중복된 her는 삭제해야 함.
sentences: <보기>
ⓐ Jenny let her children play video games.
ⓑ Some of the clothes in the store is on sale.
ⓒ Chris likes to eat the sandwich what his mom made.
ⓓ If the bridge weren’t under construction, I could arrive on time.
ⓔ It was Kate that I talked to her on the phone the day before yesterday.
ⓕ It was wise of her brother not to spend much money on the latest fashion.
questions.reason_for_classification: 사역동사, 수 일치, 관계대명사, 가정법, 강조 구문, 의미상 주어 등 중3 수준의 주요 문법들을 복합적으로 판별하는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 19. 다음 문장들은 그림의 상황을 묘사한 것이다. 어법상 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓔ는 가정법 과거완료(If I had earned...) 문장인데, 주절은 would have + p.p. 형태여야 하므로 would bought가 아니라 'would have bought'가 되어야 함.
sentences: I would go to the movies if I had no homework.	These plants wouldn’t have died if I had watered them often.
My teacher wouldn’t be angry at me if I brought my textbook.	If it were not raining, I would walk my dog.
If I had earned enough money, I would bought a new shirt.
questions.reason_for_classification: 가정법 과거와 과거완료의 형태적 차이(특히 주절의 would have p.p.)를 구분할 수 있는지 묻는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 20. 다음 가정하는 문장을 사실을 나타내는 문장으로 바꿀 때, 바꾼 문장이 의미 및 어법상 맞는 것은?
questions.explanation: ③ 가정법 과거완료(had had, could have traveled)는 과거 사실의 반대이므로 직설법 과거(didn't have, couldn't travel)로 올바르게 바뀜. ① were는 am not, ② hadn't been은 were, ④ knew는 don't know로 각각 현재/과거 시제와 긍정/부정이 반전되어야 함.
options: ① If I were you, I would build a big house.
→ As I am not you, I didn’t build a big house.
② If they hadn’t been young, they would have understood the class.
→ As they were young, they understood the class.
③ If I had had enough money, I could have traveled abroad.
→ As I didn’t have enough money, I couldn’t travel abroad.
④ If I knew her address, I could write to her.
→ As I didn’t know her address, I could write to her.
⑤ If Jane had arrived on time, she wouldn’t have been late.
questions.reason_for_classification: 가정법 시제와 직설법 시제 간의 상관관계(과거->현재, 과거완료->과거)와 의미 반전을 정확히 이해하고 있는지 평가합니다.

questions.question: 21. 짝지어진 문장들의 의미가 같도록 밑줄 친 부분에 알맞은 말을 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: '~이 없었더라면'을 의미하는 If it had not been for는 But for 또는 Without으로 고쳐 쓸 수 있음. (단, 문맥상 'forgot wet'은 'gotten wet'의 오타로 추정되나 문법 구조인 But for/Without을 묻는 의도는 명확함)
sentences: If it had not been for your help, I would have forgotten wet.
=	______ ______ your help, I would have forgotten wet.
= __________ your help, I would have forgotten wet.
questions.answer: But for, Without
questions.reason_for_classification: 가정법에서 '~이 없다면/없었더라면'을 나타내는 관용 표현(If it were not for / If it had not been for)의 대용어인 But for와 Without을 묻는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 22. 한국어 문장을 괄호 안의 어휘를 포함하여 한 문장의 영어로 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: (1) 가정법 과거: If I were a doctor, I could help sick people. (2) enough to 구문: Eric is smart enough to solve difficult math problems. (3) 과거완료: When I arrived at the station, the train had already left. (4) 의문사+to부정사: He taught us how to use the machine with patience.
sentences: (1) 내가 의사였다면 아픈 사람들을 도울 수 있었을 텐데. (If, could)
(2) Eric은 어려운 수학 문제들을 풀 만큼 충분히 똑똑하다. (enough, difficult)
(3) 내가 역에 도착했었을 때 그 기차는 이미 떠나 버렸었다. (already, at the station)
(4) 그는 우리에게 그 기계를 어떻게 사용해야 할지 인내심을 가지고 가르쳐 주었다. (how, machine, patience)
questions.answer: (1) If I were a doctor, I could help sick people. (2) Eric is smart enough to solve difficult math problems. (3) When I arrived at the station, the train had already left. (4) He taught us how to use the machine with patience.
questions.reason_for_classification: 가정법 과거, enough to 구문, 과거완료, 의문사+to부정사 등 중3 주요 어법들을 영작으로 종합 평가하는 문제입니다.

questions.passage: Researchers found that the Earth's core had started spinning in the opposite direction after coming to a complete stop in 2009. The scientists reached their conclusion after they (A)[analyze] seismic waves over the past 60 years. These are vibrations created by movements in the Earth's crust, such as earthquakes or volcanic eruptions. Previously, the core had been believed to rotate in only one direction. However, the new findings suggest that the direction of rotation (B)[change] at regular intervals of about every 35 years. According to the researchers, the last change before 2009 happened sometime in the early 1970s. It is expected that the next change will happen around the mid-2040s.
questions.question: 23. (A)와 (B)의 어법상 올바른 형태로 짝지어진 것은?
questions.explanation: (A)는 과학자들이 결론에 도달하기(과거) 전부터 60년 동안 분석해온 것이므로 과거시제 analyzed가 적절함. (B)는 회전 방향이 약 35년마다 바뀐다는 일반적인 사실(습관적/규칙적 현상)을 나타내므로 현재시제 changes가 적절함. 주어인 direction of rotation이 3인칭 단수이므로 changes임.
questions.reason_for_classification: 문맥에 따른 과거 시제와 현재 시제의 선택(특히 일반적 사실을 나타내는 현재 시제) 및 주어-동사 수 일치를 묻는 문제입니다.

questions.passage: Loki went to see the three gods with all the treasures. Brokk came along. Loki showed them the treasures from Ivaldi's sons. The first treasure was for Odin. It was a special spear. ⓐlt was its target that it never missed. ⓑIt was Frey's turn that came next. The second treasure was a big ship. It could turn into a piece of cloth. ⓒIt was Thor who was waiting for the third present. ⓓlt was the flowing golden hair for his wife which Loki showed to Thor. ⓔlt was his wife's head that Thor put the hair. It became real hair.
questions.question: 24. 윗글에서 강조구문이 사용된 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 가장 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓔ에서 Thor가 머리카락을 붙인 곳(on his wife's head)을 강조하려면 'It was on his wife's head that Thor put the hair'와 같이 장소의 부사구 형태가 강조되어야 함. 단순 명사 head만 쓰면 뒤의 문장이 불완전해야 하는데, put the hair는 장소를 필요로 함.
questions.reason_for_classification: It is ~ that 강조 구문에서 부사(구)를 강조할 때 전치사가 누락되지 않아야 함을 묻는 변별력 있는 문제입니다.

questions.passage: Dong-ju was born in 1917 near Yanbin, China. As a young boy, he loved sports, and he was a soccer player for his school. He also loved sewing too much that he sewed the numbers on all his friends' soccer uniforms. However, ⓐ<u>he loved literature most</u>. In elementary school he wrote a lot of poems. He even made a literary magazine with his cousin, Song Mong-gyu. In middle school he once borrowed a poetry book by a famous poet of the time, Baek Seok, and copied the whole book by hand. He really wanted to have his own copy of the rare book.
questions.question: 25. 밑줄 친 ⓐ에서 ‘literature’를 강조한 문장으로 바꾸시오.
questions.explanation: It is/was ~ that 강조 구문에서 목적어 literature를 강조하고, 과거 시제이므로 It was literature that he loved most가 됨.
sentences: (it~ that 구문을 이용할 것)
questions.answer: It was literature that he loved most.
questions.reason_for_classification: 문장 성분 중 하나를 it ~ that 강조 구문으로 변환하는 능력을 평가합니다.

questions.question: 26. 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: ③의 that은 진주어 절을 이끄는 접속사 that(It 가주어 구문)임. ①, ②, ④, ⑤는 모두 It is ~ that 강조 구문임.
options: ① It was the blue car <u>that</u> we saw near the school
② It was my mom <u>that</u> cooked dinner last night.
③ It is important <u>that</u> you finish your homework on time.
④ It was the big park <u>that</u> we visited during our trip.
⑤ It was yesterday afternoon <u>that</u> we stayed at home.
questions.reason_for_classification: It 가주어-진주어 구문과 It ~ that 강조 구문을 구별하는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 27. 주어진 우리말을 영어 바르게 옮긴 것은?
questions.explanation: '수학'을 강조하는 문장이므로 It was math that... 구조가 되어야 함. 따라서 ③ 'It was math that Tom studied in the library yesterday.'가 정답임.
options: ① It was Tom that studied math in the library yesterday.
② It was studied that Tom math in the library yesterday.
③ It was math that Tom studied in the library yesterday.
④ It was in the library that Tom studied math yesterday.
⑤ It was yesterday that Tom studied math in the library.
sentences: Tom이 어제 도서관에서 공부한 것은 바로 수학이었어.
questions.reason_for_classification: 강조하고 싶은 대상에 따른 강조 구문의 올바른 영작 형태를 찾는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 28. 밑줄 친 It의 용법이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: ⑤는 'so 형/부 that' 구문의 가주어가 아니라, 날씨 등을 나타내는 비인칭 주어나 단순 지시 대명사 혹은 강조 구문과 거리가 먼 문장으로 보임. 구체적으로는 It(가주어/비인칭) was so windy...의 구조임. ①~④는 모두 It ~ that 강조 구문임.
options: ① <u>It</u> is my cat that I love most.
② <u>It</u> is the pen that I was looking for.
③ <u>It</u> was Jane t hat was late for school.
④ <u>It</u> is a zoo that children want to visit.
⑤ <u>It</u> was so windy that I couldn’t go out.
questions.reason_for_classification: 강조 구문의 It과 비인칭 주어 또는 가주어 it을 구별하는 능력을 묻는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 29. ⓐ ~ ⓔ 중 어법상 바르지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓒ는 강조 구문 'It is we who...'에서 강조된 주어가 we이므로, 뒤의 동사는 we에 맞춰 are가 되어야 함. (No, it is we who are the finest...)
sentences: Loki knew ⓐ <u>only</u> the sons of Lvaldi could make fine golden hair. He went to them and said, “I heard Brokk and his brother are the finest ⓑ <u>smiths</u>. Is that true?”

“No, it is we who ⓒ <u>is</u> the finest smith,” the sons of Lvaldi replied. “They’re ⓓ <u>making</u> three treasures for Odin, THOR, and Frey,” said Loki. “Do you think you can make treasures better than theirs?”

“Of course we can,” they answered. “O,K, then you should also make three treasures for them,” said Loki. “The gods will decide on the best treasure.” Loki also told them ⓔ <u>that</u> one of the treasures had to be golden gair. They went to work immediately.
questions.reason_for_classification: 강조 구문 내에서 강조된 주어와 뒤따르는 동사의 수 일치 원칙을 이해하고 있는지 묻는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 30.  다음 중 어법상 옳은 것만을 <보기>에서 있는 대로 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: (A) 목적어 강조(meal), (B) 시간 부사구 강조(in the moment), (D) 방법 부사구 강조(through hours) 모두 올바른 강조 구문임. (C)는 강조된 주어 'the kind words'가 복수이므로 동사가 make가 되어야 함.
sentences: <보기>
(A) It was a delicious three-course meal that the chef cooked.
(B) It is in the moment of decisions that your destiny is shaped.
(C) It is the kind words spoken from a true friend that makes you feel good.
(D) It was through hours of intense practice that the team achieved victory.
questions.reason_for_classification: 강조 구문의 구조적 정확성과 주어 강조 시 수 일치 여부를 복합적으로 판단하는 문제입니다.

questions.passage: Long ago, there were no kings in the southern part of Korea. It said that a new country would be built there. One day a strange voice was heard from the hill. When people were singing and dancing for their future king, a golden box came from the sky. Twelve days later, the six eggs turned into six boys. They found six golden eggs in the box. The boys became the kings of six Gayas. (가)<u>그들 중에서 가장 힘이 센 사람은 바로 Kim Suro였다</u>.
questions.question: 31. (가)를 어법상 옳게 영어로 표현한 2개는?
questions.explanation: Kim Suro를 강조하는 문장이므로 'It was Kim Suro that/who was the strongest of them'이 적절함. ①은 that을 사용했고, ④는 who를 사용하여 사람 주어를 강조함.
options: ① It was Kim Suro that was the strongest of them.
② It was Kim Suro who is stronger than others.
③ It was Kim Suro which was the strongest of them.
④ It was Kim Suro who was the strongest of them.
⑤ He was Kim Suro, who is strongest than any other king.
questions.reason_for_classification: 강조 대상이 사람일 때 that 대신 who를 쓸 수 있다는 점과 전체적인 강조 구문의 시제 일치를 평가합니다.

questions.passage:
The manager let us ㉠painting anything we wanted. We decided to paint cute things because the wall was near an elementary school. We divided into three groups and began ㉡to paint. I was in the group with Minsu and Jiwon. I chose my spot and ㉢start to paint my favorite movie character. Minsu painted some flowers and Jiwon did some background drawings.
Our club painted ㉣about for five hours. After we finished, we got together and shared the day's experiences. Minsu was very proud of his flower painting. He said, "My flower is so real that a bee landed on it." I said, "Drawing on a wall was ㉤a lot harder than drawing on paper."
We all agreed that our wall painting wasn't perfect. But it didn't matter. (가) 우리는 우리의 동네를 조금 더 밝고 더 행복하게 만들었어. We didn't just paint pictures on a wall that day. It was a better tomorrow (나)<u>that</u> we painted.
questions.question: 32. (나)와 쓰임이 같은 that을 <보기>에서 있는 대로 골라 묶은 것은?
questions.explanation: (나)는 강조 구문의 that임. <보기> 중 ㉡, ㉣, ㉤은 각각 his dog, Linda, a tree house를 강조하는 강조 구문의 that임. ㉠, ㉢, ㉥은 가주어 it과 함께 쓰인 명사절 접속사 that임.
sentences: <보기>
㉠ It was true <u>that</u> he met Paul last week.
㉡ It was his dog <u>that</u> he lost in the park.
㉢ It was amazing <u>that</u> Yujin passed the test.
㉣ It was Linda <u>that</u> you met in the museum.
㉤ It was a tree house <u>that</u> Mike built near the park.
㉥ It was surprising <u>that</u> you met Steve in the shopping mall.
questions.reason_for_classification: 가주어-진주어 구문과 강조 구문을 판별하여 동일한 용법을 묶는 고난도 문제입니다.

questions.question: 33. 주어진 문장에서 밑줄 친 부분을 강조하는 문장을 <조건>에 맞게 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: 부사구 on the street를 강조하므로 It was on the street that Bob dropped his phone this morning.가 됨.
sentences: Bob dropped his phone <u>on the street</u> this morning.
<조건>
•'It'으로 시작하는 강조 구문으로 바꾸어 쓸 것
questions.answer: It was on the street that Bob dropped his phone this morning.
questions.reason_for_classification: 부사구를 강조하는 it ~ that 강조 구문의 작성 능력을 평가합니다.

questions.question: 34. <보기> (a)~(g)의 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 같은 것 끼리 연결된 것은?
questions.explanation: (a), (c), (e), (f), (g)는 모두 강조 구문의 that임. 반면 (b)와 (d)는 가주어 It 구문에서 진주어 절을 이끄는 접속사 that임.
sentences: <보기>
(a) It was at school <u>that</u> Layla met Jinho.
(b) It was true <u>that</u> Emma failed the exam.
⒞ It is the blue shirt <u>that</u> she wants to buy.
(d) It is important <u>that</u> you should not tell a lie.
(e) It is her father <u>that</u> Emma respects the most.
(f) It was on the desk <u>that</u> she found the book.
(g) It was her birthday party <u>that</u> James went to last Friday.
questions.reason_for_classification: 다수의 문장에서 강조 구문과 가주어 구문을 분류해내는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 35.  다음 우리말을 it~that 구문을 이용하여 영어로 써봅시다.
questions.explanation: '~라는 게 사실이니?'는 가주어-진주어 구문을 활용한 의문문이므로 'Is it true that we use only 10 percent of our brains?'가 됨. (강조 구문보다는 가주어 구문이 문맥상 자연스러움)
sentences: 우리가 우리 뇌의 10퍼센트만 쓴다는 게 사실이니?
questions.answer: Is it true that we use only 10 percent of our brains?
questions.reason_for_classification: It 가주어-진주어 구문을 활용한 의문문 영작 능력을 평가합니다.

questions.question: 36. 다음 중 어법상 어색한 것을 있는 대로 모두 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓑ 강조 구문 뒤의 문장에는 강조된 대상이 빠져야 하므로 'broke it'의 it은 중복임. ⓓ It is the Eiffel Tower that is... 혹은 It is in the Eiffel Tower that (something happens)처럼 뒤에 주어가 빠져야 하는데 is tall의 주어가 없는 것은 맞으나 in(전치사구)이 주어가 될 수 없음. ⓔ 'It was the subway that I met...'에서는 만난 장소를 강조하려면 'in the subway'가 되어야 함. ⓖ 'who'는 사람을 강조할 때 쓰는데 'a book'은 사물이므로 that/which를 써야 함.
questions.reason_for_classification: 강조 구문의 구조적 무결성(중복 요소 제거, 적절한 관계사 사용, 부사구 형태의 유지)을 묻는 종합 문제입니다.

questions.passage:
“(A)<u>I followed my father’s advice. I built a house in every city</u>. I hired people and they looked after the house. Also experts designed my bed and a great chef prepared my meal. Lastly, I bought what I wanted without worrying about money.”, Puru said.
Puneet smiled and said, “My dear brother, I also followed our father’s wisdom. But I understood (C)it a bit differently. For the house, I took it as having a place to stay all around the world. So I made friends in every city and I stayed at their houses when I visited those cities. Also, I slept comfortably each night because I would be tired after a hard day’s work, and it did not matter if I was sleeping on a bed or on the hard floor. I ate only when I was hungry, so even a simple meal tasted great.”
“Spend money like a rich man?” continued Puneet.
“A rich man knows how to make money grow. So, I tried to spend money on something that would bring me back more money rather than on luxurious things.”
Puru felt stupid what he had done after he listened to Puneet’s story.
questions.question: 37.  글의 (A)와 뜻이 같도록 <조건>을 반드시 지켜 영작하시오. (<조건>을 지키지 않을 경우 감점)
questions.explanation: 'my father's advice'라는 목적어를 강조하는 구문을 만들어야 하므로, It was my father's advice that I followed.가 정답임.
sentences: <조건>
- (A)의 문장에서 목적어를 강조할 것
- 강조 구문을 사용하여 영작할 것
questions.answer: It was my father's advice that
questions.reason_for_classification: 지문의 특정 정보를 조건에 맞춰 강조 구문으로 변환하는 영작 문제입니다.

questions.question: 38. 다음 <보기>에서 각 문장의 밑줄 친 부분을 강조하기 위해 바꾼 문장이 어법상 옳은 것만을 있는 대로 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: (C) 시간 부사구(on July 4th), (D) 주어(Mike), (E) 시간 부사구(every weekend)를 강조한 구문들이 옳음. (A)는 강조 구문에서 where도 쓰일 수 있으나 보통 부사구 강조 시 'It was on the moon that...'을 선호하며, moon이 장소 명사일 때만 where가 쓰이는데 on the moon은 전치사구라 that이 더 적절함(또는 moon만 강조해야 함). (B)는 강조 구문 뒤에 주어 I가 빠졌으므로 틀림.
sentences: <보기>
(A) Apollo 11 landed <u>on the moon</u> in 1969.
→ It was on the moon where Apollo 11 landed in 1969.
(B) He painted <u>a big house</u> on the wall yesterday.
→ It was a big house that painted on the wall yesterday.
(C) John takes a final exam at school <u>on July 4th</u>.
→ It is on July 4th that John takes a final exam at school.
(D) <u>Mike</u> won the first prize at the singing contest.
→ It was Mike that won the first prize at the singing contest.
(E) Ms. Lee rides a bicycle along Han-river <u>every weekend</u>.
→ It is every weekend that Ms. Lee rides a bicycle along Han-river.
questions.reason_for_classification: 강조 구문에서 다양한 성분(주어, 목적어, 부사구)이 강조될 때의 문법적 변화를 이해하고 있는지 묻는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 39. 다음 중 강조용법으로 쓰이지 않은 문장은?
questions.explanation: ⑤의 It은 가주어이며, 'to find information'이 진주어인 가주어-진주어 구문임. ①~④는 모두 It is ~ that/who 강조 구문임.
options: ① It was John who I met on Friday.
② It was at home that I found my bag.
③ It was Homin that I called on Wednesday.
④ It was yesterday that I finished my homework.
⑤ It would take so long for us to find information.
questions.reason_for_classification: It is ~ that 강조 구문과 It ~ to 가주어-진주어 구문을 구별하는 기초 문제입니다.

questions.question: 40. (A)의 밑줄 친 부분을, 강조하여 (B)로 바꾸어 쓸 때, ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 올바르게 바꾸지 못한 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓒ에서 주어 Amy를 강조했을 때, It is Amy that... 뒤에는 Amy에 맞춘 단수 동사 has가 그대로 와야 하는데 have로 바뀌었으므로 어법상 틀림.
sentences: ⓐ	<u>Mark</u> met Jenny in Paris.
ⓑ	I want to be <u>a chef</u> when I grow up.
ⓒ	<u>Amy</u> has to answer the question this time.
ⓓ	I bought this cute bag <u>at the flea market</u>.
ⓔ	I want to get <u>a guitar</u> for my birthday gift.
ⓐ	It was Mark that met Jenny in Paris.
ⓑ	It is a chef that I want to be when I grow up.
ⓒ	It is Amy that have to answer the question this time.
ⓓ	It was at the flea market that I bought this cute bag.
ⓔ	It is a guitar that I want to get for my birthday gift.
questions.reason_for_classification: 주어를 강조하는 강조 구문에서 뒤따르는 동사의 수 일치 원칙을 묻는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 41. 다음 문장에서 어법상 틀린 곳을 찾아 바르게 고쳐 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: It was him... 강조 구문에서 시간을 나타내는 부사구(yesterday)가 아니라 사람(him)을 강조하고 있으므로 when은 관계부사가 아니며, 강조 구문의 that 또는 who(m)를 써야 함.
sentences: It was him when I met at school yesterday.
questions.answer: when -> that (또는 whom)
questions.reason_for_classification: 강조 대상의 성격(사람)에 어울리지 않는 연결사(when)를 찾아 수정하는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 42. 다음 문장의 밑줄 친 부분을 강조하는 문장을 작성하시오.
questions.explanation: (b) 'a great dancer'는 목적격 보어이므로, It is a great dancer that his mother believes he can be in the future.가 됨.
sentences: His mother believes he can be (b)a great dancer in the future.
(b)를 강조하는 문장
questions.answer: It is a great dancer that his mother believes he can be in the future.
questions.reason_for_classification: 문장 내 보어 성분을 강조 구문으로 옮겨 적절한 형태로 변환하는 능력을 평가합니다.

questions.question: 43. 밑줄 친 ‘it’의 쓰임이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: ④는 'that 이하의 사실은 명확하다'라는 의미로 it이 가주어임. ①, ②, ③, ⑤는 모두 it ~ that 강조 구문임.
options: ① <u>It</u> was Stella that planned her sister’s wedding party.
② <u>It</u> is a guitar that I want to get for my birthday gift.
③ <u>It</u> was in France that I met my husband.
④ <u>It</u> is clear that he used to be an analyst.
⑤ <u>It</u> was yesterday that I read his report.
questions.reason_for_classification: 강조 구문의 it과 가주어 it을 판별하는 전형적인 문제입니다.

questions.question: 45. <보기>에서 어법상 옳은 것을 있는 대로 모두 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓑ 사물 목적어(doll) 강조, ⓓ 부사구(for our safety) 강조, ⓔ 사람 주어(her) 강조, ⓕ 사물 목적어(smartphone) 강조 모두 올바른 강조 구문임. (단, ⓔ에서 It was she가 주격으로 더 권장되나 구어적 her도 가능함). ⓐ는 강조 구문 뒤에 중복된 목적어 him이 남아있어 틀림. ⓒ는 'was broke'가 아니라 'was Mike that broke' 순서가 되어야 함.
sentences: <보기>
ⓐ It was Tom whom she saw him at the bus stop.
ⓑ It was a paper doll which Kate made for her son.
ⓒ It was broke that Mike the vase at home yesterday.
ⓓ It was for our safety that my father checked his car.
ⓔ It was her that played tennis in the park last Sunday.
ⓕ It was a smartphone which my mom bought me for my birthday.

questions.question: 46. 다음 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 가장 적절하지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓑ에서 장소를 강조하는 강조 구문이 되려면 It is in Ukraine that...으로 전치사 in이 포함되어 부사구가 되어야 함. 단순 명사 Ukraine만 강조하면 뒤에 장소를 나타내는 부사가 빠진 불완전한 문장이 와야 하는데 many people are dying은 자동사를 포함한 완전한 문장이므로 부사구 강조가 필요함.
questions.reason_for_classification: 강조 구문에서 장소 부사구를 강조할 때 전치사의 필요성을 묻는 변별력 있는 문법 문제입니다.

questions.passage: James and his friend were looking at the mountain from the top of the building last week.
questions.question: 47. 다음 문장의 각 요소를 강조한 문장 중 어법상 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: ③ 장소 부사구 'from the top of the building'을 강조한 구문으로 완벽함. ① 목적어 mountain을 강조하면 뒤에 look at 뒤의 at이 남아있어야 함. ② last week는 시간 부사구이므로 when이나 that이 오지만 which는 어색함. ⑤ 주어 James and his friend는 복수이므로 It was(단수 취급)를 써야 함.
options: ① It was the mountain that James and his friend were looking from the top of the building last week.
② It was last week which James and his friend were looking at the mountain from the top of the building.
③ It was from the top of the building that James and his friend were looking at the mountain last week.
④ It was at the mountain when James and his friend were looking from the top of the building last week.
⑤ It were James and his friend that were looking at the mountain from the top of the building last week.
questions.reason_for_classification: 문장의 여러 성분을 각각 강조했을 때 발생하는 문법적 변화(전치사 처리, 수 일치, 관계사 선택)를 종합적으로 평가하는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 48. 다음 대화의의 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법의 적절한 쓰임에서 가장 거리가 먼 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓓ에서 강조 구문 It is the expression... that 뒤의 문장이 완전함. 강조된 명사가 문장 내에서 주어, 목적어, 또는 전치사의 목적어 역할을 해야 하는데 'you create natural photos'는 이미 완전한 3형식 문장이므로 연결이 어색함. 'It is through the expression... that you create...'와 같이 부사구 형태가 되어야 자연스러움.

questions.question: 49. 윗글의 밑줄친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 어색한 부분은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ에서 '대화에서 그러하듯이'라는 의미로 앞에 나온 일반동사 laugh를 대신 받아야 하므로 are가 아니라 do가 되어야 함. (as we do in our conversations)

questions.passage:
After the concert, I met Favio Chávez, the conductor, and asked him about the orchestra.
Lucy White: Why did you start The Junk Orchestra?
Favio Chávez: When I went to a small town called Cateura in Paraguay to work on a recycling program in 2005, (가)<u>I saw children living in a town that was mostly filled of garbage</u>. (나)<u>I wanted to add positive something to their lives</u>, so I decided to share my love of music with them.
Lucy White: Why did you use garbage to make instruments?
Favio Chávez: One person's garbage is another person's treasure. Nicolás Gómez, a local garbage picker helped me a lot. He made it possible for children to play music by making instruments out of garbage. (다)<u>The wonderful thing about these instruments were that the children didn't have to worry about spending a lot of money on them</u>.
Lucy White: What do you want people to learn through your music?
Favio Chávez: I want people to know that even something worthless can make inspiring music.
After interviewing Chávez, I realized that it really doesn't matter (라)<u>what instrument you play with as long you put your heart into playing it</u>. The children of Cateura showed me that an orchestra is formed by people, not by instruments.
Comments
Annie: So moving to see how music can change lives. The power of music is endless!
Thomas: After the concert, I found ⓐ<u>it</u> possible to inspire people by music played with recycled instruments.
Kate: (마)<u>Not only do these talented young people deliver great music</u>, but they also bring serious environmental problems to our attention.
questions.question: 50. 윗글의 (가)~(마) 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
questions.explanation: (마)는 부정어 Not only가 문두에 나와 주어와 동사가 도치된 'do(조동사) + young people(주어) + deliver(본동사)' 구조로 어법상 완벽함. (가) filled with, (나) something positive, (다) thing이 주어이므로 was, (라) as long as로 고쳐야 함.
questions.reason_for_classification: 부정어 도치, 형용사 후치 수식, 전치사 관용구, 수 일치 등 다양한 중등 핵심 문법 사항을 지문 내에서 식별하는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 2. 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓔ는 상관접속사 Not only가 문두에 올 때 일어나는 도치(Not only + did + 주어 + 동원)가 올바르게 적용되었습니다. ⓐ는 과거 사실에 대한 가정(가정법 과거완료), ⓑ는 분사구문(and 삭제), ⓒ는 분사구문의 주어 일치, ⓓ는 with+명사+분사(수동 관계이므로 covered)가 각각 틀렸습니다.

It's an emoticon, which is a group of letters or symbols using to represent a facial expression. The emoticon XD expresses our happy feelings more visually than ha-ha and LOL ⓐ<u>do</u>.
questions.question: 3. 밑줄 친 ⓐ가 의미하는 바를 본문에서 찾아 한 단어로 쓰시오. (필요시 형태를 변형할 것)
questions.explanation: 밑줄 친 ⓐ(do)는 앞 문장의 동사인 express를 대신하여 쓰인 대동사입니다. 문맥상 'ha-ha와 LOL이 우리의 행복한 감정을 표현하는 것보다'라는 의미이므로 express가 적절합니다.

questions.reason_for_classification: 앞선 일반동사를 대신하여 쓰이는 대동사 do의 쓰임을 묻는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 1. 다음 각 문장의 어법상 어색한 부분을 바르게 고친 것은?
questions.explanation: 사역동사 let은 목적격 보어로 동사원형을 취하므로 'to correct'를 'correct'로 고친 5번이 정답입니다.
options:
① The officer had his bag open.
→ The officer had his bag opens.

② The professor made his write the report.
→ The professor had his write the report.

③ My mom had my brother cleaned his room.
→ My mom had my brother to clean his room.

④ How can I make her to become interested in me?
→ How can I make her became interested in me?

⑤ His parents let their lawyer to correct the contract.
→ His parents let their lawyer correct the contract.
questions.reason_for_classification: 사역동사(have, make, let)와 준사역동사(get)의 목적격 보어 형태를 구분하는 능력을 평가하는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 2. 다음 빈칸 (A)~(C)에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
questions.explanation: (A) 사역동사 had + 목적어 + 동사원형(bring), (B) 준사역동사 get + 목적어 + to부정사(to give), (C) 사역동사 let + 목적어 + 동사원형(use)이 적절합니다.
options: ④ to bring	giving	   to use
⑤ to bring	to give	   to use
sentences: ⦁I had Peter (A)______________ his luggage up.
⦁I'll get Andrew (B)______________ you a call.
⦁My sister let me (C)______________ her laptop.
questions.reason_for_classification: 다양한 사역동사와 준사역동사가 목적격 보어로 취하는 형태를 종합적으로 묻고 있습니다.

questions.question: 3. 다음 <보기>에서 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
questions.explanation: 'I got him to clean(O)', 'My father made my bike fixed(O, 수동관계)', 'I couldn't make him understand(O)' 세 문장이 옳습니다. 'let he'는 'let him', 'allow me go'는 'allow me to go'가 되어야 합니다.
sentences: • I got him to clean his room.
• My father made my bike fixed.
• Mike's mother let he go home early.

questions.question: 2. 다음 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
questions.explanation: 현재완료 진행형(have/has been -ing)의 올바른 쓰임을 묻는 문제로, 4번 문장은 주어 We에 맞는 have been waiting과 기간을 나타내는 for an hour가 적절히 쓰였다. 1번은 for 20 years, 2번은 2 years ago가 있으므로 과거시제나 현재완료, 3번은 has가 아닌 have, 5번은 for가 아닌 since 2023이 적절하다.

② They have been learning French two years ago.
