questions.question: 3. 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
questions.explanation: 네 번째 문장 'I have been waiting...'만이 어법상 옳다. 첫 번째는 since -> for, 두 번째는 know는 상태동사라 진행형 불가, 세 번째는 have not been, 다섯 번째는 have been reading으로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.question: 4. 두 문장을 한 문장으로 알맞게 바꾼 것은?

① Claire went to bed at nine. She is still sleeping.
Claire has been sleeping at nine.

② She began to learn Chinese in 2018. She is still learning Chinese.
She have been learning Chinese since 2018.

③ He started to clean his room two hours ago He is still cleaning it.
He has been cleaning his room for two hours ago.

The phone has been ringing for almost one minute.

⑤ Sue and Joe started volunteering at the library in February. They are still going there.
Sue and Joe has been volunteering at the library since February.

questions.question: 6. 다음 문장이 같은 의미가 되도록 밑줄 친 부분에 알맞은 말을 쓰시오.

questions.question: 7. 밑줄 친 부분이 어법상 어색한 것은?

questions.question: 8. 다음 문장에서 어법상 틀린 곳을 모두 찾아 바른 문장으로 고치시오.

questions.question: 13. 윗글의 ⓐ～ⓔ 중 문맥상 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: harmful 뒤에 원인을 나타내거나 결과를 나타낼 때 'because' 또는 'so that' 구문이 오는 것이 자연스러우며, 여기서는 'so harmful that'의 결과 구문이 되어야 하므로 ⓒ 앞에 so가 없거나 because 등으로 바뀌어야 한다.

questions.passage: Hi! My name is Kim Seho. I have been ___ⓐ___ in America for three years. Since my family moved here, I have ___ⓑ___ many cultural differences between Korea and America. I would like to share some of them with you.
questions.question: 14. 윗글의 ⓐ와 ⓑ에 들어갈 말이 바르게 연결된 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ는 현재완료 진행형의 living, ⓑ는 현재완료 시제의 experienced가 적절하다. (9번 문항과 동일)
questions.reason_for_classification: 현재완료 진행형과 현재완료 시제의 형태적 결합 및 의미를 묻는 문항임.

questions.question: 15. 주어진 조건에 맞게 우리말에 맞는 영어 문장을 완성하시오.
questions.explanation: (1)은 'has been raining'으로 계속 진행 중임을, (2)는 'The thing (that/which) Thomas is going to take'와 같은 형태나 'What Thomas will take' 등의 명사절이 주어로 와야 한다. (조건 take 사용)
sentences: (1) 3시간째 비가 오고 있다. (조건 – 현재완료 진행사용)
(2) Thomas가 극정에 타고 갈 것은 버스이다. (조건 take 사용)
(답) ______________________ to the theater is a bus.
questions.answer: (1) has been raining for three hours (2) What Thomas will take
questions.reason_for_classification: 현재완료 진행형 문장 생성 능력과 관계대명사(What) 등을 이용한 명사절 주어 구성을 평가함.

questions.passage: Laughter is human. We laugh out loud when we hear a joke, ⓐ<u>sees</u> something funny or feel happy. We laugh even in our writings, such as emails or texts, ⓑ<u>as</u> we do in our conversations. How do we do that? "Ha-ha" is a form of ⓒ<u>written</u> laughter. Everyone knows ⓓ<u>what</u> it means. Actually, it ⓔ<u>have been used</u> since long ago. Even Shakespeare used "ha-ha" in his ⓕ<u>works</u>.
questions.question: 16. 다음 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓕ중, 어법상 틀린 것의 개수는?
questions.explanation: ⓐ는 hear와 병렬이므로 see가 되어야 하고, ⓔ는 it이 3인칭 단수이므로 has been used가 되어야 한다. 따라서 2개가 틀렸다.
questions.reason_for_classification: 병렬 구조(동사원형)와 주어-동사의 수 일치(has/have)를 확인하는 문항임.

questions.passage: These days, people use 😂 - a "face with tears of joy." This is a small picture ⓐ<u>called</u> an "emoji." Lots of ⓑ<u>laughing</u> emojis are available ⓒ<u>to uses</u> online, so people can express their laughter in various ⓓ<u>ways</u>. Some emojis ⓔ<u>has grown</u> ⓕ<u>bigger</u> and some even move or ⓖ<u>makes</u> laughing sounds.
questions.question: 17. 다음 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓕ중, 어법상 틀린 것의 개수는?
questions.explanation: ⓒ to uses -> to use, ⓔ has grown -> have grown(emojis가 복수), ⓖ makes -> make(move와 병렬). 총 3개가 틀렸다.
questions.reason_for_classification: to부정사 형태, 주어-동사 수 일치, 병렬 구조를 복합적으로 평가하는 문항임.

questions.question: 18. 다음 <보기>에서 어법상 옳지 않은 것만을 있는 대로 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓒ 의문문 어순: have you been waiting, ⓕ know는 상태동사로 진행형 불가, ⓖ 부정문 위치: have not been keeping. 따라서 ⓒ, ⓕ, ⓖ가 틀렸다.
sentences: <보기>
ⓐ It's raining hard now.
ⓑ Emily didn't know where to put the sofa.
ⓒ How long have been you waiting for me?
ⓓ Alex hasn't decided when he should leave.
ⓔ She has been crying and her eyes are still red.
ⓕ We have been knowing each other for a long time.
ⓖ They have been not keeping in touch for two years.
questions.reason_for_classification: 현재완료 진행형의 의문문/부정문 어순과 진행형 불가 동사(know)의 특징을 알고 있는지 평가함.

questions.question: 19. 다음 <보기>에서 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
questions.explanation: 첫 번째, 여섯 번째, 일곱 번째 문장 3개가 옳다. 두 번째는 grab (them 삭제), 세 번째는 yesterday(과거부사)와 현재완료 진행 불가, 네 번째는 early enough, 다섯 번째는 are asked가 적절하다.
sentences: <보기>
• He's been in the jungle for almost 2 years.
• The candies are too high for the boy to grab them.
• It has been raining heavily for over two hours yesterday.
• Come home enough early for you to finish your homework.

• I have been waiting to see my favorite stars in person since this afternoon.
• Mt. Jiri and Mt. Seorak are the best places for hiking fans to learn how to get in shape and keep fit.
questions.reason_for_classification: 현재완료, enough의 위치, 부정사 구문, 현재완료 진행형의 시점 일치 등 중등 수준의 핵심 문법들을 종합적으로 평가함.

questions.question: 20. 다음 문장 중 어법상 바른 것은?
questions.explanation: 3번 문장은 현재완료 진행의 부정형(has not been -ing)과 since 시점이 잘 어울린다. 1번은 been, 2번은 Has Jane, 4번은 have been, 5번은 playing이 옳다.
options: ① It has be raining since last Sunday.
② Have Jane been doing her homework for an hour?
③ Mr. Wood has not been reading the book since the accident.
④ Tom and David has been preparing the party since yesterday.

questions.reason_for_classification: 현재완료 진행형의 기본 형태와 의문문, 부정문, 수 일치를 정확히 구사하는지 확인하는 문항임.

questions.question: 21.  다음 주어진 두 문장을 현재완료진행형을 이용하여 한 문장으로 고쳐 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: 과거에 시작되어 현재까지 진행 중인 동작은 'have/has been -ing'를 사용하여 결합한다.
sentences: <보기>
• Ben started to live in London two years ago.
• He still lives there.
questions.answer: Ben has been living in London for two years.
questions.reason_for_classification: 두 개의 문장을 현재완료 진행형의 계속적 의미로 통합하는 능력을 평가함.

questions.question: 22.  다음 중 올바르게 쓰인 문장은?
questions.explanation: 2번 문장은 주어-동사 수 일치와 현재완료 진행형의 형태가 완벽하다. 1번은 hasn't been, 3번은 has not been, 4번은 has been, 5번은 have been이 옳다.
options: ① He hasn't not been writing a novel.
② They have been doing their homework.
③ He has been not playing computer games.
④ She have been running home from school.
⑤ Paul and Jean has been helping African children in the war.
questions.reason_for_classification: 현재완료 진행형의 긍정/부정문 어순과 주어의 수에 따른 have/has 선택을 평가함.

questions.passage: Back in the 1920's, whenever people saw me in the village, they would say, "There (A)<u>goes</u> the parakho's daughter." My father was a son from a very rich family. Instead of living the life of a seonbi, he was always at the gambling house. That is why he (B)<u>was called</u> a parakho, which means someone who ruins his family's fortune. "Your father (C)<u>had gambled</u> away all of the money, and now he's asking for more. Go and tell him that we have no more money (D)<u>left</u>," my mother would tell me whenever she sent me to the gambling house. Then, my father would yell at me angrily, "Why did you come (E)<u>empty-handed</u>? Bring me more money!“
questions.question: 23.  밑줄 친 (A)~(E) 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: (C)는 어머니가 말하는 시점(현재/과거 진행 중 상황)에서 이미 완료된 결과를 나타내므로, 과거 완료(had gambled)가 아니라 현재완료(has gambled)를 쓰는 것이 문맥상 어색할 수 있으나, 여기서는 전체가 과거 회상이므로 had gambled가 맞을 수도 있다. 하지만 문맥상 '돈을 다 탕진해버렸다'는 결과이므로 현재완료가 더 자연스럽다. 원문 대조 시 has gambled가 맞다.
questions.reason_for_classification: 과거 시점의 상황 속에서 일어난 사건의 완료 상태를 나타낼 때 적절한 시제(현재완료/과거완료)를 선택하는 문항임.

questions.question: 24.  글의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말을 <조건>을 반드시 지켜 영작하시오.
questions.explanation: (A)는 깨달은 시점(과거)보다 이전의 상태를 나타내므로 과거완료 'had been', (B)는 그때 이후(Ever since)부터 지금까지의 상태이므로 현재완료 'have been'을 사용한다.

questions.reason_for_classification: 과거 시점 이전의 상태(과거완료)와 과거부터 현재까지 지속되는 상태(현재완료)를 구분하여 영작하는 능력을 평가함.

25.  다음 우리말을 현재완료진행형을 이용하여 영어로 써봅시다.

questions.question: 26.  다음 두 문장을 하나의 문장으로 바꿔 쓸 때 옳은 것은?

questions.reason_for_classification: 과거의 동작이 현재까지 계속되는 상황을 현재완료 진행형과 for 기간 구문으로 전환하는 문항임.

questions.question: 27. 다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은? (정답 2개)

options: ① They are tired because they have been working our since 3 hours.

questions.question: 28. 현재완료진행형을 사용하여 한 문장으로 썼을 때 잘못된 것은?
questions.explanation: (라)는 과거 공부했고 3월에 끝났으므로 과거 완료된 일이다. 현재완료 진행은 현재까지 진행 중이어야 하므로 적절하지 않다.
options:
(가) It's raining. The rain started three hours ago.
 It's been raining for three hours .

(나) I started taking piano lessons in March. I'm still taking them.
 I have been taking piano lessons since March.

(다) He is waiting for the bus. He got to the bus stop 30 minutes ago.
 He has been waiting for the bus for 30 minutes.

(라) I was studying Korean. I finished Korean classes in March.
 I have been studying Korean since March.

(마) Ron began watching the play two hours ago. He's still watching it.
 Ron has been watching the play for two hours.
questions.reason_for_classification: 현재완료 진행형이 쓰일 수 있는 상황(현재까지 지속되는 동작)과 이미 종료된 과거 동작을 구분하는 문항임.

questions.passage:

DREAM4 is back! I'm so excited to see my favorite Korean boy band perform. Their singing and their dancing are just perfect. I want to understand their songs without subtitles or translations though. MY tips? - Marisa, 14

questions.question: 29. 윗글 ⓐ~ⓔ에서 어법상 올바른 것은? (정답 2개)
questions.explanation: ⓐ는 현재완료 진행형으로 옳고, ⓓ도 존재 구문으로 옳다. ⓑ는 can use, ⓒ는 It's also a good idea(가주어), ⓔ는 keeps you motivated, then you will enjoy가 옳다.
questions.reason_for_classification: 지문 내 다양한 문장들의 문법적 정확성(현재완료 진행, 수동태/능동태, 가주어, 주어 일치 등)을 판별하는 문항임.

questions.question: 30. ⓐ，ⓑ에 들어갈 문장이 알맞게 짝지어진 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ는 1시간 전부터 지금까지 기다리는 중이므로 현재완료 진행형 'we have been waiting for... for an hour', ⓑ는 수리가 완료된 상태를 나타내므로 현재완료 'has repaired it'이 적절하다. (문맥상 지금 작동하므로 수리가 끝남)

questions.reason_for_classification: 대화의 맥락에 따라 현재완료 진행형(동작의 지속)과 현재완료(동작의 완료)를 적절히 사용하는지 평가함.

questions.question: 31. 다음 어법상 빈칸에 들어갈 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: '가장 좋은 선수가 멤버가 된 이후로'라는 의미이므로, 과거의 특정 시점부터 현재까지의 상태나 동작의 영향을 나타내는 현재완료 'have played'가 가장 적절하다. (진행형이 없으므로 완료 시제 선택)

questions.reason_for_classification: 과거의 사건 이후 현재까지 이어지는 상태를 나타내는 적절한 시제를 선택하는 문항임.

questions.question: 32. 다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓑ는 하루 종일 쓰고 있다는 계속, ⓒ는 의문문 형태, ⓔ는 과거 이전 사건(대과거)으로 모두 옳다. ⓐ는 know 진행형 불가, ⓓ는 for March가 아니라 since March가 되어야 한다.
sentences: ⓐ I’ve been knowing him for a long time.
ⓑ She has been writing a letter all day long.
ⓒ How long has Gina been practicing ballet?
ⓓ She has been working at the mall in March.

questions.reason_for_classification: 현재완료 진행형의 쓰임(동사 제약, 전치사)과 과거완료(대과거)의 올바른 사용을 동시에 묻는 문항임.

questions.question: 33. 다음 두 그림을 보고 오후 3시부터 현재 시각 오후 5시까지 진행 중인 상태 또는 행동을 문장으로 쓴 것이다. 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 가장 알맞은 말은?

questions.question: 34. 보기와 같이 두 문장을 한 문장으로 바르게 고친것은?
questions.explanation: 4번은 뮤지컬이 끝난 것이 내가 도착한 것보다 먼저 일어난 일이므로 과거완료(had ended)를 사용하여 시점 차이를 잘 나타냈다. 1번은 was wet, 2번은 had been ill, 3번은 because Mr. Joe had hidden, 5번은 someone had broken이 적절하다.
options:

→ The roads had been wet because it rained during the night.

② My grandma was ill for two days. I visited her.

③ Mr. Joe hid treasure under the sea. They couldn’t find it
→ They couldn’t find the treasure, Mr. Joe had hidden it.

→ When i arrived at the theater, the musical had ended.

⑤ I got home. I found someone broke into our house.

questions.passage:
(가) One night in February, after I (A)[have gone / had gone] to bed, an earthquake hit.
I woke up suddenly because my bed was shaking. I thought my brother was shaking my bed as a joke. But then I heard the mirror on my desk fall to the floor and break into pieces. I knew it wasn’t my brother then, but I still didn’t know what exactly was happening.
(나) Soon the whole room began to shake violently, and my confusion (B)[turns to / turned to] panic. My mom shouted that it was an earthquake and ran into my room. Since it was my first time experiencing an earthquake, I didn’t know how to react. I just kept saying, “What should I do?”
(다) My mom pulled me and my brother out of bed. We ran to the kitchen and crawled under the table. I could see the light swinging violently and books falling to the floor. Our family picture dropped from the wall and the glass covering it broke. A cup ㉠<u>tipped over</u> and rolled off the kitchen table. Every second, I could hear something else in the apartment break. I started to worry that the building would collapse.
(라) Then the shaking seemed to stop. We started crawling toward the door. At that moment, my mom’s cell phone rang. It was my dad, who was coming home from work.
He shouted, “It stopped!” Get out of the building! Take the stairs! Don’t take the elevator! Hurry!“ ”Where are you? Are you okay?“ my mom asked ㉡<u>urgently</u>. My dad answered, “Don’t worry. I’m okay. I (C)[was driving / have been driving] home when the shaking started. But I pulled over ㉢<u>immediately</u>. I’m listening to the radio right now to find out what’s going on.”
(마) We nervously made our way down the stairs and outside. I looked around. Parts of buildings had fallen and had smashed several cars. We went to an open space to avoid more falling pieces. How could all this have happened in a few minutes?

I can’t forget the panic I felt when the furniture was shaking and things were falling to the floor. After that night, I began to take earthquake drills ㉤<u>violently</u>. questions.passage:
Why Do People Learn Foreign Languages?
ⓐ<u>Many students learn new languages because school requirements</u>. Many others learn them for fun. In any case, students everywhere have found interesting ways to study new languages. Let’s meet there students and listen to their ideas.
I Love Soccer!
I’m a big fan of a Spanish soccer team. I want to understand interviews with my favorite players. However, it’s not easy because I don’t know Spanish that well. How can I improve my Spanish?
- Owen, 16
The best way to learn a new language is to practice it every day. I have changed the language of my phone to Spanish, and I have been writing my shopping lists in Spanish!
- Julie, 15
ⓑ<u>That is most important is to become familiar with the language first</u>. ⓒ<u>I suggest to watch Spanish movies often</u>. It will help you get used to the sound of the language. If the people talk too fast, try watching Spanish children’s movies first.
- Inho, 14
Some words are used only in soccer, not in everyday life. Learn some soccer vocabulary and memorize it. Also, why don’t you try writing a review of a match in Spanish? ⓓ<u>It will help you to improve your writing skills</u>.
- Rohan, 16
No More Subtitles!
DREAM4 is back! I’m so excited to see my favorite Korean boy band perform. Their singing and their dancing are just perfect. I want to understand their songs without subtitles or translations though. Any tips?
- Marisa, 14
You should find friends who are interested in DREAM4 and start a club. In my club, we motivate one another. We translate songs and sing together. Doing these things is fun and really improves our Korean!
- Lori, 15
Follow DREAM4 on social media. They often post short messages in Korean about how they are doing. They also post pictures with the messages, so you can understand the posts more easily.
- Aishah, 14
I recommend watching Korean dramas. ⓔ<u>I’ve been watched Korean dramas for a year</u>, and they’re really interesting! You can use Korean subtitles for help with listening. It’s also a good idea to print out the subtitles and read them first.
Brandon, 16
What Works for You?
There are hundreds of good tips out there, but everyone has their own way of learning. Find what keeps you motivated; then you will enjoy learning more. Remember, every language is hard at first, but a new language can make your world much bigger!

(A) I saw you have hung some pictures by the windows 처럼 대과거를 나타내거나, 지각동사 구문에 맞게 'you hanging some pictures by the windows'라고 구성할 수 있으나 조건의 8단어와 have/hang 활용을 따져야 합니다. 정답 후보: you having hung some pictures by the window (부자연스러움), 혹은 시제 완료를 나타내는 'you had hung some pictures by the windows'는 7단어입니다. 문맥상 '너희가 창가에 그림 몇 점을 걸어놓은 것을 보았다'는 의미로 과거완료를 쓴 형태(I saw that you had hung some pictures by the windows)가 조건에 부합할 수 있으나 'that'을 포함하면 9단어가 됩니다. 정확한 답안은 'you having hung some pictures by the' + 'window'(8단어) 혹은 'you have hung some pictures by the window' 등 형태 변화를 요구합니다. 가장 적절한 것은 'you have some pictures hung by the window' (8단어)입니다.
sentences: <조건>
‘have’ ‘hang’ 동사를 꼭 활용하시오. (형태변형 가능)
총 8단어로 쓰시오.
the, some, by를 꼭 쓰시오.
questions.answer: you have some pictures hung by the window
questions.reason_for_classification: 지각동사 또는 5형식 사역동사 have의 수동적 목적격 보어(p.p.) 형태를 활용하여 특정 단어 수에 맞춰 영작하는 복합 문제입니다.

questions.question: 33. 보기 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 밑줄 친 부분이 어법상 어색한 것끼리 짝지어진 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ는 여러 번 갔던 '경험'이므로 과거완료 had known이 자연스럽지만 문맥에 따라 어색할 수 있고, ⓒ는 잃어버린 시점이 찾은 시점보다 이전이므로 lost를 had lost로 고쳐야 합니다. ⓔ는 발견한 시점(found)보다 이전에 열쇠를 두고 온 것이므로 have left를 had left로 고쳐야 합니다.

ⓑ We found that we <u>had left</u> our ticket at home.
ⓒ My sister <u>had found</u> my phone which I lost in the market.

questions.question: 34. 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어의 형태를 알맞게 고친 것은?
questions.explanation: 모두 과거 시점(got back home) 이전에 일어난 일들이므로 과거완료(had + p.p.) 형태인 gone, left, broken, eaten이 되어야 합니다.

questions.question: 36. 다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것의 개수는?
questions.explanation: 틀린 문장은: 'Bali three years ago'는 명백한 과거이므로 현재완료를 쓸 수 없음, 'had already woke up'은 'woken up'으로, 'when I met... last week'는 과거 시점이므로 has been을 had been으로 고쳐야 함. 총 3개입니다.

questions.question: 37. 다음 대화의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 가장 적절하지 않은 것은?

questions.question: 38. 다음 대화의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 어색한 것은?

→ He realized what he had done wrong.

② 경찰이 도착했을 때 도둑들은 달아나고 없었다.
→ The thieves had run away when the police arrived.

③ 내가 그를 만나기 전에 그는 스페인에서 2년을 공부했다.
→ He had studied in Spain for two years before I met him.

④ 우리가 집에 돌아오기 전에 누군가 집에 침입했다.
→ Before we got home, somebody has broken into the house.

⑤ 내가 꽃집에 갔을 때 꽃은 다 팔리고 없었다.
→ When I went to the flower shop, all the flowers had been sold out.
questions.reason_for_classification: 과거의 특정 시점보다 이전에 일어난 사건을 나타내는 과거완료 시제의 쓰임을 묻는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 2. 다음에서 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
questions.explanation: 옳은 문장은 3개입니다. (1) After I turned twelve... (2) Claire had already woken up... (3) My grandfather was.../my father was... 두 번째 문장은 had gone으로, 다섯 번째 문장은 had kept로 고쳐야 합니다.
sentences: . After I turned twelve, we had a car at home.
. When she came home, Peter had went to bed already.
. Claire had already woken up even before her alarm clock rang.
. My grandfather was a musician, and my father was also a composer.
. Andrew had keep our shopping list in his pocket when we got to this mail.
questions.reason_for_classification: 과거완료의 형태(had+p.p.)와 단순 과거 시제의 올바른 활용을 구분하는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 3. ‘그는 문을 잠그지 않아서 놀랐다.’ 를 바르게 영작한 것은?
questions.explanation: 놀란 시점(was surprised)보다 문을 잠그지 않은 시점이 더 이전이므로 과거완료 부정형인 hadn't locked를 사용하는 것이 적절합니다.
options: ① He was surprised that he hadn't locked the door.
② He surprised that he locked the door.
③ He was surprised that he has locked the door.
④ He had surprised that he didn't locked the door.
⑤ He wasn't surprised that he has locked the door.
questions.reason_for_classification: 두 과거 사건의 전후 관계를 과거완료로 표현할 수 있는지 묻는 영작 문제입니다.

questions.question: 4. 보기의 두 문장을 참고하여, 하나의 과거완료의 문장으로 다시 적으시오.
questions.explanation: 가방을 빌린 것이 잊어버린 것(forgot)보다 먼저 일어난 일이므로 빈칸에는 had borrowed가 들어가야 합니다.
sentences: She borrowed my bag from me.
Later, she forgot it.
정답: She forgot that she _________ my bag from me.
questions.answer: had borrowed
questions.reason_for_classification: 제시된 두 문장의 시간 순서를 파악하여 대과거를 과거완료로 전환하는 능력을 평가합니다.

questions.passage: Katherine Johnson was one of the three "hidden figures" in this movie. She worked hard and shows a talent in math, and her manager Al Harrison recognized her ability. One day, he got upset when Katherine was missing from her desk for too long. ⓐ<u>Al은 Katherine에게 어디에 갔었는지 물었다</u>, and she answered.
questions.question: 5. 윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ에 들어갈 말을 바르게 영작한 것은?
questions.explanation: 물어본 시점(asked)보다 Katherine이 어딘가에 가 있었던 시점이 더 이전이므로 '의문사+주어+had p.p.' 어순의 간접의문문 형태인 'where Katherine had been'이 적절합니다.
options: ① Al asked where Katherine have been
② Al asked where Katherine has been
③ Al asked where Katherine been
④ Al asked where Katherine hadn't been
⑤ Al asked where Katherine had been
questions.reason_for_classification: 간접의문문의 어순과 주절의 시제보다 앞선 시점을 나타내는 과거완료의 결합을 묻는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 6. 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
questions.explanation: ⑤번 문장에서 지미가 도착한 시점(arrived)이 과거이므로, 기차가 이미 떠난 것은 그보다 더 이전의 일입니다. 따라서 현재완료 has 대신 과거완료인 had를 써야 합니다.
options: ① She found that she had left her homework at home.
② I missed the last bus, so I got home at midnight.
③ I went to bed after I watched my favorite TV show.
④ Mina had been ill for three days when I visited her.
⑤ Jimmy arrived at the station at 6 o'clock, but the train has already left.
questions.reason_for_classification: 과거 시점과 대비되는 대과거를 표현할 때 현재완료를 잘못 사용한 오류를 찾아내는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 7. 다음 문장의 (A)~(D) 각 네모 안에 들어갈 말을 짝지은 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: (A)는 after절이 대과거이므로 주절은 과거인 went, (B)는 도착한 과거보다 이전이므로 had left, (C)는 과거 시점의 상태를 나타내므로 were, (D)는 had 뒤에 오는 p.p. 형태이므로 finished가 적절합니다.
options: ① go		had left		were		finishes
② go		has left		has been		finished
③ went		had left		were		finishes
④ went		had left		were		finished
⑤ went		has left		has been		finishes
sentences: ◦ I (A) go/went to bed after I had watched my favorite TV show.
◦ David arrived at the station at 6 o’clock, but the train (B) has left/had left.
◦ The roads (C) were/has been wet because it had rained during the night.
◦ Jina had already (D) finished/finishes her homework when Tom opened the door.
questions.reason_for_classification: 단순 과거와 과거완료의 적절한 조합을 문맥에 따라 선택하는 종합 시제 문제입니다.

questions.passage: Yori is a middle school student and a content creator. She ⓐ<u>has been</u> interested in traditional Korean food since she was 10 years old. So, she bought a new camera and started to take pictures of Korean food in famous restaurants, Last year, she recorded a video clip with the camera that she ⓑ<u>had bought</u>. For the past several weeks, her father ⓒ<u>has taught</u> her how to edit video clips. In her video, she introduces the history of Korean foods and how to make them. She became a famous content creator after she ⓓ<u>has gotten</u> 1.000.000 views on WolchonTube Until then, not many people ⓔ<u>had watched</u> her video clips. However, she is now a popular content creator who promotes traditional Korean food worldwide.
questions.question: 8. 다음 글의 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 흐름과 어법에 맞지 않는 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓓ가 속한 문장에서 그녀가 유명해진 것(became)이 과거이므로, 조회수를 기록한 것은 그보다 이전의 일입니다. 따라서 현재완료 has gotten을 과거완료인 had gotten으로 고쳐야 합니다.
questions.reason_for_classification: 현재완료와 과거완료를 문맥 속에서 정확히 구분하여 사용할 수 있는지 묻는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 9. 다음은 지난 여름 Jina의 제주 여행 일정표이다. 이 표의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
questions.explanation: 일정표의 시간 순서상 'Hyeopjae Beach'에서 수영을 한 시점이 'shopping at the local market'보다 나중이라면, ③번 혹은 ⑤번 등 전후 관계가 뒤바뀐 보기가 정답이 됩니다. (지문 내 표 누락으로 일반적인 과거완료 시제 논리를 적용함)
options: ① Jina visited the Haenyeo Museum after she had checked in at the hotel.
② Jina had walked along the Jeju Olle Trail before she went to Udo.
③ After Jina had climbed Mt. Halla, she stayed at the hotel.
④ Before Jina rode a horse, she had gone to a maze park.
⑤ Jina went shopping at the local market after shed had gone swimming at Hyeopjae Beach.

questions.question: 10. 다음 중 대화의 흐름이 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: ③번 대화에서 'This is on me'는 '내가 낼게'라는 뜻이지 '네가 나에게 이것을 사줘'라는 뜻이 아닙니다.
options:
① A: I feel under the weather.
B: What did you say?
A: I said, “I feel under the weather.” It means “I feel ill.” I think I have a cold.
B: Oh. You’d better see a doctor.

② A: I’ve been working so hard in the gym for the past six months. How do I look?
B: You look the same as six months ago.
A: What? But I’ve lost 10 kilos.
B: Come on. You look great. I was just pulling your leg.

③ A: Oh, here comes the waiter with the check.
B: How much is the total?
A: 50 dollars.
B: Here is 25 dollars.
A: No, keep your money. This is on me.
B: Excuse me? What is the meaning of that?
A: I said, “This is on me.” It means “You buy me this.”

④ A: We pigged out.
B: Pardon me?
A: I said, “We pigged out.” It means “We ate a lot.”
B: Oh, I agree. The buffer was so good that we totally pigged out.

⑤ A: Look. It’s raining cats and dogs outside.
B: Raining cats and dogs? What do you mean by that?
A: It means “it’s raining heavily outside.”
B: Fortunately, I have an umbrella in my backpack. Do you want to share it?

questions.question: 11. 다음 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
questions.explanation: 영화관에 도착한 것(got)이 과거이고, 영화가 시작된 것은 그보다 더 이전이므로 과거완료인 had already started를 써야 합니다.
options: ④ had gotten		has already started
⑤ has gotten		had already started
sentences: James was late for the movie yesterday. When he (A)_____________ to the movie theater, the movie (B)____________.
questions.reason_for_classification: 과거의 두 사건 중 먼저 일어난 일을 과거완료로 표현하는 전형적인 시제 문제입니다.

questions.question: 12. 다음 (A)~(C)에 어법상 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: (A) 도시로 이사 오기 전에 살았던 것이므로 과거완료 had lived, (B) 이사 온 이후 지금까지의 변화를 나타내므로 현재완료 has changed, (C) 그 변화를 경험한 이후 지금까지 얼마나 성장했는지를 묻고 있으므로 현재완료 have grown이 적절합니다.
options: ② lived		has changed		had grown
③ had lived		has changed		have grown
④ had lived		had changed		had grown
⑤ have lived		has changed		have grown
sentences: Before I moved to the city, I (A)__________ in a small town. However, since I moved to the big city, my life (B)__________ significantly. It is amazing to see how much I (C)__________ since I experienced that change.
questions.reason_for_classification: 현재완료와 과거완료의 기준점을 정확히 파악하여 빈칸을 채우는 시제 혼합 문제입니다.

questions.passage:
However, he was wrong. Everyone was wise. Each man had chosen his path and created his future.
The map who went to the left walked deeper (A)____________ the forest. He was attacked by wild animals and almost died (B)____________ hunger. Soon he learned how to protect himself and find food. (C)____________ the end, he made his way out of the forest and taught others survival skills.
The man who went to the right met a group of thieves. They took everything (D)____________ him and made him join them. ⓐ<u>While being with them, he showed great kindness to them</u>. The thieves were moved by his kindness and learned from his wisdom. Later, they also became wise men.
The man who walked back created a safe path (E)____________ the forest. ⓑ<u>When people used this path</u>, they could get where they were going without getting lost, even though the trip took a little longer.
The man who went straight became a pioneer. ⓒ<u>He left the forest and discovered where no one else has been before</u>. Thanks to him, people could enjoy these new beautiful lands.
The man who climbed the tree became a guide. ⓓ<u>Having found many different paths</u>, he was able to teach people how to find the quickest ways to their destinations.
ⓔ<u>This is the way in which the five men found their own paths</u>. (가)_____________________________.
(나)_____________________________. You have to create your own path. (다)_____________________________. (라)_____________________________.
questions.question: 13. 위 글의 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 바르지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓒ번 문장에서 그가 발견한(discovered) 과거 시점보다 아무도 가보지 않았던 경험은 그 이전의 일이어야 하므로 현재완료 has been을 과거완료인 had been으로 고쳐야 합니다.
questions.reason_for_classification: 지문 내의 과거 시점 상황에서 그보다 앞선 대과거의 경험을 표현하기 위해 과거완료를 적절히 사용했는지 확인하는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 14. 문맥상 ㄱ,ㄴ 에 들어갈 동사의 형태로 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
questions.explanation: 사라가 도착한 시점(arrived)이 과거이고, 닉이 그보다 먼저 집에 간 상태이므로 과거완료인 had gone을 사용해야 합니다.
sentences: Jenny and Nick went to the same party last week, but they didn’t see each other. Nick left the party at 9:00 abd Sarah arrived at 10:30.
So when Sarah ㉠(arrive) at the party, Nick wasn’t there. He ㉡(go) home.
questions.reason_for_classification: 특정 과거 시점 이전에 완료된 동작을 과거완료 시제로 나타낼 수 있는지 묻는 문제입니다.

questions.passage: A rich and wise father had two sons, Puru and Puneet. Before he passed away, he called his two sons to give them some last words of advice. “Listen carefully, my dear sons. Live by these words throughout your life, and you will be happy,” he said. “My last words of advice are written on this paper…” Before he could explain himself, he passed away. After his death, the two sons took their share of the father’s wealth and settled in different cities. Five years passed. Puru, ⓐ_____ had been following his father’s words carefully, had no money left. But his brother was richer than ever. Puru was puzzled about where he ⓑ_____ wrong, so he visited Puneet to find out. Puneet welcomed Puru with open arms. That night, ⓒ_____ the brothers sat down to chat after dinner, Puru asked the question that had been on his mind for days.
questions.question: 15. 글의 문맥과 어법상 ⓐ~ⓒ에 들어갈 것으로 옳은 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ는 선행사 Puru를 수식하는 주격 관계대명사 who, ⓑ는 의문을 가진 과거 시점(was puzzled)보다 이전에 일이 잘못된 것이므로 과거완료 had gone, ⓒ는 형제들이 대화를 하기 위해 앉은 '때'를 나타내는 접속사 when이 적절합니다.
questions.reason_for_classification: 관계대명사와 과거완료 시제, 그리고 부사절 접속사의 적절한 쓰임을 종합적으로 평가하는 문제입니다.

questions.passage:
Back in the 1920's, whenever people saw me in the village, they would say, "There (A)<u>goes</u> the parakho's daughter."
My father was a son from a very rich family. Instead of living the life of a seonbi, he was always at the gambling house. That is why he (B)<u>was called</u> a parakho, which means someone who ruins his family's fortune.
"Your father (C)<u>had gambled</u> away all of the money, and now he's asking for more. Go and tell him that we have no more money (D)<u>left</u>," my mother would tell me whenever she sent me to the gambling house.
Then, my father would yell at me angrily, "Why did you come (E)<u>empty-handed</u>? Bring me more money!“
questions.question: 16. 글의 밑줄 친 (A)~(E) 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: (C)에서 어머니가 돈이 없다고 말하며 과거에 돈을 다 탕진했다는 사실을 언급할 때, 기준 시점이 과거인 문맥에서 단순히 그 이전의 일을 나타낼 때는 'has gambled' 혹은 문맥에 따라 'gambled'가 쓰여야 합니다. 이 지문에서는 직접화법 문장 내부이므로 'has gambled'가 더 적절하거나, 단순 과거형을 써야 하는 자리입니다. (교과서 원문 근거 시 대과거 표현의 오용 여부 확인)
questions.reason_for_classification: 지문 전체의 시제 흐름과 직접화법 내의 시제 일치, 그리고 과거완료의 적절한 사용 여부를 묻는 문제입니다.

questions.passage:
Today everything went wrong. First, I got up late.
(A) Suddenly my teacher asked me to read my report.
(B) Soon I realized that I had left my report at home.
(C) When I arrived at school, class had already begun.
(D) I quietly sat down at my desk.
(E) I (가) <u>had never been</u> in such a situation, so my face got really red.
I want to forget everything about today!
questions.question: 17. 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 (가)와 같은 것은?
questions.explanation: (가)의 had never been은 과거완료의 '경험' 용법입니다. ①의 'had worked... before' 또한 이전에 일해 본 '경험'을 나타내므로 쓰임이 같습니다.
options: ① She <u>had worked</u> for the bank before.
② They <u>had studied</u> French for five years.
③ The show <u>had already begun</u> when we arrived.
④ He <u>had lost</u> his glasses earlier, so he couldn’t read anything.
⑤ When she visited his house, he <u>had left</u> for the airport to go on vacation.
questions.reason_for_classification: 과거완료의 4가지 용법(완료, 경험, 계속, 결과)을 구분하는 문제입니다.

questions.passage:
Then the shaking seemed to stop. We started crawling toward the door. At that moment, my mom’s cell phone rang. It was my dad, who was coming home from work.
He shouted, “It stopped! Get out of the building! Take the stairs! Don’t take the elevator! Hurry!” “Where are you? Are you okay?” my mom asked ⓐ<u>urgently</u>. My dad answered, “Don’t worry. I’m okay. I was driving home when the shaking started ⓑ<u>violently</u>. But I pulled over ⓒ<u>immediately</u>. I’m listening to the radio right now to find out what’s going on.”
We ⓓnervously made our way down the stairs and outside. I looked around. (A)<u>Parts of buildings had fallen and had smashed several cars. We went to an open space to avoid more falling pieces</u>. (B) <u>How could all this had happened in a few minutes</u>? (C) <u>Though I had done many earthquake drills in school, I had not thought I would experience a real earthquake</u>. I still get scared when I remember that night. (D) <u>I can’t forget the panic which I felt when the furniture shaking and things falling to the floor.</u> After that night, I began to take earthquake ⓔ<u>seriously</u>. (E) <u>I realized that I need to be prepared for the next earthquake, that can occur at any time</u>.
questions.question: 18. (A)~(E)중 어법상 올바른 문장은? (정답 2개)
questions.explanation: (A)는 건물이 무너지고 차를 덮친 것이 과거 시점 이전의 일이므로 과거완료를 쓴 것이 옳으며, (C) 또한 훈련을 했던 것이 과거 이전의 일이므로 과거완료가 적절히 쓰였습니다. (B)는 조동사 could 뒤에 동사원형 have가 와야 하며, (D)는 shaking 앞에 be동사(was)가 빠졌고, (E)는 realized라는 과거 동사에 맞춰 need를 needed로 써야 하며 계속적 용법의 관계대명사 that은 쓸 수 없습니다.
questions.reason_for_classification: 지문 속에서 과거완료, 조동사, 시제 일치, 관계대명사 등 다양한 문법적 요소를 정확히 파악하여 옳은 문장을 고르는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 19. 다음 일정표에서 추론할 수 있는 문장으로 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: ③번 문장에서 은행에 가기(went) '전에' 보고서를 끝낸 것(had finished)이므로, before절에는 과거 시제인 went를 쓰고 주절에 과거완료를 써야 합니다. 문장 구조상 'Before I had gone'은 어색한 표현입니다.
options: ① The bank had already closed when I visited it.
② After I had had dinner with my family, I went to the bank.
③ Before I had gone to the bank, I finished my science report.
④ When I made a call to Kate, she had submitted her report online.
⑤ I had already finished my science report before I had dinner with my family.
sentences: I finished my science report	I had dinner with my family	I made a call to Kate
The bank closed	Kate submitted her report online	I went to the bank
questions.reason_for_classification: 시간표를 바탕으로 두 사건의 선후 관계를 과거완료 시제를 사용하여 올바르게 표현했는지 묻는 문제입니다.

questions.passage:
(가) One night in February, and earthquake hit. I had gone to bed (A)[since / before] it occurred, and woke up suddenly because my bed was shaking. I thought my brother was shaking my bed ㉠<u>as</u> a joke. But ㉡<u>then</u> I heard the mirror on my desk fall to the floor and break into pieces. I knew it wasn’t my brother then, but I still don’t know what exactly happened.
(나) ㉢<u>Soon</u> the whole room began to shake violently, and Ⓐ<u>my confusion</u> turned to panic. My mom shouted that it was an earthquake and ran into my room. ⓐ<u>I didn’t know how should I react</u>. (B)[As / Though] it was my first time experiencing an earthquake, I just kept saying, “What should I do?”
(다) My mom pulled me and my brother out of bed. We ran to the kitchen and crawled under the table. I could see the light swinging violently and books falling to the floor. ⓑ<u>Our family picture dropped from the wall and the glass covered it broke</u>. A cup tipped over and rolled off the kitchen table. ⓒ<u>Every second, I could hear something else in the apartment breaking</u>. I started to worry that the building would collapse.
(라) ⓓ<u>Then the shaking seemed stopped</u>. We started crawling toward the door. At that moment, my mom’s cell phone rang. It was my dad, who was coming home from work.
He shouted, “It stopped! Get out of the building! Take the stairs! Don’t take the elevator! Hurry!” “Where are you? Are you okay?” my mom asked urgently. My dad answered. “Don’t worry. I’m Okay. I was driving home when the shaking started. But I pulled over immediately. I’m listening to the radio right now to find out what’s going on.”
(마) We nervously made our way down the stairs and outside. I looked around. Parts of buildings had fallen and had smashed several cars. We went to Ⓑ<u>an open space</u> to avoid more falling pieces. How could all this have happened in a few minutes?
(바) (C)[Since / Even though] I had done many earthquake drills in school, I had never thought I’d experience a real earthquake. I still get scared ㉣<u>when</u> I remember that night. I can’t forget the panic that I felt when the furniture was shaking and things were falling to the floor. ㉤<u>After</u> that night, I began to take earthquake drills seriously. ⓔ<u>I realized that I should be prepared for the next earthquake, that can occur at any time</u>.
questions.question: 20. 윗글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C) 안에서 문맥상 적절한 것들로만 묶인 것은?
questions.explanation: (A) 지진이 일어나기 '전에' 침대에 들었으므로 before, (B) 처음 경험하는 것이었기 '때문에' 당황했으므로 이유를 나타내는 As, (C) 훈련을 했음에도 '불구하고' 실제 지진을 겪을 줄은 몰랐으므로 양보의 Even though가 적절합니다.

questions.question: 21. 다음 일기 속 밑줄 친 문장 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓓ번 문장에서 내가 도착했을 때 영화가 이미 시작된 상태여야 하므로, 과거 시점인 arrived보다 더 이전을 나타내기 위해 had started를 쓴 것은 옳지만, 문맥상 '이미'의 의미를 강조하거나 전후 관계를 명확히 할 때 어색함이 없는지 확인해야 합니다. 하지만 ⓔ번의 'had visited it' 등 다른 문장들이 모두 과거완료를 적절히 쓰고 있는 반면, ⓓ에서 'missed'와의 병렬 시제 관계에서 오류가 발생하기 쉽습니다. (실제 답안 근거 확인 시 ⓓ 혹은 다른 미세 오류 확인 필요)
sentences: Today I saw a doctor in the morning. ⓐ<u>I said to him that I had been sick for a week</u>. He said my kidney got worse. I should have seen him earlier. ⓑ<u>After I had visited the hospital, I went to Jenny’s house</u>. We planned to watch Doctor Stranger at 3:00 p.m. ⓒ<u>But her mom told me she had already left, so I had to run to the movie theater</u>. ⓓ<u>Doctor Strange had started when I arrived there, so I missed several scenes</u>. For dinner, I and Jenny went to a Vietnamese restaurant. ⓔI didn’t eat pho until I had visited it. It was amazing!
questions.reason_for_classification: 일기 형식의 글에서 과거 시점과 대비되는 과거완료 시제의 쓰임을 문장별로 판단하는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 22. 다음 중 주어진 시간을 참고해서 같은 날 일어났던 두 문장을 한 문장으로 만들 때 어법상 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: ⑤번에서 앤이 주스를 마신 것(2:00)이 선생님이 들어온 것(2:30)보다 먼저이므로, 선생님이 들어왔을 때 이미 마셨다는 의미의 과거완료(had already drunk)를 쓴 문장이 가장 적절합니다. ①은 시제가 반대로 되었고, ②는 stole을 p.p.형인 stolen으로 써야 하며, ④는 수동태 been spent가 부적절합니다.
options:
① (8:30 p.m.) My whole family went to bed.
(9:30 p.m.) I came back home.
→ When I had come back home, my whole family went to bed.

② (10:00 p.m.) Somebody stole my bike.
(11:30 p.m.) I was shocked to hear that.
→ I was shocked to hear that somebody had stole my bike.

③ (8:30 a.m.) My younger brother ate too much.
(9:30 a.m.) He had a stomachache.
→ My younger brother had had a stomachache after he ate too much.

④ (10:00 a.m.) She spent all of her money.
(11:30 a.m.) She couldn't buy the movie ticket.
→ She couldn't buy the movie ticket since she had been spent all of her money.

⑤ (2:00 p.m.) Ann drank her juice.
(2:30 p.m.) The teacher came into the classroom.
→ When the teacher came into the classroom, Ann had already drunk her juice.
questions.reason_for_classification: 제시된 시간을 분석하여 두 사건의 전후 관계를 과거완료 시제로 정확히 결합할 수 있는지 평가합니다.

questions.question: 23. 다음 그림과 어울리는 표현을 사용하여 문장을 완성하시오.
questions.explanation: 여자가 역에 도착한 시점(got)보다 기차가 떠난 것이 먼저 일어난 일이므로 'had already left'를 사용해야 합니다.
sentences: <조건>
ㆍ‘이미, 벌써’라는 의미의 단어를 사용할 것
ㆍ동사 leave를 활용할 것
ㆍ과거 완료시제를 사용할 것
정답: When the woman got to the train station, the train ____________ ____________ ____________.
questions.answer: had already left
questions.reason_for_classification: 조건에 맞춰 과거완료 시제와 특정 부사를 활용한 문장을 완성하는 서술형 문제입니다.

questions.question: 24. 다음 글의 어법상 빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 것은?
questions.explanation: 집에 온 시점(came)이 과거이므로, 사람들이 자러 간 것은 그보다 이전의 일임을 나타내기 위해 과거완료인 had gone이 적절합니다.
sentences: · When I came home, everybody ____________ to bed.
(내가 집에 왔을 때, 모든 사람들은 자러갔다.)
questions.reason_for_classification: 과거 시점과 대비되는 대과거를 나타내기 위해 과거완료 시제를 선택하는 기본 문제입니다.

questions.passage:
Cyril Boggis was an antique furniture dealer in London. ⓐ<u>He was known for buy good things at a low price and then selling them at a high price</u>. People asked him (가)<u>그가 어디서 그 가구를 얻었는지</u>, but he just said, “It’s a secret.
Mr. Boggis’ secret was simple. ⓑ<u>He went to small towns every Sunday and knocked on doors</u>. ⓒ<u>He told people that he was a furniture dealer</u>. People didn’t know how expensive their things were, so Mr. Boggis took advantage of them.
ⓓ<u>He was able buy things very cheaply</u>.
Now it was another Sunday, and Mr. Boggis was in a small town again. At a house he visited, he met two men. ⓔ<u>One was Rummins, the owner, and the other was his son Bert</u>.
“I buy old furniture. Do you have any?” asked Mr. Boggis.
“No, I don’t,” said Rummins.
“Can I just take a look?” asked Mr. Boggis.
“Sure. Please come in,” said Rummins.
Mr. Boggis first went to the kitchen, and there was nothing. He then moved to the living room. And there it was! A table which was a priceless piece of eighteenth-century English furniture. He was so excited that he almost fell over.
“What’s wrong?” Bert asked.
Mr. Boggis lied with a straight face.
“Oh, nothing. This table is a reproduction. It’s worth only a few pounds.”
questions.question: 25. 위 글의 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 어색한 것을 있는 대로 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ는 전치사 for 뒤에 동명사 buying이 와야 하며, ⓓ는 be able to 동사원형 구조이므로 to가 빠졌습니다. 따라서 ⓐ, ⓓ가 어색합니다.
questions.reason_for_classification: 동명사의 전치사 목적어 쓰임과 be able to 부정사 구문의 구조적 정확성을 묻는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 26. 위 글의 (가)를 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오.
questions.explanation: 사람들이 물어본 시점(asked)보다 가구를 얻은 것이 먼저이므로 과거완료(had gotten)를 사용하며, 간접의문문 어순(의문사+주어+동사)에 맞춰 'where he had gotten the furniture'로 영작합니다.
sentences: <조건>
과거완료를 사용할 것
단어 ‘get’을 활용할 것
questions.answer: where he had gotten the furniture
questions.reason_for_classification: 간접의문문과 과거완료 시제를 결합하여 문맥에 맞는 문장을 생성하는 서술형 문제입니다.

questions.question: 27. 주어진 우리말에 맞게 영작하시오. [3점]
questions.explanation: 영화관에 도착한(arrived) 것보다 영화가 시작된 것이 먼저이므로 과거완료 시제를 사용하여 'When I arrived at the movie theater, the movie had already started.'로 영작합니다.
sentences: 내가 영화관에 도착했을 때, 영화는 이미 시작되었다.
* 과거완료 시제 활용할 것
questions.answer: When I arrived at the movie theater, the movie had already started.
questions.reason_for_classification: 과거완료 시제를 사용하여 두 사건의 전후 관계를 명확히 표현하는 영작 문제입니다.

questions.question: 28. 주어진 우리말에 맞게 영작하시오. [2점]
questions.explanation: 생각한 시점보다 책을 둔 시점이 더 이전이므로 과거완료를 사용해 'I thought (that) I had left the book on her desk'라고 씁니다.
sentences: (내가 그 책을 그녀의 책상에 두었었다고 생각했는데), but it is not here. It’s gone.
questions.answer: I thought I had left the book on her desk
questions.reason_for_classification: 주절의 과거 시제보다 앞선 시점을 과거완료로 표현하는 영작 능력을 평가합니다.

questions.passage:
<Biography of Hong Beomdo>
Hong Beomdo __(가)__ in 1868 in Pyeongyang. He was originally a hunter during the Joseon Dynasty. In 1907, Japan made hunters turn in their hunting guns so that they __(나)__ weaken the Korean resistance. In 1910, he moved to Gando, China and established the Korean Independence Army. Hong and his soldiers __(다)__ successfully attacked the Japanese troops for 10 years when Korea was under Japanese rule. In 1920, his army won a great victory in the battle of Bongodong. In the same year, he again carried out an attack against Japanese troops in the battle of Cheongsanri.
questions.question: 29. 빈칸 (가)~(다)에 들어갈 말이 순서대로 연결된 것은? [4.1점]
questions.explanation: (가)는 출생한 과거 사실이므로 was born, (나)는 1907년 시점의 목적을 나타내므로 조동사 can의 과거형 could, (다)는 과거 기준 시점 이전부터 10년 동안의 행동을 나타내므로 과거완료 had가 적절합니다.
questions.reason_for_classification: 역사적 사실 기술을 위한 단순 과거 시제와 대과거를 나타내는 과거완료 시제의 적절한 사용을 묻는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 30. 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
questions.explanation: ④번에서 내가 장소를 방문했던 것(had visited)이 나를 기쁘게 만든(made) 것보다 이전의 일이므로 과거완료를 쓴 것이 어법상 옳습니다. ①은 has fixed를 had fixed로, ⑤는 lost를 had lost로 고쳐야 합니다.
options: ① He found that somebody has fixed his car.
② I am having lunch when he had called me.
③ I arrived early before I had bought a ticket.
④ The fact that I had visited the place made me happy.
⑤ He hadn't been able to open the door because he lost his key.
questions.reason_for_classification: 여러 문장 중에서 과거완료와 다른 시제들과의 조응이 올바른 것을 골라내는 문제입니다.

questions.question: 31. 시간 전후 시제를 고려하여 다음 두 개의 문장을 하나의 문장으로 만드시오.
questions.explanation: 그가 은행에 간 것이 내가 사무실에 들른 것보다 먼저이므로, 과거완료를 사용하여 'When I dropped by his office, he had gone to the bank.'로 결합합니다.
sentences: He went to the bank. After that, I dropped by his office.
questions.answer: When I dropped by his office, he had gone to the bank
questions.reason_for_classification: 두 과거 문장의 순서를 파악하여 한 문장으로 합칠 때 과거완료 시제를 올바르게 적용하는 능력을 평가합니다.

questions.question: 32. 위 대화의 빈 칸 (A)에 들어갈 Ms. Kim의 말을 주어진 조건에 맞게 완성하시오.
questions.explanation: 조건에 맞춰 '당신들이 창가에 그림을 걸어둔 것을 보았다'는 의미로 현재완료를 포함한 8단어 문장을 만들면 'I saw you have hung some pictures by the windows' 등이 가능합니다. (지각동사 목적격 보어 구문 혹은 명사절 접속사절 활용)
sentences: <조건>
‘have’ ‘hang’ 동사를 꼭 활용하시오. (형태변형 가능)
총 8단어로 쓰시오.
the, some, by를 꼭 쓰시오.
questions.answer: you have hung some pictures by the windows
questions.reason_for_classification: 주어진 단어와 조건을 모두 충족하면서 문법적으로 옳은 현재완료 문장을 구성하는 서술형 문제입니다.

questions.question: 33. 보기 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 밑줄 친 부분이 어법상 어색한 것끼리 짝지어진 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ는 상태를 나타내는 동사 know이므로 대과거 상황에서는 had known이 적절할 수 있으나 문맥에 따라 knew로 충분합니다. 하지만 ⓔ에서 열쇠를 차에 두고 온 것이 화가 난 시점(got angry)보다 이전이므로 have left를 had left로 고쳐야 하는 오류가 명확합니다. ⓒ 또한 휴대폰을 잃어버린 것이 찾은 것보다 먼저이므로 had lost가 되어야 합니다. 종합하면 ⓐ, ⓒ, ⓔ 등이 어색한 후보가 됩니다.
sentences: ⓐ I <u>had known</u> Seoul well because I went there many times.
ⓑ We found that we <u>had left</u> our ticket at home.

questions.explanation: 옳은 문장은 1, 2, 5, 7번 총 4개이다. 3번은 see(지각동사)의 수동태 뒤에 to leave, 4번은 believed to be flat, 6번은 get the machine fixed, 8번은 bananas가 되어야 한다.
sentences: The number 18 still considered unlucky.
I heard that Peter had his car stolen last night.
Mr. Kim was seen leave without saying anything.
The world was believed to flat until the 15th century.
We were warned not to play with balls in the classroom.
I wanted to get the machine to fix as soon as possible.
It was my grandparents that I visited during summer vacation.
Efforts are being made to enable even future generations to enjoy banana's.
questions.reason_for_classification: 지각/사역동사의 수동태, 사물 목적어와 과거분사의 관계(5형식), 강조 구문 등 고난도 문법 사항들을 통합적으로 판별하는 문제이다.

questions.passage: We finally found a teen volunteer project on the Internet. The project was doing a wall painting in our neighborhood. We applied for it, and two weeks later, our club ① <u>got rejected</u>! The day of the project finally came. We ② <u>were scheduled</u> to meet at the painting site at 9 a.m. The wall was in very poor ③ <u>condition</u>. There were strange writings and drawings in some parts. Other parts had old posters on them. We removed the posters first and painted over the writings and drawings with white paint. We ④ <u>were told</u> to paint anything we wanted. So we decided to paint something cute ⑤ <u>given</u> the fact that the elementary school was nearby.
questions.question: 21. 밑줄 친 부분이 문맥상 어울리지 않는 것은?
questions.explanation: 맥락상 프로젝트 당일이 찾아오고 작업을 진행했으므로, 2주 뒤에 클럽이 거절당했다(got rejected)는 내용은 흐름에 맞지 않으며 '선발되었다(were selected)'가 적절하다.

questions.question: 22. 어법상 맞는 문장은?
questions.explanation: ⑤ 'The headline reads, ~'에서 read는 '~라고 적혀 있다'는 의미의 능동태로 쓰일 수 있다. ①은 be delivered, ②는 has been offered a scholarship(to 삭제), ③은 be used, ④는 is being built가 되어야 한다.
options: ① Will our pizza deliver in 10 minutes?
② She has been offered to a scholarship.
③ A robot may use to assemble parts in the factory.
④ A new hospital for children is building near city hall.
⑤ The headline reads, "UFO Seen in the Korean Sky."
questions.reason_for_classification: 특정 동사(read)의 독특한 용법과 조동사/진행형 수동태의 올바른 구성을 묻는 문제이다.

questions.question: 23. 어법상 옳은 문장을 있는 대로 고른 것의 개수는?
questions.explanation: 옳은 문장은 2, 3, 4, 7, 9, 10번으로 총 6개이다. 1번은 fed up with, 5번은 are being updated, 6번은 hotels (which are) located, 8번은 common for(of가 아님)가 되어야 한다.
sentences: I'm really fed up by this constant rain.
I can't remember the person I lent my umbrella to.
The country is well-known for its unique food culture.
It is always pleasant to be wanted by other people.
The websites are updating every month by the engineers.
The hotels located along the river offer astounding views.
There is a key in the doll's hand, which can open the box.
It's common of less-experienced drivers to be out of their lane.
These old scissors my mom bought a few years ago still cut well.
Almost one-fifth of the population around the world doesn't have access to safe water.
questions.reason_for_classification: 수동태의 전치사, 진행형 수동태, 분사 수식, 의미상 주어의 전치사(of/for) 등 세밀한 문법 요소를 변별하는 문제이다.

questions.passage:
Here in America, in most states, people pay a tax when they buy goods. It ⓐ<u>called</u> a sales tax. Sales tax rates ⓑ<u>differ by</u> state. They range from less than one percent to more than ten percent. So when you buy goods in America, you usually need to pay more than the price on the tag.
In America, people often greet each other by ⓒ<u>waving</u>. Waving to an older person is not ⓓ<u>regarded</u> as rude. When you come to America, you may feel uncomfortable about it at first, but why don't you try it? You can wave to and smile at an elderly man ⓔ<u>walked</u> on the street. He may wave back.
questions.question: 24. 윗글의 밑줄친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 알맞은 것의 개수는?
questions.explanation: ⓑ differ by, ⓒ waving, ⓓ regarded 3개가 옳다. ⓐ는 'It is called', ⓔ는 'walking'으로 수식해야 한다.
questions.reason_for_classification: 수동태(be called, be regarded)와 분사의 능동/수동 수식(walking) 등을 문맥 안에서 변별하는 문제이다.

questions.question: 25. 주어진 영어 단어와 문장 부호만을 변형없이 모두 배열하여 영작할 때 어법상 옳은 것은? (대소문자 구분 없음)
questions.explanation: ④ 'It is amazing that people built such a huge stone structure.'는 가주어-진행구조가 어법상 가장 완벽하다. ①은 is thought to be, ②는 what was surprising was watching, ③은 that animals can use tools is interesting, ⑤는 It is true that...이 적절하다.
options: ① project / the / thought / is / be / idea / good / a / .
② was / what / surprising / the / fireworks / to / watch /.
③ is / that / interesting / which / some / animals / use / can / tools / .
④ is / it / amazing / people / that / huge / built / a / such / stone / structure / .
⑤ true / is / it / which / King Sejong / very / was / creative.
questions.reason_for_classification: 가주어 it과 진주어 that절을 활용한 문장 구조를 이해하고 있는지를 묻는 문제이다.

questions.question: 26. <보기>의 단어가 빈칸에 들어갈 수 없는 문장은?
questions.explanation: ⑤ 'be satisfied with'가 적절한 표현이므로 <보기>의 as, in, on, to는 들어갈 수 없다. ① as, ② on, ③ to, ④ in이 각각 적절하다.
options: ① Mount Everest, known _____ the world's highest peak, always encourages climbers around the world to get to the top of it.
② The novel is based ____ the author's experiences, and many of the episodes make readers sad.
③ He was accustomed _____ starting his day before sunrise and enjoyed the quietness of the morning.
④ Sally has been involved _____ volunteer work at the animal shelter for five years.
⑤ Are you satisfied _____ your progress, or do you think there is more to improve?
sentences: <보기>
as in on to
questions.reason_for_classification: 수동태 구문에서 'by' 이외의 전치사를 사용하는 관용적인 표현(be known as, be based on 등)을 묻는 문제이다.

questions.question: 27. 어법상 옳은 문장은?
questions.explanation: ② 'It is said that + 주어 + 동사' 구문에서 'Mr. Kim has been ~' 시제 일치와 함께 올바르게 쓰였다. ①은 that절 내 시제 확인(과거 일이면 had/was), ③은 to be wearing, ④는 Expected to release(가주어 it 사용 권장), ⑤는 to have ended가 되어야 한다.
options: ① It was believed that the ancient Chinese have amazing knowledge of mathematics.
② It is said that Mr. Kim has been a skilled engineer since he was young.
③ The missing boy is said to wearing a yellow shirt and white pants.
④ Samsung is expected that it will release its latest product soon.
⑤ The factory strike is reported to end last month.
questions.reason_for_classification: 명사절(that절) 수동태 구문의 전환 및 완료 부정사, 시제 일치 등의 복합 문법을 다룬다.

questions.passage: Have you ever been on an airplane? Wasn’t it exciting to look out the window and see the world below? Surprisingly, there was a small hole in your window. Airplane windows are made up Ⓐ _______ three panes. There is a hole in the middle pane. It balances the air pressure. Without this little hole, airplane windows might break in an emergency. The hole also prevents the window Ⓑ _________ fogging up so that you can enjoy that fantastic view.
questions.question: 28. 위 글의 Ⓐ 와 Ⓑ에 들어갈 알맞은 전치사는?
questions.explanation: Ⓐ 'be made up of' (~로 구성되다), Ⓑ 'prevent A from B' (A가 B하는 것을 막다)가 적절하다.

questions.passage: The origin of the first hamburger is not clear. However, (A)<u>many people believe that the hamburger was invented in a small town in Texas</u>, USA, sometime between 1885 and 1904. A cook placed a Hamburg-style steak between two slices of bread, and people started to call such food a hamburger.
questions.question: 29. 위 글의 (A)를 같은 뜻을 가진 (B)로 바꿔 쓸 때 필요하지 않은 것은? (단, 모든 빈칸에 한 단어씩 쓸 것)
questions.explanation: (A) 'Many people believe that ~'을 가주어 it 수동태 구문으로 바꾸면 'It is believed that the hamburger was invented in a small town in Texas.'가 된다. 이 과정에서 원문의 주어인 'people'은 불필요하게 된다.
sentences: (A) many people believe that the hamburger was invented in a small town in Texas
questions.reason_for_classification: 능동태의 명사절 목적어를 수동태(가주어 it)로 전환하는 과정을 묻는 문제이다.

questions.question: 30. 밑줄 친 부분이 어법상 옳은 것은?
questions.explanation: ③ 'It was reported that ~' 구문에서 과거 시제 was planning은 문맥과 문법상 적절하다. ①은 uses -> used (과거 사건), ②는 be imposed -> have imposed(능동) 또는 be -> have been, ④는 have seen -> have been seen, ⑤는 is -> was가 적절하다.
options: ① It is alleged that the police officers uses excessive force during the arrest.
② The government had been reported to be imposed a tax on fur products.
③ It was reported that the company was planning to expand into new markets.
④ The Great Wall of China was believed to have seen from space.
⑤ It was believed that the Titanic is unsinkable.
questions.reason_for_classification: 가주어 수동태 구문에서의 시제 일치 및 완료 수동 부정사(to have been p.p.) 등 정교한 문법 구사 능력을 묻는다.

questions.question: 31. 밑줄 친 부분이 어법상 틀린 것은?
questions.explanation: ② 'long ago'는 명백한 과거 시점이므로 현재 시제인 'owns'가 아니라 과거 시제 'owned'를 써야 한다.
options: ① I heard that Mark goes jogging every morning.
② It is said that the old man owns a lot of land here long ago
③ My history teacher said that Hong Kong was returned to China in 1997.
④ It is thought that ChatGPT doesn't provide correct answers to every question.
⑤ It is said that Leonardo da Vinci was the first person to think of the idea of an airplane.
questions.reason_for_classification: 문장 내의 부사구(long ago)를 통해 적절한 시제를 결정할 수 있는지 확인하는 문제이다.

questions.passage:
Many of the volcanoes on Earth are located along the Ring of Fire that circles the Pacific Ocean. The ring is about 40,000 kilometers long, and it is home to around 75% of the world's active volcanoes. Indonesia alone has over 120 active volcanoes ⓐ<u>since the country lies on the Ring of Fire.</u> ⓑ<u>This ring is also the area where most of the world's earthquakes occur</u>.
You may think volcanoes can be found only on Earth. However, they have been discovered on other planets, too, such as Mars and Jupiter. In fact, "Olympus Mons" on Mars is the largest known volcano in the solar system. Its volume is about 100 times greater than that of Mauna Loa, the largest volcano on Earth.
ⓒ<u>Being very powerful and dangerous, volcanoes do harm to people in many ways</u>. Sometimes people get hurt, or they may lose their houses. ⓓ<u>Crops may destroy, and air traffic can threaten</u>. ⓔ<u>Volcanoes can also have serious effects on world weather</u>. A volcanic eruption shoots lots of ash and dust into the air, preventing some of the sunlight from reaching Earth and thus disturbing usual weather patterns.
questions.question: 32. 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓓ 농작물(Crops)은 파괴되는 대상이고, 항공 교통(air traffic)은 위협받는 대상이므로 조동사 수동태인 'may be destroyed', 'can be threatened'로 써야 옳다.
questions.reason_for_classification: 조동사가 포함된 문장에서 주어와 동사의 수동 관계를 파악하여 '조동사 + be + p.p.' 형태를 적용하는 문제이다.

questions.question: 33. 어법상 알맞게 쓰인 것은?
questions.explanation: ①, ③번 문장이 옳다. (질문에는 하나만 고르게 되어 있으므로 가장 적절한 것을 골라야 함) ①은 조동사(should) 수동태가 올바르고, ③도 (must be finished) 올바르다. ②는 be bought, ④는 will not be, ⑤는 should be reviewed가 되어야 한다. (정답을 ③으로 가정함)
options: ➀ This book should be read by everyone.
➁ Tickets for the opera can bought online.
➂ The project must be finished by tomorrow.
➃ The room will not been cleaned until 2 p.m.
➄ The report should reviewed by the manager.
questions.reason_for_classification: 조동사와 결합한 수동태의 기본 형태(조동사+be+p.p.)를 숙지하고 있는지 묻는 기초 문제이다.

questions.passage:
Robots are making things faster and easier. (a) <u>They can help us anywhere — in our homes, on roads, or in disaster areas</u>.
Home Helper Robot
(b) <u>This robot helps your family throughout the day</u>. Cooking and cleaning would be easier if you had one. (c) <u>It also talks with family members and can sense emotions</u>.
Self-Driving Car
A self-driving car doesn’t need a driver. With cameras, sensors, and software, (d) <u>it can navigate roads for you so that you can relax and enjoy the ride</u>.
Robot Swarm
A robot swarm is a large group of robots that can communicate with one another, like ants or bees. (e) <u>They can use in a variety of places, including farms or building sites</u>. They work on tasks and find solutions as a group.
questions.question: 34. (a)-(e)중 어법상 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: (e)의 'They'는 로봇 군집(robot swarm)을 의미하며, 로봇이 장소에서 '사용되는' 것이므로 수동태인 'They can be used'가 적절하다.
questions.reason_for_classification: 조동사 뒤에 수동태(be+p.p.)가 필요한 문맥임을 파악하는 문제이다.

questions.question: 35. 주어진 우리말 의미의 영어 문장을 완성할 때 빈 칸에 들어갈 단어로 알맞게 짝지어진 것은?
questions.explanation: 첫 번째 문장은 'can be done'(수동태), 두 번째 문장은 선행사를 포함한 관계대명사 'what', 세 번째 문장은 '~에 관한 조언'에서 'on'이 적절하다.
sentences: 오늘 할 수 있는 일을 내일로 미루지 마라.
Don't put ( ) till tomorrow ( ) can be (ⓐ) today.
목적은 삶에 의미를 부여하는 것이다.
Purpose is (ⓑ) gives life a ( ).
우리는 마케팅에 있어 우리에게 조언을 해줄 전문가가 필요하다.
We need an expert ( ) can ( ) ( ) (ⓒ) marketing.
questions.reason_for_classification: 수동태, 관계대명사 what, 그리고 특정 전치사의 쓰임 등 여러 어법 요소를 복합적으로 질문하고 있다.

questions.question: 36. 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영어로 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: 조건에 따라 주어 'Seventy percent of the homework', 조동사 포함 수동태 'must be completed', 행위자 'by the student'를 조합하면 11단어의 문장이 완성된다.
sentences: 그 숙제의 70 퍼센트가 그 학생에 의해 완료되어야만 한다.
<조건>
・조동사를 포함한 수동태를 사용할 것
・숫자는 영어로 쓸 것
・the를 2번 포함하여 11단어의 완전한 문장으로 쓸 것
questions.answer: Seventy percent of the homework must be completed by the student
questions.reason_for_classification: 부분 표현의 주어 수 일치와 조동사 수동태를 활용하여 조건에 맞게 영작하는 고난도 서술형 문제이다.

questions.passage:

questions.question: 37. 다음중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: ㉤에서 'must stopped'는 '조동사 + be + p.p.' 형태인 'must be stopped'가 되어야 수동의 의미를 완성할 수 있다.
questions.reason_for_classification: 조동사가 포함된 문장에서 수동태의 동사원형 be가 생략되었음을 지적하는 문제이다.

questions.question: 38. 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영어로 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: (1) 'must be delivered', (2) 'can be planted'를 사용하여 수동태 문장을 완성한다.
sentences: (1) 이 편지는 내일까지 배달돼야만 한다.
(2) 이 나무들은 우리에 의해서 심어질 수 있다.
<조건>
• (1), (2) 모두 의미에 맞는 조동사를 포함할 것.
• (1), (2) 모두 수동태의 형태를 포함할 것.
questions.answer: (1) This letter must be delivered by tomorrow. (2) These trees can be planted by us.
questions.reason_for_classification: 문맥에 맞는 조동사를 선택하고 수동태 구문(be+p.p.)을 정확히 작성할 수 있는지 묻는 서술형 문제이다.

questions.question: 39. (가)의 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영어로 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: 주어 'Honey from ancient Egypt', 조동사 포함 수동태 'can be eaten', 시간 부사 'today'를 연결하여 8단어를 만든다.
sentences: <조건>

questions.reason_for_classification: 단어 수 제한이라는 조건 하에서 조동사가 포함된 수동태 문장을 정확하게 영작하는 능력을 평가한다.

English has often borrowed words from other cultures or languages. Here are some examples with interesting stories.
shampoo
(A) The word shampoo comes from the Hindi word chāmpo, which means "to press." In India, the word ⓐ<u>used</u> for a head massage. (B) The meaning of the word shampoo changed a few times after it first entered English around 1762. (C) In the 19th century, shampoo got its present meaning of "washing the hair." (D) Shortly after that, the word began to be also used for a special soap for the hair. (E)
robot
The word robot comes from the play R.U.R., which ⓑ<u>wrote</u> in 1920 by a Czech writer Karel Čapek. In the play, robots are machines that ⓒ<u>look</u> humans. They are designed to work for humans and ⓓ<u>are produced</u> in a factory.
It is interesting that the idea of using the word robot didn't come from Karel Čapek himself. He originally called the machines in his play labori from the Latin word for "work." However, his brother suggested roboti, which means "slave workers" in Czech. Karel Čapek liked the idea and decided to use the word roboti. In 1938, the play ⓔ<u>made into</u> a science fiction show on television in Britain.

Where have all the honey bees gone? It is really hard to see them these days. The bees are disappearing! ① <u>About 1/3 of the bee population die every year</u>. ② <u>This is bad news for bees, but it's very worse news for people</u>.
Bees are very helpful to humans. First, bees give us honey. Honey is a truly wonderful food. ③ <u>It is good for our health and tastes great</u>. Honey can last almost forever. questions.question: 8. 윗글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?
questions.explanation: ④는 문맥상 코끼리가 아닌 다른 대상에 의해 수행되는 행동을 나타내야 하나, 해당 지문의 ④번 보기는 'anyone who found something interesting would give the day off'로 되어 있어 'give'가 아닌 'be given'이 되어야 함. (제시된 텍스트 중 하단의 Camp Green Lake 지문 8번 문제와 연결됨)
questions.reason_for_classification: 수동태 구문의 적절한 사용 여부(누가 누구에게 무엇을 주는지)를 묻는 문제임.

questions.question: 9. 다음 대화의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓓ 'It said that'은 뒤에 나오는 내용을 '말하다/보도하다'의 의미로 쓰일 때 가주어-진행 구문이나 수동태 'It is said that' (~라고들 한다)으로 쓰이는 것이 일반적임.
sentences: W: Hey, Mark, do you know about Father Lee Taeseok?
M: Yeah, ⓐ<u>I’ve heard</u> of him. Why?
W: Take a look at this article. He is going to ⓑ<u>be included</u> in the social studies textbook in South Sudan.
M: Wow, that’s great.
W: Yeah, he helped the children ⓒ<u>by building</u> a clinic and a school. It ⓓ<u>said</u> that such stories will be included in the textbook.
M: It is good ⓔ<u>to hear</u> that students will learn about such a great person.
questions.reason_for_classification: 전달 동사 및 수동태 구문의 적절한 사용법을 묻는 문제임.

questions.question: 10. (가)~(라)에 들어갈 알맞은 단어를 바르게 짝지은 것은?
questions.explanation: (가) be동사 뒤 형용사 different, (나) 명사 수식 형용사 quick, (다) 동사 수식 부사 quickly, (라) it is (not) easy to-부정사 구조임.
sentences: • We are (가)__________ from each other.
• He took a (나)________ shower.
• The news spread the (다)__________ throughout the town.
• A: The cookies look very delicious.
B: Yeah. It is not (라)__________ to eat just one.

questions.question: 11. 밑줄 친 단어의 성격이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: ① deadly, ② costly, ③ likely, ④ daily는 모두 -ly 형태의 형용사이나, ⑤ greedily는 부사임.
options: ① Cancer is still one of the most deadly diseases.
② Such a database would be highly costly to set up.
③ The younger animals are less likely to survive in the wild.
④ If you are on a diet, you must record your daily weight.
⑤ Upon seeing piles of money, his eyes shone so greedily.
questions.reason_for_classification: -ly로 끝나는 단어들 중 형용사와 부사를 구별하는 문제임.

questions.question: 12. 다음 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ에 들어갈 단어로 어법상 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓑ 'early'는 부사로 쓰여 문맥상 '5분 일찍 왔다'는 뜻이 적절함. ⓐ는 early/late, ⓒ는 suddenly, ⓓ는 friendly(형용사이나 보어 자리가 아니면 어색) 혹은 kindly, ⓔ는 careful(보어)이 되어야 함.
sentences: ◦ I always get up ____ⓐ___
◦ The bus came five minutes ____ⓑ____
◦ The bus broke down ____ⓒ____ on the way here.
◦ She speaks very _____ⓓ_____ when she talks to him.
◦ When you cross the street, you have to be _____ⓔ_____
questions.reason_for_classification: 형용사와 부사의 올바른 문장 내 쓰임을 구별하는 문제임.

questions.question: 13. 다음 대화의 ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 어법상 옳은 것을 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓔ 'Despite + 명사구'는 옳음. ⓐ는 보어 자리이므로 adorable(형용사), ⓑ는 look + 형용사(cold)로 보이나 전체 문장 중 옳은 것을 고르는 것임. ⓓ는 배수사 비교 구문 'twice as cold as'가 되어야 함. (제시된 답안 근거하여 ⓑ, ⓔ가 가장 적절)
sentences: Billy: Look at the baby penguins on TV. ⓐ<u>They’re so adorably</u>.
Suji: Yes, ⓑ<u>but they look very cold out there</u>.
Billy: Yeah, ⓒ<u>the South Pole is the more cold place on Earth</u>.
Suji: I’m curious about the temperature.
Billy: The average temperature is about –58℃ in July and –26℃ in December.
Suji: Oh, ⓟ<u>July is about twice as cold December there</u>. Interesting!
Billy: Yes. ⓔ<u>Despite the cold weather there, it doesn’t snow much</u>.
Suji: That’s interesting, too!
questions.reason_for_classification: 감각동사 뒤 형용사 보어 사용과 전치사 despite의 쓰임을 묻는 문제임.

questions.question: 14. 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 어법상 쓰임이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: ① quick, ② lovely, ③ close, ⑤ deadly는 명사를 수식하거나 보어로 쓰인 형용사이나, ④ globally는 형용사 serious를 수식하는 부사임.
options: ① Ann: Are you ready to go out? / Jenny: I'll take a quick shower.
② Kevin: The cookies look very delicious. / Chris: Yeah, and the box is so lovely, too.
③ Mina: I lost in the game just by one point. / Jack: That was really close.
④ Linda: Have you ever heard of Garbage Island? / Minho: Yes, I have. That's a globally serious problem.
⑤ Tom: People are wearing masks to protect themselves from a virus. / Mike: Yeah, it can lead to a deadly disease.
questions.reason_for_classification: 문장 내에서 형용사와 부사의 수식 역할을 구분하는 문제임.

questions.passage:
G: Hi, Jinsu! We're in the same class again!
B: Yeah! It's good to see you, Sora. How have you been?
G: I've been great. How about you?

questions.question: 15. 위 대화의 밑줄 친 (A)와 쓰임이 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: (A) pretty는 형용사 busy를 수식하는 '꽤/매우'라는 의미의 부사임. ①, ②, ③, ④의 밑줄 친 단어들도 모두 부사이나, ⑤ enough는 명사 money를 앞에서 수식하는 형용사임.
options: ① Children grow up so fast these days.
② I stayed up late to study for an exam.
③ She jumped high to reach the bookshelf.
④ Susan and Jinsu live close to each other.
⑤ I have enough money to buy a new bicycle.
questions.reason_for_classification: 부사와 형용사의 역할을 구별하는 문제임.

questions.question: 16. 다음 글의 ⓐ~ⓖ 중 어법상 적절한 것만을 있는 대로 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ 부사(운 좋게도), ⓑ 부사(완벽하게), ⓓ 부사(쉽게), ⓔ 형용사(즉각적인)는 각각 적절한 자리에 쓰임. ⓒ는 명사 mindset을 수식해야 하므로 careful, ⓕ는 명사 exam을 수식해야 하므로 actual, ⓖ는 명사 preparation을 수식해야 하므로 careful이 되어야 함.
sentences: ⓐ<u>Luckily</u>, I was ⓑ<u>completely</u> prepared for the exam with a ⓒ<u>carefully</u> mindset.
The questions were challenging a bit, but I was able to answer them ⓓ<u>easily</u> thanks to my ⓔ<u>immediate</u> recall of the things I studied.
The ⓕ<u>actually</u> exam turned out to be easier than I expected, so I was very happy.
Eventually, my ⓖ<u>carefully</u> preparation made me stay calm during the test, and I was able to take the exam with confidence.
questions.reason_for_classification: 형용사와 부사의 올바른 수식 관계를 문맥 내에서 파악하는 문제임.

questions.question: 17. 다음 그림과 일치하도록 빈칸 (A),(B)에 들어갈 말을 옳게 나열한 것은?
questions.explanation: 나머지 전체를 가리킬 때는 the others를 쓰고, 둘 중 나머지 하나를 가리킬 때는 the other를 씀. (그림 내용상 하나는 사과, 나머지는 오렌지 등일 경우)

questions.question: 18. 다음 문장의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
questions.explanation: '몇몇은 ~하고, 다른 이들은 ~하다'는 의미의 짝꿍 표현인 'Some ~, and others ...'를 완성하는 문제임.
sentences: "__________ are cooking, and others are eating."
questions.reason_for_classification: 부정대명사 some과 others의 상관 관계를 묻는 기초 문법 문제임.

questions.question: 19. 다음 대화의 (A)~(C) 각 네모 안에서 어법 상 적절한 것을 골라 짝지은 것은?
questions.explanation: (A) be동사 뒤 보어인 terrible(형용사), (B) 감정을 나타내는 anxious(형용사), (C) 나머지 한 팀이나 다른 멤버들을 가리키므로 the other가 적절함.
sentences: Kathy: Are you ready for our soccer game today?
Sam: Kathy, didn’t you see the news?
Kathy: No, I didn’t. What did it say?
Sam: The yellow dust is (A) (terrible / extremely) today.
Kathy: Oh, no. Yellow dust can cause many health problems.
Sam: Yeah, I'm (B) (anxious / expecting) about our soccer game.
Kathy: We can play next time.
Sam: You’re right. I’ll text (C) (another / the other) team members right now.
Kathy: Great idea.
questions.reason_for_classification: 형용사 보어의 쓰임과 부정대명사/형용사 the other의 용법을 묻는 문제임.

questions.question: 20. 밑줄 친 ㉠~㉤ 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: ㉤은 부대상황의 with 분사구문 'with + 명사 + 분사' 구조에서 1초가 '남은' 상태이므로 left(과거분사)가 와야 함.

questions.question: 22. ㉠~㉤ 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?

questions.question: 23. 어법상 어색한 문장은?
questions.explanation: ③ 'A number of + 복수명사'는 '많은 ~'라는 뜻으로 복수 취급하므로 동사는 were가 되어야 함. 반면 ⑤ 'The number of ~'는 '~의 수'라는 뜻으로 단수 취급함.

questions.question: 25. 밑줄 친 ⓐ와 ⓑ에 들어갈 말이 바르게 연결된 것은?
questions.explanation: 24번과 동일한 지문의 문제로, ⓐ those, ⓑ as well이 정답임.

questions.question: 26. 빈칸에 'is' 또는 'was'가 들어갈 수 없는 것은?
questions.explanation: ③ 'A large number of + 복수명사'는 복수 취급하므로 복수 동사(are/were)가 와야 함.
options: ① The United States _____ famous for landmarks and national parks, such as the Statue of Liberty and the Grand Canyon.
② Access to quality education _____ a basic human right that all societies try to achieve.
③ A large number of purchased items _____ recalled because of safety issues or defects.
④ Linguistics _____ the subject that studies languages and their structure and grammar.
⑤ What he appreciates most _____ the excellent customer service of the hotel.
questions.reason_for_classification: 부분 표현과 특정 명사(학문명, 국가명)의 단/복수 일치를 묻는 문제임.

questions.question: 27. 밑줄 친 부분이 어법상 옳은 것은?
questions.explanation: ⑤ Payments(주어) ... will be charged(동사)는 적절한 구조임. ① Learning(동명사 주어)은 단수 취급(is), ② An article(주어)은 단수 취급(was), ③ Diabetes(학문/병명)는 단수 취급(is), ④ The government's program(주어)은 단수 취급(is).
options: ① Learning foreign languages <u>are</u> sometimes very challenging.
② An article on health supplements reported in newspapers <u>were</u> not true.
③ Diabetes <u>are</u> one of the serious diseases that cause health complications.
④ The government's program to reduce tuition fees <u>are</u> intended for poor students.
⑤ Payments for Internet usage <u>that</u> are not received will be charged to the next month's bill.
questions.reason_for_classification: 동명사 주어, 구/절의 수식을 받는 주어, 특정 단어의 단/복수 수 일치를 종합적으로 묻는 문제임.

This skill is getting more important these days as stories can spread very fast, and anyone can make ⓔ<u>a website full of false information</u>.
questions.question: 28. 윗글의 ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓓ의 주어는 'many teenagers(복수)'이므로 동사는 are learning이 되어야 함.

questions.question: 29. 윗글의 ⓐ-ⓔ중, 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?

questions.question: 30. 다음 ⓐ~ⓓ 문장 중 어법상 옳지 않은 문장 2개의 기호를 쓰고, 잘못된 부분을 바르게 고치시오.
questions.explanation: ⓐ Everything은 단수 취급하므로 say를 says로 고쳐야 함. ⓓ 절(What you draw)과 절(how you draw it)이 and로 연결되어 서로 다른 내용을 나타내므로 복수 취급하여 is를 are로 고침.
sentences: <조건>
· 한 문장에 어법상 잘못된 부분은 한 단어임
· 전체 문장이 아닌 잘못된 부분을 찾아 수정전에 쓰고 바르게 수정한 부분을 수정후에 작성할 것

ⓒ The things that you draw are not much different.
ⓓ What you draw and how you draw it is related to your personality.
questions.answer: (1) ⓐ, say, says / (2) ⓓ, is, are
questions.reason_for_classification: 부정대명사 Everything과 병렬된 명사절 주어의 복잡한 수 일치를 묻는 서술형 문제임.

questions.question: 31. 다음 ⓐ ~ ⓔ 문장 중 어법상 옳은 것의 개수는?
questions.explanation: ⓑ만 옳음(1개). ⓐ는 a hole(선행사)이 '목격된' 것이므로 that has been seen, ⓒ는 everywhere 앞에 복수 유도 부사구 There are가 있으므로 holes, ⓓ는 '숨겨져 있다'는 수동의 의미로 well hidden, ⓔ는 make + 목적어 + 형용사 보어 구조로 safe가 되어야 함.

questions.reason_for_classification: 수동태, 수 일치, 5형식 형용사 보어 등 다양한 기초 문법의 오류를 찾아내는 종합 문제임.

questions.question: 32. 어법상 올바른 문장의 개수는?
questions.explanation: 'Half of the children have...' 한 문장만 옳음. 첫 번째 문장은 milk가 불가산이므로 was, 두 번째는 to be sold, 네 번째는 be not -> not be, 다섯 번째는 people이 복수이므로 spend.
sentences: • About two-thirds of the milk were spilled.

• Half of the children have brothers or sisters.

questions.question: 33. 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영어로 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: 'Three-fifths of the money'는 단수 취급하므로 동사는 was spent를 사용함.
sentences: 그 돈의 5분의 3이 책들에 소비됐다.
<조건>

questions.answer: Three-fifths of the money was spent on books.
questions.reason_for_classification: 분수 표현의 영어 표기법과 그에 따른 수 일치를 적용하는 영작 문제임.

questions.question: 34. 어법상 올바른 문장의 개수는?
questions.explanation: 옳은 문장은 'Either you or Brain has...', 'Each year the number...', 'Around half of...', 'Almost 90 percent...' 4개임. 'A number of people'은 복수이므로 want, 'The members'는 복수이므로 have.

• The members in my team has great teamwork.

questions.question: 35. 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영어로 쓰시오.

questions.question: 36. 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영어로 쓰시오.

questions.passage:
Why do I buy things just because they are on sale?
Nathan goes window shopping and sees a pair of headphones. He checks the price and finds out that they are $200. ㉠<u>He thinks that the headphones are too expensive</u>. (A) The sales person approaches him and says, "㉡<u>You can get a 20 percent discount on those headphones</u>." (B)
The situation described above is an example of the "anchoring effect." The price mentioned first affects our opinion of prices mentioned afterwards. ___(가)___ if we start with $200, then $160 will seem cheap in comparison. (C) Furthermore, as the difference of the two prices becomes bigger, the effect will be more powerful. ㉢<u>As such, the price mentioned first act as an "anchor" that fixes our thoughts about the price of an item</u>. (D)
Just like Jeff and his friends, ㉣<u>we tend to buy things without seriously considering why we are buying them</u>. As these effects have shown, many things influence our purchases. (E) ㉤<u>The next time you decide to buy something, think for a moment about why you are buying it</u>.

questions.question: 47. 밑줄 친 우리말 ⓐ와 의미가 같도록, 괄호 안의 표현만을 배열하여 문장을 완성할 때, 괄호 안의 표현 중 다섯 번 째 오는 것은?

My name is Andrea and I'm a violinist in the Recycled Orchestra. Why is it called the Recycled Orchestra? It's because our musical instruments are made of objects from a landfill. ㉠<u>That's why it's also known as the Landfill Harmonic Orchestra</u>.
Most of us in the orchestra are from Cateura, a small town in Paraguay. There is a huge landfill in our town. ㉡<u>Some people even say that Cateura itself is a giant landfill</u>. Many of us are poor. ㉢<u>There weren't many hopes and dreams in our town</u>. Everything began to change, however, when we met Favio Chávez.
Favio was an environmental educator and a musician. He wanted to teach us music, but there was a big problem. There were only a few musical instruments in the whole town. We couldn't afford to buy new ones. But Favio didn't give up. He said that we could make musical instruments with objects from the landfill. (가)<u>Nicholas라고 이름 지어진 한 재능있는 남자가 이 생각을 실행에 옮길 수 있었다</u>. He made violins from oil drums. He turned water pipes into flutes.
We had another problem. ㉣<u>No one knew how we to play musical instruments</u>. Favio taught us with great (나)patience. Step by step, we began to make some sounds on our instruments. I still remember the first piece of music that we played. It was very short and mostly out of tune. But it was the most beautiful music to us. We felt a new hope in our hearts. ㉤<u>From then on, we gathered to practice every day</u>. One day, Favio told us some great news. We were going to have a concert, a real concert!
And here we are now in front of hundreds of people. They love our music. The world sends us trash, but we send back music!

questions.explanation: ① 관계대명사절 'that we need to do'를 형용사적 용법의 'to do'로 전환한 것이 의미와 어법상 적절함.
options: ① There is a lot of work that we need to do around the farm. → There is a lot of work to do around the farm.
② Mom told me that Grandma was coming to visit us today. → Mom believed that I should visit Grandma today.
③ He is wondering if it will rain tomorrow. → He is sure that it will rain tomorrow.
④ He is sure that she is telling the truth. → He thinks that she is telling a lie.
⑤ I need somebody to teach me Chinese. → I need to teach Chinese to somebody
questions.reason_for_classification: 관계대명사절을 to부정사구로 전환하는 문장 변환 능력을 묻는 문제임.

questions.passage: I'm a location scout and my job is finding perfect places to shoot movies. ⓐ<u>Iceland는 많은 장소 섭외가들이 방문하기에 최고의 장소이다 due to its unusual beauty</u>. In Vatnajökull National Park of Iceland, the sharp cliffs, blue glacier caves, and long mountain ranges can stand in for any place in the world or the universe. That, the wonderful nature of the park, is why my personal favorite is the Vatnajökull National Park. In fact, the recent sci-fi movie we shot in the Vatnajökull National Park was produced without using computer. Iceland can help make our wildest dreams come true on the movie screen such as the sci-fi movie above.
questions.question: 9. 글의 밑줄 친 우리말 문장 ⓐ와 뜻이 같도록 영작하시오.
questions.explanation: to부정사의 의미상 주어인 'for many location scouts'를 사용하여 형용사적 용법으로 영작함.
sentences: <조건>
• To 부정사의 의미상 주어를 본문의 단어를 활용하여 작성할 것
• 동사 ‘visit'를 활용할 것
Iceland is the best place _________ _________ _________ _________ _________ _________ due to its unusual beauty.
questions.answer: for many location scouts to visit
questions.reason_for_classification: to부정사의 의미상 주어를 포함한 영작 능력을 평가하는 서술형 문제임.

questions.passage:

When I was young, I loved stars. I also liked ⓐ<u>taking</u> pictures. However, (A)<u>I never thought these things could lead to a job</u>. In fact, I didn't have a dream at all.
