questions.question: 10. 위 글이 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법에 맞지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓒ 오로라를 직접 본 것이므로 수동태 'to be seen'이 아닌 능동형 'to see'가 적절함.
questions.reason_for_classification: to부정사의 능동/수동 의미 관계를 파악하는 문제임.

questions.question: 11. 다음 두 문장을 to부정사를 사용하여 한 문장으로 바꿀 때 (5)에 들어가는 말은?
questions.explanation: 'The teacher gave me a pencil to write with.'로 결합되며, (5)에는 전치사 'with'가 들어감.
sentences: ⦁The teacher gave me a pencil.
⦁I will write with it.
→ The teacher gave    (1)       (2)       (3)
questions.reason_for_classification: 두 문장을 to부정사의 형용사적 용법으로 결합할 때 필요한 전치사를 파악하는 문제임.

questions.question: 12. 다음 <보기>에서 어법에 맞게 쓰인 문장을 있는 대로 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: (C) 'something cold to drink'는 어순과 용법이 옳음. (E) 'so that + 주어 + could' 구문은 목적을 나타내는 표현으로 옳음. (A)는 'to talk with', (B)는 'enough money to buy', (D)는 시제 일치상 'could take'가 적절함.
sentences: <보기>
(A) He has a lot of friends to talk.
(B) Sumi has enough money buy a car.
(C) Can you get me something cold to drink?
(D) He went home early so that he takes a rest.
(E) John did his best so that his team could win.
questions.reason_for_classification: to부정사의 형용사적 용법과 so that 목적 구문을 종합적으로 묻는 문제임.

questions.question: 13. 의미와 어법에 맞게 영작한 문장의 개수는?
questions.explanation: 세 번째(to keep fit), 네 번째(so that she could), 다섯 번째(to show) 문장이 어법과 의미상 적절함. 첫 번째는 'so as not to', 두 번째는 주어 불일치로 어색함.
sentences: ° 그들은 그들의 런던행 비행기를 놓치지 않기 위해 그 공항에 서둘러 갔다.
→ They hurried to the airport not so as to miss their flight to London.
° 학생들이 신선한 공기를 마실 수 있도록 그 창문들을 열어 주세요.
→ Please open the windows in order to have some fresh air.
° 나의 아버지는 건강을 유지하기 위해 그 체육관에서 30분간 운동을 하신다.
→ My father works out for 30 minutes at the gym to keep fit.
° 제인은 자신의 차를 고칠 수 있도록 자동차 저비 수업을 받고 있다.
→ Jane is taking a car maintenance class so that she could fix her own car.
° 그녀는 그 장소가 어땠는지 그녀의 친구들에게 보여주려고 휴가 때 많은 사진들을 찍었다.
→ She took lots of photos on holiday to show her friends what the place was like.
questions.reason_for_classification: 목적을 나타내는 다양한 표현(to, so that, in order to 등)의 올바른 사용을 묻는 문제임.

questions.question: 14. 다음 중 짝지어진 두 문장의 뜻이 서로 같지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: ① 'so dark that I couldn't see'는 'too dark to see'와 같으며, 'dark enough to see'는 '볼 수 있을 만큼 어둡다'는 의미이므로 반대의 뜻임.
options: ① It was so dark that I couldn't see anything. = It was dark enough to see anything.
② She felt so nervous that she kept biting her nails. = She felt nervous enough to keep biting her nails.
③She felt so hungry that she could not keep walking. = She felt too hungry to keep walking.
④The car is so small that it can pass through a narrow street. = The car is small enough to pass through a narrow street.
⑤ He danced so well that he won the first prize. = He danced well enough to win the first prize.
questions.reason_for_classification: so ~ that 구문을 too ~ to 또는 enough to로 전환할 때의 의미 일치 여부를 묻는 문제임.

questions.question: 15. 다음 문장과 같은 의미가 되도록 바꿔 쓴 것으로 어법상 옳은 것은?
questions.explanation: 'so fast that he could'는 긍정의 결과/목적이므로 'fast enough to'로 전환하는 것이 옳음.
options: ① He ran too fast to win the race.
② He ran too fast winning the race.
③ He ran fast enough to win the race.
④ He ran enough fast to win the race.
⑤ He ran fast enough winning the race.
sentences: He ran so fast that he could win the race.
questions.reason_for_classification: so ~ that 긍정 구문을 enough to로 전환하는 기초적인 문법 문제임.

questions.question: 16. 다음 우리말과 같은 의미가 되도록 빈칸에 들어갈 수 있는 말을 <보기>에서 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: 목적을 나타내는 (A) 'to pass'와 (D) 'so that he can pass'가 문법적으로 적절함. (B)는 'so as to', (C)는 'so that he can', (E)는 'in order that he can' 등이 되어야 함.
sentences: ⦁Tom은 그 시험에 합격하기 위해서 열심히 공부하고 있다.
→ Tom is studying hard ______________________.
<보기>
(A) to pass the test
(B) so to pass the test
(C) so that pass the test
(D) so that he can pass the test
(E) in order to he can pass the test
questions.reason_for_classification: 목적을 나타내는 다양한 구문의 정확한 형태를 구별하는 문제임.

questions.question: 17. 다음 문장의 어법이 틀린 것은?
questions.explanation: ② 'in order to' 뒤에는 동사원형이 와야 하며, 주어+동사 절이 오려면 'in order that'을 써야 함.
options: ① Tom went to bed early so as to get up early
② Please speak louder in order to we can hear you.
③ My father went to the airport to pick up my sister.
④ We collected old clothes so that we could donate them.
⑤ He practiced singing very hard in order that he could be a singer.
questions.reason_for_classification: in order to와 in order that의 구조적 차이를 묻는 문제임.

questions.question: 18. 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 표현의 문맥상 쓰임이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: ①, ②, ③, ⑤는 모두 '~하기 위해서'라는 목적의 부사적 의미를 나타내는 반면, ④는 Ann이 돈을 절약했다는 선행사를 수식하는 관계대명사절로 쓰임.
options: ① to buy a new bicycle
② so as to travel with her friends
③ so that she could donate it to the poor
④ that she usually spent on food and drinks
⑤ in order that she could build her own house
questions.reason_for_classification: 목적의 부사구/절과 관계대명사절의 기능을 구별하는 문제임.

questions.question: 19. 다음 문장 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
questions.explanation: ② 'to focus'는 목적을 나타내는 to부정사의 부사적 용법으로 적절함. ①은 'so as to', ③은 'to lose', ④는 'in order that', ⑤는 'in order to prepare'가 되어야 함.
options: ① She went to bed early so to get up early.
② I often drink coffee to focus on my studies.
③ Minsu swam every morning to losing weight.
④ I saved money in order I could buy a new car.
⑤ Tom practices hard in order preparing for the contest.
questions.reason_for_classification: 목적 표현의 다양한 구문 오류를 찾고 정문을 선택하는 문제임.

questions.question: 20. <보기>의 단어들을 사용해서 문장을 영작할 때 주어진 빈칸에 들어갈 단어로 바르게 짝지어진 것을 고르면?
questions.explanation: 'What will you do to achieve your dream?'으로 영작되므로 ⓓ 자리에 'do'가 오는 것이 옳음.
sentences: <보기> what, achieve
꿈을 이루기 위해 당신은 무엇을 할 것인가요?
questions.reason_for_classification: 의문문과 목적을 나타내는 to부정사를 결합한 어순 배열 문제임.

questions.passage: My name is Yeji. I am an ocean scientist. Ocean science is a big field. It includes studies of the oceans and the creatures living in ⓐ<u>it</u>. Among other things, I have studied many kinds of fish ⓑ<u>living</u> in the seas near Korea. It is the growth ring in a fish that interests me. By looking at it, I can find out when and where the fish ⓒ<u>born</u>. All the information I get from fish is used to understand sea resources and ⓓ<u>manages</u> the oceans better. questions.question: 21. 윗글의 밑줄친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 알맞은 것의 개수는? [4.2점]
questions.explanation: ⓑ 'living'은 명사를 수식하는 현재분사로 옳고, ⓔ 'possible'은 목적격 보어 형태로 적절함. 반면 ⓐ는 'them', ⓒ는 'was born', ⓓ는 'manage'가 되어야 함.
questions.reason_for_classification: 대명사의 수 일치, 수동태, 병렬 구조 등 다양한 문법 요소의 정오를 판별하는 복합 문제임.

questions.passage:

questions.question: 22. 밑줄 친 (a)의 to부정사와 같은 용법으로 사용된 문장은?
questions.explanation: (A) 'to keep'은 '~하기 위해'라는 목적의 부사적 용법임. ⑤ 'to have time' 또한 목적을 나타내는 부사적 용법임.
options: ① I need to read more books.
② Did you decide to sell the house?
③ It’s impossible to live without air.
④ My goal is to travel around the world.
⑤ He got up early to have time for breakfast.
questions.reason_for_classification: to부정사의 용법 구별 중 목적의 부사적 용법을 찾는 문제임.

questions.passage:
㉠<u>또 다른</u> form of written laughter is LoL.. It stands for “Laugh Out Loud” People also use ROFL. quite often, ___(A)___ means "Rolling On the Floor Laughing." These expressions have become popular because they can be written quite quickly.

I can't wait to go to Disneyland. XD
questions.question: 23. 윗글의 밑줄 친 (C)to represent와 같은 용법인 것은?
questions.explanation: (C) 'used to represent'는 목적을 나타내는 부사적 용법임. ④ 'stood up to see' 또한 목적을 나타내는 부사적 용법임.
options: ① My job is to look after children.
② We have enough chairs to sit on.
③ The baby needs something to eat.
④ The people stood up to see the star better.
⑤ It is not easy for us to exercise every day.
questions.reason_for_classification: to부정사의 부사적 용법(목적)을 다른 문장에서 찾아내는 문제임.

questions.question: 24. 다음 우리말을 주어진 단어를 이용하여 영어로 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: 사람의 성품(kind)을 나타내는 형용사가 올 때 의미상 주어는 'of + 목적격'을 사용함.
sentences: 그 노인을 도와주다니, 그녀는 매우 친절하구나.
<it, elderly man, help, to, is>
questions.answer: It is very kind of her to help the elderly man.
questions.reason_for_classification: to부정사의 의미상 주어(of+목적격)를 사용한 가주어-진주어 구문 영작 문제임.

questions.question: 25. 다음 우리말을 주어진 단어를 이용하여 영어로 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: '현명한(wise)'이라는 성품 형용사와 함께 의미상 주어 'of her'를 사용함.
sentences: 그녀가 창의적은 해결책을 찾은 것은 현명했다.
<she , easy, a creative solution, to find>
questions.answer: It was wise of her to find a creative solution.
questions.reason_for_classification: to부정사의 의미상 주어(of+목적격)를 사용한 가주어-진주어 구문 영작 문제임.

questions.question: 26. 다음 우리말을 주어진 단어를 이용하여 영어로 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: '현명한(wise)'이라는 성품 형용사가 오므로 의미상 주어 'of you'를 사용하여 영작함.
sentences: 너의 실수를 인정하다니 현명하다.
<to admit, wise, your mistake, you>
questions.answer: It is wise of you to admit your mistake.
questions.reason_for_classification: to부정사의 의미상 주어(of+목적격)를 사용한 가주어-진주어 구문 영작 문제임.

questions.passage: Once upon a time there was a small village in a forest. The villagers were farmers and raised cows. Luckily, some good grassland lay in the middle of the village.Everyone ⓐ <u>was allowed to use</u> the grassland. Therefore, it was called "the commons." By tradition, each family only had one cow, so it was easy ⓑ<u>of each cow in the village</u> to find enough grass ⓒ<u>to eat</u>. The grass on the commons was green all summer long.But one day a villager broke the rule. He brought another cow and ⓓ<u>let it graze</u> on the commons. He thought that nobody would notice it. A happy feeling filled his heart when he thought of the milk and cheese ⓔ<u>that</u> the second cow would bring to his family.
questions.question: 27. 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓑ 'easy'는 성품 형용사가 아니므로 의미상 주어 전치사로 'of'가 아닌 'for'를 써야 함.
questions.reason_for_classification: 형용사의 종류에 따른 to부정사의 의미상 주어 전치사(for vs of)를 구별하는 문제임.

questions.question: 28. 밑줄 친 부분이 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: ③ 'necessary'는 사람의 성질을 나타내는 형용사가 아니므로 의미상 주어 앞에 'of' 대신 'for'를 써야 함.
options: ① It was difficult for me to please her.
② It's naive of Jack to think that he can learn a language in a few weeks.
③ It is very necessary of blood banks to test all donated blood for the virus.
④ It is generous of you to always consider the needs of those around you.
⑤ It's essential for athletes to set goals that help them focus on their development.
questions.reason_for_classification: to부정사의 의미상 주어 전치사 선택의 적절성을 판별하는 문제임.

questions.question: 29. 다음 어법상 옳은 것만을 <보기>에서 있는 대로 고른 것은?
questions.explanation: (C) 'impossible for', (D) 'foolish of'는 적절함. (A)는 'dangerous for', (B)는 'for her', (E)는 'kind of'가 되어야 함.
sentences: <보 기>
(A) It is dangerous of her to go there alone.
(B) Will it be easy for hers to pass the test?
(C) It was impossible for me to understand Spanish.
(D) It is foolish of him to make the same mistake again.
(E)It is kind for you to help the old lady to get on the bus.
questions.reason_for_classification: 의미상 주어의 전치사와 인칭대명사의 격이 올바르게 쓰였는지 확인하는 문제임.

questions.question: 30. 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영어로 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: '부주의한(careless)'은 성품 형용사이므로 'of him'을 의미상 주어로 사용함.
sentences: 버스에 그의 우산을 두고 내리다니 그는 부주의했다.
<조건>

questions.passage:
It is important for us to find ways to protect the environment. Some people have found creative ways to save the earth. One example is an underwater museum in Cancun, Mexico. Let’s meet Dr. Rosa Allison, an art professor, and listen to her explanation about the special museum.
Cancun is a city where 4.8 million tourists travel every year. One of the most popular activities to do there is looking at the area’s beautiful sea life underwater. However, tourist activities are seriously damaging parts of the sea near Cancun.
To prevent this, artists did something interesting. They thought if they attracted tourists to a different part of the sea, the dying areas could have time to get better. They made an underwater museum away from the places where sea life was dying. It’s about 14 meters below the surface and contains 500 statues.
ⓐ<u>The statues are made from materials which support sea life</u>. ⓑ<u>They provide additional places plants and animals to live on</u>. Over time, many types of sea life will grow on the statues, ⓒ<u>which will make the artwork uniquely</u>. ⓓ<u>If people realize how rich sea life is, they will understand how important it is to save the sea</u>. 
In Singapore, people are using architecture to protect the environment. Let’s hear what Rajesh Khan, an architect, says about eco-friendly buildings.
Singapore is hot throughout the year. Most buildings need air conditioning, which uses a lot of energy and contributes to climate change. That’s why architects in Singapore have begun to design eco-friendly buildings that use less air conditioning but are still cool inside. For example, many buildings in Singapore are designed to have an open structure. ⓔ<u>This structure makes possible for outside air to move throughout a building</u>. This natural air flow is how these buildings stay cool.
In addition to making open structures, architects add large gardens. This greenery provides shade and protects parts of the building from direct sunlight, which keeps the building cooler.
Eco-friendly buildings like these not only help protect the environment, but also provide people with a good quality of life. Those are the goals of this new style of architecture. Hopefully, architects will keep coming up with new eco-friendly ideas.
Every field has different ways of protecting the environment. With more innovation, humans and nature will be able to live together in harmony far into the future,

questions.passage:
Frances Perkins worked for the working classes, children, women and the poor. As a student, in American history class, she visited local factories and wrote about what she found. The factory conditions Fannie witnessed changed her forever. She became passionate about improving working conitions in factories. 
In 1904, she spent her free time at Settlement Houses in Chicago. Settlement Houses were located in poor areas of cities and attempted to help the poor with social services such as shelter, food, clothing, and job searching. Perkins often took on the most difficult tasks for the houses. For example, she visited employers who had failed to pay workers and told them to pay the wages.
After graduating Columbia, Perkins successfully made the 54-Hour Bill passed. This law prohibited males under eighteen years of age and females of any age from working more than fifty-four hours per week in factories.
In 1918, Perkins’s friend, Al Smith, was elected as a governor. During Smith’s terms as governor, she dealt with employees, employers, and insurance companies with intelligence, honesty, and fairness. As head of the commission, she continued to analyze problematic situations of workers and do factory inspection. Also, she worked to further reduce the workweek (from fifty-four to forty-eight hours), prohibit child labor, and set a minimum standard wage.
